verses.text_hr: Vratili su se u Jeruzalem i u ostale krajeve Judeje, svaki u svoj grad. Došli su sa Zorobabelom, Ješuom, Nehemijom, Zaharijom, Rešajom, Enenijem, Mordokajem, Beelsarom, Asfarasom, Reelijem, Roimom i Baanom, svojim vođama.

verses.text_en: The number of them of the nation, and their governors, sons of Phoros, two thousand an hundred seventy and two; the sons of Saphat, four hundred seventy and two:
verses.text_hr: Broj ljudi iz naroda i njihovih glavara: Peresovih sinova dvije tisuće sto sedamdeset i dva; Šafatovih sinova četiri stotine sedamdeset i dva.

verses.text_en: The sons of Ares, seven hundred fifty and six:
verses.text_hr: Aresovih sinova sedam stotina pedeset i šest.

verses.text_en: The sons of Phaath Moab, two thousand eight hundred and twelve:
verses.text_hr: Pahat-Moabovih sinova dvije tisuće osam stotina i dvanaest.

verses.text_en: The sons of Elam, a thousand two hundred fifty and four: the sons of Zathul, nine hundred forty and five: the sons of Corbe, seven hundred and five: the sons of Bani, six hundred forty and eight:
verses.text_hr: Elamovih sinova tisuću dvjesto pedeset i četiri; Zatulovih sinova devet stotina četrdeset i pet; Korbeovih sinova sedam stotina i pet; Banijevih sinova šest stotina četrdeset i osam.

verses.text_en: The sons of Bebai, six hundred twenty and three: the sons of Sadas, three thousand two hundred twenty and two:
verses.text_hr: Bebajevih sinova šest stotina dvadeset i tri; Sadasovih sinova tri tisuće dvjesto dvadeset i dva.

verses.text_en: The sons of Adonikam, six hundred sixty and seven: the sons of Bagoi, two thousand sixty and six: the sons of Adin, four hundred fifty and four:
verses.text_hr: Adonikamovih sinova šest stotina šezdeset i sedam; Bagojevih sinova dvije tisuće šezdeset i šest; Adinovih sinova četiri stotine pedeset i četiri.

verses.text_en: The sons of Aterezias, ninety and two: the sons of Ceilan and Azetas threescore and seven: the sons of Azuran, four hundred thirty and two:
verses.text_hr: Aterezijinih sinova devedeset i dva; Keilanovih i Azetinih sinova šezdeset i sedam; Azuranovih sinova četiri stotine trideset i dva.

verses.text_en: The sons of Ananias, an hundred and one: the sons of Arom, thirty two: and the sons of Bassa, three hundred twenty and three: the sons of Azephurith, an hundred and two:
verses.text_hr: Ananijinih sinova sto i jedan; Aromovih sinova trideset i dva; Basaovih sinova tri stotine dvadeset i tri; Azefuritovih sinova sto i dva.

verses.text_en: The sons of Meterus, three thousand and five: the sons of Bethlomon, an hundred twenty and three:
verses.text_hr: Meterovih sinova tri tisuće i pet; Betlehemljana sto dvadeset i tri.

verses.text_en: They of Netophah, fifty and five: they of Anathoth, an hundred fifty and eight: they of Bethsamos, forty and two:
verses.text_hr: Iz Netofe pedeset i pet; iz Anatota sto pedeset i osam; iz Bet-Šemeša četrdeset i dva.

verses.text_en: They of Kiriathiarius, twenty and five: they of Caphira and Beroth, seven hundred forty and three: they of Pira, seven hundred:
verses.text_hr: Iz Kirjat-Jearima dvadeset i pet; iz Kefire i Beerota sedam stotina četrdeset i tri; iz Pire sedam stotina.

verses.text_en: They of Chadias and Ammidoi, four hundred twenty and two: they of Cirama and Gabdes, six hundred twenty and one:
verses.text_hr: Iz Kadije i Amidoja četiri stotine dvadeset i dva; iz Kirame i Gabdesa šest stotina dvadeset i jedan.

verses.text_en: They of Macalon, an hundred twenty and two: they of Betolius, fifty and two: the sons of Nephis, an hundred fifty and six:
verses.text_hr: Iz Makalona sto dvadeset i dva; iz Betolija pedeset i dva; Nefisovih sinova sto pedeset i šest.

verses.text_en: The sons of Calamolalus and Onus, seven hundred twenty and five: the sons of Jerechus, two hundred forty and five:
verses.text_hr: Kalamolalovih i Onusovih sinova sedam stotina dvadeset i pet; Jerihoćana dvije stotine četrdeset i pet.

verses.text_en: The sons of Annas, three thousand three hundred and thirty.
verses.text_hr: Anasovih sinova tri tisuće tristo i trideset.

verses.text_en: The priests: the sons of Jeddu, the son of Jesus among the sons of Sanasib, nine hundred seventy and two: the sons of Meruth, a thousand fifty and two:
verses.text_hr: Svećenici: Jedduovi sinovi, potomci Ješue među Sanasibovim sinovima, devet stotina sedamdeset i dva; Merutovi sinovi tisuću pedeset i dva.

verses.text_en: The sons of Phassaron, a thousand forty and seven: the sons of Carme, a thousand and seventeen.
verses.text_hr: Fasaronovih sinova tisuću četrdeset i sedam; Karmeovih sinova tisuću i sedamnaest.

verses.text_en: The Levites: the sons of Jessue, and Cadmiel, and Banuas, and Sudias, seventy and four.
verses.text_hr: Leviti: sinovi Ješue, Kadmiela, Banuasa i Sudije, sedamdeset i četiri.

verses.text_en: The holy singers: the sons of Asaph, an hundred twenty and eight.
verses.text_hr: Sveti pjevači: Asafovih sinova sto dvadeset i osam.

verses.text_en: The porters: the sons of Salum, the sons of Jatal, the sons of Talmon, the sons of Dacobi, the sons of Teta, the sons of Sami, in all an hundred thirty and nine.
verses.text_hr: Vratari: sinovi Šaluma, Jatala, Talmona, Dakobija, Tete i Samija, ukupno sto trideset i devet.

verses.text_en: The servants of the temple: the sons of Esau, the sons of Asipha, the sons of Tabaoth, the sons of Ceras, the sons of Sud, the sons of Phaleas, the sons of Labana, the sons of Graba,
verses.text_hr: Hramski sluge: sinovi Esaua, Asife, Tabaota, Kerasa, Suda, Faleasa, Labane i Grabe;

verses.text_en: The sons of Acua, the sons of Uta, the sons of Cetab, the sons of Agaba, the sons of Subai, the sons of Anan, the sons of Cathua, the sons of Geddur,
verses.text_hr: sinovi Akue, Ute, Ketaba, Agabe, Subaja, Anana, Katue i Gedura;

verses.text_en: The sons of Airus, the sons of Daisan, the sons of Noeba, the sons of Chaseba, the sons of Gazera, the sons of Azia, the sons of Phinees, the sons of Azare, the sons of Bastai, the sons of Asana, the sons of Meani, the sons of Naphisi, the sons of Acub, the sons of Acipha, the sons of Assur, the sons of Pharacim, the sons of Basaloth,
verses.text_hr: sinovi Aira, Daisana, Noebe, Kasebe, Gazere, Azije, Fineesa, Azare, Bastaja, Asane, Meanija, Nafisija, Akuba, Akife, Asura, Farakima i Basalota;

verses.text_en: The sons of Meeda, the sons of Coutha, the sons of Charea, the sons of Charcus, the sons of Aserer, the sons of Thomoi, the sons of Nasith, the sons of Atipha.
verses.text_hr: sinovi Meede, Kute, Karee, Karkusa, Aserera, Tomoja, Nasita i Atife.

verses.text_en: The sons of the servants of Solomon: the sons of Azaphion, the sons of Pharira, the sons of Jeeli, the sons of Lozon, the sons of Israel, the sons of Sapheth,
verses.text_hr: Potomci Salomonovih slugu: sinovi Azafiona, Farire, Jeelija, Lozona, Izraela i Safeta;

verses.text_en: The sons of Hagia, the sons of Pharacareth, the sons of Sabi, the sons of Sarothie, the sons of Masias, the sons of Gar, the sons of Addus, the sons of Suba, the sons of Apherra, the sons of Barodis, the sons of Sabat, the sons of Allom.
verses.text_hr: sinovi Hagije, Farakareta, Sabija, Sarotija, Masije, Gara, Adusa, Sube, Afere, Barodisa, Sabata i Aloma.

verses.text_en: All the ministers of the temple, and the sons of the servants of Solomon, were three hundred seventy and two.
verses.text_hr: Svih hramskih službenika i potomaka Salomonovih slugu bilo je tri stotine sedamdeset i dva.

verses.text_en: These came up from Thermeleth and Thelersas, Charaathalar leading them, and Aalar;
verses.text_hr: Ovi su došli iz Tel-Melaha i Tel-Harše, pod vodstvom Karaatalara i Aalara:

verses.text_en: Neither could they shew their families, nor their stock, how they were of Israel: the sons of Ladan, the son of Ban, the sons of Necodan, six hundred fifty and two.
verses.text_hr: nisu mogli dokazati svoje obitelji ni podrijetlo, to jest pripadaju li Izraelu: Ladanovi, Banovi i Nekodanovi sinovi, njih šest stotina pedeset i dva.

verses.text_en: And of the priests that usurped the office of the priesthood, and were not found: the sons of Obdia, the sons of Accoz, the sons of Addus, who married Augia one of the daughters of Barzelus, and was named after his name.
verses.text_hr: Od svećenika koji su prisvojili svećeničku službu, ali nisu nađeni u popisu, bili su: Obdijini, Hakosovi i Adusovi sinovi. Adus se oženio Augijom, jednom od kćeri Barzelaja, pa je prozvan njegovim imenom.

verses.text_en: And when the description of the kindred of these men was sought in the register, and was not found, they were removed from executing the office of the priesthood:
verses.text_hr: Kad su podatke o rodu tih ljudi potražili u rodoslovniku, nisu ih pronašli, pa su bili isključeni iz obavljanja svećeničke službe.

verses.text_en: For unto them said Nehemias and Atharias, that they should not be partakers of the holy things, till there arose up an high priest clothed with doctrine and truth.
verses.text_hr: Nehemija i Atarija rekli su im da ne smiju blagovati od svetinja dok ne ustane veliki svećenik odjeven poukom i istinom.

verses.text_en: So of Israel, from them of twelve years old and upward, they were all in number forty thousand, beside menservants and womenservants two thousand three hundred and sixty.
verses.text_hr: Svih Izraelaca u dobi od dvanaest godina naviše bilo je četrdeset tisuća, ne računajući dvije tisuće tristo i šezdeset slugu i sluškinja.

verses.text_en: Their menservants and handmaids were seven thousand three hundred forty and seven: the singing men and singing women, two hundred forty and five:
verses.text_hr: Njihovih slugu i sluškinja bilo je sedam tisuća tristo četrdeset i sedam, a pjevača i pjevačica dvije stotine četrdeset i pet.

verses.text_en: Four hundred thirty and five camels, seven thousand thirty and six horses, two hundred forty and five mules, five thousand five hundred twenty and five beasts used to the yoke.
verses.text_hr: Imali su četiri stotine trideset i pet deva, sedam tisuća trideset i šest konja, dvije stotine četrdeset i pet mazgi i pet tisuća pet stotina dvadeset i pet teglećih životinja.

verses.text_en: And certain of the chief of their families, when they came to the temple of God that is in Jerusalem, vowed to set up the house again in his own place according to their ability,
verses.text_hr: Kad su neki od obiteljskih glavara stigli do Hrama Božjega u Jeruzalemu, zavjetovali su se da će prema svojim mogućnostima ponovno podići Dom na njegovu mjestu.

verses.text_en: And to give into the holy treasury of the works a thousand pounds of gold, five thousand of silver, and an hundred priestly vestments.
verses.text_hr: U svetu riznicu za radove dali su tisuću mina zlata, pet tisuća mina srebra i sto svećeničkih haljina.

verses.text_en: And so dwelt the priests and the Levites and the people in Jerusalem, and in the country, the singers also and the porters; and all Israel in their villages.
verses.text_hr: Tako su se svećenici, leviti i dio naroda nastanili u Jeruzalemu i okolici, a pjevači i vratari te sav Izrael u svojim selima.

verses.text_en: But when the seventh month was at hand, and when the children of Israel were every man in his own place, they came all together with one consent into the open place of the first gate which is toward the east.
verses.text_hr: Kad se približio sedmi mjesec i svaki je Izraelac bio u svojem mjestu, svi su jednodušno došli na otvoreni prostor kod prvih vrata okrenutih prema istoku.

verses.text_en: Then stood up Jesus the son of Josedec, and his brethren the priests and Zorobabel the son of Salathiel, and his brethren, and made ready the altar of the God of Israel,
verses.text_hr: Tada ustadoše Ješua, sin Josadakov, njegova braća svećenici, Zorobabel, sin Šealtielov, i njegova braća te pripraviše žrtvenik Boga Izraelova,

verses.text_en: To offer burnt sacrifices upon it, according as it is expressly commanded in the book of Moses the man of God.
verses.text_hr: da na njemu prinose žrtve paljenice, kako je izričito zapovjeđeno u knjizi Mojsija, čovjeka Božjega.

verses.text_en: And there were gathered unto them out of the other nations of the land, and they erected the altar upon his own place, because all the nations of the land were at enmity with them, and oppressed them; and they offered sacrifices according to the time, and burnt offerings to the Lord both morning and evening.
verses.text_hr: Pridružili su im se ljudi iz drugih naroda zemlje. Podigli su žrtvenik na njegovu prijašnjem mjestu jer su svi narodi zemlje bili neprijateljski raspoloženi prema njima i tlačili ih. Prinosili su žrtve u propisano vrijeme i paljenice Gospodinu jutrom i večerom.

verses.text_en: Also they held the feast of tabernacles, as it is commanded in the law, and offered sacrifices daily, as was meet:
verses.text_hr: Svetkovali su i Blagdan sjenica, kako je zapovjeđeno u Zakonu, te svakoga dana prinosili propisane žrtve.

verses.text_en: And after that, the continual oblations, and the sacrifice of the sabbaths, and of the new moons, and of all holy feasts.
verses.text_hr: Nakon toga prinosili su trajne prinose, žrtve subotama, za mlađaka i za sve svete blagdane.

verses.text_en: And all they that had made any vow to God began to offer sacrifices to God from the first day of the seventh month, although the temple of the Lord was not yet built.
verses.text_hr: Svi koji su se zavjetovali Bogu počeli su prinositi žrtve Bogu od prvoga dana sedmoga mjeseca, premda Hram Gospodnji još nije bio izgrađen.

verses.text_en: And they gave unto the masons and carpenters money, meat, and drink, with cheerfulness.
verses.text_hr: Zidarima i tesarima radosno su davali novac, hranu i piće.

verses.text_en: Unto them of Zidon also and Tyre they gave carrs, that they should bring cedar trees from Libanus, which should be brought by floats to the haven of Joppa, according as it was commanded them by Cyrus king of the Persians.
verses.text_hr: Sidoncima i Tircima dali su kola da iz Libanona dovezu cedrovinu, koju su splavima trebali dopremiti u luku Jafu, kako im je zapovjedio perzijski kralj Kir.

verses.text_en: And in the second year and second month after his coming to the temple of God at Jerusalem began Zorobabel the son of Salathiel, and Jesus the son of Josedec, and their brethren, and the priests, and the Levites, and all they that were come unto Jerusalem out of the captivity:
verses.text_hr: Druge godine i drugoga mjeseca nakon dolaska do Hrama Božjega u Jeruzalemu započeli su rad Zorobabel, sin Šealtielov, Ješua, sin Josadakov, njihova braća, svećenici, leviti i svi koji su se iz sužanjstva vratili u Jeruzalem.

verses.text_en: And they laid the foundation of the house of God in the first day of the second month, in the second year after they were come to Jewry and Jerusalem.
verses.text_hr: Prvoga dana drugoga mjeseca, druge godine nakon dolaska u Judeju i Jeruzalem, položili su temelje Doma Božjega.

verses.text_en: And they appointed the Levites from twenty years old over the works of the Lord. Then stood up Jesus, and his sons and brethren, and Cadmiel his brother, and the sons of Madiabun, with the sons of Joda the son of Eliadun, with their sons and brethren, all Levites, with one accord setters forward of the business, labouring to advance the works in the house of God. So the workmen built the temple of the Lord.
verses.text_hr: Levite od dvadeset godina naviše postavili su da nadgledaju djelo Gospodnje. Ješua, njegovi sinovi i braća, njegov brat Kadmiel, sinovi Madiabunovi i sinovi Jode, sina Eliadunova, sa svojim sinovima i braćom — svi leviti — jednodušno su vodili posao i unapređivali radove u Domu Božjem. Tako su graditelji podizali Hram Gospodnji.

verses.text_en: And the priests stood arrayed in their vestments with musical instruments and trumpets; and the Levites the sons of Asaph had cymbals,
verses.text_hr: Svećenici su stajali odjeveni u svoje haljine, s glazbalima i trubama, a leviti, Asafovi sinovi, držali su cimbale.

verses.text_en: Singing songs of thanksgiving, and praising the Lord, according as David the king of Israel had ordained.
verses.text_hr: Pjevali su zahvalnice i hvalili Gospodina, kako je odredio izraelski kralj David.

verses.text_en: And they sung with loud voices songs to the praise of the Lord, because his mercy and glory is for ever in all Israel.
verses.text_hr: Snažnim su glasovima pjevali pjesme hvale Gospodinu, jer njegova milost i slava zauvijek ostaju nad svim Izraelom.

verses.text_en: And all the people sounded trumpets, and shouted with a loud voice, singing songs of thanksgiving unto the Lord for the rearing up of the house of the Lord.
verses.text_hr: Sav je narod trubio u trube i glasno klicao, pjevajući zahvalnice Gospodinu zato što je Dom Gospodnji ponovno podignut.

verses.text_en: Also of the priests and Levites, and of the chief of their families, the ancients who had seen the former house came to the building of this with weeping and great crying.
verses.text_hr: No starci među svećenicima, levitima i obiteljskim glavarima, koji su vidjeli prijašnji Dom, došli su na gradnju ovoga Doma plačući i glasno naričući.

verses.text_en: But many with trumpets and joy shouted with loud voice,
verses.text_hr: Mnogi su pak glasno klicali uz trube i radost,

verses.text_en: Insomuch that the trumpets might not be heard for the weeping of the people: yet the multitude sounded marvellously, so that it was heard afar off.
verses.text_hr: tako da se zvuk truba nije mogao razaznati od plača naroda. Ipak je mnoštvo stvaralo tako silan zvuk da se čuo izdaleka.

verses.text_en: Wherefore when the enemies of the tribe of Judah and Benjamin heard it, they came to know what that noise of trumpets should mean.
verses.text_hr: Kad su to čuli neprijatelji Judina i Benjaminova plemena, došli su saznati što znači taj zvuk truba.

verses.text_en: And they perceived that they that were of the captivity did build the temple unto the Lord God of Israel.
verses.text_hr: Shvatili su da povratnici iz sužanjstva grade Hram Gospodinu, Bogu Izraelovu.

verses.text_en: So they went to Zorobabel and Jesus, and to the chief of the families, and said unto them, We will build together with you.
verses.text_hr: Stoga su otišli Zorobabelu, Ješui i obiteljskim glavarima te im rekli: „Gradit ćemo zajedno s vama.

verses.text_en: For we likewise, as ye, do obey your Lord, and do sacrifice unto him from the days of Azbazareth the king of the Assyrians, who brought us hither.
verses.text_hr: Jer i mi se poput vas pokoravamo vašemu Gospodinu i prinosimo mu žrtve još od vremena asirskoga kralja Azbazareta, koji nas je doveo ovamo.“

verses.text_en: Then Zorobabel and Jesus and the chief of the families of Israel said unto them, It is not for us and you to build together an house unto the Lord our God.
verses.text_hr: Ali Zorobabel, Ješua i glavari izraelskih obitelji odgovoriše im: „Ne pripada vama da zajedno s nama gradite Dom Gospodinu, Bogu našemu.

verses.text_en: We ourselves alone will build unto the Lord of Israel, according as Cyrus the king of the Persians hath commanded us.
verses.text_hr: Mi ćemo ga sami sagraditi Gospodinu Izraelovu, kako nam je zapovjedio perzijski kralj Kir.“

verses.text_en: But the heathen of the land lying heavy upon the inhabitants of Judea, and holding them strait, hindered their building;
verses.text_hr: No narodi zemlje teško su pritiskali stanovnike Judeje, držali ih u tjeskobi i ometali njihovu gradnju.

verses.text_en: And by their secret plots, and popular persuasions and commotions, they hindered the finishing of the building all the time that king Cyrus lived: so they were hindered from building for the space of two years, until the reign of Darius.
verses.text_hr: Skrivenim spletkama, nagovaranjem naroda i izazivanjem nemira sprečavali su dovršetak gradnje sve dok je kralj Kir bio živ. Tako je gradnja bila zaustavljena dvije godine, sve do Darijeve vladavine.

verses.text_en: Now in the second year of the reign of Darius Aggeus and Zacharias the son of Addo, the prophets, prophesied unto the Jews in Jewry and Jerusalem in the name of the Lord God of Israel, which was upon them.
verses.text_hr: Druge godine Darijeva kraljevanja proroci Hagaj i Zaharija, sin Idov, prorokovali su Židovima u Judeji i Jeruzalemu u ime Gospodina, Boga Izraelova, koji je bio nad njima.

verses.text_en: Then stood up Zorobabel the son of Salatiel, and Jesus the son of Josedec, and began to build the house of the Lord at Jerusalem, the prophets of the Lord being with them, and helping them.
verses.text_hr: Tada ustadoše Zorobabel, sin Šealtielov, i Ješua, sin Josadakov, te počeše graditi Dom Gospodnji u Jeruzalemu. Proroci Gospodnji bili su s njima i pomagali im.

verses.text_en: At the same time came unto them Sisinnes the governor of Syria and Phenice, with Sathrabuzanes and his companions, and said unto them,
verses.text_hr: U isto su vrijeme k njima došli Sisines, upravitelj Sirije i Fenicije, Satrabuzan i njihovi drugovi te ih upitali:

verses.text_en: By whose appointment do ye build this house and this roof, and perform all the other things? and who are the workmen that perform these things?
verses.text_hr: „Po čijoj odredbi gradite ovaj Dom i podižete ovaj krov te obavljate sve ostale radove? Tko su graditelji koji to rade?“

verses.text_en: Nevertheless the elders of the Jews obtained favour, because the Lord had visited the captivity;
verses.text_hr: Ipak su židovski starješine uživali naklonost jer je Gospodin pohodio povratnike iz sužanjstva.

verses.text_en: And they were not hindered from building, until such time as signification was given unto Darius concerning them, and an answer received.
verses.text_hr: Gradnja im nije bila obustavljena dok Darije nije bio obaviješten o njima i dok nije stigao odgovor.

verses.text_en: The copy of the letters which Sisinnes, governor of Syria and Phenice, and Sathrabuzanes, with their companions, rulers in Syria and Phenice, wrote and sent unto Darius; To king Darius, greeting:
verses.text_hr: Ovo je prijepis pisma koje su Sisines, upravitelj Sirije i Fenicije, Satrabuzan i njihovi drugovi, poglavari u Siriji i Feniciji, napisali i poslali Dariju: „Kralju Dariju, pozdrav!

verses.text_en: Let all things be known unto our lord the king, that being come into the country of Judea, and entered into the city of Jerusalem we found in the city of Jerusalem the ancients of the Jews that were of the captivity
verses.text_hr: Neka naš gospodar kralj bude o svemu obaviješten: došli smo u Judeju i ušli u grad Jeruzalem. Ondje smo zatekli židovske starješine, povratnike iz sužanjstva,

verses.text_en: Building an house unto the Lord, great and new, of hewn and costly stones, and the timber already laid upon the walls.
verses.text_hr: kako Gospodinu grade velik i nov Dom od klesanoga dragocjenog kamena, a grede su već položene na zidove.

verses.text_en: And those works are done with great speed, and the work goeth on prosperously in their hands, and with all glory and diligence is it made.
verses.text_hr: Ti se radovi obavljaju velikom brzinom; djelo u njihovim rukama dobro napreduje i izvršava se sa svom krasotom i marljivošću.

verses.text_en: Then asked we these elders, saying, By whose commandment build ye this house, and lay the foundations of these works?
verses.text_hr: Tada smo upitali starješine: ‘Po čijoj zapovijedi gradite ovaj Dom i polažete temelje ovim radovima?’

verses.text_en: Therefore to the intent that we might give knowledge unto thee by writing, we demanded of them who were the chief doers, and we required of them the names in writing of their principal men.
verses.text_hr: Da bismo te mogli pismeno obavijestiti, pitali smo ih tko predvodi radove i zatražili da nam napišu imena svojih glavara.

verses.text_en: So they gave us this answer, We are the servants of the Lord which made heaven and earth.
verses.text_hr: Odgovorili su nam ovako: ‘Mi smo sluge Gospodina koji je stvorio nebo i zemlju.

verses.text_en: And as for this house, it was builded many years ago by a king of Israel great and strong, and was finished.
verses.text_hr: Ovaj je Dom prije mnogo godina sagradio velik i moćan izraelski kralj te ga dovršio.

verses.text_en: But when our fathers provoked God unto wrath, and sinned against the Lord of Israel which is in heaven, he gave them over into the power of Nabuchodonosor king of Babylon, of the Chaldees;
verses.text_hr: Ali kad su naši oci izazvali Božju srdžbu i sagriješili protiv Gospodina Izraelova koji je na nebu, predao ih je u ruke kaldejskoga kralja Nabukodonozora Babilonskoga.

verses.text_en: Who pulled down the house, and burned it, and carried away the people captives unto Babylon.
verses.text_hr: On je Dom porušio i spalio, a narod kao sužnje odveo u Babilon.

verses.text_en: But in the first year that king Cyrus reigned over the country of Babylon Cyrus the king wrote to build up this house.
verses.text_hr: No prve godine vladavine kralja Kira nad Babilonijom kralj Kir napisao je zapovijed da se ovaj Dom ponovno izgradi.

verses.text_en: And the holy vessels of gold and of silver, that Nabuchodonosor had carried away out of the house at Jerusalem, and had set them in his own temple those Cyrus the king brought forth again out of the temple at Babylon, and they were delivered to Zorobabel and to Sanabassarus the ruler,
verses.text_hr: Svete zlatne i srebrne posude koje je Nabukodonozor odnio iz jeruzalemskoga Doma i smjestio u svoj hram kralj Kir ponovno je iznio iz babilonskoga hrama i predao Zorobabelu i upravitelju Šešbasaru,

verses.text_en: With commandment that he should carry away the same vessels, and put them in the temple at Jerusalem; and that the temple of the Lord should be built in his place.
verses.text_hr: zapovjedivši da te posude odnesu i postave u Hramu u Jeruzalemu te da se Hram Gospodnji sagradi na svojem mjestu.

verses.text_en: Then the same Sanabassarus, being come hither, laid the foundations of the house of the Lord at Jerusalem; and from that time to this being still a building, it is not yet fully ended.
verses.text_hr: Kad je Šešbasar došao ovamo, položio je temelje Doma Gospodnjega u Jeruzalemu. Otada se gradi sve do danas, ali još nije posve dovršen.’

verses.text_en: Now therefore, if it seem good unto the king, let search be made among the records of king Cyrus:
verses.text_hr: Stoga, ako je kralju po volji, neka se pretraže spisi kralja Kira.

verses.text_en: And if it be found that the building of the house of the Lord at Jerusalem hath been done with the consent of king Cyrus, and if our lord the king be so minded, let him signify unto us thereof.
verses.text_hr: Ako se utvrdi da je gradnju Doma Gospodnjega u Jeruzalemu odobrio kralj Kir i ako je to po volji našemu gospodaru kralju, neka nam javi svoju odluku.“

verses.text_en: Then commanded king Darius to seek among the records at Babylon: and so at Ecbatane the palace, which is in the country of Media, there was found a roll wherein these things were recorded.
verses.text_hr: Kralj Darije tada je zapovjedio da se pretraže spisi u Babilonu. U tvrđavi Ekbatani, u medijskoj zemlji, pronađen je svitak na kojem je bilo zapisano:

verses.text_en: In the first year of the reign of Cyrus king Cyrus commanded that the house of the Lord at Jerusalem should be built again, where they do sacrifice with continual fire:
verses.text_hr: „Prve godine vladavine kralja Kira kralj Kir zapovjedio je da se ponovno izgradi Dom Gospodnji u Jeruzalemu, gdje se prinose žrtve uz trajnu vatru.

verses.text_en: Whose height shall be sixty cubits and the breadth sixty cubits, with three rows of hewn stones, and one row of new wood of that country; and the expences thereof to be given out of the house of king Cyrus:
verses.text_hr: Neka mu visina bude šezdeset lakata i širina šezdeset lakata, s tri reda klesanoga kamena i jednim redom novoga domaćeg drveta; troškovi neka se podmire iz kuće kralja Kira.

verses.text_en: And that the holy vessels of the house of the Lord, both of gold and silver, that Nabuchodonosor took out of the house at Jerusalem, and brought to Babylon, should be restored to the house at Jerusalem, and be set in the place where they were before.
verses.text_hr: Neka se i svete zlatne i srebrne posude Doma Gospodnjega, koje je Nabukodonozor odnio iz jeruzalemskoga Doma i donio u Babilon, vrate u Dom u Jeruzalemu i postave ondje gdje su bile prije.

verses.text_en: And also he commanded that Sisinnes the governor of Syria and Phenice, and Sathrabuzanes, and their companions, and those which were appointed rulers in Syria and Phenice, should be careful not to meddle with the place, but suffer Zorobabel, the servant of the Lord, and governor of Judea, and the elders of the Jews, to build the house of the Lord in that place.
verses.text_hr: Zapovjedio je i da Sisines, upravitelj Sirije i Fenicije, Satrabuzan i njihovi drugovi te svi koji su postavljeni za poglavare u Siriji i Feniciji ne zadiru u to mjesto, nego dopuste Zorobabelu, sluzi Gospodnjem i upravitelju Judeje, te židovskim starješinama da ondje grade Dom Gospodnji.

verses.text_en: I have commanded also to have it built up whole again; and that they look diligently to help those that be of the captivity of the Jews, till the house of the Lord be finished:
verses.text_hr: I ja sam zapovjedio da se Dom ponovno sagradi u cijelosti. Neka pomno pomažu povratnicima iz židovskoga sužanjstva dok Dom Gospodnji ne bude dovršen.

verses.text_en: And out of the tribute of Celosyria and Phenice a portion carefully to be given these men for the sacrifices of the Lord, that is, to Zorobabel the governor, for bullocks, and rams, and lambs;
verses.text_hr: Od danka Koelesirije i Fenicije neka se tim ljudima, to jest upravitelju Zorobabelu, redovito daje dio za žrtve Gospodnje: za junce, ovnove i janjce.

verses.text_en: And also corn, salt, wine, and oil, and that continually every year without further question, according as the priests that be in Jerusalem shall signify to be daily spent:
verses.text_hr: Neka se i pšenica, sol, vino i ulje daju bez prekida iz godine u godinu i bez daljnjega propitivanja, prema količinama za dnevnu uporabu koje odrede svećenici u Jeruzalemu.

verses.text_en: That offerings may be made to the most high God for the king and for his children, and that they may pray for their lives.
verses.text_hr: Tako će se moći prinositi žrtve Svevišnjemu Bogu za kralja i njegovu djecu te moliti za njihov život.

verses.text_en: And he commanded that whosoever should transgress, yea, or make light of any thing afore spoken or written, out of his own house should a tree be taken, and he thereon be hanged, and all his goods seized for the king.
verses.text_hr: Zapovjedio je da se svakomu tko prestupi ili prezre bilo što od prethodno izrečenoga ili napisanoga iz njegove kuće iščupa greda, da ga na njoj objese, a sva njegova dobra zaplijene za kralja.

verses.text_en: The Lord therefore, whose name is there called upon, utterly destroy every king and nation, that stretcheth out his hand to hinder or endamage that house of the Lord in Jerusalem.
verses.text_hr: Neka Gospodin, čije se ime ondje zaziva, potpuno uništi svakoga kralja i narod koji pruži ruku da omete ili ošteti taj Dom Gospodnji u Jeruzalemu.

verses.text_en: I Darius the king have ordained that according unto these things it be done with diligence.
verses.text_hr: Ja, kralj Darije, odredio sam da se sve to izvrši pomno i bez odlaganja.“

verses.text_en: Then Sisinnes the governor of Celosyria and Phenice, and Sathrabuzanes, with their companions following the commandments of king Darius,
verses.text_hr: Tada su Sisines, upravitelj Koelesirije i Fenicije, Satrabuzan i njihovi drugovi, izvršavajući zapovijedi kralja Darija,

verses.text_en: Did very carefully oversee the holy works, assisting the ancients of the Jews and governors of the temple.
verses.text_hr: vrlo pomno nadgledali svete radove i pomagali židovskim starješinama i hramskim upraviteljima.

verses.text_en: And so the holy works prospered, when Aggeus and Zacharias the prophets prophesied.
verses.text_hr: Tako su sveti radovi dobro napredovali dok su proroci Hagaj i Zaharija prorokovali.

verses.text_en: And they finished these things by the commandment of the Lord God of Israel, and with the consent of Cyrus, Darius, and Artexerxes, kings of Persia.
verses.text_hr: Dovršili su ih po zapovijedi Gospodina, Boga Izraelova, i uz odobrenje perzijskih kraljeva Kira, Darija i Artakserksa.

verses.text_en: And thus was the holy house finished in the three and twentieth day of the month Adar, in the sixth year of Darius king of the Persians
verses.text_hr: Sveti je Dom dovršen dvadeset i trećega dana mjeseca adara, šeste godine kraljevanja perzijskoga kralja Darija.

verses.text_en: And the children of Israel, the priests, and the Levites, and others that were of the captivity, that were added unto them, did according to the things written in the book of Moses.
verses.text_hr: Izraelovi sinovi, svećenici, leviti i drugi povratnici iz sužanjstva koji su im se pridružili postupili su prema onome što je zapisano u Mojsijevoj knjizi.

verses.text_en: And to the dedication of the temple of the Lord they offered an hundred bullocks two hundred rams, four hundred lambs;
verses.text_hr: Za posvećenje Hrama Gospodnjega prinijeli su sto junaca, dvije stotine ovnova i četiri stotine janjaca,

verses.text_en: And twelve goats for the sin of all Israel, according to the number of the chief of the tribes of Israel.
verses.text_hr: te dvanaest jaraca za grijeh svega Izraela, prema broju poglavara izraelskih plemena.

verses.text_en: The priests also and the Levites stood arrayed in their vestments, according to their kindreds, in the service of the Lord God of Israel, according to the book of Moses: and the porters at every gate.
verses.text_hr: Svećenici i leviti stajali su odjeveni u svoje haljine, po rodovima, u službi Gospodina, Boga Izraelova, prema Mojsijevoj knjizi; vratari su bili na svim vratima.

verses.text_en: And the children of Israel that were of the captivity held the passover the fourteenth day of the first month, after that the priests and the Levites were sanctified.
verses.text_hr: Izraelovi sinovi koji su se vratili iz sužanjstva svetkovali su Pashu četrnaestoga dana prvoga mjeseca, nakon što su se svećenici i leviti posvetili.

verses.text_en: They that were of the captivity were not all sanctified together: but the Levites were all sanctified together.
verses.text_hr: Povratnici iz sužanjstva nisu se svi posvetili u isto vrijeme, ali svi su se leviti zajedno posvetili.

verses.text_en: And so they offered the passover for all them of the captivity, and for their brethren the priests, and for themselves.
verses.text_hr: Zato su zaklali pashalne žrtve za sve povratnike iz sužanjstva, za svoju braću svećenike i za sebe.

verses.text_en: And the children of Israel that came out of the captivity did eat, even all they that had separated themselves from the abominations of the people of the land, and sought the Lord.
verses.text_hr: Jeli su Izraelovi sinovi koji su se vratili iz sužanjstva, i svi koji su se odvojili od gadosti naroda zemlje te tražili Gospodina.

verses.text_en: And they kept the feast of unleavened bread seven days, making merry before the Lord,
verses.text_hr: Sedam su dana svetkovali Blagdan beskvasnih kruhova, radujući se pred Gospodinom,

verses.text_en: For that he had turned the counsel of the king of Assyria toward them, to strengthen their hands in the works of the Lord God of Israel.
verses.text_hr: jer je on okrenuo srce asirskoga kralja prema njima i ojačao njihove ruke u djelu Gospodina, Boga Izraelova.

verses.text_en: And after these things, when Artexerxes the king of the Persians reigned came Esdras the son of Saraias, the son of Ezerias, the son of Helchiah, the son of Salum,
verses.text_hr: Nakon toga, za kraljevanja perzijskoga kralja Artakserksa, došao je Ezra, sin Seraje, sina Azarje, sina Helkije, sina Šaluma,

verses.text_en: The son of Sadduc, the son of Achitob, the son of Amarias, the son of Ezias, the son of Meremoth, the son of Zaraias, the son of Savias, the son of Boccas, the son of Abisum, the son of Phinees, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the chief priest.
verses.text_hr: sina Sadoka, sina Ahituba, sina Amarije, sina Ezije, sina Meremota, sina Zeraje, sina Savije, sina Bokasa, sina Abišue, sina Fineesa, sina Eleazara, sina velikoga svećenika Arona.

verses.text_en: This Esdras went up from Babylon, as a scribe, being very ready in the law of Moses, that was given by the God of Israel.
verses.text_hr: Taj je Ezra došao iz Babilona kao pisar dobro upućen u Mojsijev zakon koji je dao Bog Izraelov.

verses.text_en: And the king did him honour: for he found grace in his sight in all his requests.
verses.text_hr: Kralj mu je iskazao čast, jer je Ezra u svemu što je tražio našao milost pred njim.

verses.text_en: There went up with him also certain of the children of Israel, of the priest of the Levites, of the holy singers, porters, and ministers of the temple, unto Jerusalem,
verses.text_hr: S njim su u Jeruzalem pošli i neki od Izraelovih sinova, svećenika i levita, svetih pjevača, vratara i hramskih službenika.

verses.text_en: In the seventh year of the reign of Artexerxes, in the fifth month, this was the king’s seventh year; for they went from Babylon in the first day of the first month, and came to Jerusalem, according to the prosperous journey which the Lord gave them.
verses.text_hr: Bilo je to sedme godine Artakserksova kraljevanja, u petome mjesecu. Iz Babilona su krenuli prvoga dana prvoga mjeseca i stigli u Jeruzalem zahvaljujući sretnu putovanju koje im je Gospodin podario.

verses.text_en: For Esdras had very great skill, so that he omitted nothing of the law and commandments of the Lord, but taught all Israel the ordinances and judgments.
verses.text_hr: Ezra je bio vrlo vješt, pa nije zanemario ništa od Zakona i zapovijedi Gospodnjih, nego je sav Izrael poučavao odredbama i sudovima.

verses.text_en: Now the copy of the commission, which was written from Artexerxes the king, and came to Esdras the priest and reader of the law of the Lord, is this that followeth;
verses.text_hr: Ovo je prijepis ovlaštenja koje je kralj Artakserkso napisao i dao svećeniku Ezri, čitaču Zakona Gospodnjega:

verses.text_en: King Artexerxes unto Esdras the priest and reader of the law of the Lord sendeth greeting:
verses.text_hr: „Kralj Artakserkso šalje pozdrav svećeniku Ezri, čitaču Zakona Gospodnjega.

verses.text_en: Having determined to deal graciously, I have given order, that such of the nation of the Jews, and of the priests and Levites being within our realm, as are willing and desirous should go with thee unto Jerusalem.
verses.text_hr: Odlučio sam iskazati milost i zapovjedio da oni iz židovskoga naroda te svećenici i leviti u našemu kraljevstvu koji žele ići pođu s tobom u Jeruzalem.

verses.text_en: As many therefore as have a mind thereunto, let them depart with thee, as it hath seemed good both to me and my seven friends the counsellors;
verses.text_hr: Svatko tko to želi neka krene s tobom, jer se to učinilo dobrim meni i sedmorici mojih prijatelja savjetnika,

verses.text_en: That they may look unto the affairs of Judea and Jerusalem, agreeably to that which is in the law of the Lord;
verses.text_hr: da ispitaju prilike u Judeji i Jeruzalemu prema onome što stoji u Zakonu Gospodnjemu.

verses.text_en: And carry the gifts unto the Lord of Israel to Jerusalem, which I and my friends have vowed, and all the gold and silver that in the country of Babylon can be found, to the Lord in Jerusalem,
verses.text_hr: Neka u Jeruzalem odnesu darove Gospodinu Izraelovu koje smo zavjetovali ja i moji prijatelji te sve zlato i srebro što se može pronaći u Babiloniji za Gospodina u Jeruzalemu,

verses.text_en: With that also which is given of the people for the temple of the Lord their God at Jerusalem: and that silver and gold may be collected for bullocks, rams, and lambs, and things thereunto appertaining;
verses.text_hr: zajedno s onim što narod daruje za Hram Gospodina, svojega Boga, u Jeruzalemu. Neka se srebro i zlato prikupe za junce, ovnove, janjce i sve što je za njih potrebno,

verses.text_en: To the end that they may offer sacrifices unto the Lord upon the altar of the Lord their God, which is in Jerusalem.
verses.text_hr: da bi mogli prinijeti žrtve Gospodinu na žrtveniku Gospodina, svojega Boga, u Jeruzalemu.

verses.text_en: And whatsoever thou and thy brethren will do with the silver and gold, that do, according to the will of thy God.
verses.text_hr: Ti i tvoja braća učinite sa srebrom i zlatom što god smatrate dobrim, prema volji svojega Boga.

verses.text_en: And the holy vessels of the Lord, which are given thee for the use of the temple of thy God, which is in Jerusalem, thou shalt set before thy God in Jerusalem.
verses.text_hr: Svete posude Gospodnje koje su ti predane za službu Hrama tvojega Boga u Jeruzalemu postavit ćeš pred svojega Boga u Jeruzalemu.

verses.text_en: And whatsoever thing else thou shalt remember for the use of the temple of thy God, thou shalt give it out of the king’s treasury.
verses.text_hr: Što god još smatraš potrebnim za službu Hrama svojega Boga, podmirit ćeš iz kraljevske riznice.

verses.text_en: And I king Artexerxes have also commanded the keepers of the treasures in Syria and Phenice, that whatsoever Esdras the priest and the reader of the law of the most high God shall send for, they should give it him with speed,
verses.text_hr: Ja, kralj Artakserkso, zapovjedio sam čuvarima riznica u Siriji i Feniciji da sve što svećenik Ezra, čitač Zakona Svevišnjega Boga, zatraži odmah predaju,

verses.text_en: To the sum of an hundred talents of silver, likewise also of wheat even to an hundred cors, and an hundred pieces of wine, and other things in abundance.
verses.text_hr: do svote od sto talenata srebra, do sto kora pšenice i sto posuda vina, a ostaloga u izobilju.

verses.text_en: Let all things be performed after the law of God diligently unto the most high God, that wrath come not upon the kingdom of the king and his sons.
verses.text_hr: Neka se sve pomno izvrši po Zakonu Božjemu za Svevišnjega Boga, da srdžba ne dođe na kraljevstvo kralja i njegovih sinova.

verses.text_en: I command you also, that ye require no tax, nor any other imposition, of any of the priests, or Levites, or holy singers, or porters, or ministers of the temple, or of any that have doings in this temple, and that no man have authority to impose any thing upon them.
verses.text_hr: Zapovijedam vam i da ne tražite porez ni ikakav drugi namet ni od jednoga svećenika, levita, svetoga pjevača, vratara, hramskoga službenika niti ikoga tko radi u tome Hramu; nitko nema vlast nametnuti im bilo što.

verses.text_en: And thou, Esdras, according to the wisdom of God ordain judges and justices, that they may judge in all Syria and Phenice all those that know the law of thy God; and those that know it not thou shalt teach.
verses.text_hr: A ti, Ezra, prema mudrosti Božjoj postavi suce i pravnike da u svoj Siriji i Feniciji sude svima koji poznaju Zakon tvojega Boga; one koji ga ne poznaju ti ćeš poučiti.

verses.text_en: And whosoever shall transgress the law of thy God, and of the king, shall be punished diligently, whether it be by death, or other punishment, by penalty of money, or by imprisonment.
verses.text_hr: Tko prestupi Zakon tvojega Boga i kraljev zakon neka bude strogo kažnjen: smrću ili drugom kaznom, novčanom globom ili tamnicom.“

verses.text_en: Then said Esdras the scribe, Blessed be the only Lord God of my fathers, who hath put these things into the heart of the king, to glorify his house that is in Jerusalem:
verses.text_hr: Tada pisar Ezra reče: „Blagoslovljen neka je jedini Gospodin, Bog mojih otaca, koji je to stavio kralju u srce da proslavi njegov Dom u Jeruzalemu,

verses.text_en: And hath honoured me in the sight of the king, and his counsellors, and all his friends and nobles.
verses.text_hr: i koji mi je iskazao čast pred kraljem, njegovim savjetnicima te svim njegovim prijateljima i velikašima.

verses.text_en: Therefore was I encouraged by the help of the Lord my God, and gathered together men of Israel to go up with me.
verses.text_hr: Ohrabrila me pomoć Gospodina, Boga mojega, pa sam okupio izraelske ljude da pođu sa mnom.“

verses.text_en: And these are the chief according to their families and several dignities, that went up with me from Babylon in the reign of king Artexerxes:
verses.text_hr: Ovo su glavari po svojim obiteljima i pojedinim dostojanstvima koji su pošli sa mnom iz Babilona za kraljevanja kralja Artakserksa:

verses.text_en: Of the sons of Phinees, Gerson: of the sons of Ithamar, Gamael: of the sons of David, Lettus the son of Sechenias:
verses.text_hr: od Fineesovih sinova Geršom; od Itamarovih sinova Gamael; od Davidovih sinova Let, sin Šekanijin.

verses.text_en: Of the sons of Pharez, Zacharias; and with him were counted an hundred and fifty men:
verses.text_hr: Od Peresovih sinova Zaharija, a s njim je bilo popisano sto pedeset ljudi.

verses.text_en: Of the sons of Pahath Moab, Eliaonias, the son of Zaraias, and with him two hundred men:
verses.text_hr: Od Pahat-Moabovih sinova Elioenaj, sin Zerajin, a s njim dvije stotine ljudi.

verses.text_en: Of the sons of Zathoe, Sechenias the son of Jezelus, and with him three hundred men: of the sons of Adin, Obeth the son of Jonathan, and with him two hundred and fifty men:
verses.text_hr: Od Zatuevih sinova Šekanija, sin Jezielov, a s njim tri stotine ljudi; od Adinovih sinova Obed, sin Jonatanov, a s njim dvije stotine pedeset ljudi.

verses.text_en: Of the sons of Elam, Josias son of Gotholias, and with him seventy men:
verses.text_hr: Od Elamovih sinova Josija, sin Atalijin, a s njim sedamdeset ljudi.

verses.text_en: Of the sons of Saphatias, Zaraias son of Michael, and with him threescore and ten men:
verses.text_hr: Od Šefatjinih sinova Zeraja, sin Mihaelov, a s njim sedamdeset ljudi.

verses.text_en: Of the sons of Joab, Abadias son of Jezelus, and with him two hundred and twelve men:
verses.text_hr: Od Joabovih sinova Obadija, sin Jezielov, a s njim dvije stotine i dvanaest ljudi.

verses.text_en: Of the sons of Banid, Assalimoth son of Josaphias, and with him an hundred and threescore men:
verses.text_hr: Od Banijevih sinova Šelomit, sin Josifijin, a s njim sto šezdeset ljudi.

verses.text_en: Of the sons of Babi, Zacharias son of Bebai, and with him twenty and eight men:
verses.text_hr: Od Bebajevih sinova Zaharija, sin Bebajev, a s njim dvadeset i osam ljudi.

verses.text_en: Of the sons of Astath, Johannes son of Acatan, and with him an hundred and ten men:
verses.text_hr: Od Azgadovih sinova Johanan, sin Hakatanov, a s njim sto deset ljudi.

verses.text_en: Of the sons of Adonikam the last, and these are the names of them, Eliphalet, Jewel, and Samaias, and with them seventy men:
verses.text_hr: Od posljednjih Adonikamovih sinova — ovo su njihova imena: Elifelet, Jeuel i Šemaja — a s njima sedamdeset ljudi.

verses.text_en: Of the sons of Bago, Uthi the son of Istalcurus, and with him seventy men.
verses.text_hr: Od Bagojevih sinova Utaj, sin Istalkurov, a s njim sedamdeset ljudi.

verses.text_en: And these I gathered together to the river called Theras, where we pitched our tents three days: and then I surveyed them.
verses.text_hr: Okupio sam ih kod rijeke zvane Teras, gdje smo tri dana taborovali; tada sam ih pregledao.

verses.text_en: But when I had found there none of the priests and Levites,
verses.text_hr: Kad među njima nisam našao nijednoga svećenika ni levita,

verses.text_en: Then sent I unto Eleazar, and Iduel, and Masman,
verses.text_hr: poslao sam po Eleazara, Iduela i Masmana,

verses.text_en: And Alnathan, and Mamaias, and Joribas, and Nathan, Eunatan, Zacharias, and Mosollamon, principal men and learned.
verses.text_hr: zatim Elnatana, Mamaju, Joriba, Natana, Eunatana, Zahariju i Mešulama, ugledne i učene ljude.

verses.text_en: And I bade them that they should go unto Saddeus the captain, who was in the place of the treasury:
verses.text_hr: Naložio sam im da odu k zapovjedniku Sadeju, koji je bio u mjestu riznice,

verses.text_en: And commanded them that they should speak unto Daddeus, and to his brethren, and to the treasurers in that place, to send us such men as might execute the priests’ office in the house of the Lord.
verses.text_hr: i zapovjedio im da kažu Dadeju, njegovoj braći i tamošnjim rizničarima neka nam pošalju ljude sposobne obavljati svećeničku službu u Domu Gospodnjemu.

verses.text_en: And by the mighty hand of our Lord they brought unto us skilful men of the sons of Moli the son of Levi, the son of Israel, Asebebia, and his sons, and his brethren, who were eighteen.
verses.text_hr: Moćnom rukom našega Gospodina doveli su nam sposobne ljude od sinova Mahlija, sina Levijeva, sina Izraelova: Šerebiju, njegove sinove i braću, ukupno osamnaest ljudi.

verses.text_en: And Asebia, and Annus, and Osaias his brother, of the sons of Channuneus, and their sons, were twenty men.
verses.text_hr: Doveli su i Hašabiju, Anuna i njegova brata Izaiju, od Kanunejevih sinova; s njihovim sinovima bilo ih je dvadeset.

verses.text_en: And of the servants of the temple whom David had ordained, and the principal men for the service of the Levites to wit, the servants of the temple two hundred and twenty, the catalogue of whose names were shewed.
verses.text_hr: Od hramskih slugu, koje su David i glavari odredili za službu levitima, bilo je dvije stotine i dvadeset; sva su njihova imena bila navedena u popisu.

verses.text_en: And there I vowed a fast unto the young men before our Lord, to desire of him a prosperous journey both for us and them that were with us, for our children, and for the cattle:
verses.text_hr: Ondje sam za mladiće proglasio post pred našim Gospodinom, da od njega izmolimo sretan put za sebe, za one koji su bili s nama, za našu djecu i stoku.

verses.text_en: For I was ashamed to ask the king footmen, and horsemen, and conduct for safeguard against our adversaries.
verses.text_hr: Stidio sam se od kralja zatražiti pješake, konjanike i pratnju da nas putem štite od neprijatelja.

verses.text_en: For we had said unto the king, that the power of the Lord our God should be with them that seek him, to support them in all ways.
verses.text_hr: Jer smo rekli kralju da je sila Gospodina, Boga našega, uz one koji ga traže i da ih podupire na svim njihovim putovima.

verses.text_en: And again we besought our Lord as touching these things, and found him favourable unto us.
verses.text_hr: Zato smo ponovno za sve to molili našega Gospodina i on nam se smilovao.

verses.text_en: Then I separated twelve of the chief of the priests, Esebrias, and Assanias, and ten men of their brethren with them:
verses.text_hr: Tada sam izdvojio dvanaestoricu svećeničkih glavara: Šerebiju, Hašabiju i s njima desetoricu njihove braće.

verses.text_en: And I weighed them the gold, and the silver, and the holy vessels of the house of our Lord, which the king, and his council, and the princes, and all Israel, had given.
verses.text_hr: Odvagnuo sam im zlato, srebro i svete posude Doma našega Gospodina koje su darovali kralj, njegovo vijeće, knezovi i sav Izrael.

verses.text_en: And when I had weighed it, I delivered unto them six hundred and fifty talents of silver, and silver vessels of an hundred talents, and an hundred talents of gold,
verses.text_hr: Kad sam sve odvagnuo, predao sam im šest stotina pedeset talenata srebra, srebrnih posuda u vrijednosti sto talenata i sto talenata zlata,

verses.text_en: And twenty golden vessels, and twelve vessels of brass, even of fine brass, glittering like gold.
verses.text_hr: zatim dvadeset zlatnih posuda i dvanaest posuda od fine mjedi, sjajne poput zlata.

verses.text_en: And I said unto them, Both ye are holy unto the Lord, and the vessels are holy, and the gold and the silver is a vow unto the Lord, the Lord of our fathers.
verses.text_hr: Rekao sam im: „Vi ste sveti Gospodinu i posude su svete; zlato i srebro zavjetni su dar Gospodinu, Bogu naših otaca.

verses.text_en: Watch ye, and keep them till ye deliver them to the chief of the priests and Levites, and to the principal men of the families of Israel, in Jerusalem, into the chambers of the house of our God.
verses.text_hr: Bdijte i čuvajte ih dok ih u Jeruzalemu ne predate glavarima svećenika i levita te prvacima izraelskih obitelji, u odaje Doma našega Boga.“

verses.text_en: So the priests and the Levites, who had received the silver and the gold and the vessels, brought them unto Jerusalem, into the temple of the Lord.
verses.text_hr: Svećenici i leviti koji su primili srebro, zlato i posude odnijeli su ih u Jeruzalem, u Hram Gospodnji.

verses.text_en: And from the river Theras we departed the twelfth day of the first month, and came to Jerusalem by the mighty hand of our Lord, which was with us: and from the beginning of our journey the Lord delivered us from every enemy, and so we came to Jerusalem.
verses.text_hr: Od rijeke Terasa krenuli smo dvanaestoga dana prvoga mjeseca i stigli u Jeruzalem pod moćnom rukom našega Gospodina koja je bila nad nama. Od početka našega putovanja Gospodin nas je izbavljao od svakoga neprijatelja te smo stigli u Jeruzalem.

verses.text_en: And when we had been there three days, the gold and silver that was weighed was delivered in the house of our Lord on the fourth day unto Marmoth the priest the son of Iri.
verses.text_hr: Nakon što smo ondje proveli tri dana, četvrtoga su dana odvagnuto zlato i srebro predani u Domu našega Gospodina svećeniku Meremotu, sinu Urijinu.

verses.text_en: And with him was Eleazar the son of Phinees, and with them were Josabad the son of Jesu and Moeth the son of Sabban, Levites: all was delivered them by number and weight.
verses.text_hr: S njim je bio Eleazar, sin Fineesov, a s njima leviti Jozabad, sin Ješuin, i Moet, sin Sabanov. Sve im je predano po broju i težini.

verses.text_en: And all the weight of them was written up the same hour.
verses.text_hr: Sva je težina zapisana istoga časa.

verses.text_en: Moreover they that were come out of the captivity offered sacrifice unto the Lord God of Israel, even twelve bullocks for all Israel, fourscore and sixteen rams,
verses.text_hr: Povratnici iz sužanjstva prinijeli su žrtvu Gospodinu, Bogu Izraelovu: dvanaest junaca za sav Izrael i devedeset i šest ovnova,

verses.text_en: Threescore and twelve lambs, goats for a peace offering, twelve; all of them a sacrifice to the Lord.
verses.text_hr: sedamdeset i dva janjca te dvanaest jaraca kao žrtvu pomirnicu; sve je to bilo žrtva Gospodinu.

verses.text_en: And they delivered the king’s commandments unto the king’s stewards’ and to the governors of Celosyria and Phenice; and they honoured the people and the temple of God.
verses.text_hr: Kraljeve zapovijedi predali su kraljevskim upraviteljima i namjesnicima Koelesirije i Fenicije, a oni su iskazali čast narodu i Hramu Božjemu.

verses.text_en: Now when these things were done, the rulers came unto me, and said,
verses.text_hr: Kad je sve to bilo obavljeno, poglavari su došli k meni i rekli:

verses.text_en: The nation of Israel, the princes, the priests and Levites, have not put away from them the strange people of the land, nor the pollutions of the Gentiles to wit, of the Canaanites, Hittites, Pheresites, Jebusites, and the Moabites, Egyptians, and Edomites.
verses.text_hr: „Izraelski narod, knezovi, svećenici i leviti nisu se odvojili od tuđih naroda zemlje ni od nečistoća pogana — Kanaanaca, Hetita, Perižana, Jebusejaca, Moabaca, Egipćana i Edomaca.

verses.text_en: For both they and their sons have married with their daughters, and the holy seed is mixed with the strange people of the land; and from the beginning of this matter the rulers and the great men have been partakers of this iniquity.
verses.text_hr: I oni i njihovi sinovi uzimali su njihove kćeri za žene, pa se sveto sjeme pomiješalo s tuđim narodima zemlje. Poglavari i velikaši od početka su predvodili u toj nepravdi.“

verses.text_en: And as soon as I had heard these things, I rent my clothes, and the holy garment, and pulled off the hair from off my head and beard, and sat me down sad and very heavy.
verses.text_hr: Čim sam to čuo, razderao sam svoju odjeću i svetu haljinu, čupao kosu s glave i brade te sjeo tužan i silno potresen.

verses.text_en: So all they that were then moved at the word of the Lord God of Israel assembled unto me, whilst I mourned for the iniquity: but I sat still full of heaviness until the evening sacrifice.
verses.text_hr: Dok sam oplakivao tu nepravdu, oko mene su se okupili svi koje je potresla riječ Gospodina, Boga Izraelova. Ja sam pak sjedio shrvan sve do večernje žrtve.

verses.text_en: Then rising up from the fast with my clothes and the holy garment rent, and bowing my knees, and stretching forth my hands unto the Lord,
verses.text_hr: Tada sam ustao od posta, razderane odjeće i svete haljine, pao na koljena i ispružio ruke prema Gospodinu

verses.text_en: I said, O Lord, I am confounded and ashamed before thy face;
verses.text_hr: te rekao: „Gospodine, smućen sam i stidim se podići lice pred tobom.

verses.text_en: For our sins are multiplied above our heads, and our ignorances have reached up unto heaven.
verses.text_hr: Naši su se grijesi umnožili više od naših glava, a naši prijestupi iz neznanja doprli su do neba.

verses.text_en: For ever since the time of our fathers we have been and are in great sin, even unto this day.
verses.text_hr: Od vremena svojih otaca sve do današnjega dana bili smo i ostali u velikome grijehu.

verses.text_en: And for our sins and our fathers’ we with our brethren and our kings and our priests were given up unto the kings of the earth, to the sword, and to captivity, and for a prey with shame, unto this day.
verses.text_hr: Zbog svojih grijeha i grijeha svojih otaca mi, naša braća, naši kraljevi i naši svećenici bili smo predani kraljevima zemlje, maču, sužanjstvu i pljački, na sramotu koja traje do danas.

verses.text_en: And now in some measure hath mercy been shewed unto us from thee, O Lord, that there should be left us a root and a name in the place of thy sanctuary;
verses.text_hr: A sada si nam, Gospodine, iskazao bar nešto milosti i ostavio nam korijen i ime na mjestu svojega Svetišta.

verses.text_en: And to discover unto us a light in the house of the Lord our God, and to give us food in the time of our servitude.
verses.text_hr: Dao si da nam zasja svjetlo u Domu Gospodina, Boga našega, i dao nam hranu u vrijeme našega ropstva.

verses.text_en: Yea, when we were in bondage, we were not forsaken of our Lord; but he made us gracious before the kings of Persia, so that they gave us food;
verses.text_hr: Premda smo bili robovi, naš nas Gospodin nije napustio, nego nam je dao milost pred perzijskim kraljevima, tako da su nam dali hranu.

verses.text_en: Yea, and honoured the temple of our Lord, and raised up the desolate Sion, that they have given us a sure abiding in Jewry and Jerusalem.
verses.text_hr: Iskazali su čast Hramu našega Gospodina i podigli opustošeni Sion te nam dali sigurno prebivalište u Judeji i Jeruzalemu.

verses.text_en: And now, O Lord, what shall we say, having these things? for we have transgressed thy commandments, which thou gavest by the hand of thy servants the prophets, saying,
verses.text_hr: A sada, Gospodine, što da kažemo poslije svega toga? Prestupili smo tvoje zapovijedi koje si nam dao po svojim slugama prorocima govoreći:

verses.text_en: That the land, which ye enter into to possess as an heritage, is a land polluted with the pollutions of the strangers of the land, and they have filled it with their uncleanness.
verses.text_hr: ‘Zemlja u koju ulazite da je baštinite zemlja je onečišćena nečistoćama tuđinaca te zemlje; oni su je ispunili svojom nečistoćom.

verses.text_en: Therefore now shall ye not join your daughters unto their sons, neither shall ye take their daughters unto your sons.
verses.text_hr: Zato nemojte udavati svoje kćeri za njihove sinove niti uzimati njihove kćeri svojim sinovima.

verses.text_en: Moreover ye shall never seek to have peace with them, that ye may be strong, and eat the good things of the land, and that ye may leave the inheritance of the land unto your children for evermore.
verses.text_hr: Nikada ne tražite mir s njima, da biste bili snažni, jeli dobra zemlje i ostavili zemlju u baštinu svojoj djeci zauvijek.’

verses.text_en: And all that is befallen is done unto us for our wicked works and great sins; for thou, O Lord, didst make our sins light,
verses.text_hr: Sve što nas je snašlo došlo je zbog naših zlih djela i velikih grijeha, premda si ti, Gospodine, našu kaznu učinio lakšom od naših grijeha

verses.text_en: And didst give unto us such a root: but we have turned back again to transgress thy law, and to mingle ourselves with the uncleanness of the nations of the land.
verses.text_hr: i dao nam ovakav korijen. A mi smo se opet vratili prestupanju tvojega Zakona i miješanju s nečistoćom naroda ove zemlje.

verses.text_en: Mightest not thou be angry with us to destroy us, till thou hadst left us neither root, seed, nor name?
verses.text_hr: Ne bi li se mogao rasrditi na nas i uništiti nas tako da nam ne ostanu ni korijen, ni potomstvo, ni ime?

verses.text_en: O Lord of Israel, thou art true: for we are left a root this day.
verses.text_hr: Gospodine Izraelov, ti si istinit, jer nam je sve do danas ostao korijen.

verses.text_en: Behold, now are we before thee in our iniquities, for we cannot stand any longer by reason of these things before thee.
verses.text_hr: Evo, sada stojimo pred tobom u svojim bezakonjima; zbog svega toga ne možemo više opstati pred tobom.“

verses.text_en: And as Esdras in his prayer made his confession, weeping, and lying flat upon the ground before the temple, there gathered unto him from Jerusalem a very great multitude of men and women and children: for there was great weeping among the multitude.
verses.text_hr: Dok se Ezra tako u molitvi ispovijedao, plakao i ležao ničice pred Hramom, oko njega se iz Jeruzalema okupilo veoma veliko mnoštvo muškaraca, žena i djece; silan se plač širio mnoštvom.

verses.text_en: Then Jechonias the son of Jeelus, one of the sons of Israel, called out, and said, O Esdras, we have sinned against the Lord God, we have married strange women of the nations of the land, and now is all Israel aloft.
verses.text_hr: Tada Jekonija, sin Jeelov, jedan od Izraelovih sinova, povika: „Ezra, sagriješili smo protiv Gospodina Boga jer smo se oženili tuđinkama iz naroda ove zemlje. Ali još ima nade za sav Izrael.

verses.text_en: Let us make an oath to the Lord, that we will put away all our wives, which we have taken of the heathen, with their children,
verses.text_hr: Zakletvom se obvežimo Gospodinu da ćemo otpustiti sve žene koje smo uzeli među poganima, zajedno s njihovom djecom,

verses.text_en: Like as thou hast decreed, and as many as do obey the law of the Lord.
verses.text_hr: kako si ti odredio i kako nalažu svi koji se pokoravaju Zakonu Gospodnjemu.

verses.text_en: Arise and put in execution: for to thee doth this matter appertain, and we will be with thee: do valiantly.
verses.text_hr: Ustani i izvrši to, jer je ovo tvoja odgovornost, a mi ćemo biti uz tebe. Budi odvažan!“

verses.text_en: So Esdras arose, and took an oath of the chief of the priests and Levites of all Israel to do after these things; and so they sware.
verses.text_hr: Tada Ezra ustade i zakletvom obveza glavare svećenika i levita svega Izraela da će postupiti prema tim riječima; i oni se zakleše.

verses.text_en: Then Esdras rising from the court of the temple went to the chamber of Joanan the son of Eliasib,
verses.text_hr: Tada je Ezra ustao iz hramskoga predvorja i otišao u odaju Johanana, sina Elijašibova.

verses.text_en: And remained there, and did eat no meat nor drink water, mourning for the great iniquities of the multitude.
verses.text_hr: Ondje je ostao ne jedući hranu ni pijući vodu, jer je tugovao zbog velikoga bezakonja mnoštva.

verses.text_en: And there was a proclamation in all Jewry and Jerusalem to all them that were of the captivity, that they should be gathered together at Jerusalem:
verses.text_hr: Po svoj Judeji i Jeruzalemu upućen je proglas svim povratnicima iz sužanjstva da se okupe u Jeruzalemu.

verses.text_en: And that whosoever met not there within two or three days according as the elders that bare rule appointed, their cattle should be seized to the use of the temple, and himself cast out from them that were of the captivity.
verses.text_hr: Tko se prema odluci starješina i poglavara ne pojavi u roku od dva ili tri dana, njegova će stoka biti zaplijenjena za potrebe Hrama, a on isključen iz zajednice povratnika iz sužanjstva.

verses.text_en: And in three days were all they of the tribe of Judah and Benjamin gathered together at Jerusalem the twentieth day of the ninth month.
verses.text_hr: U roku od tri dana svi iz Judina i Benjaminova plemena okupili su se u Jeruzalemu, dvadesetoga dana devetoga mjeseca.

verses.text_en: And all the multitude sat trembling in the broad court of the temple because of the present foul weather.
verses.text_hr: Sve je mnoštvo sjedilo dršćući na širokome hramskom trgu zbog nevremena koje je vladalo.

verses.text_en: So Esdras arose up, and said unto them, Ye have transgressed the law in marrying strange wives, thereby to increase the sins of Israel.
verses.text_hr: Ezra ustade i reče im: „Prestupili ste Zakon oženivši se tuđinkama i tako umnožili grijehe Izraela.

verses.text_en: And now by confessing give glory unto the Lord God of our fathers,
verses.text_hr: Sada se ispovjedite i dajte slavu Gospodinu, Bogu svojih otaca.

verses.text_en: And do his will, and separate yourselves from the heathen of the land, and from the strange women.
verses.text_hr: Izvršite njegovu volju i odvojite se od poganskih naroda zemlje i od tuđinki.“

verses.text_en: Then cried the whole multitude, and said with a loud voice, Like as thou hast spoken, so will we do.
verses.text_hr: Tada je sve mnoštvo snažnim glasom povikalo: „Učinit ćemo kako si rekao.

verses.text_en: But forasmuch as the people are many, and it is foul weather, so that we cannot stand without, and this is not a work of a day or two, seeing our sin in these things is spread far:
verses.text_hr: Ali naroda je mnogo, vrijeme je loše i ne možemo stajati vani. To nije posao za jedan ili dva dana, jer se naš grijeh u tome veoma proširio.

verses.text_en: Therefore let the rulers of the multitude stay, and let all them of our habitations that have strange wives come at the time appointed,
verses.text_hr: Neka zato ostanu poglavari mnoštva, a svi iz naših naselja koji imaju tuđinke za žene neka dođu u određeno vrijeme.

verses.text_en: And with them the rulers and judges of every place, till we turn away the wrath of the Lord from us for this matter.
verses.text_hr: S njima neka dođu poglavari i suci svakoga mjesta, dok zbog toga ne odvratimo od sebe srdžbu Gospodnju.“

verses.text_en: Then Jonathan the son of Azael and Ezechias the son of Theocanus accordingly took this matter upon them: and Mosollam and Levis and Sabbatheus helped them.
verses.text_hr: Jonatan, sin Azaelov, i Ezekija, sin Teokanov, preuzeli su taj posao, a pomagali su im Mešulam, Levi i Šabetaj.

verses.text_en: And they that were of the captivity did according to all these things.
verses.text_hr: Povratnici iz sužanjstva postupili su prema svemu tome.

verses.text_en: And Esdras the priest chose unto him the principal men of their families, all by name: and in the first day of the tenth month they sat together to examine the matter.
verses.text_hr: Svećenik Ezra izabrao je poimence glavare njihovih obitelji; prvoga dana desetoga mjeseca sjeli su zajedno da ispitaju slučajeve.

verses.text_en: So their cause that held strange wives was brought to an end in the first day of the first month.
verses.text_hr: Do prvoga dana prvoga mjeseca završili su postupak sa svima koji su imali tuđinke za žene.

verses.text_en: And of the priests that were come together, and had strange wives, there were found:
verses.text_hr: Među okupljenim svećenicima pronađeni su ovi koji su imali tuđinke za žene:

verses.text_en: Of the sons of Jesus the son of Josedec, and his brethren; Matthelas and Eleazar, and Joribus and Joadanus.
verses.text_hr: od sinova Ješue, sina Josadakova, i njegove braće: Matela, Eleazar, Jorib i Joadan.

verses.text_en: And they gave their hands to put away their wives and to offer rams to make reconcilement for their errors.
verses.text_hr: Oni su pružili ruku u znak obećanja da će otpustiti svoje žene i prinijeti ovnove kao žrtvu pomirnicu za svoje prijestupe.

verses.text_en: And of the sons of Emmer; Ananias, and Zabdeus, and Eanes, and Sameius, and Hiereel, and Azarias.
verses.text_hr: Od Imerovih sinova: Ananija, Zabdej, Eanes, Šemaja, Jehiel i Azarja.

verses.text_en: And of the sons of Phaisur; Elionas, Massias Israel, and Nathanael, and Ocidelus and Talsas.
verses.text_hr: Od Pašhurovih sinova: Elioenaj, Masija, Izrael, Natanael, Okidel i Talsa.

verses.text_en: And of the Levites; Jozabad, and Semis, and Colius, who was called Calitas, and Patheus, and Judas, and Jonas.
verses.text_hr: Od levita: Jozabad, Šimej, Kelaja zvani Kelita, Petahija, Juda i Jona.

verses.text_en: Of the holy singers; Eleazurus, Bacchurus.
verses.text_hr: Od svetih pjevača: Eliašib i Bakur.

verses.text_en: Of the porters; Sallumus, and Tolbanes.
verses.text_hr: Od vratara: Šalum i Tolban.

verses.text_en: Of them of Israel, of the sons of Phoros; Hiermas, and Eddias, and Melchias, and Maelus, and Eleazar, and Asibias, and Baanias.
verses.text_hr: Od Izraelaca, od Peresovih sinova: Jirma, Edija, Malkija, Mael, Eleazar, Hašabija i Baanija.

verses.text_en: Of the sons of Ela; Matthanias, Zacharias, and Hierielus, and Hieremoth, and Aedias.
verses.text_hr: Od Elamovih sinova: Matanija, Zaharija, Jehiel, Jeremot i Edija.

verses.text_en: And of the sons of Zamoth; Eliadas, Elisimus, Othonias, Jarimoth, and Sabatus, and Sardeus.
verses.text_hr: Od Zatuovih sinova: Eliada, Eljašib, Otonija, Jeremot, Zabad i Zardej.

verses.text_en: Of the sons of Babai; Johannes, and Ananias and Josabad, and Amatheis.
verses.text_hr: Od Bebajevih sinova: Johanan, Ananija, Jozabad i Amataj.

verses.text_en: Of the sons of Mani; Olamus, Mamuchus, Jedeus, Jasubus, Jasael, and Hieremoth.
verses.text_hr: Od Banijevih sinova: Olam, Mamuk, Jedaj, Jašub, Šeal i Jeremot.

verses.text_en: And of the sons of Addi; Naathus, and Moosias, Lacunus, and Naidus, and Mathanias, and Sesthel, Balnuus, and Manasseas.
verses.text_hr: Od Adinovih sinova: Naat, Mozija, Lakun, Naid, Matanija, Šestel, Balnuj i Manaše.

verses.text_en: And of the sons of Annas; Elionas and Aseas, and Melchias, and Sabbeus, and Simon Chosameus.
verses.text_hr: Od Haninovih sinova: Elioenaj, Asa, Malkija, Šebaj i Šimun Košamej.

verses.text_en: And of the sons of Asom; Altaneus, and Matthias, and Baanaia, Eliphalet, and Manasses, and Semei.
verses.text_hr: Od Hašumovih sinova: Matenaj, Matatija, Baanija, Elifelet, Manaše i Šimej.

verses.text_en: And of the sons of Maani; Jeremias, Momdis, Omaerus, Juel, Mabdai, and Pelias, and Anos, Carabasion, and Enasibus, and Mamnitanaimus, Eliasis, Bannus, Eliali, Samis, Selemias, Nathanias: and of the sons of Ozora; Sesis, Esril, Azaelus, Samatus, Zambis, Josephus.
verses.text_hr: Od Banijevih sinova: Jeremija, Momdi, Omar, Juel, Mabdaj, Pelaja, Anos, Karabasion, Eljašib, Matanaj, Eliasis, Banuj, Eliali, Šamis, Šelemija i Natanija; a od Ozorinih sinova: Šišaj, Ezril, Azael, Šemat, Zambis i Josip.

verses.text_en: And of the sons of Ethma; Mazitias, Zabadaias, Edes, Juel, Banaias.
verses.text_hr: Od Etminih sinova: Mazitija, Zabadija, Edes, Juel i Baanija.

verses.text_en: All these had taken strange wives, and they put them away with their children.
verses.text_hr: Svi su oni bili uzeli tuđinke za žene, pa su ih otpustili zajedno s njihovom djecom.

verses.text_en: And the priests and Levites, and they that were of Israel, dwelt in Jerusalem, and in the country, in the first day of the seventh month: so the children of Israel were in their habitations.
verses.text_hr: Svećenici, leviti i ostali Izraelci nastanili su se u Jeruzalemu i okolici. Prvoga dana sedmoga mjeseca Izraelovi sinovi bili su u svojim naseljima.

verses.text_en: And the whole multitude came together with one accord into the broad place of the holy porch toward the east:
verses.text_hr: Sav se narod jednodušno okupio na širokome prostoru pred svetim trijemom okrenutim prema istoku.

verses.text_en: And they spake unto Esdras the priest and reader, that he would bring the law of Moses, that was given of the Lord God of Israel.
verses.text_hr: Zatražili su od svećenika i čitača Ezre da donese Mojsijev zakon koji je dao Gospodin, Bog Izraelov.

verses.text_en: So Esdras the chief priest brought the law unto the whole multitude from man to woman, and to all the priests, to hear law in the first day of the seventh month.
verses.text_hr: Veliki svećenik Ezra donio je Zakon pred sve mnoštvo — pred muškarce, žene i sve svećenike — da ga čuju prvoga dana sedmoga mjeseca.

verses.text_en: And he read in the broad court before the holy porch from morning unto midday, before both men and women; and the multitude gave heed unto the law.
verses.text_hr: Čitao ga je na širokome trgu pred svetim trijemom od jutra do podneva, pred muškarcima i ženama, a mnoštvo je pozorno slušalo Zakon.

verses.text_en: And Esdras the priest and reader of the law stood up upon a pulpit of wood, which was made for that purpose.
verses.text_hr: Svećenik Ezra, čitač Zakona, stajao je na drvenome postolju načinjenom za tu svrhu.

verses.text_en: And there stood up by him Mattathias, Sammus, Ananias, Azarias, Urias, Ezecias, Balasamus, upon the right hand:
verses.text_hr: Zdesna uz njega stajali su Matatija, Šamus, Ananija, Azarja, Urija, Ezekija i Baalsam.

verses.text_en: And upon his left hand stood Phaldaius, Misael, Melchias, Lothasubus, and Nabarias.
verses.text_hr: Slijeva su stajali Faldaj, Mišael, Malkija, Lotašub i Nabarija.

verses.text_en: Then took Esdras the book of the law before the multitude: for he sat honourably in the first place in the sight of them all.
verses.text_hr: Ezra je uzeo Knjigu Zakona pred mnoštvom, jer je sjedio na počasnome prvom mjestu pred očima sviju.

verses.text_en: And when he opened the law, they stood all straight up. So Esdras blessed the Lord God most High, the God of hosts, Almighty.
verses.text_hr: Kad je otvorio Zakon, svi su ustali. Ezra je blagoslovio Svevišnjega Gospodina Boga, Boga nad vojskama, Svemogućega.

verses.text_en: And all the people answered, Amen; and lifting up their hands they fell to the ground, and worshipped the Lord.
verses.text_hr: Sav je narod odgovorio: „Amen!“ Podigli su ruke, pali ničice na zemlju i poklonili se Gospodinu.

verses.text_en: Also Jesus, Anus, Sarabias, Adinus, Jacubus, Sabateas, Auteas, Maianeas, and Calitas, Asrias, and Joazabdus, and Ananias, Biatas, the Levites, taught the law of the Lord, making them withal to understand it.
verses.text_hr: A leviti Ješua, Anus, Šerebija, Adin, Jakub, Šabetaj, Hodeja, Maanija, Kelita, Azarja, Jozabad, Ananija i Pelaja poučavali su Zakon Gospodnji i pomagali narodu da ga razumije.

verses.text_en: Then spake Attharates unto Esdras the chief priest. and reader, and to the Levites that taught the multitude, even to all, saying,
verses.text_hr: Tada je Atarat rekao velikomu svećeniku i čitaču Ezri, levitima koji su poučavali mnoštvo i svemu narodu:

verses.text_en: This day is holy unto the Lord; (for they all wept when they heard the law:)
verses.text_hr: „Ovaj je dan svet Gospodinu.“ Jer svi su plakali dok su slušali Zakon.

verses.text_en: Go then, and eat the fat, and drink the sweet, and send part to them that have nothing;
verses.text_hr: „Pođite, jedite masna jela, pijte slatka pića i pošaljite dio onima koji nemaju ništa.

verses.text_en: For this day is holy unto the Lord: and be not sorrowful; for the Lord will bring you to honour.
verses.text_hr: Ovaj je dan svet Gospodinu. Ne žalostite se, jer će vas Gospodin dovesti do časti.“

verses.text_en: So the Levites published all things to the people, saying, This day is holy to the Lord; be not sorrowful.
verses.text_hr: Leviti su zatim svemu narodu objavili: „Ovaj je dan svet Gospodinu; ne žalostite se.“

verses.text_en: Then went they their way, every one to eat and drink, and make merry, and to give part to them that had nothing, and to make great cheer;
verses.text_hr: Svi su otišli jesti, piti i veseliti se. Dijelili su s onima koji nisu imali ništa i priredili veliko slavlje,

verses.text_en: Because they understood the words wherein they were instructed, and for the which they had been assembled.
verses.text_hr: jer su razumjeli riječi kojima su bili poučeni i zbog kojih su se okupili.
