verses.text_hr: Uzmi svoj broj, o Sione, i zatvori one svoje koji su odjeveni u bijelo, koji su ispunili zakon Gospodnji.

verses.text_en: The number of thy children, whom thou longedst for, is fulfilled: beseech the power of the Lord, that thy people, which have been called from the beginning, may be hallowed.
verses.text_hr: Ispunio se broj djece za kojom si čeznuo. Zatraži od Gospodina moć da posveti tvoj narod, koji je pozvan od početka.

verses.text_en: I Esdras saw upon the mount Sion a great people, whom I could not number, and they all praised the Lord with songs.
verses.text_hr: Ja, Ezra, vidio sam na brdu Sionu velik narod, koji nisam mogao nabrojati, i svi su slavili Gospodina pjesmama.

verses.text_en: And in the midst of them there was a young man of a high stature, taller than all the rest, and upon every one of their heads he set crowns, and was more exalted; which I marvelled at greatly.
verses.text_hr: Među njima je stajao mladić visoka stasa, viši od svih ostalih. Na glavu svakoga od njih stavljao je vijenac, a sam je bio još uzvišeniji; tomu sam se veoma čudio.

verses.text_en: So I asked the angel, and said, Sir, what are these?
verses.text_hr: Upitao sam anđela: Gospodaru, što je ovo?

verses.text_en: He answered and said unto me, These be they that have put off the mortal clothing, and put on the immortal, and have confessed the name of God: now are they crowned, and receive palms.
verses.text_hr: Odgovorio mi je: Ovo su oni koji su svukli smrtnu odjeću, obukli besmrtnu i ispovjedili Božje ime. Sada primaju vijence i palme.

verses.text_en: Then said I unto the angel, What young person is it that crowneth them, and giveth them palms in their hands?
verses.text_hr: Tada sam rekao anđelu: Koji je to mladić koji ih kruni i daje im palme u ruke?

verses.text_en: So he answered and said unto me, It is the Son of God, whom they have confessed in the world. Then began I greatly to commend them that stood so stiffly for the name of the Lord.
verses.text_hr: Odgovorio mi je: To je Sin Božji kojega su priznavali u svijetu. Tada sam počeo veoma hvaliti one koji su postojano stajali uz Gospodnje ime.

verses.text_en: Then the angel said unto me, Go thy way, and tell my people what manner of things, and how great wonders of the Lord thy God, thou hast seen.
verses.text_hr: Tada mi je anđeo rekao: Idi i reci mojemu narodu kakva si i kako velika čudesa Gospodina, svojega Boga, vidio.

verses.text_en: In the thirtieth year after the ruin of the city I was in Babylon, and lay troubled upon my bed, and my thoughts came up over my heart:
verses.text_hr: Tridesete godine nakon propasti grada bio sam u Babilonu. Ležao sam uznemiren na svojoj postelji, a misli su mi se rojile u srcu.

verses.text_en: For I saw the desolation of Sion, and the wealth of them that dwelt at Babylon.
verses.text_hr: Jer sam vidio pustoš Siona i bogatstvo onih koji su živjeli u Babilonu.

verses.text_en: And my spirit was sore moved, so that I began to speak words full of fear to the most High, and said,
verses.text_hr: I moj je duh bio jako ganut, tako da sam počeo govoriti riječi pune straha Svevišnjem, i rekao sam,

verses.text_en: O Lord, who bearest rule, thou spakest at the beginning, when thou didst plant the earth, and that thyself alone, and commandedst the people,
verses.text_hr: O Gospodine, Vladaru, ti si govorio na početku, kada si sâm zasadio zemlju i zapovjedio narodu,

verses.text_en: And gavest a body unto Adam without soul, which was the workmanship of thine hands, and didst breathe into him the breath of life, and he was made living before thee.
verses.text_hr: I dao si Adamu tijelo bez duše, koje je bilo djelo tvojih ruku, i udahnuo si mu dah života, i oživio je pred tobom.

verses.text_en: And thou leadest him into paradise, which thy right hand had planted, before ever the earth came forward.
verses.text_hr: A ti ga vodiš u raj, koji je tvoja desnica zasadila, prije nego što je zemlja iznikla.

verses.text_en: And unto him thou gavest commandment to love thy way: which he transgressed, and immediately thou appointedst death in him and in his generations, of whom came nations, tribes, people, and kindreds, out of number.
verses.text_hr: Dao si mu zapovijed da ljubi tvoj put; on ju je prekršio, pa si odmah odredio smrt njemu i njegovim naraštajima, od kojih su potekli bezbrojni narodi, plemena, puci i rodovi.

verses.text_en: And every people walked after their own will, and did wonderful things before thee, and despised thy commandments.
verses.text_hr: I svaki je narod hodio po svojoj volji i činio divna djela pred tobom, i prezirao je tvoje zapovijedi.

verses.text_en: And again in process of time thou broughtest the flood upon those that dwelt in the world, and destroyedst them.
verses.text_hr: I opet si tijekom vremena pustio potop na one koji su živjeli u svijetu i uništio ih.

verses.text_en: And it came to pass in every of them, that as death was to Adam, so was the flood to these.
verses.text_hr: Svakomu se od njih dogodilo isto: kao što je Adamu došla smrt, tako je njima došao potop.

verses.text_en: Nevertheless one of them thou leftest, namely, Noah with his household, of whom came all righteous men.
verses.text_hr: Ipak si ostavio jednoga od njih, naime Nou s domom njegovim, od kojih su potekli svi pravednici.

verses.text_en: And it happened, that when they that dwelt upon the earth began to multiply, and had gotten them many children, and were a great people, they began again to be more ungodly than the first.
verses.text_hr: Kad su se stanovnici zemlje počeli množiti, dobili su mnogo djece i postali velik narod, ali su ponovno postali bezbožniji od svojih prethodnika.

verses.text_en: Now when they lived so wickedly before thee, thou didst choose thee a man from among them, whose name was Abraham.
verses.text_hr: Sad kad su živjeli tako opako prije tebe, ti si između njih izabrao sebi čovjeka po imenu Abraham.

verses.text_en: Him thou lovedst, and unto him only thou shewedst thy will:
verses.text_hr: Njega si volio, i samo njemu si iskazao svoju volju:

verses.text_en: And madest an everlasting covenant with him, promising him that thou wouldest never forsake his seed.
verses.text_hr: I sklopio s njim vječni savez, obećavši mu da nikada nećeš napustiti njegovo potomstvo.

verses.text_en: And unto him thou gavest Isaac, and unto Isaac also thou gavest Jacob and Esau. As for Jacob, thou didst choose him to thee, and put by Esau: and so Jacob became a great multitude.
verses.text_hr: I njemu si dao Izaka, a Izaku si dao i Jakova i Ezava. Što se tiče Jakova, ti si ga izabrao sebi i postavio uz Ezava; i tako je Jakov postao veliko mnoštvo.

verses.text_en: And it came to pass, that when thou leadest his seed out of Egypt, thou broughtest them up to the mount Sinai.
verses.text_hr: I dogodi se da kad si izveo njegovo potomstvo iz Egipta, doveo si ih na brdo Sinaj.

verses.text_en: And bowing the heavens, thou didst set fast the earth, movedst the whole world, and madest the depths to tremble, and troubledst the men of that age.
verses.text_hr: I sagnuvši nebesa, ti si učvrstio zemlju, pokrenuo si cijeli svijet i učinio da zadrhtaju dubine i uznemirio si ljude onoga doba.

verses.text_en: And thy glory went through four gates, of fire, and of earthquake, and of wind, and of cold; that thou mightest give the law unto the seed of Jacob, and diligence unto the generation of Israel.
verses.text_hr: Tvoja je slava prošla kroz četvera vrata — ognja, potresa, vjetra i studeni — da predaš Zakon Jakovljevu potomstvu i revnost Izraelovu naraštaju.

verses.text_en: And yet tookest thou not away from them a wicked heart, that thy law might bring forth fruit in them.
verses.text_hr: Ipak im nisi oduzeo zlo srce kako bi tvoj Zakon u njima donosio plod.

verses.text_en: For the first Adam bearing a wicked heart transgressed, and was overcome; and so be all they that are born of him.
verses.text_hr: Prvi Adam nosio je zlo srce, sagriješio i bio svladan; isto se dogodilo svima koji su od njega rođeni.

verses.text_en: Thus infirmity was made permanent; and the law (also) in the heart of the people with the malignity of the root; so that the good departed away, and the evil abode still.
verses.text_hr: Tako je slabost postala trajna, a Zakon je ostao u srcu naroda zajedno sa zloćom korijena; dobro je iščeznulo, a zlo je ostalo.

verses.text_en: So the times passed away, and the years were brought to an end: then didst thou raise thee up a servant, called David:
verses.text_hr: Vremena su prolazila i godine došle do kraja; tada si sebi podigao slugu po imenu David.

verses.text_en: Whom thou commandedst to build a city unto thy name, and to offer incense and oblations unto thee therein.
verses.text_hr: Kome si zapovjedio da sagradi grad tvome imenu i da ti u njemu prinosi tamjan i darove.

verses.text_en: When this was done many years, then they that inhabited the city forsook thee,
verses.text_hr: Mnogo godina nakon toga stanovnici toga grada napustili su te,

verses.text_en: And in all things did even as Adam and all his generations had done: for they also had a wicked heart:
verses.text_hr: I u svemu su činili kao što su činili Adam i svi njegovi naraštaji: jer i oni su imali opako srce:

verses.text_en: And so thou gavest thy city over into the hands of thine enemies.
verses.text_hr: I tako si predao svoj grad u ruke svojih neprijatelja.

verses.text_en: Are their deeds then any better that inhabit Babylon, that they should therefore have the dominion over Sion?
verses.text_hr: Jesu li djela stanovnika Babilona išta bolja da bi zbog toga imali vlast nad Sionom?

verses.text_en: For when I came thither, and had seen impieties without number, then my soul saw many evildoers in this thirtieth year, so that my heart failed me.
verses.text_hr: Kad sam došao onamo i vidio bezbrojne opačine, moja je duša u ovoj tridesetoj godini vidjela mnoge zločince, te me srce izdalo.

verses.text_en: For I have seen how thou sufferest them sinning, and hast spared wicked doers: and hast destroyed thy people, and hast preserved thine enemies, and hast not signified it.
verses.text_hr: Vidio sam kako trpiš da griješe i štediš zlotvore; uništio si svoj narod, sačuvao svoje neprijatelje, a nisi objavio razlog.

verses.text_en: I do not remember how this way may be left: Are they then of Babylon better than they of Sion?
verses.text_hr: Ne razumijem kako se taj poredak može održati. Jesu li Babilonci bolji od Sionaca?

verses.text_en: Or is there any other people that knoweth thee beside Israel? or what generation hath so believed thy covenants as Jacob?
verses.text_hr: Ili ima li još koji narod koji te poznaje osim Izraela? Ili koji je naraštaj vjerovao savezima tvojim kao Jakov?

verses.text_en: And yet their reward appeareth not, and their labour hath no fruit: for I have gone here and there through the heathen, and I see that they flow in wealth, and think not upon thy commandments.
verses.text_hr: Pa ipak, njihova se nagrada ne vidi i njihov trud nema ploda. Prošao sam među narodima i vidim da obiluju bogatstvom, a na tvoje zapovijedi ne misle.

verses.text_en: Weigh thou therefore our wickedness now in the balance, and their’s also that dwell the world; and so shall thy name no where be found but in Israel.
verses.text_hr: Izvagni zato na vagi našu zloću i zloću onih koji prebivaju u svijetu; tada se tvoje ime neće naći nigdje osim u Izraelu.

verses.text_en: Or when was it that they which dwell upon the earth have not sinned in thy sight? or what people have so kept thy commandments?
verses.text_hr: Je li ikada bilo doba kada stanovnici zemlje nisu sagriješili pred tobom? Ili koji je narod tako čuvao tvoje zapovijedi?

verses.text_en: Thou shalt find that Israel by name hath kept thy precepts; but not the heathen.
verses.text_hr: Vidjet ćeš da je Izrael po imenu držao tvoje zapovijedi; ali ne i pogani.

verses.text_en: And the angel that was sent unto me, whose name was Uriel, gave me an answer,
verses.text_hr: I anđeo koji mi je bio poslan, čije je ime bilo Uriel, dao mi je odgovor,

verses.text_en: And said, Thy heart hath gone to far in this world, and thinkest thou to comprehend the way of the most High?
verses.text_hr: I rekao je: Tvoje je srce otišlo predaleko na ovome svijetu, a misliš li da ćeš shvatiti put Svevišnjega?

verses.text_en: Then said I, Yea, my lord. And he answered me, and said, I am sent to shew thee three ways, and to set forth three similitudes before thee:
verses.text_hr: Tada sam rekao, Da, moj gospodaru. On mi je odgovorio: Poslan sam da ti pokažem tri puta i da ti iznesem tri usporedbe:

verses.text_en: Whereof if thou canst declare me one, I will shew thee also the way that thou desirest to see, and I shall shew thee from whence the wicked heart cometh.
verses.text_hr: Ako mi možeš razjasniti jedan od tih putova, pokazat ću ti put koji želiš vidjeti i objasniti ti odakle dolazi zlo srce.

verses.text_en: And I said, Tell on, my lord. Then said he unto me, Go thy way, weigh me the weight of the fire, or measure me the blast of the wind, or call me again the day that is past.
verses.text_hr: Rekao sam: Nastavi, gospodaru. On mi je odgovorio: Izvagni mi težinu ognja, izmjeri udar vjetra ili mi vrati dan koji je prošao.

verses.text_en: Then answered I and said, What man is able to do that, that thou shouldest ask such things of me?
verses.text_hr: Tada sam odgovorio i rekao: Koji je čovjek u stanju to učiniti da tražiš takve stvari od mene?

verses.text_en: And he said unto me, If I should ask thee how great dwellings are in the midst of the sea, or how many springs are in the beginning of the deep, or how many springs are above the firmament, or which are the outgoings of paradise:
verses.text_hr: A on mi je rekao: "Ako bih te pitao koliki su stanovi usred mora, ili koliko je izvora na početku bezdana, ili koliko je izvora iznad nebeskog svoda, ili koji su izlazi raja:

verses.text_en: Peradventure thou wouldest say unto me, I never went down into the deep, nor as yet into hell, neither did I ever climb up into heaven.
verses.text_hr: Možda bi mi rekao da nikad nisam sišao u dubinu, niti u podzemlje, niti sam se ikad popeo na nebo.

verses.text_en: Nevertheless now have I asked thee but only of the fire and wind, and of the day wherethrough thou hast passed, and of things from which thou canst not be separated, and yet canst thou give me no answer of them.
verses.text_hr: Ipak, sad sam te pitao samo o vatri i vjetru, i o danu kroz koji si prošao, i o stvarima od kojih se ne možeš odvojiti, a ipak mi ne možeš odgovoriti na njih.

verses.text_en: He said moreover unto me, Thine own things, and such as are grown up with thee, canst thou not know;
verses.text_hr: Nadalje mi je rekao: Svoje stvari i ono što je s tobom odraslo ne možeš znati;

verses.text_en: How should thy vessel then be able to comprehend the way of the Highest, and, the world being now outwardly corrupted to understand the corruption that is evident in my sight?
verses.text_hr: Kako bi onda tvoja posuda mogla obuhvatiti put Svevišnjega i, dok je svijet izvana iskvaren, razumjeti iskvarenost koja je očita pred mojim očima?

verses.text_en: Then said I unto him, It were better that we were not at all, than that we should live still in wickedness, and to suffer, and not to know wherefore.
verses.text_hr: Tada sam mu rekao: Bolje da nas uopće nema, nego da još živimo u zloći i da patimo, a da ne znamo zašto.

verses.text_en: He answered me, and said, I went into a forest into a plain, and the trees took counsel,
verses.text_hr: Odgovorio mi je: Otišao sam u šumu na ravnici, a stabla su se posavjetovala,

verses.text_en: And said, Come, let us go and make war against the sea that it may depart away before us, and that we may make us more woods.
verses.text_hr: I rekao je: Hajde, pođimo i zaratimo s morem da ono odstupi pred nama i da si napravimo još više šuma.

verses.text_en: The floods of the sea also in like manner took counsel, and said, Come, let us go up and subdue the woods of the plain, that there also we may make us another country.
verses.text_hr: I morske su se bujice posavjetovale: Hajdemo pokoriti šume u ravnici kako bismo ondje sebi načinile novu zemlju.

verses.text_en: The thought of the wood was in vain, for the fire came and consumed it.
verses.text_hr: Pomisao na drvo bila je uzaludna, jer vatra je došla i progutala ga.

verses.text_en: The thought of the floods of the sea came likewise to nought, for the sand stood up and stopped them.
verses.text_hr: Pomisao na morske bujice također je bila uzaludna, jer se pijesak uspravio i zaustavio ih.

verses.text_en: If thou wert judge now betwixt these two, whom wouldest thou begin to justify? or whom wouldest thou condemn?
verses.text_hr: Da si sada sudac između ove dvojice, koga bi počeo opravdavati? Ili koga bi osudio?

verses.text_en: I answered and said, Verily it is a foolish thought that they both have devised, for the ground is given unto the wood, and the sea also hath his place to bear his floods.
verses.text_hr: Odgovorio sam: Uistinu je nerazumna zamisao koju su oboje smislili, jer je tlo dano šumi, a more ima svoje mjesto za svoje bujice.

verses.text_en: Then answered he me, and said, Thou hast given a right judgment, but why judgest thou not thyself also?
verses.text_hr: Tada mi je odgovorio: Ti si dao pravu presudu, ali zašto ne sudiš i sebi?

verses.text_en: For like as the ground is given unto the wood, and the sea to his floods: even so they that dwell upon the earth may understand nothing but that which is upon the earth: and he that dwelleth above the heavens may only understand the things that are above the height of the heavens.
verses.text_hr: Jer kao što je tlo dano šumi, a more njegovim poplavama, tako i oni koji žive na zemlji ne razumiju ništa osim onoga što je na zemlji: a onaj koji živi iznad neba može razumjeti samo ono što je iznad visine neba.

verses.text_en: Then answered I and said, I beseech thee, O Lord, let me have understanding:
verses.text_hr: Tada sam odgovorio i rekao: Molim te, Gospodine, daj mi razuma:

verses.text_en: For it was not my mind to be curious of the high things, but of such as pass by us daily, namely, wherefore Israel is given up as a reproach to the heathen, and for what cause the people whom thou hast loved is given over unto ungodly nations, and why the law of our forefathers is brought to nought, and the written covenants come to none effect,
verses.text_hr: Nisam htio istraživati uzvišene stvari, nego ono što svakodnevno prolazi pred nama: zašto je Izrael predan na porugu narodima, zašto je narod koji si ljubio predan bezbožnicima, zašto je Zakon naših otaca poništen i pisani savezi nemaju učinka,

verses.text_en: And we pass away out of the world as grasshoppers, and our life is astonishment and fear, and we are not worthy to obtain mercy.
verses.text_hr: Zašto sa svijeta prolazimo kao skakavci, a naš je život ispunjen čuđenjem i strahom te nismo dostojni zadobiti milosrđe.

verses.text_en: What will he then do unto his name whereby we are called? of these things have I asked.
verses.text_hr: Što će onda učiniti radi svojega imena kojim smo nazvani? O tome sam pitao.

verses.text_en: Then answered he me, and said, The more thou searchest, the more thou shalt marvel; for the world hasteth fast to pass away,
verses.text_hr: Tada mi je odgovorio: Što više budeš tražio, to ćeš se više čuditi; jer svijet žuri da prođe,

verses.text_en: And cannot comprehend the things that are promised to the righteous in time to come: for this world is full of unrighteousness and infirmities.
verses.text_hr: I ne može shvatiti stvari koje su obećane pravednicima u vremenu koje dolazi: jer ovaj je svijet pun nepravednosti i slabosti.

verses.text_en: But as concerning the things whereof thou askest me, I will tell thee; for the evil is sown, but the destruction thereof is not yet come.
verses.text_hr: Ali što se tiče stvari o kojima me pitaš, reći ću ti; jer zlo je posijano, ali propast još nije došla.

verses.text_en: If therefore that which is sown be not turned upside down, and if the place where the evil is sown pass not away, then cannot it come that is sown with good.
verses.text_hr: Ako se, dakle, ono što je posijano ne okrene naopako, i ako mjesto gdje je posijano zlo ne prođe, onda ne može doći ono što je zasijano dobrim.

verses.text_en: For the grain of evil seed hath been sown in the heart of Adam from the beginning, and how much ungodliness hath it brought up unto this time? and how much shall it yet bring forth until the time of threshing come?
verses.text_hr: Jer je zrno zlog sjemena posijano u srce Adamovo od početka, i koliko je opačine donijelo do ovog vremena? I koliko će još uroditi dok ne dođe vrijeme vršidbe?

verses.text_en: Ponder now by thyself, how great fruit of wickedness the grain of evil seed hath brought forth.
verses.text_hr: Razmisli sada sam o tome kako je velik plod zloće donijelo zrno zlog sjemena.

verses.text_en: And when the ears shall be cut down, which are without number, how great a floor shall they fill?
verses.text_hr: Kad se požanje bezbrojno klasje, koliko će veliko gumno napuniti?

verses.text_en: Then I answered and said, How, and when shall these things come to pass? wherefore are our years few and evil?
verses.text_hr: Tada sam odgovorio i rekao: Kako i kada će se ove stvari dogoditi? Zašto su naše godine male i zle?

verses.text_en: And he answered me, saying, Do not thou hasten above the most Highest: for thy haste is in vain to be above him, for thou hast much exceeded.
verses.text_hr: Odgovorio mi je: Ne žuri više od Svevišnjega. Uzalud ga pokušavaš preteći; već si predaleko otišao.

verses.text_en: Did not the souls also of the righteous ask question of these things in their chambers, saying, How long shall I hope on this fashion? when cometh the fruit of the floor of our reward?
verses.text_hr: Nisu li i duše pravednika u svojim odajama pitale: Dokle ćemo se tako nadati? Kada će doći plod gumna naše nagrade?

verses.text_en: And unto these things Uriel the archangel gave them answer, and said, Even when the number of seeds is filled in you: for he hath weighed the world in the balance.
verses.text_hr: Arkanđeo Uriel odgovorio im je: Kad se ispuni broj posijanih među vama, jer Svevišnji je izvagao svijet na vagi.

verses.text_en: By measure hath he measured the times; and by number hath he numbered the times; and he doth not move nor stir them, until the said measure be fulfilled.
verses.text_hr: Mjerom je mjerio vremena; i brojem je izbrojio vremena; i on ih ne miče niti miče, dok se navedena mjera ne ispuni.

verses.text_en: Then answered I and said, O Lord that bearest rule, even we all are full of impiety.
verses.text_hr: Tada sam odgovorio: O Gospodine, Vladaru, svi smo mi puni bezbožnosti.

verses.text_en: And for our sakes peradventure it is that the floors of the righteous are not filled, because of the sins of them that dwell upon the earth.
verses.text_hr: Možda se upravo zbog nas gumna pravednika ne pune, zbog grijeha stanovnika zemlje.

verses.text_en: So he answered me, and said, Go thy way to a woman with child, and ask of her when she hath fulfilled her nine months, if her womb may keep the birth any longer within her.
verses.text_hr: Odgovorio mi je: Pođi k trudnoj ženi i upitaj je može li, kad navrši devet mjeseci, još zadržavati dijete u utrobi.

verses.text_en: Then said I, No, Lord, that can she not. And he said unto me, In the grave the chambers of souls are like the womb of a woman:
verses.text_hr: Rekao sam: Ne može, gospodaru. On mi je rekao: Odaje duša u grobu slične su ženinoj utrobi.

verses.text_en: For like as a woman that travaileth maketh haste to escape the necessity of the travail: even so do these places haste to deliver those things that are committed unto them.
verses.text_hr: Kao što žena u trudovima žuri osloboditi se porođajne muke, tako i ta mjesta žure predati ono što im je povjereno.

verses.text_en: From the beginning, look, what thou desirest to see, it shall be shewed thee.
verses.text_hr: Od početka gledaj: pokazat će ti se ono što želiš vidjeti.

verses.text_en: Then answered I and said, If I have found favour in thy sight, and if it be possible, and if I be meet therefore,
verses.text_hr: Odgovorio sam: Ako sam našao milost u tvojim očima, ako je moguće i ako sam toga dostojan,

verses.text_en: Shew me then whether there be more to come than is past, or more past than is to come.
verses.text_hr: Pokaži mi onda hoće li doći više od onoga što je prošlo, ili više od onoga što će doći.

verses.text_en: What is past I know, but what is for to come I know not.
verses.text_hr: Ono što je prošlo znam, ali ono što dolazi ne znam.

verses.text_en: And he said unto me, Stand up upon the right side, and I shall expound the similitude unto thee.
verses.text_hr: I rekao mi je, Ustani s desne strane i ja ću ti objasniti usporedbu.

verses.text_en: So I stood, and saw, and, behold, an hot burning oven passed by before me: and it happened that when the flame was gone by I looked, and, behold, the smoke remained still.
verses.text_hr: Stao sam i vidio kako preda mnom prolazi užarena peć. Kad je plamen prošao, pogledao sam, a dim je još ostao.

verses.text_en: After this there passed by before me a watery cloud, and sent down much rain with a storm; and when the stormy rain was past, the drops remained still.
verses.text_hr: Nakon toga preda mnom je prošao vodeni oblak, i pustio mnogo kiše s olujom; a kad je olujna kiša prošla, kapi su ostale mirne.

verses.text_en: Then said he unto me, Consider with thyself; as the rain is more than the drops, and as the fire is greater than the smoke; but the drops and the smoke remain behind: so the quantity which is past did more exceed.
verses.text_hr: Tada mi je rekao: Razmisli. Kao što je kiša veća od kapljica i oganj veći od dima, a kapljice i dim ostaju iza njih, tako je i ono što je prošlo bilo mnogo veće.

verses.text_en: Then I prayed, and said, May I live, thinkest thou, until that time? or what shall happen in those days?
verses.text_hr: Tada sam se pomolio i rekao: Mogu li živjeti, što misliš, do tog vremena? Ili što će se dogoditi u one dane?

verses.text_en: He answered me, and said, As for the tokens whereof thou askest me, I may tell thee of them in part: but as touching thy life, I am not sent to shew thee; for I do not know it.
verses.text_hr: Odgovorio mi je i rekao: Što se tiče znakova za koje me pitaš, mogu ti ih djelomično reći; ali što se tiče tvog života, nisam poslan da ti pokažem; jer ja to ne znam.

verses.text_en: Nevertheless as concerning the tokens, behold, the days shall come, that they which dwell upon earth shall be taken in a great number, and the way of truth shall be hidden, and the land shall be barren of faith.
verses.text_hr: A što se tiče znakova: evo, dolaze dani kada će velik broj stanovnika zemlje biti uzet, put istine skriven, a zemlja ostati bez vjere.

verses.text_en: But iniquity shall be increased above that which now thou seest, or that thou hast heard long ago.
verses.text_hr: Ali opačina će se povećati iznad onoga što sada vidiš ili što si davno čuo.

verses.text_en: And the land, that thou seest now to have root, shalt thou see wasted suddenly.
verses.text_hr: A zemlju, za koju sada vidiš da ima korijen, vidjet ćeš da je iznenada opustošena.

verses.text_en: But if the most High grant thee to live, thou shalt see after the third trumpet that the sun shall suddenly shine again in the night, and the moon thrice in the day:
verses.text_hr: Ako ti Svevišnji dopusti da živiš, nakon treće ćeš trube vidjeti kako sunce iznenada ponovno sja noću, a mjesec triput danju.

verses.text_en: And blood shall drop out of wood, and the stone shall give his voice, and the people shall be troubled:
verses.text_hr: I krv će kapati iz drveta, i kamen će dati svoj glas, i narod će biti uznemiren.

verses.text_en: And even he shall rule, whom they look not for that dwell upon the earth, and the fowls shall take their flight away together:
verses.text_hr: Zavladat će onaj kojega stanovnici zemlje ne očekuju, a ptice će zajedno odletjeti.

verses.text_en: And the Sodomitish sea shall cast out fish, and make a noise in the night, which many have not known: but they shall all hear the voice thereof.
verses.text_hr: I sodomsko će more izbaciti ribe i napraviti buku u noći, koju mnogi ne poznaju, ali svi će čuti njen glas.

verses.text_en: There shall be a confusion also in many places, and the fire shall be oft sent out again, and the wild beasts shall change their places, and menstruous women shall bring forth monsters:
verses.text_hr: Također će biti pomutnje na mnogim mjestima, i vatra će se često ponovno slati, i divlje će zvijeri promijeniti svoja mjesta, a žene s menstruacijom rađat će čudovišta:

verses.text_en: And salt waters shall be found in the sweet, and all friends shall destroy one another; then shall wit hide itself, and understanding withdraw itself into his secret chamber,
verses.text_hr: I slane će se vode naći u slatkim, i svi će prijatelji uništiti jedni druge; tada će se pamet sakriti, a razum će se povući u njegovu tajnu odaju,

verses.text_en: And shall be sought of many, and yet not be found: then shall unrighteousness and incontinency be multiplied upon earth.
verses.text_hr: I tražit će se od mnogih, ali neće se naći: tada će se nepravda i neuzdržljivost umnožiti na zemlji.

verses.text_en: One land also shall ask another, and say, Is righteousness that maketh a man righteous gone through thee? And it shall say, No.
verses.text_hr: Jedna će zemlja pitati drugu i reći: Je li kroz tebe prošla pravda koja čovjeka čini pravednim? I reći će, Ne.

verses.text_en: At the same time shall men hope, but nothing obtain: they shall labour, but their ways shall not prosper.
verses.text_hr: U isto vrijeme ljudi će se nadati, ali ništa neće postići: trudit će se, ali putovi im neće uspjeti.

verses.text_en: To shew thee such tokens I have leave; and if thou wilt pray again, and weep as now, and fast even days, thou shalt hear yet greater things.
verses.text_hr: Dopušteno mi je pokazati ti takve znakove; i ako opet budeš molio, i plakao kao sada, i postio čak i dane, čut ćeš još veće stvari.

verses.text_en: Then I awaked, and an extreme fearfulness went through all my body, and my mind was troubled, so that it fainted.
verses.text_hr: Tada sam se probudio. Silan mi je strah prožeo tijelo, a um mi se toliko uznemirio da sam gotovo izgubio svijest.

verses.text_en: So the angel that was come to talk with me held me, comforted me, and set me up upon my feet.
verses.text_hr: Tako me anđeo koji je došao razgovarati sa mnom držao, tješio i uspravio na noge.

verses.text_en: And in the second night it came to pass, that Salathiel the captain of the people came unto me, saying, Where hast thou been? and why is thy countenance so heavy?
verses.text_hr: Sljedeće noći došao mi je Salatiel, zapovjednik naroda, i upitao: Gdje si bio? Zašto ti je lice tako sumorno?

verses.text_en: Knowest thou not that Israel is committed unto thee in the land of their captivity?
verses.text_hr: Zar ne znaš da je Izrael predan tebi u zemlji sužanjstva?

verses.text_en: Up then, and eat bread, and forsake us not, as the shepherd that leaveth his flock in the hands of cruel wolves.
verses.text_hr: Gore dakle, i jedi kruha, i ne ostavljaj nas, kao pastir koji svoje stado ostavlja u rukama okrutnih vukova.

verses.text_en: Then said I unto him, Go thy ways from me, and come not nigh me. And he heard what I said, and went from me.
verses.text_hr: Tada sam mu rekao: Idi od mene i ne približavaj mi se. I čuo je što sam rekao i otišao od mene.

verses.text_en: And so I fasted seven days, mourning and weeping, like as Uriel the angel commanded me.
verses.text_hr: I tako sam postio sedam dana, tugujući i plačući, kao što mi je naredio anđeo Uriel.

verses.text_en: And after seven days so it was, that the thoughts of my heart were very grievous unto me again,
verses.text_hr: I nakon sedam dana tako je bilo, da su misli moga srca opet bile vrlo teške za mene,

verses.text_en: And my soul recovered the spirit of understanding, and I began to talk with the most High again,
verses.text_hr: U dušu mi se vratio duh razuma i ponovno sam počeo govoriti Svevišnjemu.

verses.text_en: And said, O Lord that bearest rule, of every wood of the earth, and of all the trees thereof, thou hast chosen thee one only vine:
verses.text_hr: Rekao sam: O Gospodine, Vladaru, od svih šuma na zemlji i svega njihova drveća izabrao si samo jednu lozu.

verses.text_en: And of all lands of the whole world thou hast chosen thee one pit: and of all the flowers thereof one lily:
verses.text_hr: Od svih zemalja svijeta izabrao si sebi samo jedno mjesto, a od svega cvijeća samo jedan ljiljan.

verses.text_en: And of all the depths of the sea thou hast filled thee one river: and of all builded cities thou hast hallowed Sion unto thyself:
verses.text_hr: I od svih morskih dubina ti si jednu rijeku napunio, i od svih sagrađenih gradova posvetio si sebi Sion.

verses.text_en: And of all the fowls that are created thou hast named thee one dove: and of all the cattle that are made thou hast provided thee one sheep:
verses.text_hr: Od svih stvorenih ptica nazvao si svojom samo jednu golubicu, a od sve stoke dao si sebi jednu ovcu.

verses.text_en: And among all the multitudes of people thou hast gotten thee one people: and unto this people, whom thou lovedst, thou gavest a law that is approved of all.
verses.text_hr: I među svim mnoštvom naroda stekao si sebi jedan narod: i ovom narodu, koji si ljubio, dao si zakon koji svi odobravaju.

verses.text_en: And now, O Lord, why hast thou given this one people over unto many? and upon the one root hast thou prepared others, and why hast thou scattered thy only one people among many?
verses.text_hr: A sada, Gospodine, zašto si ovaj jedan narod predao mnogima? I na jednom si korijenu pripremio druge, i zašto si jedini svoj narod raspršio među mnoge?

verses.text_en: And they which did gainsay thy promises, and believed not thy covenants, have trodden them down.
verses.text_hr: I oni koji su se protivili tvojim obećanjima i nisu vjerovali tvojim savezima, pogazili su ih.

verses.text_en: If thou didst so much hate thy people, yet shouldest thou punish them with thine own hands.
verses.text_hr: Ako si svoj narod toliko zamrzio, trebao bi ga kazniti vlastitom rukom.

verses.text_en: Now when I had spoken these words, the angel that came to me the night afore was sent unto me,
verses.text_hr: Kad sam izgovorio ove riječi, anđeo koji mi je došao prethodne noći bio je poslan k meni,

verses.text_en: And said unto me, Hear me, and I will instruct thee; hearken to the thing that I say, and I shall tell thee more.
verses.text_hr: I rekao mi je: Slušaj me i poučit ću te; poslušaj što ti govorim i još ću ti reći.

verses.text_en: And I said, Speak on, my Lord. Then said he unto me, Thou art sore troubled in mind for Israel’s sake: lovest thou that people better than he that made them?
verses.text_hr: Rekao sam, Govori dalje, moj Gospodaru. Tada mi je rekao: Jako si zabrinut zbog Izraela: voliš li taj narod više od onoga koji ga je stvorio?

verses.text_en: And I said, No, Lord: but of very grief have I spoken: for my reins pain me every hour, while I labour to comprehend the way of the most High, and to seek out part of his judgment.
verses.text_hr: Odgovorio sam: Ne, Gospodine. Govorio sam od silne žalosti; slabine me neprestano bole dok nastojim razumjeti put Svevišnjega i proniknuti u dio njegova suda.

verses.text_en: And he said unto me, Thou canst not. And I said, Wherefore, Lord? whereunto was I born then? or why was not my mother’s womb then my grave, that I might not have seen the travail of Jacob, and the wearisome toil of the stock of Israel?
verses.text_hr: A on mi je rekao, Ne možeš. Rekao sam: Zašto, Gospodine? Gdje sam se tada rodio? Ili zašto utroba moje majke nije bila onda moj grob, da ne bih vidio muke Jakovljeve i mukotrpan rad stada Izraelova?

verses.text_en: And he said unto me, Number me the things that are not yet come, gather me together the dross that are scattered abroad, make me the flowers green again that are withered,
verses.text_hr: Rekao mi je: Izbroji mi ono što još nije došlo, skupi mi rasute kapljice i učini da uvelo cvijeće ponovno pozeleni.

verses.text_en: Open me the places that are closed, and bring me forth the winds that in them are shut up, shew me the image of a voice: and then I will declare to thee the thing that thou labourest to know.
verses.text_hr: Otvori mi mjesta koja su zatvorena, i izvedi mi vjetrove koji su u njima zatvoreni, pokaži mi sliku glasa: i tada ću ti objaviti ono što se trudiš znati.

verses.text_en: And I said, O Lord that bearest rule, who may know these things, but he that hath not his dwelling with men?
verses.text_hr: Rekao sam, O Gospodine koji vladaš, tko može znati ove stvari osim onoga koji ne živi s ljudima?

verses.text_en: As for me, I am unwise: how may I then speak of these things whereof thou askest me?
verses.text_hr: Što se mene tiče, ja sam nerazborit: kako onda mogu govoriti o ovim stvarima o kojima me pitaš?

verses.text_en: Then said he unto me, Like as thou canst do none of these things that I have spoken of, even so canst thou not find out my judgment, or in the end the love that I have promised unto my people.
verses.text_hr: Tada mi je rekao: Kao što ne možeš učiniti ništa od onoga o čemu sam govorio, tako ne možeš spoznati moj sud ni ljubav koju sam na svršetku obećao svojemu narodu.

verses.text_en: And I said, Behold, O Lord, yet art thou nigh unto them that be reserved till the end: and what shall they do that have been before me, or we that be now, or they that shall come after us?
verses.text_hr: Rekao sam: Gle, Gospodine, ipak si blizu onima koji su zadržani do kraja: i što će učiniti oni koji su bili prije mene, ili mi koji smo sada, ili oni koji će doći poslije nas?

verses.text_en: And he said unto me, I will liken my judgment unto a ring: like as there is no slackness of the last, even so there is no swiftness of the first.
verses.text_hr: I rekao mi je: "Svoj ću sud usporediti s prstenom: kao što nema tromosti posljednjih, tako nema ni brzine prvih."

verses.text_en: So I answered and said, Couldest thou not make those that have been made, and be now, and that are for to come, at once; that thou mightest shew thy judgment the sooner?
verses.text_hr: Pa sam odgovorio i rekao: Zar nisi mogao učiniti one koji su stvoreni, koji su sada, i koji će doći, odjednom; da bi što prije mogao objaviti svoj sud?

verses.text_en: Then answered he me, and said, The creature may not haste above the maker; neither may the world hold them at once that shall be created therein.
verses.text_hr: Tada mi je odgovorio: Stvorenje ne smije žuriti iznad Stvoritelja; niti ih svijet može odjednom zadržati što će se u njemu stvoriti.

verses.text_en: And I said, As thou hast said unto thy servant, that thou, which givest life to all, hast given life at once to the creature that thou hast created, and the creature bare it: even so it might now also bear them that now be present at once.
verses.text_hr: Rekao sam: Kao što si svojemu sluzi rekao, ti koji svima daješ život mogao si odjednom oživiti sve stvorenje koje si sazdao, a ono bi ih moglo odjednom podnijeti.

verses.text_en: And he said unto me, Ask the womb of a woman, and say unto her, If thou bringest forth children, why dost thou it not together, but one after another? pray her therefore to bring forth ten children at once.
verses.text_hr: I rekao mi je: Pitaj utrobu ženinu i reci joj: Ako rađaš djecu, zašto ne rađaš zajedno, nego jedno za drugim? Moli je stoga da rodi desetero djece odjednom.

verses.text_en: And I said, She cannot: but must do it by distance of time.
verses.text_hr: Rekao sam: Ne može; mora ih rađati u vremenskim razmacima.

verses.text_en: Then said he unto me, Even so have I given the womb of the earth to those that be sown in it in their times.
verses.text_hr: Tada mi je rekao: Tako sam ja dao utrobu zemlje onima koji su u njoj posijani u svoje vrijeme.

verses.text_en: For like as a young child may not bring forth the things that belong to the aged, even so have I disposed the world which I created.
verses.text_hr: Kao što malo dijete ne može roditi ono što pripada starijoj dobi, tako sam uredio i svijet koji sam stvorio.

verses.text_en: And I asked, and said, Seeing thou hast now given me the way, I will proceed to speak before thee: for our mother, of whom thou hast told me that she is young, draweth now nigh unto age.
verses.text_hr: Upitao sam: Budući da si mi sada otvorio put, nastavit ću govoriti pred tobom. Naša majka, za koju si rekao da je mlada, već se približava starosti.

verses.text_en: He answered me, and said, Ask a woman that beareth children, and she shall tell thee.
verses.text_hr: On mi je odgovorio: Pitaj ženu koja rađa i ona će ti reći.

verses.text_en: Say unto her, Wherefore are unto they whom thou hast now brought forth like those that were before, but less of stature?
verses.text_hr: Reci joj: Zašto su oni koje si sada rodila kao oni koji su prije bili, ali manjeg rasta?

verses.text_en: And she shall answer thee, They that be born in the strength of youth are of one fashion, and they that are born in the time of age, when the womb faileth, are otherwise.
verses.text_hr: Odgovorit će ti: Djeca rođena u snazi mladosti međusobno su slična, a drukčija su ona rođena u starosti, kada utroba oslabi.

verses.text_en: Consider thou therefore also, how that ye are less of stature than those that were before you.
verses.text_hr: Razmotri dakle i ti kako si niži od onih koji su bili prije tebe.

verses.text_en: And so are they that come after you less than ye, as the creatures which now begin to be old, and have passed over the strength of youth.
verses.text_hr: A tako su i oni koji dolaze nakon vas manji od vas, kao stvorenja koja sada počinju stariti i prešla su snagu mladosti.

verses.text_en: Then said I, Lord, I beseech thee, if I have found favour in thy sight, shew thy servant by whom thou visitest thy creature.
verses.text_hr: Tada sam rekao: Gospodine, molim te, ako sam našao milost u tvojim očima, pokaži svojemu sluzi po komu pohodiš svoje stvorenje.

verses.text_en: And he said unto me, In the beginning, when the earth was made, before the borders of the world stood, or ever the winds blew,
verses.text_hr: I rekao mi je, U početku, kad je zemlja stvorena, prije nego što su granice svijeta stajale, ili vjetrovi ikad puhali,

verses.text_en: Before it thundered and lightened, or ever the foundations of paradise were laid,
verses.text_hr: Prije nego što je zagrmjelo i sijevnulo, ili su ikad bili postavljeni temelji raja,

verses.text_en: Before the fair flowers were seen, or ever the moveable powers were established, before the innumerable multitude of angels were gathered together,
verses.text_hr: Prije nego što se lijepo cvijeće vidjelo, ili ikada pokretne moći uspostavljene, prije nego što je bezbrojno mnoštvo anđela okupljeno zajedno,

verses.text_en: Or ever the heights of the air were lifted up, before the measures of the firmament were named, or ever the chimneys in Sion were hot,
verses.text_hr: Ili su ikada visine zraka bile uzdignute, prije nego što su mjere nebeskog svoda bile imenovane, ili su ikada dimnjaci u Sionu bili vrući,

verses.text_en: And ere the present years were sought out, and or ever the inventions of them that now sin were turned, before they were sealed that have gathered faith for a treasure:
verses.text_hr: I prije nego što su sadašnje godine bile tražene, i ili su ikada izmišljotine onih koji sada griješe preokrenute, prije nego što su bili zapečaćeni koji su sakupili vjeru za blago:

verses.text_en: Then did I consider these things, and they all were made through me alone, and through none other: by me also they shall be ended, and by none other.
verses.text_hr: Tada sam promotrio sve to: sve je bilo stvoreno po meni i ni po komu drugom; po meni će biti i dovršeno, a ni po komu drugom.

verses.text_en: Then answered I and said, What shall be the parting asunder of the times? or when shall be the end of the first, and the beginning of it that followeth?
verses.text_hr: Odgovorio sam: Što će razdvojiti vremena? Kada će završiti prvo, a započeti ono koje slijedi?

verses.text_en: And he said unto me, From Abraham unto Isaac, when Jacob and Esau were born of him, Jacob’s hand held first the heel of Esau.
verses.text_hr: I rekao mi je, Od Abrahama do Izaka, kad su se od njega rodili Jakov i Ezav, Jakovljeva je ruka prvo držala Ezavovu petu.

verses.text_en: For Esau is the end of the world, and Jacob is the beginning of it that followeth.
verses.text_hr: Jer Ezav je kraj svijeta, a Jakov je početak onoga što slijedi.

verses.text_en: The hand of man is betwixt the heel and the hand: other question, Esdras, ask thou not.
verses.text_hr: Čovjekova je ruka između pete i šake; ne postavljaj drugo pitanje, Ezra.

verses.text_en: I answered then and said, O Lord that bearest rule, if I have found favour in thy sight,
verses.text_hr: Odgovorio sam: O Gospodine, Vladaru, ako sam našao milost u tvojim očima,

verses.text_en: I beseech thee, shew thy servant the end of thy tokens, whereof thou shewedst me part the last night.
verses.text_hr: Preklinjem te, pokaži sluzi svome kraj svojih znakova, od kojih si mi dao dio prošle noći.

verses.text_en: So he answered and said unto me, Stand up upon thy feet, and hear a mighty sounding voice.
verses.text_hr: Zatim mi je odgovorio: Ustani na noge i čuj snažan glas.

verses.text_en: And it shall be as it were a great motion; but the place where thou standest shall not be moved.
verses.text_hr: I to će biti kao veliko kretanje; ali mjesto gdje stojiš neće se pomaknuti.

verses.text_en: And therefore when it speaketh be not afraid: for the word is of the end, and the foundation of the earth is understood.
verses.text_hr: I zato kad progovori ne boj se: jer riječ je svršetka, a temelj zemlje se razumije.

verses.text_en: And why? because the speech of these things trembleth and is moved: for it knoweth that the end of these things must be changed.
verses.text_hr: Zašto? Zato što glas tih stvari dršće i potresa se, jer zna da se njihov svršetak mora promijeniti.

verses.text_en: And it happened, that when I had heard it I stood up upon my feet, and hearkened, and, behold, there was a voice that spake, and the sound of it was like the sound of many waters.
verses.text_hr: I kad sam to čuo, ustao sam na noge i poslušao, i gle, glas je govorio, a šum je bio kao šum mnogih voda.

verses.text_en: And it said, Behold, the days come, that I will begin to draw nigh, and to visit them that dwell upon the earth,
verses.text_hr: I rekao je: Evo dolaze dani kad ću se početi približavati i pohoditi one koji žive na zemlji,

verses.text_en: And will begin to make inquisition of them, what they be that have hurt unjustly with their unrighteousness, and when the affliction of Sion shall be fulfilled;
verses.text_hr: I počet ću ispitivati one koji su nepravedno nanosili zlo; tada će se ispuniti nevolja Siona.

verses.text_en: And when the world, that shall begin to vanish away, shall be finished, then will I shew these tokens: the books shall be opened before the firmament, and they shall see all together:
verses.text_hr: Kad se dovrši svijet koji počinje nestajati, pokazat ću ove znakove: knjige će se otvoriti pred nebeskim svodom i svi će ih zajedno vidjeti.

verses.text_en: And the children of a year old shall speak with their voices, the women with child shall bring forth untimely children of three or four months old, and they shall live, and be raised up.
verses.text_hr: I djeca od godinu dana govorit će svojim glasom, trudne će žene rađati prijevremenu djecu od tri ili četiri mjeseca, i oni će živjeti i biti podignuti.

verses.text_en: And suddenly shall the sown places appear unsown, the full storehouses shall suddenly be found empty:
verses.text_hr: I iznenada će se zasijana mjesta pokazati nezasijana, puna skladišta iznenada će se naći prazna:

verses.text_en: And the trumpet shall give a sound, which when every man heareth, they shall be suddenly afraid.
verses.text_hr: Truba će zatrubiti, a kad je svi ljudi čuju, odjednom će se prestrašiti.

verses.text_en: At that time shall friends fight one against another like enemies, and the earth shall stand in fear with those that dwell therein, the springs of the fountains shall stand still, and in three hours they shall not run.
verses.text_hr: U to će se vrijeme prijatelji međusobno boriti kao neprijatelji. Zemlja će se prestraviti zajedno sa svojim stanovnicima; izvori će stati i tri sata neće teći.

verses.text_en: Whosoever remaineth from all these that I have told thee shall escape, and see my salvation, and the end of your world.
verses.text_hr: Tko god ostane od svega ovoga što sam ti rekao, pobjeći će i vidjeti moje spasenje i kraj vašeg svijeta.

verses.text_en: And the men that are received shall see it, who have not tasted death from their birth: and the heart of the inhabitants shall be changed, and turned into another meaning.
verses.text_hr: Vidjet će to i ljudi koji budu uzeti, koji od rođenja nisu okusili smrt. Srca stanovnika promijenit će se i zadobiti drukčiji razum.

verses.text_en: For evil shall be put out, and deceit shall be quenched.
verses.text_hr: Jer zlo će biti iskorijenjeno, a prijevara će se ugasiti.

verses.text_en: As for faith, it shall flourish, corruption shall be overcome, and the truth, which hath been so long without fruit, shall be declared.
verses.text_hr: Vjera će procvjetati, raspadljivost biti svladana, a istina koja je tako dugo bila neplodna bit će objavljena.

verses.text_en: And when he talked with me, behold, I looked by little and little upon him before whom I stood.
verses.text_hr: Dok je govorio sa mnom, malo-pomalo gledao sam onoga pred kim sam stajao.

verses.text_en: And these words said he unto me; I am come to shew thee the time of the night to come.
verses.text_hr: I rekao mi je ove riječi; Došao sam ti pokazati vrijeme noći koja dolazi.

verses.text_en: If thou wilt pray yet more, and fast seven days again, I shall tell thee greater things by day than I have heard.
verses.text_hr: Ako se još više budeš molio i ponovno postio sedam dana, danju ću ti kazati veće stvari nego što si ih čuo.

verses.text_en: For thy voice is heard before the most High: for the Mighty hath seen thy righteous dealing, he hath seen also thy chastity, which thou hast had ever since thy youth.
verses.text_hr: Jer tvoj se glas čuje pred Svevišnjim: jer Silni je vidio tvoju pravednost, vidio je i tvoju čednost, koju imaš od svoje mladosti.

verses.text_en: And therefore hath he sent me to shew thee all these things, and to say unto thee, Be of good comfort and fear not
verses.text_hr: I zato me poslao da ti pokažem sve te stvari i da ti kažem: Budi utješen i ne boj se

verses.text_en: And hasten not with the times that are past, to think vain things, that thou mayest not hasten from the latter times.
verses.text_hr: Ne žuri za vremenima koja su prošla i ne razmišljaj o ispraznim stvarima, da ne bi brzopleto pohrlio prema budućim vremenima.

verses.text_en: And it came to pass after this, that I wept again, and fasted seven days in like manner, that I might fulfil the three weeks which he told me.
verses.text_hr: I dogodi se nakon toga da sam opet plakao i postio sedam dana na isti način, da ispunim tri tjedna koja mi je rekao.

verses.text_en: And in the eighth night was my heart vexed within me again, and I began to speak before the most High.
verses.text_hr: I u osmoj noći moje srce opet se uznemiri u meni, i počeo sam govoriti pred Svevišnjim.

verses.text_en: For my spirit was greatly set on fire, and my soul was in distress.
verses.text_hr: Duh mi je silno gorio, a duša mi je bila u nevolji.

verses.text_en: And I said, O Lord, thou spakest from the beginning of the creation, even the first day, and saidst thus; Let heaven and earth be made; and thy word was a perfect work.
verses.text_hr: Rekao sam: O Gospodine, ti si govorio od početka stvaranja, već prvoga dana: Neka nastanu nebo i zemlja! I tvoja je riječ bila savršeno djelo.

verses.text_en: And then was the spirit, and darkness and silence were on every side; the sound of man’s voice was not yet formed.
verses.text_hr: A onda je bio duh, a tama i tišina bili su sa svih strana; zvuk čovječjeg glasa još nije bio formiran.

verses.text_en: Then commandedst thou a fair light to come forth of thy treasures, that thy work might appear.
verses.text_hr: Tada si zapovjedio lijepoj svjetlosti da izađe iz tvojih blaga, da se tvoje djelo može pojaviti.

verses.text_en: Upon the second day thou madest the spirit of the firmament, and commandedst it to part asunder, and to make a division betwixt the waters, that the one part might go up, and the other remain beneath.
verses.text_hr: Drugoga dana stvorio si duh nebeskog svoda i zapovjedio mu da se rastavi i da razdvoji vode, tako da jedan dio može ići gore, a drugi ostati ispod.

verses.text_en: Upon the third day thou didst command that the waters should be gathered in the seventh part of the earth: six parts hast thou dried up, and kept them, to the intent that of these some being planted of God and tilled might serve thee.
verses.text_hr: Trećega si dana zapovjedio da se vode skupe na sedminu zemlje. Šest si dijelova isušio i sačuvao kako bi ti neki od njih, zasađeni i obrađeni po Božjoj volji, služili.

verses.text_en: For as soon as thy word went forth the work was made.
verses.text_hr: Jer čim je tvoja riječ izašla, djelo je izvršeno.

verses.text_en: For immediately there was great and innumerable fruit, and many and divers pleasures for the taste, and flowers of unchangeable colour, and odours of wonderful smell: and this was done the third day.
verses.text_hr: Odmah su se pojavili veliki i bezbrojni plodovi, mnogi raznovrsni okusi, cvijeće nepromjenjive boje i mirisi čudesne ugode. To se dogodilo trećega dana.

verses.text_en: Upon the fourth day thou commandedst that the sun should shine, and the moon give her light, and the stars should be in order:
verses.text_hr: Četvrtog dana zapovjedio si da sunce sja, da mjesec svijetli i da zvijezde budu poredane.

verses.text_en: And gavest them a charge to do service unto man, that was to be made.
verses.text_hr: I dao im nalog da služe čovjeku, što je trebalo učiniti.

verses.text_en: Upon the fifth day thou saidst unto the seventh part, where the waters were gathered that it should bring forth living creatures, fowls and fishes: and so it came to pass.
verses.text_hr: U peti dan rekao si sedmom dijelu, gdje su se vode skupile, da će iznjedriti živa bića, ptice i ribe: i tako se dogodilo.

verses.text_en: For the dumb water and without life brought forth living things at the commandment of God, that all people might praise thy wondrous works.
verses.text_hr: Jer nijema voda i bez života stvorila je živa bića na zapovijed Božju, da svi ljudi mogu slaviti tvoja čudesna djela.

verses.text_en: Then didst thou ordain two living creatures, the one thou calledst Enoch, and the other Leviathan;
verses.text_hr: Tada si odredio dva živa stvorenja: jedno si nazvao Henok, a drugo Levijatan.

verses.text_en: And didst separate the one from the other: for the seventh part, namely, where the water was gathered together, might not hold them both.
verses.text_hr: Odvojio si ih jedno od drugoga jer ih sedmi dio, gdje su bile skupljene vode, nije mogao oba sadržavati.

verses.text_en: Unto Enoch thou gavest one part, which was dried up the third day, that he should dwell in the same part, wherein are a thousand hills:
verses.text_hr: Henoku si dao dio koji se osušio trećega dana da prebiva ondje gdje je tisuću brežuljaka.

verses.text_en: But unto Leviathan thou gavest the seventh part, namely, the moist; and hast kept him to be devoured of whom thou wilt, and when.
verses.text_hr: Levijatanu si dao sedmi dio, vodu, i sačuvao ga da ga proždere onaj koga ti odrediš i kada ti odrediš.

verses.text_en: Upon the sixth day thou gavest commandment unto the earth, that before thee it should bring forth beasts, cattle, and creeping things:
verses.text_hr: Šestog dana zapovjedio si zemlji da pred tobom pusti životinje, stoku i gmizavce.

verses.text_en: And after these, Adam also, whom thou madest lord of all thy creatures: of him come we all, and the people also whom thou hast chosen.
verses.text_hr: A nakon njih i Adam, kojega si učinio gospodarem svih svojih stvorenja: od njega potječemo svi mi, a također i ljudi koje si odabrao.

verses.text_en: All this have I spoken before thee, O Lord, because thou madest the world for our sakes
verses.text_hr: Sve sam to rekao pred tobom, Gospodine, jer si radi nas stvorio svijet.

verses.text_en: As for the other people, which also come of Adam, thou hast said that they are nothing, but be like unto spittle: and hast likened the abundance of them unto a drop that falleth from a vessel.
verses.text_hr: Za druge narode, koji također potječu od Adama, rekao si da nisu ništa, da su poput sline; njihovo si mnoštvo usporedio s kapljicom koja pada iz posude.

verses.text_en: And now, O Lord, behold, these heathen, which have ever been reputed as nothing, have begun to be lords over us, and to devour us.
verses.text_hr: A sada, o Gospodine, gle, ovi pogani, koji su oduvijek slovili kao ništa, počeli su biti gospodari nad nama i proždirati nas.

verses.text_en: But we thy people, whom thou hast called thy firstborn, thy only begotten, and thy fervent lover, are given into their hands.
verses.text_hr: Ali mi, tvoj narod, koji si nazvao svojim prvorođencem, jedincem i žarko ljubljenim, predani smo u njihove ruke.

verses.text_en: If the world now be made for our sakes, why do we not possess an inheritance with the world? how long shall this endure?
verses.text_hr: Ako je sada svijet stvoren radi nas, zašto ne bismo posjedovali baštinu sa svijetom? Koliko će ovo izdržati?

verses.text_en: And when I had made an end of speaking these words, there was sent unto me the angel which had been sent unto me the nights afore:
verses.text_hr: I kad sam prestao govoriti ove riječi, poslan mi je anđeo koji mi je bio poslan prethodne noći:

verses.text_en: And he said unto me, Up, Esdras, and hear the words that I am come to tell thee.
verses.text_hr: I rekao mi je, Ustani, Ezra, i čuj riječi koje sam ti došao reći.

verses.text_en: And I said, Speak on, my God. Then said he unto me, The sea is set in a wide place, that it might be deep and great.
verses.text_hr: A ja sam rekao, Govori, moj Bože. Tada mi je rekao: More je na širokom mjestu, da bude duboko i veliko.

verses.text_en: But put the case the entrance were narrow, and like a river;
verses.text_hr: Ali zamisli da je ulaz uzak i nalik rijeci.

verses.text_en: Who then could go into the sea to look upon it, and to rule it? if he went not through the narrow, how could he come into the broad?
verses.text_hr: Tko bi onda mogao ući u more da ga promatra i da njime vlada? Ako nije prošao kroz usko, kako bi mogao doći u široko?

verses.text_en: There is also another thing; A city is builded, and set upon a broad field, and is full of all good things:
verses.text_hr: Postoji još jedna stvar; Grad je sagrađen i postavljen na širokom polju i pun je svih dobara.

verses.text_en: The entrance thereof is narrow, and is set in a dangerous place to fall, like as if there were a fire on the right hand, and on the left a deep water:
verses.text_hr: Ulaz mu je uzak, i postavljen je na opasno mjesto za pad, kao da je s desne strane vatra, a s lijeve duboka voda:

verses.text_en: And one only path between them both, even between the fire and the water, so small that there could but one man go there at once.
verses.text_hr: I jedan jedini put između njih dvojice, čak i između vatre i vode, tako malen da je samo jedan čovjek mogao tamo proći odjednom.

verses.text_en: If this city now were given unto a man for an inheritance, if he never shall pass the danger set before it, how shall he receive this inheritance?
verses.text_hr: Kad bi ovaj grad sada bio dan čovjeku u nasljedstvo, ako on nikada ne prođe opasnost koja je pred njim, kako će primiti ovo nasljedstvo?

verses.text_en: And I said, It is so, Lord. Then said he unto me, Even so also is Israel’s portion.
verses.text_hr: Rekao sam: Tako je, Gospodine. Tada mi je rekao: To je i Izraelov dio.

verses.text_en: Because for their sakes I made the world: and when Adam transgressed my statutes, then was decreed that now is done.
verses.text_hr: Radi njih sam stvorio svijet; kada je Adam prekršio moje uredbe, određeno je ono što je sada nastupilo.

verses.text_en: Then were the entrances of this world made narrow, full of sorrow and travail: they are but few and evil, full of perils, and very painful.
verses.text_hr: Tada su prolazi ovoga svijeta postali uski, puni žalosti i muke; malobrojni su i tegobni, puni opasnosti i veoma bolni.

verses.text_en: For the entrances of the elder world were wide and sure, and brought immortal fruit.
verses.text_hr: Prolazi prijašnjega svijeta bili su široki i sigurni te su donosili besmrtan plod.

verses.text_en: If then they that live labour not to enter these strait and vain things, they can never receive those that are laid up for them.
verses.text_hr: Ako se živi ne trude proći kroz te uske i tegobne prolaze, nikada neće primiti ono što je za njih pohranjeno.

verses.text_en: Now therefore why disquietest thou thyself, seeing thou art but a corruptible man? and why art thou moved, whereas thou art but mortal?
verses.text_hr: Zašto se dakle uznemiruješ, kad si raspadljiv čovjek? Zašto se potresaš, kad si smrtnik?

verses.text_en: Why hast thou not considered in thy mind this thing that is to come, rather than that which is present?
verses.text_hr: Zašto u svom umu nisi razmišljao o onome što će doći, a ne o onome što je sada?

verses.text_en: Then answered I and said, O Lord that bearest rule, thou hast ordained in thy law, that the righteous should inherit these things, but that the ungodly should perish.
verses.text_hr: Tada sam odgovorio i rekao: Gospodine koji vladaš, ti si odredio u svom zakonu da pravednici posjeduju ove stvari, a da bezbožnici propadnu.

verses.text_en: Nevertheless the righteous shall suffer strait things, and hope for wide: for they that have done wickedly have suffered the strait things, and yet shall not see the wide.
verses.text_hr: Ipak, pravednici će podnijeti nevolje i nadati se prostranstvu; oni koji su činili zlo pretrpjeli su nevolje, ali prostranstvo neće ugledati.

verses.text_en: And he said unto me. There is no judge above God, and none that hath understanding above the Highest.
verses.text_hr: I rekao mi je. Nema suca iznad Boga, niti ima razuma iznad Svevišnjeg.

verses.text_en: For there be many that perish in this life, because they despise the law of God that is set before them.
verses.text_hr: Jer ima mnogo onih koji propadaju u ovom životu, jer preziru Božji zakon koji im je postavljen.

verses.text_en: For God hath given strait commandment to such as came, what they should do to live, even as they came, and what they should observe to avoid punishment.
verses.text_hr: Bog je onima koji su došli dao strogu zapovijed što trebaju činiti da bi živjeli i što trebaju obdržavati da bi izbjegli kaznu.

verses.text_en: Nevertheless they were not obedient unto him; but spake against him, and imagined vain things;
verses.text_hr: Ali oni ga nisu poslušali, nego su mu se protivili i smišljali isprazne stvari.

verses.text_en: And deceived themselves by their wicked deeds; and said of the most High, that he is not; and knew not his ways:
verses.text_hr: Zavarali su sami sebe svojim zlim djelima, rekli za Svevišnjega da ne postoji i nisu poznavali njegove putove.

verses.text_en: But his law have they despised, and denied his covenants; in his statutes have they not been faithful, and have not performed his works.
verses.text_hr: Prezreli su njegov Zakon, zanijekali njegove saveze, nisu bili vjerni njegovim uredbama niti su vršili njegova djela.

verses.text_en: And therefore, Esdras, for the empty are empty things, and for the full are the full things.
verses.text_hr: Zato, Ezra, ispraznima pripadaju isprazne stvari, a punima one koje su pune.

verses.text_en: Behold, the time shall come, that these tokens which I have told thee shall come to pass, and the bride shall appear, and she coming forth shall be seen, that now is withdrawn from the earth.
verses.text_hr: Gle, doći će vrijeme da će se ovi znakovi koje sam ti rekao ostvariti, i nevjesta će se pojaviti, i vidjet će se ona kako izlazi, a koja je sada povučena sa zemlje.

verses.text_en: And whosoever is delivered from the foresaid evils shall see my wonders.
verses.text_hr: I tko god se izbavi od gore navedenih zala, vidjet će moja čuda.

verses.text_en: For my son Jesus shall be revealed with those that be with him, and they that remain shall rejoice within four hundred years.
verses.text_hr: Jer će se moj sin Isus objaviti s onima koji budu s njim, a oni koji ostanu radovat će se za četiri stotine godina.

verses.text_en: After these years shall my son Christ die, and all men that have life.
verses.text_hr: Nakon ovih godina umrijet će moj sin Krist i svi ljudi koji imaju život.

verses.text_en: And the world shall be turned into the old silence seven days, like as in the former judgments: so that no man shall remain.
verses.text_hr: Svijet će se na sedam dana vratiti u drevnu tišinu, kao pri prijašnjim sudovima, tako da nitko neće ostati.

verses.text_en: And after seven days the world, that yet awaketh not, shall be raised up, and that shall die that is corrupt
verses.text_hr: Nakon sedam dana svijet, koji još nije budan, bit će podignut, a ono što je raspadljivo umrijet će.

verses.text_en: And the earth shall restore those that are asleep in her, and so shall the dust those that dwell in silence, and the secret places shall deliver those souls that were committed unto them.
verses.text_hr: Zemlja će vratiti one koji u njoj spavaju, prah one koji prebivaju u tišini, a skrovita mjesta predat će duše koje su im bile povjerene.

verses.text_en: And the most High shall appear upon the seat of judgment, and misery shall pass away, and the long suffering shall have an end:
verses.text_hr: Svevišnji će se pojaviti na sudačkom prijestolju; nevolja će proći i dugotrpljivosti doći kraj.

verses.text_en: But judgment only shall remain, truth shall stand, and faith shall wax strong:
verses.text_hr: Ostat će samo sud; istina će stajati, a vjera jačati.

verses.text_en: And the work shall follow, and the reward shall be shewed, and the good deeds shall be of force, and wicked deeds shall bear no rule.
verses.text_hr: Djelo će uslijediti, nagrada će se pokazati, dobra će djela imati snagu, a zla neće vladati.

verses.text_en: Then said I, Abraham prayed first for the Sodomites, and Moses for the fathers that sinned in the wilderness:
verses.text_hr: Tada sam rekao, Abraham se najprije molio za Sodomljane, a Mojsije za očeve koji su sagriješili u pustinji:

verses.text_en: And Jesus after him for Israel in the time of Achan:
verses.text_hr: Nakon njega Jošua za Izrael u Akanovo vrijeme,

verses.text_en: And Samuel and David for the destruction: and Solomon for them that should come to the sanctuary:
verses.text_hr: Samuel i David za vrijeme propasti, a Salomon za one koji će doći u svetište,

verses.text_en: And Helias for those that received rain; and for the dead, that he might live:
verses.text_hr: Ilija za one koji su primili kišu i za mrtvoga da bi oživio,

verses.text_en: And Ezechias for the people in the time of Sennacherib: and many for many.
verses.text_hr: I Ezekija za narod u vrijeme Senaheriba: i mnogi za mnoge.

verses.text_en: Even so now, seeing corruption is grown up, and wickedness increased, and the righteous have prayed for the ungodly: wherefore shall it not be so now also?
verses.text_hr: Tako je i sada, budući da je pokvarenost rasla, i zloća se povećala, a pravednici su se molili za bezbožnike: zašto i sada neće biti tako?

verses.text_en: He answered me, and said, This present life is not the end where much glory doth abide; therefore have they prayed for the weak.
verses.text_hr: Odgovorio mi je: Ovaj život nije svršetak u kojem prebiva velika slava; zato su se molili za slabe.

verses.text_en: But the day of doom shall be the end of this time, and the beginning of the immortality for to come, wherein corruption is past,
verses.text_hr: Dan osude bit će kraj ovoga vremena i početak buduće besmrtnosti, kada će raspadljivost proći,

verses.text_en: Intemperance is at an end, infidelity is cut off, righteousness is grown, and truth is sprung up.
verses.text_hr: Neumjerenosti će doći kraj, nevjera će biti odsječena, pravednost će rasti, a istina niknuti.

verses.text_en: Then shall no man be able to save him that is destroyed, nor to oppress him that hath gotten the victory.
verses.text_hr: Tada nitko neće moći spasiti onoga koji je izgubljen niti tlačiti onoga koji je izvojevao pobjedu.

verses.text_en: I answered then and said, This is my first and last saying, that it had been better not to have given the earth unto Adam: or else, when it was given him, to have restrained him from sinning.
verses.text_hr: Odgovorio sam: Ovo je moja prva i posljednja riječ: bilo bi bolje da zemlja nije bila dana Adamu ili da je, nakon što mu je dana, bio spriječen sagriješiti.

verses.text_en: For what profit is it for men now in this present time to live in heaviness, and after death to look for punishment?
verses.text_hr: Kakva je korist ljudima da sada žive u žalosti, a nakon smrti očekuju kaznu?

verses.text_en: O thou Adam, what hast thou done? for though it was thou that sinned, thou art not fallen alone, but we all that come of thee.
verses.text_hr: O ti Adame, što si učinio? Jer iako si ti sagriješio, nisi pao sam, nego svi mi koji od tebe nastajemo.

verses.text_en: For what profit is it unto us, if there be promised us an immortal time, whereas we have done the works that bring death?
verses.text_hr: Kakva nam je korist ako nam je obećano besmrtno vrijeme, dok smo činili djela koja donose smrt?

verses.text_en: And that there is promised us an everlasting hope, whereas ourselves being most wicked are made vain?
verses.text_hr: Kakva je korist što nam je obećana vječna nada, kad smo se mi, veoma zli, predali ispraznosti?

verses.text_en: And that there are laid up for us dwellings of health and safety, whereas we have lived wickedly?
verses.text_hr: I što su nam pripravljena prebivališta zdravlja i sigurnosti, kad smo živjeli opako?

verses.text_en: And that the glory of the most High is kept to defend them which have led a wary life, whereas we have walked in the most wicked ways of all?
verses.text_hr: I što se slava Svevišnjega čuva da obrani one koji su živjeli oprezno, kad smo mi hodili najgorim putovima?

verses.text_en: And that there should be shewed a paradise, whose fruit endureth for ever, wherein is security and medicine, since we shall not enter into it?
verses.text_hr: I što će se pokazati raj čiji plod traje dovijeka i u kojem su sigurnost i lijek, kad mi u njega nećemo ući?

verses.text_en: (For we have walked in unpleasant places.)
verses.text_hr: Jer hodili smo tegobnim mjestima.

verses.text_en: And that the faces of them which have used abstinence shall shine above the stars, whereas our faces shall be blacker than darkness?
verses.text_hr: I što će lica onih koji su živjeli uzdržljivo sjati jače od zvijezda, kad će naša lica biti crnja od tame?

verses.text_en: For while we lived and committed iniquity, we considered not that we should begin to suffer for it after death.
verses.text_hr: Dok smo živjeli i činili opačine, nismo mislili da ćemo nakon smrti zbog njih trpjeti.

verses.text_en: Then answered he me, and said, This is the condition of the battle, which man that is born upon the earth shall fight;
verses.text_hr: Tada mi je odgovorio: Ovo je uvjet bitke u kojoj će se boriti čovjek koji je rođen na zemlji;

verses.text_en: That, if he be overcome, he shall suffer as thou hast said: but if he get the victory, he shall receive the thing that I say.
verses.text_hr: Da će, ako bude pobijeđen, patiti kao što si rekao: ali ako dobije pobjedu, primit će ono što kažem.

verses.text_en: For this is the life whereof Moses spake unto the people while he lived, saying, Choose thee life, that thou mayest live.
verses.text_hr: Jer ovo je život o kojem je Mojsije govorio narodu dok je bio živ, govoreći: Izaberi sebi život da živiš.

verses.text_en: Nevertheless they believed not him, nor yet the prophets after him, no nor me which have spoken unto them,
verses.text_hr: Ipak nisu vjerovali njemu, ni prorocima poslije njega, ni meni koji sam im govorio,

verses.text_en: That there should not be such heaviness in their destruction, as shall be joy over them that are persuaded to salvation.
verses.text_hr: U njihovoj propasti neće biti takve žalosti kakva će biti radost nad onima koji su uvjereni u spasenje.

verses.text_en: I answered then, and said, I know, Lord, that the most High is called merciful, in that he hath mercy upon them which are not yet come into the world,
verses.text_hr: Odgovorio sam: Znam, Gospodine, da se Svevišnji naziva milosrdnim jer iskazuje milosrđe onima koji još nisu došli na svijet,

verses.text_en: And upon those also that turn to his law;
verses.text_hr: I onima koji se obrate njegovu Zakonu,

verses.text_en: And that he is patient, and long suffereth those that have sinned, as his creatures;
verses.text_hr: Da je strpljiv i dugo podnosi one koji su sagriješili, jer su njegova stvorenja,

verses.text_en: And that he is bountiful, for he is ready to give where it needeth;
verses.text_hr: Da je darežljiv i spreman dati gdje je potrebno,

verses.text_en: And that he is of great mercy, for he multiplieth more and more mercies to them that are present, and that are past, and also to them which are to come.
verses.text_hr: I da je prepun milosrđa, jer sve više umnaža milosrđe prema sadašnjima, prošlima i budućima.

verses.text_en: For if he shall not multiply his mercies, the world would not continue with them that inherit therein.
verses.text_hr: Kad ne bi umnažao svoje milosrđe, svijet ne bi opstao sa svojim baštinicima.

verses.text_en: And he pardoneth; for if he did not so of his goodness, that they which have committed iniquities might be eased of them, the ten thousandth part of men should not remain living.
verses.text_hr: On oprašta; kad u svojoj dobroti ne bi olakšavao teret onima koji su počinili opačine, ni desettisućiti dio ljudi ne bi ostao živ.

verses.text_en: And being judge, if he should not forgive them that are cured with his word, and put out the multitude of contentions,
verses.text_hr: Budući da je sudac, kad ne bi opraštao onima koje je njegova riječ izliječila i utišao mnoštvo prijepora,

verses.text_en: There should be very few left peradventure in an innumerable multitude.
verses.text_hr: Od bezbrojnoga bi mnoštva možda ostalo tek nekoliko ljudi.

verses.text_en: And he answered me, saying, The most High hath made this world for many, but the world to come for few.
verses.text_hr: Odgovorio mi je: Svevišnji je ovaj svijet stvorio za mnoge, a budući za malobrojne.

verses.text_en: I will tell thee a similitude, Esdras; As when thou askest the earth, it shall say unto thee, that it giveth much mould whereof earthen vessels are made, but little dust that gold cometh of: even so is the course of this present world.
verses.text_hr: Kazat ću ti usporedbu, Ezra. Upitaš li zemlju, reći će ti da daje mnogo gline od koje nastaju zemljane posude, ali malo praha od kojega nastaje zlato. Tako je i u ovome svijetu.

verses.text_en: There be many created, but few shall be saved.
verses.text_hr: Mnogo ih je stvoreno, ali malo će ih biti spašeno.

verses.text_en: So answered I and said, Swallow then down, O my soul, understanding, and devour wisdom.
verses.text_hr: Odgovorio sam: Upij, dušo moja, razum i proždiraj mudrost.

verses.text_en: For thou hast agreed to give ear, and art willing to prophesy: for thou hast no longer space than only to live.
verses.text_hr: Pristala si slušati i voljna si prorokovati, jer nemaš drugoga vremena osim onoga koje ti je dano živjeti.

verses.text_en: O Lord, if thou suffer not thy servant, that we may pray before thee, and thou give us seed unto our heart, and culture to our understanding, that there may come fruit of it; how shall each man live that is corrupt, who beareth the place of a man?
verses.text_hr: O Gospodine, dopusti svojemu sluzi da se moli pred tobom. Daj sjeme našemu srcu i obradu našemu razumu kako bi donijeli plod. Kako će inače živjeti svaki raspadljiv čovjek koji zauzima mjesto čovjeka?

verses.text_en: For thou art alone, and we all one workmanship of thine hands, like as thou hast said.
verses.text_hr: Jer ti si jedini, a svi smo mi jedno djelo tvojih ruku, kao što si rekao.

verses.text_en: For when the body is fashioned now in the mother’s womb, and thou givest it members, thy creature is preserved in fire and water, and nine months doth thy workmanship endure thy creature which is created in her.
verses.text_hr: Kada se tijelo oblikuje u majčinoj utrobi i ti mu daješ udove, tvoje se stvorenje čuva u ognju i vodi; devet mjeseci tvoja tvorevina nosi stvorenje oblikovano u njoj.

verses.text_en: But that which keepeth and is kept shall both be preserved: and when the time cometh, the womb preserved delivereth up the things that grew in it.
verses.text_hr: I ono što čuva i ono što je čuvano bit će sačuvano; kad dođe vrijeme, sačuvana utroba predaje ono što je u njoj raslo.

verses.text_en: For thou hast commanded out of the parts of the body, that is to say, out of the breasts, milk to be given, which is the fruit of the breasts,
verses.text_hr: Zapovjedio si da iz dijelova tijela, to jest iz dojki, poteče mlijeko, plod dojki,

verses.text_en: That the thing which is fashioned may be nourished for a time, till thou disposest it to thy mercy.
verses.text_hr: Kako bi se oblikovano stvorenje hranilo neko vrijeme, dok ga ne predaš svojemu milosrđu.

verses.text_en: Thou broughtest it up with thy righteousness, and nurturedst it in thy law, and reformedst it with thy judgment.
verses.text_hr: Odgojio si ga svojom pravednošću, othranio svojim Zakonom i obnovio svojim sudom.

verses.text_en: And thou shalt mortify it as thy creature, and quicken it as thy work.
verses.text_hr: Umrtvit ćeš ga kao svoje stvorenje i oživiti kao djelo svojih ruku.

verses.text_en: If therefore thou shalt destroy him which with so great labour was fashioned, it is an easy thing to be ordained by thy commandment, that the thing which was made might be preserved.
verses.text_hr: Ako uništiš onoga koji je oblikovan uz toliki trud, lako je tvojom zapovijedi odrediti da ono što je načinjeno bude sačuvano.

verses.text_en: Now therefore, Lord, I will speak; touching man in general, thou knowest best; but touching thy people, for whose sake I am sorry;
verses.text_hr: Sada ću, Gospodine, govoriti. Što se čovjeka općenito tiče, ti najbolje znaš; ali govorim o tvojemu narodu radi kojega tugujem,

verses.text_en: And for thine inheritance, for whose cause I mourn; and for Israel, for whom I am heavy; and for Jacob, for whose sake I am troubled;
verses.text_hr: O tvojoj baštini za kojom žalim, o Izraelu zbog kojega sam žalostan i o Jakovu zbog kojega sam uznemiren.

verses.text_en: Therefore will I begin to pray before thee for myself and for them: for I see the falls of us that dwell in the land.
