verses.text_hr: Zato ću se pred tobom početi moliti za sebe i za njih, jer vidim padove nas koji prebivamo u zemlji.

verses.text_en: But I have heard the swiftness of the judge which is to come.
verses.text_hr: Čuo sam kako brzo dolazi Sudac.

verses.text_en: Therefore hear my voice, and understand my words, and I shall speak before thee. This is the beginning of the words of Esdras, before he was taken up: and I said,
verses.text_hr: Zato čuj moj glas i razumi moje riječi, i ja ću govoriti pred tobom. Ovo je početak Esdrinih riječi, prije nego što je bio uzdignut: i ja sam rekao,

verses.text_en: O Lord, thou that dwellest in everlastingness which beholdest from above things in the heaven and in the air;
verses.text_hr: O Gospodine, ti koji prebivaš u vječnosti i odozgor gledaš ono što je na nebu i u zraku,

verses.text_en: Whose throne is inestimable; whose glory may not be comprehended; before whom the hosts of angels stand with trembling,
verses.text_hr: Čije je prijestolje neprocjenjivo i slava neshvatljiva, pred kojim čete anđela stoje dršćući,

verses.text_en: Whose service is conversant in wind and fire; whose word is true, and sayings constant; whose commandment is strong, and ordinance fearful;
verses.text_hr: Čija se služba izvršava u vjetru i ognju, čija je riječ istinita, a kazivanja postojana, čija je zapovijed snažna, a naredba strašna,

verses.text_en: Whose look drieth up the depths, and indignation maketh the mountains to melt away; which the truth witnesseth:
verses.text_hr: Čiji pogled isušuje bezdane, a gnjev topi planine — o čemu istina svjedoči —

verses.text_en: O hear the prayer of thy servant, and give ear to the petition of thy creature.
verses.text_hr: Usliši molitvu sluge svoga i poslušaj molbu stvorenja svoga.

verses.text_en: For while I live I will speak, and so long as I have understanding I will answer.
verses.text_hr: Jer dok sam živ, govorit ću, i dok god imam razuma, odgovarat ću.

verses.text_en: O look not upon the sins of thy people; but on them which serve thee in truth.
verses.text_hr: Ne gledaj na grijehe svoga naroda; nego na one koji ti služe u istini.

verses.text_en: Regard not the wicked inventions of the heathen, but the desire of those that keep thy testimonies in afflictions.
verses.text_hr: Ne obaziri se na zle izmišljotine pogana, nego na želje onih koji čuvaju tvoja svjedočanstva u nevoljama.

verses.text_en: Think not upon those that have walked feignedly before thee: but remember them, which according to thy will have known thy fear.
verses.text_hr: Ne misli na one koji su prijetvorno hodali pred tobom: već se sjeti onih koji su prema tvojoj volji upoznali strah tvoj.

verses.text_en: Let it not be thy will to destroy them which have lived like beasts; but to look upon them that have clearly taught thy law.
verses.text_hr: Neka ne bude tvoja volja uništiti one koji su živjeli poput zvijeri, nego pogledaj na one koji su jasno poučavali tvoj Zakon.

verses.text_en: Take thou no indignation at them which are deemed worse than beasts; but love them that always put their trust in thy righteousness and glory.
verses.text_hr: Ne gnjevi se na one koje smatraju gorima od zvijeri, nego ljubi one koji se uvijek uzdaju u tvoju pravednost i slavu.

verses.text_en: For we and our fathers do languish of such diseases: but because of us sinners thou shalt be called merciful.
verses.text_hr: Jer mi i naši očevi klonemo od takvih bolesti: ali zbog nas grješnika ti ćeš se zvati milosrdnim.

verses.text_en: For if thou hast a desire to have mercy upon us, thou shalt be called merciful, to us namely, that have no works of righteousness.
verses.text_hr: Jer ako nam se želiš smilovati, milosrdnim ćeš se zvati, nama, naime, koji nemamo djela pravednosti.

verses.text_en: For the just, which have many good works laid up with thee, shall out of their own deeds receive reward.
verses.text_hr: Jer pravednici, koji imaju mnoga dobra djela kod tebe, iz svojih će djela primiti plaću.

verses.text_en: For what is man, that thou shouldest take displeasure at him? or what is a corruptible generation, that thou shouldest be so bitter toward it?
verses.text_hr: Jer što je čovjek da se na njega ljutiš? Ili što je raspadljiv naraštaj da si tako ogorčen na njega?

verses.text_en: For in truth them is no man among them that be born, but he hath dealt wickedly; and among the faithful there is none which hath not done amiss.
verses.text_hr: Uistinu, među rođenima nema čovjeka koji nije činio zlo, niti među vjernima ikoga tko nije pogriješio.

verses.text_en: For in this, O Lord, thy righteousness and thy goodness shall be declared, if thou be merciful unto them which have not the confidence of good works.
verses.text_hr: U tome će se, Gospodine, pokazati tvoja pravednost i dobrota: ako budeš milosrdan prema onima koji nemaju pouzdanja u svoja dobra djela.

verses.text_en: Then answered he me, and said, Some things hast thou spoken aright, and according unto thy words it shall be.
verses.text_hr: Tada mi je odgovorio: Neke stvari si dobro rekao i bit će po tvojim riječima.

verses.text_en: For indeed I will not think on the disposition of them which have sinned before death, before judgment, before destruction:
verses.text_hr: Jer doista neću misliti na nakane onih koji su sagriješili prije smrti, suda i propasti.

verses.text_en: But I will rejoice over the disposition of the righteous, and I will remember also their pilgrimage, and the salvation, and the reward, that they shall have.
verses.text_hr: Radovat ću se nakanama pravednika i sjećati se njihova putovanja, spasenja i nagrade koju će primiti.

verses.text_en: Like as I have spoken now, so shall it come to pass.
verses.text_hr: Kao što sam sada govorio, tako će se i dogoditi.

verses.text_en: For as the husbandman soweth much seed upon the ground, and planteth many trees, and yet the thing that is sown good in his season cometh not up, neither doth all that is planted take root: even so is it of them that are sown in the world; they shall not all be saved.
verses.text_hr: Kao što ratar sije mnogo sjemena i sadi mnoga stabla, ali ne nikne sve što je dobro posijano niti se ukorijeni sve što je posađeno, tako je i s onima koji su posijani u svijetu: neće se svi spasiti.

verses.text_en: I answered then and said, If I have found grace, let me speak.
verses.text_hr: Tada sam odgovorio i rekao: Ako sam našao milost, pusti me da govorim.

verses.text_en: Like as the husbandman’s seed perisheth, if it come not up, and receive not thy rain in due season; or if there come too much rain, and corrupt it:
verses.text_hr: Kao što ratarovo sjeme propada ako ne nikne i ne primi tvoju kišu u pravo vrijeme, ili ako ga preobilna kiša uništi,

verses.text_en: Even so perisheth man also, which is formed with thy hands, and is called thine own image, because thou art like unto him, for whose sake thou hast made all things, and likened him unto the husbandman’s seed.
verses.text_hr: Tako propada i čovjek oblikovan tvojim rukama, koji se naziva tvojom slikom. Nalik si njemu; radi njega si sve stvorio i usporedio ga s ratarovim sjemenom.

verses.text_en: Be not wroth with us but spare thy people, and have mercy upon thine own inheritance: for thou art merciful unto thy creature.
verses.text_hr: Ne ljuti se na nas, nego poštedi svoj narod i smiluj se vlastitoj baštini: jer si milostiv prema svome stvorenju.

verses.text_en: Then answered he me, and said, Things present are for the present, and things to cometh for such as be to come.
verses.text_hr: Tada mi je odgovorio: Sadašnje je za sada, a ono što dolazi za ono što će doći.

verses.text_en: For thou comest far short that thou shouldest be able to love my creature more than I: but I have ofttimes drawn nigh unto thee, and unto it, but never to the unrighteous.
verses.text_hr: Daleko si od toga da možeš ljubiti moje stvorenje više od mene. Ja sam se često približavao tebi i njemu, ali nikada nepravedniku.

verses.text_en: In this also thou art marvellous before the most High:
verses.text_hr: I u tome si divan pred Svevišnjim:

verses.text_en: In that thou hast humbled thyself, as it becometh thee, and hast not judged thyself worthy to be much glorified among the righteous.
verses.text_hr: U tome što si se ponizio, kako ti dolikuje, i nisi sebe smatrao dostojnim da budeš mnogo slavljen među pravednicima.

verses.text_en: For many great miseries shall be done to them that in the latter time shall dwell in the world, because they have walked in great pride.
verses.text_hr: Mnoge će velike nevolje zadesiti one koji će u posljednje vrijeme prebivati u svijetu, jer su hodili u velikoj oholosti.

verses.text_en: But understand thou for thyself, and seek out the glory for such as be like thee.
verses.text_hr: Ali razumi ti sam i traži slavu za one koji su tebi slični.

verses.text_en: For unto you is paradise opened, the tree of life is planted, the time to come is prepared, plenteousness is made ready, a city is builded, and rest is allowed, yea, perfect goodness and wisdom.
verses.text_hr: Jer vama je raj otvoren, drvo života je posađeno, vrijeme koje dolazi je pripremljeno, obilje je pripremljeno, grad je izgrađen, a odmor je dopušten, da, savršena dobrota i mudrost.

verses.text_en: The root of evil is sealed up from you, weakness and the moth is hid from you, and corruption is fled into hell to be forgotten:
verses.text_hr: Korijen zla zapečaćen je daleko od vas, slabost i moljac od vas su skriveni, a raspadljivost je pobjegla u podzemlje da bude zaboravljena.

verses.text_en: Sorrows are passed, and in the end is shewed the treasure of immortality.
verses.text_hr: Tuge prolaze, a na kraju se pokazuje blago besmrtnosti.

verses.text_en: And therefore ask thou no more questions concerning the multitude of them that perish.
verses.text_hr: I zato ne postavljaj više pitanja o mnoštvu onih koji nestaju.

verses.text_en: For when they had taken liberty, they despised the most High, thought scorn of his law, and forsook his ways.
verses.text_hr: Jer kad su uzeli slobodu, prezreli su Svevišnjega, prezirali njegov zakon i napustili njegove putove.

verses.text_en: Moreover they have trodden down his righteous,
verses.text_hr: Štoviše, pogazili su njegova Pravednika,

verses.text_en: And said in their heart, that there is no God; yea, and that knowing they must die.
verses.text_hr: I u srcu govorili da Boga nema, premda su znali da moraju umrijeti.

verses.text_en: For as the things aforesaid shalt receive you, so thirst and pain are prepared for them: for it was not his will that men should come to nought:
verses.text_hr: Kao što će vas primiti prije spomenute stvari, tako su za njih pripravljeni žeđ i bol, jer nije bila njegova volja da ljudi propadnu.

verses.text_en: But they which be created have defiled the name of him that made them, and were unthankful unto him which prepared life for them.
verses.text_hr: Ali oni koji su stvoreni oskvrnili su ime onoga koji ih je stvorio i bili su nezahvalni onome koji im je pripremio život.

verses.text_en: And therefore is my judgment now at hand.
verses.text_hr: I stoga je moj sud sada pri ruci.

verses.text_en: These things have I not shewed unto all men, but unto thee, and a few like thee. Then answered I and said,
verses.text_hr: Ovo nisam pokazao svim ljudima, osim tebi i nekolicini tebi sličnim. Tada sam odgovorio i rekao:

verses.text_en: Behold, O Lord, now hast thou shewed me the multitude of the wonders, which thou wilt begin to do in the last times: but at what time, thou hast not shewed me.
verses.text_hr: Gle, Gospodine, sada si mi pokazao mnoštvo čudesa, koja ćeš početi činiti u posljednja vremena: ali u koje vrijeme, nisi mi pokazao.

verses.text_en: He answered me then, and said, Measure thou the time diligently in itself: and when thou seest part of the signs past, which I have told thee before,
verses.text_hr: Odgovorio mi je: Pomno mjeri vrijeme u sebi. Kad vidiš da je prošao dio znakova o kojima sam ti prije govorio,

verses.text_en: Then shalt thou understand, that it is the very same time, wherein the Highest will begin to visit the world which he made.
verses.text_hr: Tada ćeš shvatiti da je to isto vrijeme u kojem će Svevišnji početi posjećivati svijet koji je stvorio.

verses.text_en: Therefore when there shall be seen earthquakes and uproars of the people in the world:
verses.text_hr: Stoga kada se budu vidjeli potresi i pobune ljudi u svijetu:

verses.text_en: Then shalt thou well understand, that the most High spake of those things from the days that were before thee, even from the beginning.
verses.text_hr: Tada ćeš dobro razumjeti da je Svevišnji govorio o tim stvarima od dana koji su bili prije tebe, čak od početka.

verses.text_en: For like as all that is made in the world hath a beginning and an end, and the end is manifest:
verses.text_hr: Jer kao što sve što je stvoreno na svijetu ima početak i kraj, a kraj je očit:

verses.text_en: Even so the times also of the Highest have plain beginnings in wonder and powerful works, and endings in effects and signs.
verses.text_hr: Čak i vremena Svevišnjega imaju jasne početke u čudima i moćnim djelima, a završetke u učincima i znakovima.

verses.text_en: And every one that shall be saved, and shall be able to escape by his works, and by faith, whereby ye have believed,
verses.text_hr: Svatko tko se spasi i svojim djelima i vjerom u koju ste povjerovali uspije umaći,

verses.text_en: Shall be preserved from the said perils, and shall see my salvation in my land, and within my borders: for I have sanctified them for me from the beginning.
verses.text_hr: Bit će sačuvan od spomenutih opasnosti i vidjet će moje spasenje u mojoj zemlji i unutar mojih granica, koje sam posvetio sebi od početka.

verses.text_en: Then shall they be in pitiful case, which now have abused my ways: and they that have cast them away despitefully shall dwell in torments.
verses.text_hr: Tada će biti jadni oni koji sada zlorabe moje putove, a oni koji su ih svojevoljno odbacili prebivat će u mukama.

verses.text_en: For such as in their life have received benefits, and have not known me;
verses.text_hr: Jer oni koji su u životu primili dobrobiti, a mene nisu upoznali;

verses.text_en: And they that have loathed my law, while they had yet liberty, and, when as yet place of repentance was open unto them, understood not, but despised it;
verses.text_hr: I oni koji su mrzili moj zakon, dok su još imali slobodu, i, kada im je još bilo otvoreno mjesto pokajanja, nisu razumjeli, nego su ga prezirali;

verses.text_en: The same must know it after death by pain.
verses.text_hr: Oni će to nakon smrti spoznati kroz bol.

verses.text_en: And therefore be thou not curious how the ungodly shall be punished, and when: but enquire how the righteous shall be saved, whose the world is, and for whom the world is created.
verses.text_hr: Zato ne istražuj kako će i kada bezbožni biti kažnjeni, nego kako će se spasiti pravednici, kojima pripada svijet i radi kojih je stvoren.

verses.text_en: Then answered I and said,
verses.text_hr: Tada sam odgovorio i rekao,

verses.text_en: I have said before, and now do speak, and will speak it also hereafter, that there be many more of them which perish, than of them which shall be saved:
verses.text_hr: Rekao sam prije, i sada govorim, i govorit ću to i poslije, da je mnogo više onih koji će propasti, nego onih koji će se spasiti:

verses.text_en: Like as a wave is greater than a drop.
verses.text_hr: Kao što je val veći od kapi.

verses.text_en: And he answered me, saying, Like as the field is, so is also the seed; as the flowers be, such are the colours also; such as the workman is, such also is the work; and as the husbandman is himself, so is his husbandry also: for it was the time of the world.
verses.text_hr: Odgovorio mi je: Kakva je njiva, takvo je sjeme; kakvo je cvijeće, takve su boje; kakav je radnik, takav je posao; kakav je ratar, takva je obrada. Takvo je bilo vrijeme svijeta.

verses.text_en: And now when I prepared the world, which was not yet made, even for them to dwell in that now live, no man spake against me.
verses.text_hr: Kad sam pripravio svijet koji još nije bio stvoren, za one koji sada u njemu prebivaju, nitko mi se nije protivio.

verses.text_en: For then every one obeyed: but now the manners of them which are created in this world that is made are corrupted by a perpetual seed, and by a law which is unsearchable rid themselves.
verses.text_hr: Tada su svi bili poslušni; sada su navike onih koji su stvoreni u ovome svijetu iskvarene trajnim sjemenom i neistraživim zakonom.

verses.text_en: So I considered the world, and, behold, there was peril because of the devices that were come into it.
verses.text_hr: Promotrio sam svijet i vidio da mu prijeti opasnost zbog nakana koje su u njega ušle.

verses.text_en: And I saw, and spared it greatly, and have kept me a grape of the cluster, and a plant of a great people.
verses.text_hr: Vidio sam to i veoma ga poštedio; sačuvao sam sebi grozd iz vinograda i sadnicu velikoga naroda.

verses.text_en: Let the multitude perish then, which was born in vain; and let my grape be kept, and my plant; for with great labour have I made it perfect.
verses.text_hr: Neka propadne mnoštvo koje se uzalud rodilo, a moj grozd i moja sadnica neka budu sačuvani, jer sam ih uz velik trud doveo do savršenstva.

verses.text_en: Nevertheless, if thou wilt cease yet seven days more, (but thou shalt not fast in them,
verses.text_hr: Ako se povučeš još sedam dana — ali u njima nemoj postiti —

verses.text_en: But go into a field of flowers, where no house is builded, and eat only the flowers of the field; taste no flesh, drink no wine, but eat flowers only;)
verses.text_hr: Pođi u cvjetno polje gdje nema sagrađene kuće i jedi samo poljsko cvijeće. Ne kušaj meso i ne pij vino, nego jedi samo cvijeće.

verses.text_en: And pray unto the Highest continually, then will I come and talk with thee.
verses.text_hr: I neprestano se moli Svevišnjem, tada ću doći i razgovarati s tobom.

verses.text_en: So I went my way into the field which is called Ardath, like as he commanded me; and there I sat among the flowers, and did eat of the herbs of the field, and the meat of the same satisfied me.
verses.text_hr: Pošao sam u polje zvano Ardat, kako mi je zapovjedio. Sjeo sam među cvijeće, jeo poljsko bilje i tom se hranom nasitio.

verses.text_en: After seven days I sat upon the grass, and my heart was vexed within me, like as before:
verses.text_hr: Nakon sedam dana sjedio sam na travi, a srce mi je bilo uznemireno kao prije:

verses.text_en: And I opened my mouth, and began to talk before the most High, and said,
verses.text_hr: Otvorio sam usta i počeo govoriti pred Svevišnjim:

verses.text_en: O Lord, thou that shewest thyself unto us, thou wast shewed unto our fathers in the wilderness, in a place where no man treadeth, in a barren place, when they came out of Egypt.
verses.text_hr: O Gospodine, ti koji nam se javljaš, pokazao si se našim očevima u pustinji, na mjestu gdje nitko ne kroči, na neplodnom mjestu, kad su izašli iz Egipta.

verses.text_en: And thou spakest saying, Hear me, O Israel; and mark my words, thou seed of Jacob.
verses.text_hr: Govorio si: Čuj me, Izraele, i zapamti moje riječi, Jakovljevo potomstvo.

verses.text_en: For, behold, I sow my law in you, and it shall bring fruit in you, and ye shall be honoured in it for ever.
verses.text_hr: Jer, evo, sijem svoj zakon u vas, i on će donijeti plod u vama, i bit ćete u njemu čašćeni zauvijek.

verses.text_en: But our fathers, which received the law, kept it not, and observed not thy ordinances: and though the fruit of thy law did not perish, neither could it, for it was thine;
verses.text_hr: Ali naši oci, koji su primili Zakon, nisu ga čuvali ni obdržavali tvoje uredbe. Plod tvojega Zakona nije nestao niti je mogao nestati, jer je bio tvoj.

verses.text_en: Yet they that received it perished, because they kept not the thing that was sown in them.
verses.text_hr: Ali oni koji su ga primili propali su, jer nisu sačuvali što je u njima posijano.

verses.text_en: And, lo, it is a custom, when the ground hath received seed, or the sea a ship, or any vessel meat or drink, that, that being perished wherein it was sown or cast into,
verses.text_hr: Uobičajeno je da, kad zemlja primi sjeme, more brod, ili posuda hranu ili piće, nestane ono u čemu je nešto posijano ili pohranjeno,

verses.text_en: That thing also which was sown, or cast therein, or received, doth perish, and remaineth not with us: but with us it hath not happened so.
verses.text_hr: Dok posijano, bačeno ili primljeno ostaje. Ali s nama se nije tako dogodilo.

verses.text_en: For we that have received the law perish by sin, and our heart also which received it
verses.text_hr: Mi koji smo primili Zakon propadamo zbog grijeha, kao i naše srce koje ga je primilo,

verses.text_en: Notwithstanding the law perisheth not, but remaineth in his force.
verses.text_hr: Usprkos tome, zakon ne nestaje, nego ostaje u svojoj sili.

verses.text_en: And when I spake these things in my heart, I looked back with mine eyes, and upon the right side I saw a woman, and, behold, she mourned and wept with a loud voice, and was much grieved in heart, and her clothes were rent, and she had ashes upon her head.
verses.text_hr: Dok sam tako razmišljao, okrenuo sam se i s desne strane ugledao ženu. Tugovala je i glasno plakala, srce joj je bilo silno ožalošćeno, odjeća razderana, a glava posuta pepelom.

verses.text_en: Then let I my thoughts go that I was in, and turned me unto her,
verses.text_hr: Napustio sam svoje misli i okrenuo se prema njoj.

verses.text_en: And said unto her, Wherefore weepest thou? why art thou so grieved in thy mind?
verses.text_hr: Rekao sam joj: Zašto plačeš? Zašto si tako tužna u duši?

verses.text_en: And she said unto me, Sir, let me alone, that I may bewail myself, and add unto my sorrow, for I am sore vexed in my mind, and brought very low.
verses.text_hr: Odgovorila mi je: Gospodaru, pusti me da sama oplakujem i umnožim svoju žalost, jer sam u duši veoma uznemirena i duboko ponižena.

verses.text_en: And I said unto her, What aileth thee? tell me.
verses.text_hr: Upitao sam je: Što ti je? Reci mi.

verses.text_en: She said unto me, I thy servant have been barren, and had no child, though I had an husband thirty years,
verses.text_hr: Rekla mi je: Ja, tvoja službenica, bila sam nerotkinja i nisam imala djeteta, premda sam trideset godina imala muža.

verses.text_en: And those thirty years I did nothing else day and night, and every hour, but make my, prayer to the Highest.
verses.text_hr: I tih trideset godina ništa drugo nisam radila danju i noću, i svakoga sata, nego sam se molila Svevišnjemu.

verses.text_en: After thirty years God heard me thine handmaid, looked upon my misery, considered my trouble, and gave me a son: and I was very glad of him, so was my husband also, and all my neighbours: and we gave great honour unto the Almighty.
verses.text_hr: Nakon trideset godina Bog je uslišio svoju službenicu, pogledao moju bijedu, vidio moju nevolju i dao mi sina. Veoma sam mu se radovala, kao i moj muž i svi susjedi, a Svemogućemu smo iskazali veliku čast.

verses.text_en: And I nourished him with great travail.
verses.text_hr: I odgajala sam ga uz velike muke.

verses.text_en: So when he grew up, and came to the time that he should have a wife, I made a feast.
verses.text_hr: Kad je odrastao i došlo vrijeme da uzme ženu, pripravila sam svadbenu gozbu.

verses.text_en: And it so came to pass, that when my son was entered into his wedding chamber, he fell down, and died.
verses.text_hr: I dogodilo se da kad je moj sin ušao u svoju svadbenu odaju, pao je i umro.

verses.text_en: Then we all overthrew the lights, and all my neighbours rose up to comfort me: so I took my rest unto the second day at night.
verses.text_hr: Tada smo svi pogasili svjetla, a svi su moji susjedi ustali da me tješe. Tako sam počivala do noći drugoga dana.

verses.text_en: And it came to pass, when they had all left off to comfort me, to the end I might be quiet; then rose I up by night and fled, and came hither into this field, as thou seest.
verses.text_hr: I dogodi se, kad su svi otišli da me tješe, da bih mogao biti na miru; tada sam ustao noću i pobjegao, i došao ovamo u ovo polje, kao što vidiš.

verses.text_en: And I do now purpose not to return into the city, but here to stay, and neither to eat nor drink, but continually to mourn and to fast until I die.
verses.text_hr: I sada se ne namjeravam vratiti u grad, nego ostati ovdje, i ne jesti ni piti, nego neprestano tugovati i postiti dok ne umrem.

verses.text_en: Then left I the meditations wherein I was, and spake to her in anger, saying,
verses.text_hr: Napustio sam razmišljanja kojima sam bio zaokupljen i ljutito joj se obratio:

verses.text_en: Thou foolish woman above all other, seest thou not our mourning, and what happeneth unto us?
verses.text_hr: Ti, najnerazumnija od svih žena, zar ne vidiš našu žalost, i što se s nama događa?

verses.text_en: How that Sion our mother is full of all heaviness, and much humbled, mourning very sore?
verses.text_hr: Zar ne vidiš kako je Sion, naša majka, ispunjena svakom tugom, duboko ponižena i u gorkoj žalosti?

verses.text_en: And now, seeing we all mourn and are sad, for we are all in heaviness, art thou grieved for one son?
verses.text_hr: A sada, gledajući da svi tugujemo i tužni smo, jer svi smo u nevolji, tuguješ li zbog jednoga sina?

verses.text_en: For ask the earth, and she shall tell thee, that it is she which ought to mourn for the fall of so many that grow upon her.
verses.text_hr: Upitaj zemlju i reći će ti da upravo ona treba oplakivati pad tolikih koji na njoj rastu.

verses.text_en: For out of her came all at the first, and out of her shall all others come, and, behold, they walk almost all into destruction, and a multitude of them is utterly rooted out.
verses.text_hr: Iz nje su u početku svi izišli i iz nje će izići svi budući; a gle, gotovo svi idu u propast i veliko je mnoštvo posve iskorijenjeno.

verses.text_en: Who then should make more mourning than she, that hath lost so great a multitude; and not thou, which art sorry but for one?
verses.text_hr: Tko bi trebao više tugovati od nje, koja je izgubila tako veliko mnoštvo, a ne ti koja žališ samo za jednim?

verses.text_en: But if thou sayest unto me, My lamentation is not like the earth’s, because I have lost the fruit of my womb, which I brought forth with pains, and bare with sorrows;
verses.text_hr: Ali ako mi kažeš: Moje jadikovanje nije kao zemaljsko, jer sam izgubila plod svoje utrobe, koji sam u bolovima rodila i s tugom nosila;

verses.text_en: But the earth not so: for the multitude present in it according to the course of the earth is gone, as it came:
verses.text_hr: Ali sa zemljom nije tako: mnoštvo koje je na njoj prisutno, prema zemaljskomu tijeku, odlazi kao što je došlo.

verses.text_en: Then say I unto thee, Like as thou hast brought forth with labour; even so the earth also hath given her fruit, namely, man, ever since the beginning unto him that made her.
verses.text_hr: Tada ti kažem: kao što si ti rodila uz trud, tako i zemlja od početka daje svoj plod — čovjeka — onomu koji ju je stvorio.

verses.text_en: Now therefore keep thy sorrow to thyself, and bear with a good courage that which hath befallen thee.
verses.text_hr: Sada, dakle, zadrži svoju tugu za sebe i hrabro podnosi ono što te snašlo.

verses.text_en: For if thou shalt acknowledge the determination of God to be just, thou shalt both receive thy son in time, and shalt be commended among women.
verses.text_hr: Ako priznaš da je Božja odluka pravedna, svojega ćeš sina primiti u određeno vrijeme i bit ćeš pohvaljena među ženama.

verses.text_en: Go thy way then into the city to thine husband.
verses.text_hr: Idi dakle u grad svome mužu.

verses.text_en: And she said unto me, That will I not do: I will not go into the city, but here will I die.
verses.text_hr: A ona mi je rekla: To neću učiniti: neću ići u grad, ali ću ovdje umrijeti.

verses.text_en: So I proceeded to speak further unto her, and said,
verses.text_hr: Pa sam nastavio razgovarati s njom i rekao:

verses.text_en: Do not so, but be counselled. by me: for how many are the adversities of Sion? be comforted in regard of the sorrow of Jerusalem.
verses.text_hr: Ne čini tako, nego poslušaj moj savjet. Pomisli na nevolje Siona i utješi se s obzirom na žalost Jeruzalema.

verses.text_en: For thou seest that our sanctuary is laid waste, our altar broken down, our temple destroyed;
verses.text_hr: Jer ti vidiš da je naše svetište opustošeno, naš žrtvenik razvaljen, naš hram uništen;

verses.text_en: Our psaltery is laid on the ground, our song is put to silence, our rejoicing is at an end, the light of our candlestick is put out, the ark of our covenant is spoiled, our holy things are defiled, and the name that is called upon us is almost profaned: our children are put to shame, our priests are burnt, our Levites are gone into captivity, our virgins are defiled, and our wives ravished; our righteous men carried away, our little ones destroyed, our young men are brought in bondage, and our strong men are become weak;
verses.text_hr: Naš psaltir leži na zemlji, naša je pjesma utihnula, našemu je veselju došao kraj, svjetlost našega svijećnjaka ugašena je, Kovčeg našega saveza opljačkan, svetinje oskvrnjene, a ime kojim smo nazvani gotovo obeščašćeno. Naša su djeca posramljena, svećenici spaljeni, leviti odvedeni u sužanjstvo, djevice oskvrnjene, žene silovane, pravednici odvedeni, maleni uništeni, mladići porobljeni, a snažni oslabjeli.

verses.text_en: And, which is the greatest of all, the seal of Sion hath now lost her honour; for she is delivered into the hands of them that hate us.
verses.text_hr: Najgore od svega, Sionski je pečat izgubio svoju čast jer je predan u ruke onima koji nas mrze.

verses.text_en: And therefore shake off thy great heaviness, and put away the multitude of sorrows, that the Mighty may be merciful unto thee again, and the Highest shall give thee rest and ease from thy labour.
verses.text_hr: Zato otresi svoju silnu tugu i odbaci mnoštvo žalosti, da ti Silni ponovno iskaže milosrđe i Svevišnji podari počinak i olakšanje od truda.

verses.text_en: And it came to pass while I was talking with her, behold, her face upon a sudden shined exceedingly, and her countenance glistered, so that I was afraid of her, and mused what it might be.
verses.text_hr: I dok sam s njom razgovarao, gle, njezino lice iznenada silno zasja, a lice joj zablista, tako da sam je se uplašio i razmišljao što bi to moglo biti.

verses.text_en: And, behold, suddenly she made a great cry very fearful: so that the earth shook at the noise of the woman.
verses.text_hr: I gle, iznenada je jako i strašno zavapila: tako da se zemlja zatresla od ženine buke.

verses.text_en: And I looked, and, behold, the woman appeared unto me no more, but there was a city builded, and a large place shewed itself from the foundations: then was I afraid, and cried with a loud voice, and said,
verses.text_hr: Pogledao sam: žena mi se više nije ukazivala, nego je preda mnom stajao izgrađen grad i pokazivao se širok prostor njegovih temelja. Prestrašio sam se i povikao iz svega glasa:

verses.text_en: Where is Uriel the angel, who came unto me at the first? for he hath caused me to fall into many trances, and mine end is turned into corruption, and my prayer to rebuke.
verses.text_hr: Gdje je anđeo Uriel, koji mi je prvi došao? On me bacio u tolike zanose; moja se nakana pretvorila u propast, a molitva u prijekor.

verses.text_en: And as I was speaking these words behold, he came unto me, and looked upon me.
verses.text_hr: I dok sam govorio ove riječi, gle, došao je do mene i pogledao me.

verses.text_en: And, lo, I lay as one that had been dead, and mine understanding was taken from me: and he took me by the right hand, and comforted me, and set me upon my feet, and said unto me,
verses.text_hr: I gle, ležao sam kao mrtav, i razum mi je bio oduzet; i on me uhvatio za desnu ruku, utješio me, postavio me na noge i rekao mi:

verses.text_en: What aileth thee? and why art thou so disquieted? and why is thine understanding troubled, and the thoughts of thine heart?
verses.text_hr: Što ti je? Zašto si tako uznemiren? Zašto su ti razum i misli srca smeteni?

verses.text_en: And I said, Because thou hast forsaken me, and yet I did according to thy words, and I went into the field, and, lo, I have seen, and yet see, that I am not able to express.
verses.text_hr: Odgovorio sam: Zato što si me napustio. Postupio sam prema tvojim riječima i otišao u polje, a ondje sam vidio i još gledam ono što ne mogu izraziti.

verses.text_en: And he said unto me, Stand up manfully, and I will advise thee.
verses.text_hr: Rekao mi je: Ustani hrabro, a ja ću te poučiti.

verses.text_en: Then said I, Speak on, my lord, in me; only forsake me not, lest I die frustrate of my hope.
verses.text_hr: Tada sam rekao: Govori mi, gospodaru; samo me ne napuštaj, da ne umrem razočaran zbog svoje nade.

verses.text_en: For I have seen that I knew not, and hear that I do not know.
verses.text_hr: Jer vidio sam ono što nisam poznavao i čuo ono što ne razumijem.

verses.text_en: Or is my sense deceived, or my soul in a dream?
verses.text_hr: Ili su moja osjetila zavarana, ili mi duša sanja?

verses.text_en: Now therefore I beseech thee that thou wilt shew thy servant of this vision.
verses.text_hr: Sada te molim da svome sluzi pokažeš ovo viđenje.

verses.text_en: He answered me then, and said, Hear me, and I shall inform thee, and tell thee wherefore thou art afraid: for the Highest will reveal many secret things unto thee.
verses.text_hr: Odgovorio mi je: Slušaj me; poučit ću te i objasniti zašto se bojiš. Svevišnji će ti otkriti mnoge tajne.

verses.text_en: He hath seen that thy way is right: for that thou sorrowest continually for thy people, and makest great lamentation for Sion.
verses.text_hr: Vidio je da je tvoj put ispravan jer neprestano tuguješ za svojim narodom i duboko oplakuješ Sion.

verses.text_en: This therefore is the meaning of the vision which thou lately sawest:
verses.text_hr: Ovo je dakle značenje vizije koju si nedavno vidio:

verses.text_en: Thou sawest a woman mourning, and thou begannest to comfort her:
verses.text_hr: Vidio si ženu kako tuguje i počeo si je tješiti:

verses.text_en: But now seest thou the likeness of the woman no more, but there appeared unto thee a city builded.
verses.text_hr: Sada više ne vidiš obličje žene, nego ti se ukazao izgrađen grad.

verses.text_en: And whereas she told thee of the death of her son, this is the solution:
verses.text_hr: Ovo je tumačenje onoga što ti je rekla o smrti svojega sina:

verses.text_en: This woman, whom thou sawest is Sion: and whereas she said unto thee, even she whom thou seest as a city builded,
verses.text_hr: Žena koju si vidio jest Sion; glede onoga što ti je rekla ona koju sada vidiš kao izgrađen grad,

verses.text_en: Whereas, I say, she said unto thee, that she hath been thirty years barren: those are the thirty years wherein there was no offering made in her.
verses.text_hr: Da je bila nerotkinja trideset godina: to su trideset godina u kojima se u njoj nije prinosila žrtva.

verses.text_en: But after thirty years Solomon builded the city and offered offerings: and then bare the barren a son.
verses.text_hr: Ali nakon trideset godina Salomon je sagradio grad i prinio žrtve: i tada je nerotkinja rodila sina.

verses.text_en: And whereas she told thee that she nourished him with labour: that was the dwelling in Jerusalem.
verses.text_hr: A to što ti je rekla da ga je othranila uz trud označava prebivanje u Jeruzalemu.

verses.text_en: But whereas she said unto thee, That my son coming into his marriage chamber happened to have a fail, and died: this was the destruction that came to Jerusalem.
verses.text_hr: A to što je rekla da joj je sin pao i umro ulazeći u bračnu odaju označava propast koja je zadesila Jeruzalem.

verses.text_en: And, behold, thou sawest her likeness, and because she mourned for her son, thou begannest to comfort her: and of these things which have chanced, these are to be opened unto thee.
verses.text_hr: Vidio si njezin lik i počeo je tješiti dok je tugovala za sinom; sada ti se otkriva značenje onoga što se dogodilo.

verses.text_en: For now the most High seeth that thou art grieved unfeignedly, and sufferest from thy whole heart for her, so hath he shewed thee the brightness of her glory, and the comeliness of her beauty:
verses.text_hr: Svevišnji vidi da iskreno tuguješ i svim srcem patiš za njom, pa ti je pokazao sjaj njezine slave i krasotu njezine ljepote.

verses.text_en: And therefore I bade thee remain in the field where no house was builded:
verses.text_hr: I zato sam ti zapovjedio da ostaneš u polju gdje nije sagrađena kuća:

verses.text_en: For I knew that the Highest would shew this unto thee.
verses.text_hr: Jer sam znao da će ti Svevišnji ovo pokazati.

verses.text_en: Therefore I commanded thee to go into the field, where no foundation of any building was.
verses.text_hr: Zato sam ti zapovjedio da odeš u polje, gdje nije bilo temelja ni jednoj zgradi.

verses.text_en: For in the place wherein the Highest beginneth to shew his city, there can no man’s building be able to stand.
verses.text_hr: Na mjestu gdje Svevišnji počinje pokazivati svoj grad ne može stajati nijedna ljudska građevina.

verses.text_en: And therefore fear not, let not thine heart be affrighted, but go thy way in, and see the beauty and greatness of the building, as much as thine eyes be able to see:
verses.text_hr: Zato se ne boj i ne plaši u srcu. Uđi i pogledaj ljepotu i veličinu građevine koliko je tvoje oči mogu obuhvatiti.

verses.text_en: And then shalt thou hear as much as thine ears may comprehend.
verses.text_hr: I tada ćeš čuti onoliko koliko tvoje uši mogu shvatiti.

verses.text_en: For thou art blessed above many other, and art called with the Highest; and so are but few.
verses.text_hr: Blagoslovljen si više od mnogih i pozvan si k Svevišnjemu, kao samo malobrojni.

verses.text_en: But to morrow at night thou shalt remain here;
verses.text_hr: Ali sutra navečer ostat ćeš ovdje;

verses.text_en: And so shall the Highest shew thee visions of the high things, which the most High will do unto them that dwell upon the earth in the last days. So I slept that night and another, like as he commanded me.
verses.text_hr: Svevišnji će ti pokazati viđenja uzvišenih stvari koje će u posljednjim danima učiniti stanovnicima zemlje. Spavao sam te noći i sljedeće, kako mi je zapovjedio.

verses.text_en: Then saw I a dream, and, behold, there came up from the sea an eagle, which had twelve feathered wings, and three heads.
verses.text_hr: Tada sam vidio san, i gle, iz mora je izašao orao, koji je imao dvanaest pernatih krila i tri glave.

verses.text_en: And I saw, and, behold, she spread her wings over all the earth, and all the winds of the air blew on her, and were gathered together.
verses.text_hr: Vidio sam, i gle, raširi krila po svoj zemlji, i svi vjetrovi nebeski zapuhali su prema njemu i skupili se.

verses.text_en: And I beheld, and out of her feathers there grew other contrary feathers; and they became little feathers and small.
verses.text_hr: Vidio sam kako su iz njegova perja izrasla druga, suprotna pera; postala su sitna i kratka.

verses.text_en: But her heads were at rest: the head in the midst was greater than the other, yet rested it with the residue.
verses.text_hr: Ali njegove su glave mirovale. Srednja je glava bila veća od drugih, ali je i ona mirovala zajedno s njima.

verses.text_en: Moreover I beheld, and, lo, the eagle flew with her feathers, and reigned upon earth, and over them that dwelt therein.
verses.text_hr: Nadalje sam vidio, i gle, orao leti sa svojim perjem i vlada nad zemljom i nad onima koji prebivaju na njoj.

verses.text_en: And I saw that all things under heaven were subject unto her, and no man spake against her, no, not one creature upon earth.
verses.text_hr: Vidio sam da mu je bilo podložno sve pod nebom; nitko mu se nije protivio, nijedno stvorenje na zemlji.

verses.text_en: And I beheld, and, lo, the eagle rose upon her talons, and spake to her feathers, saying,
verses.text_hr: Pogledao sam, i gle, orao se podigao na kandžama i rekao svojemu perju:

verses.text_en: Watch not all at once: sleep every one in his own place, and watch by course:
verses.text_hr: Ne bdijte svi odjednom: spavajte svatko na svome mjestu i bdijte redom:

verses.text_en: But let the heads be preserved for the last.
verses.text_hr: Ali neka se glave sačuvaju za kraj.

verses.text_en: And I beheld, and, lo, the voice went not out of her heads, but from the midst of her body.
verses.text_hr: Vidio sam, i gle, glas ne izlazi iz njezinih glava, nego iz sredine njezina tijela.

verses.text_en: And I numbered her contrary feathers, and, behold, there were eight of them.
verses.text_hr: Izbrojio sam njegova suprotna pera, i gle, bilo ih je osam.

verses.text_en: And I looked, and, behold, on the right side there arose one feather, and reigned over all the earth;
verses.text_hr: Pogledao sam, i gle, s desne se strane podiglo jedno pero i zavladalo svom zemljom.

verses.text_en: And so it was, that when it reigned, the end of it came, and the place thereof appeared no more: so the next following stood up. and reigned, and had a great time;
verses.text_hr: Kad je zavladalo, došao mu je kraj i više mu se nije vidjelo mjesta. Zatim se podiglo sljedeće, zavladalo i dugo potrajalo.

verses.text_en: And it happened, that when it reigned, the end of it came also, like as the first, so that it appeared no more.
verses.text_hr: Kad je ono zavladalo, i njemu je, kao prvomu, došao kraj te se više nije pojavljivalo.

verses.text_en: Then came there a voice unto it, and said,
verses.text_hr: Tada mu se začuo glas koji je rekao:

verses.text_en: Hear thou that hast borne rule over the earth so long: this I say unto thee, before thou beginnest to appear no more,
verses.text_hr: Čuj, ti koji si tako dugo vladao zemljom. Ovo ti govorim prije nego što posve nestaneš:

verses.text_en: There shall none after thee attain unto thy time, neither unto the half thereof.
verses.text_hr: Nitko nakon tebe neće dosegnuti trajanje tvoje vladavine, čak ni polovicu toga vremena.

verses.text_en: Then arose the third, and reigned as the other before, and appeared no more also.
verses.text_hr: Tada se podiglo treće pero, zavladalo poput prethodnih i također nestalo.

verses.text_en: So went it with all the residue one after another, as that every one reigned, and then appeared no more.
verses.text_hr: Tako je bilo i sa svima preostalima, jednim za drugim: svako je zavladalo, a zatim nestalo.

verses.text_en: Then I beheld, and, lo, in process of time the feathers that followed stood up upon the right side, that they might rule also; and some of them ruled, but within a while they appeared no more:
verses.text_hr: Potom sam vidio kako su se, s vremenom, sljedeća pera podizala s desne strane da i ona zavladaju. Neka su vladala, ali su ubrzo nestala.

verses.text_en: For some of them were set up, but ruled not.
verses.text_hr: Neka su se podigla, ali nisu zavladala.

verses.text_en: After this I looked, and, behold, the twelve feathers appeared no more, nor the two little feathers:
verses.text_hr: Nakon toga pogledao sam, i gle, dvanaest pera i ona dva mala pera više se nisu pojavljivali.

verses.text_en: And there was no more upon the eagle’s body, but three heads that rested, and six little wings.
verses.text_hr: Na tijelu orla više nije bilo ništa, osim tri glave koje su počivale i šest malih krila.

verses.text_en: Then saw I also that two little feathers divided themselves from the six, and remained under the head that was upon the right side: for the four continued in their place.
verses.text_hr: Tada sam također vidio da su se dva mala pera odvojila od šest, i ostala ispod glave koja je bila na desnoj strani: jer su četiri ostala na svom mjestu.

verses.text_en: And I beheld, and, lo, the feathers that were under the wing thought to set up themselves and to have the rule.
verses.text_hr: Pogledao sam, i gle, pera pod krilom namjeravala su se podići i zavladati.

verses.text_en: And I beheld, and, lo, there was one set up, but shortly it appeared no more.
verses.text_hr: Pogledao sam, i gle, jedno se podiglo, ali je ubrzo nestalo.

verses.text_en: And the second was sooner away than the first.
verses.text_hr: Drugo je nestalo još brže od prvoga.

verses.text_en: And I beheld, and, lo, the two that remained thought also in themselves to reign:
verses.text_hr: Pogledao sam, i gle, dva preostala pera također su u sebi naumila zavladati.

verses.text_en: And when they so thought, behold, there awaked one of the heads that were at rest, namely, it that was in the midst; for that was greater than the two other heads.
verses.text_hr: Dok su tako mislila, gle, probudila se jedna od glava koje su mirovale, ona srednja; bila je veća od drugih dviju glava.

verses.text_en: And then I saw that the two other heads were joined with it.
verses.text_hr: Tada sam vidio da su joj se pridružile druge dvije glave.

verses.text_en: And, behold, the head was turned with them that were with it, and did eat up the two feathers under the wing that would have reigned.
verses.text_hr: I gle, glava se okrenula zajedno s onima koje su bile uz nju te proždrla dva pera pod krilom koja su htjela zavladati.

verses.text_en: But this head put the whole earth in fear, and bare rule in it over all those that dwelt upon the earth with much oppression; and it had the governance of the world more than all the wings that had been.
verses.text_hr: Ta je glava zastrašila svu zemlju i uz veliko tlačenje zavladala svim njezinim stanovnicima; imala je veću vlast nad svijetom od svih prijašnjih krila.

verses.text_en: And after this I beheld, and, lo, the head that was in the midst suddenly appeared no more, like as the wings.
verses.text_hr: Nakon toga sam vidio, i gle, srednja je glava iznenada nestala, kao i krila.

verses.text_en: But there remained the two heads, which also in like sort ruled upon the earth, and over those that dwelt therein.
verses.text_hr: Ali ostale su dvije glave, koje su također na sličan način vladale zemljom i onima koji su na njoj prebivali.

verses.text_en: And I beheld, and, lo, the head upon the right side devoured it that was upon the left side.
verses.text_hr: Pogledao sam, i gle, glava s desne strane proždrla je onu s lijeve.

verses.text_en: Then I head a voice, which said unto me, Look before thee, and consider the thing that thou seest.
verses.text_hr: Tada sam začuo glas koji mi je rekao: Pogledaj pred sebe i razmotri ono što vidiš.

verses.text_en: And I beheld, and lo, as it were a roaring lion chased out of the wood: and I saw that he sent out a man’s voice unto the eagle, and said,
verses.text_hr: Pogledao sam, i gle, pojavio se kao ričući lav koji je izišao iz šume. Vidio sam da je ljudskim glasom progovorio orlu:

verses.text_en: Hear thou, I will talk with thee, and the Highest shall say unto thee,
verses.text_hr: Čuj! Govorit ću s tobom, a Svevišnji će ti reći:

verses.text_en: Art not thou it that remainest of the four beasts, whom I made to reign in my world, that the end of their times might come through them?
verses.text_hr: Nisi li ti ona preostala od četiriju zvijeri koje sam postavio da vladaju mojim svijetom, kako bi preko njih došao kraj njihovim vremenima?

verses.text_en: And the fourth came, and overcame all the beasts that were past, and had power over the world with great fearfulness, and over the whole compass of the earth with much wicked oppression; and so long time dwelt he upon the earth with deceit.
verses.text_hr: Četvrta je došla, svladala sve prijašnje zvijeri i s velikim strahom zavladala svijetom, a sa silnim opakim tlačenjem čitavim prostranstvom zemlje; tako je dugo prijevarno prebivala na zemlji.

verses.text_en: For the earth hast thou not judged with truth.
verses.text_hr: Jer zemlji nisi sudio po istini.

verses.text_en: For thou hast afflicted the meek, thou hast hurt the peaceable, thou hast loved liars, and destroyed the dwellings of them that brought forth fruit, and hast cast down the walls of such as did thee no harm.
verses.text_hr: Tlačila si krotke, nanosila zlo miroljubivima, ljubila lašce, uništavala domove plodonosnih i rušila zidine onih koji ti nisu naudili.

verses.text_en: Therefore is thy wrongful dealing come up unto the Highest, and thy pride unto the Mighty.
verses.text_hr: Zato je tvoje nepravedno postupanje doprlo do Svevišnjega, a tvoja oholost do Silnoga.

verses.text_en: The Highest also hath looked upon the proud times, and, behold, they are ended, and his abominations are fulfilled.
verses.text_hr: Svevišnji je pogledao i ohola vremena; gle, ona su završila i gadosti su dosegle svoju puninu.

verses.text_en: And therefore appear no more, thou eagle, nor thy horrible wings, nor thy wicked feathers nor thy malicious heads, nor thy hurtful claws, nor all thy vain body:
verses.text_hr: Zato se više ne pojavljuj, orle: ni tvoja strašna krila, ni tvoja opaka pera, ni tvoje zlobne glave, ni tvoje pogubne pandže, ni sve tvoje isprazno tijelo.

verses.text_en: That all the earth may be refreshed, and may return, being delivered from thy violence, and that she may hope for the judgment and mercy of him that made her.
verses.text_hr: Neka se sva zemlja okrijepi i, oslobođena tvojega nasilja, vrati svojemu miru te se uzda u sud i milosrđe onoga koji ju je stvorio.

verses.text_en: And it came to pass, whiles the lion spake these words unto the eagle, I saw,
verses.text_hr: I dogodi se, dok je lav govorio ove riječi orlu, vidio sam,

verses.text_en: And, behold, the head that remained and the four wings appeared no more, and the two went unto it and set themselves up to reign, and their kingdom was small, and fill of uproar.
verses.text_hr: I gle, nestali su preostala glava i četiri krila; ona dva pera prišla su joj i postavila se da vladaju, ali njihovo je kraljevstvo bilo maleno i puno meteža.

verses.text_en: And I saw, and, behold, they appeared no more, and the whole body of the eagle was burnt so that the earth was in great fear: then awaked I out of the trouble and trance of my mind, and from great fear, and said unto my spirit,
verses.text_hr: Vidio sam, i gle, i ona su nestala, a čitavo je tijelo orla izgorjelo, tako da je zemlju obuzeo velik strah. Tada sam se, silno prestrašen, probudio iz duševne smetenosti i zanosa te rekao svojemu duhu:

verses.text_en: Lo, this hast thou done unto me, in that thou searchest out the ways of the Highest.
verses.text_hr: Evo, ovo si mi učinio, tražeći puteve Svevišnjega.

verses.text_en: Lo, yet am I weary in my mind, and very weak in my spirit; and little strength is there in me, for the great fear wherewith I was afflicted this night.
verses.text_hr: Gle, um mi je još iscrpljen, duh veoma slab, a u meni je malo snage zbog silnoga straha koji me ove noći obuzeo.

verses.text_en: Therefore will I now beseech the Highest, that he will comfort me unto the end.
verses.text_hr: Zato ću sada moliti Svevišnjega, da me utješi do kraja.

verses.text_en: And I said, Lord that bearest rule, if I have found grace before thy sight, and if I am justified with thee before many others, and if my prayer indeed be come up before thy face;
verses.text_hr: Rekao sam: Gospodine, Vladaru, ako sam našao milost pred tobom, ako si me opravdao više od mnogih drugih i ako je moja molitva doista doprla pred tvoje lice,

verses.text_en: Comfort me then, and shew me thy servant the interpretation and plain difference of this fearful vision, that thou mayest perfectly comfort my soul.
verses.text_hr: Utješi me i pokaži svojemu sluzi jasno tumačenje ovoga strašnog viđenja, kako bi potpuno utješio moju dušu.

verses.text_en: For thou hast judged me worthy to shew me the last times.
verses.text_hr: Jer ti si me ocijenio dostojnim da mi pokažeš posljednja vremena.

verses.text_en: And he said unto me, This is the interpretation of the vision:
verses.text_hr: Odgovorio mi je: Ovo je tumačenje viđenja:

verses.text_en: The eagle, whom thou sawest come up from the sea, is the kingdom which was seen in the vision of thy brother Daniel.
verses.text_hr: Orao kojega si vidio kako izlazi iz mora kraljevstvo je koje je u viđenju vidio tvoj brat Daniel.

verses.text_en: But it was not expounded unto him, therefore now I declare it unto thee.
verses.text_hr: Njemu to nije bilo protumačeno, a sada ga ja objavljujem tebi.

verses.text_en: Behold, the days will come, that there shall rise up a kingdom upon earth, and it shall be feared above all the kingdoms that were before it.
verses.text_hr: Gle, dolaze dani kada će se na zemlji podići kraljevstvo kojega će se bojati više od svih kraljevstava prije njega.

verses.text_en: In the same shall twelve kings reign, one after another:
verses.text_hr: U istom će kraljevati dvanaest kraljeva, jedan za drugim:

verses.text_en: Whereof the second shall begin to reign, and shall have more time than any of the twelve.
verses.text_hr: Drugi od njih počet će vladati i njegova će vladavina trajati dulje od vladavine bilo kojega od dvanaestorice.

verses.text_en: And this do the twelve wings signify, which thou sawest.
verses.text_hr: A ovo označavaju dvanaest krila, koja si vidio.

verses.text_en: As for the voice which thou heardest speak, and that thou sawest not to go out from the heads but from the midst of the body thereof, this is the interpretation:
verses.text_hr: Što se tiče glasa koji si čuo da govori, i koji si vidio da ne izlazi iz glava nego iz sredine njegova tijela, ovo je tumačenje:

verses.text_en: That after the time of that kingdom there shall arise great strivings, and it shall stand in peril of failing: nevertheless it shall not then fall, but shall be restored again to his beginning.
verses.text_hr: Da će nakon vremena tog kraljevstva nastati velike borbe i ono će biti u opasnosti od propasti: ipak neće tada pasti, već će se ponovno vratiti na svoj početak.

verses.text_en: And whereas thou sawest the eight small under feathers sticking to her wings, this is the interpretation:
verses.text_hr: A osam malih pera pod njegovim krilima koja si vidio znače ovo:

verses.text_en: That in him there shall arise eight kings, whose times shall be but small, and their years swift.
verses.text_hr: U njemu će se podići osam kraljeva, ali njihova će vremena biti kratka, a godine brzo proći.

verses.text_en: And two of them shall perish, the middle time approaching: four shall be kept until their end begin to approach: but two shall be kept unto the end.
verses.text_hr: Dvojica će propasti kad se približi srednje vrijeme; četvorica će biti sačuvana dok im se ne počne približavati kraj, a dvojica do samoga kraja.

verses.text_en: And whereas thou sawest three heads resting, this is the interpretation:
verses.text_hr: I budući da si vidio tri glave kako počivaju, ovo je tumačenje:

verses.text_en: In his last days shall the most High raise up three kingdoms, and renew many things therein, and they shall have the dominion of the earth,
verses.text_hr: U njegovim posljednjim danima Svevišnji će podići tri kraljevstva i u njima obnoviti mnogo toga; ona će zavladati zemljom,

verses.text_en: And of those that dwell therein, with much oppression, above all those that were before them: therefore are they called the heads of the eagle.
verses.text_hr: I njezinim stanovnicima, tlačeći ih više od svih svojih prethodnika; zato su nazvana glavama orla.

verses.text_en: For these are they that shall accomplish his wickedness, and that shall finish his last end.
verses.text_hr: Oni će dovršiti njegovu opačinu i privesti kraju njegov posljednji svršetak.

verses.text_en: And whereas thou sawest that the great head appeared no more, it signifieth that one of them shall die upon his bed, and yet with pain.
verses.text_hr: I budući da si vidio da se velika glava više nije pojavila, to označava da će jedan od njih umrijeti na svojoj postelji, ali ipak s bolovima.

verses.text_en: For the two that remain shall be slain with the sword.
verses.text_hr: Jer dvojica koja preostanu bit će ubijena mačem.

verses.text_en: For the sword of the one shall devour the other: but at the last shall he fall through the sword himself.
verses.text_hr: Jer će mač jednog proždrijeti drugoga, ali će naposljetku sam od mača pasti.

verses.text_en: And whereas thou sawest two feathers under the wings passing over the head that is on the right side;
verses.text_hr: I budući da si vidio dva pera ispod krila kako prolaze iznad glave koja je s desne strane;

verses.text_en: It signifieth that these are they, whom the Highest hath kept unto their end: this is the small kingdom and full of trouble, as thou sawest.
verses.text_hr: To znači da su to oni koje je Svevišnji sačuvao do njihova kraja. To je ono maleno kraljevstvo, puno nevolja, koje si vidio.

verses.text_en: And the lion, whom thou sawest rising up out of the wood, and roaring, and speaking to the eagle, and rebuking her for her unrighteousness with all the words which thou hast heard;
verses.text_hr: Lav kojega si vidio kako izlazi iz šume, riče, govori orlu i svim riječima koje si čuo kori ga zbog nepravednosti,

verses.text_en: This is the anointed, which the Highest hath kept for them and for their wickedness unto the end: he shall reprove them, and shall upbraid them with their cruelty.
verses.text_hr: Jest Pomazanik kojega je Svevišnji sačuvao do kraja za njih i njihovu opačinu. On će ih ukoriti i predbaciti im njihovu okrutnost.

verses.text_en: For he shall set them before him alive in judgment, and shall rebuke them, and correct them.
verses.text_hr: Postavit će ih žive pred svoj sud, ukoriti ih i kazniti.

verses.text_en: For the rest of my people shall he deliver with mercy, those that have been pressed upon my borders, and he shall make them joyful until the coming of the day of judgment, whereof I have spoken unto thee from the beginning.
verses.text_hr: Ostatak mojega naroda milosrdno će izbaviti — one koji su bili pritisnuti unutar mojih granica — i obradovati ih sve do dolaska Sudnjega dana, o kojemu sam ti govorio od početka.

verses.text_en: This is the dream that thou sawest, and these are the interpretations.
verses.text_hr: Ovo je san koji si vidio, a ovo su tumačenja.

verses.text_en: Thou only hast been meet to know this secret of the Highest.
verses.text_hr: Samo si ti bio dostojan spoznati ovu tajnu Svevišnjega.

verses.text_en: Therefore write all these things that thou hast seen in a book, and hide them:
verses.text_hr: Zato sve što si vidio zapiši u knjigu i sakrij to.

verses.text_en: And teach them to the wise of the people, whose hearts thou knowest may comprehend and keep these secrets.
verses.text_hr: Pouči o tome mudre među narodom, one za čija srca znaš da mogu razumjeti i sačuvati ove tajne.

verses.text_en: But wait thou here thyself yet seven days more, that it may be shewed thee, whatsoever it pleaseth the Highest to declare unto thee. And with that he went his way.
verses.text_hr: Ali ostani ovdje još sedam dana, kako bi ti se pokazalo sve što ti Svevišnji odluči objaviti. Zatim je otišao.

verses.text_en: And it came to pass, when all the people saw that the seven days were past, and I not come again into the city, they gathered them all together, from the least unto the greatest, and came unto me, and said,
verses.text_hr: Kad je sav narod vidio da je prošlo sedam dana, a ja se nisam vratio u grad, svi su se okupili, od najmanjega do najvećega, došli k meni i rekli:

verses.text_en: What have we offended thee? and what evil have we done against thee, that thou forsakest us, and sittest here in this place?
verses.text_hr: Čime smo ti sagriješili? Kakvo smo zlo učinili protiv tebe da si nas napustio i sjediš ovdje?

verses.text_en: For of all the prophets thou only art left us, as a cluster of the vintage, and as a candle in a dark place, and as a haven or ship preserved from the tempest.
verses.text_hr: Od svih proroka samo si ti ostao nama, poput grozda nakon berbe, poput svjetiljke na mračnom mjestu i poput luke ili lađe sačuvane od oluje.

verses.text_en: Are not the evils which are come to us sufficient?
verses.text_hr: Zar nam nisu dovoljna zla koja su nas snašla?

verses.text_en: If thou shalt forsake us, how much better had it been for us, if we also had been burned in the midst of Sion?
verses.text_hr: Ako nas ostaviš, koliko bi bolje bilo za nas da smo i mi spaljeni usred Siona?

verses.text_en: For we are not better than they that died there. And they wept with a loud voice. Then answered I them, and said,
verses.text_hr: Jer nismo bolji od onih koji su ondje umrli. Tada su glasno zaplakali, a ja sam im odgovorio:

verses.text_en: Be of good comfort, O Israel; and be not heavy, thou house of Jacob:
verses.text_hr: Utješi se, Izraele, i ne tuguj, dome Jakovljev.

verses.text_en: For the Highest hath you in remembrance, and the Mighty hath not forgotten you in temptation.
verses.text_hr: Svevišnji vas se sjeća i Silni vas nije zaboravio u kušnji.

verses.text_en: As for me, I have not forsaken you, neither am I departed from you: but am come into this place, to pray for the desolation of Sion, and that I might seek mercy for the low estate of your sanctuary.
verses.text_hr: Ja vas nisam napustio niti sam otišao od vas. Došao sam na ovo mjesto moliti zbog opustošenja Siona i tražiti milosrđe za poniženo stanje vašega svetišta.

verses.text_en: And now go your way home every man, and after these days will I come unto you.
verses.text_hr: A sada neka se svatko vrati svojemu domu; nakon ovih dana doći ću k vama.

verses.text_en: So the people went their way into the city, like as I commanded them:
verses.text_hr: Narod se tada vratio u grad, kako sam mu zapovjedio.

verses.text_en: But I remained still in the field seven days, as the angel commanded me; and did eat only in those days of the flowers of the field, and had my meat of the herbs.
verses.text_hr: Ostao sam u polju sedam dana, kako mi je anđeo zapovjedio; tih sam dana jeo samo poljsko cvijeće, a bilje mi je bilo hrana.

verses.text_en: And it came to pass after seven days, I dreamed a dream by night:
verses.text_hr: I dogodi se nakon sedam dana, noću sam sanjao san:

verses.text_en: And, lo, there arose a wind from the sea, that it moved all the waves thereof.
verses.text_hr: I, gle, digne se vjetar s mora i pokrene sve njegove valove.

verses.text_en: And I beheld, and, lo, that man waxed strong with the thousands of heaven: and when he turned his countenance to look, all the things trembled that were seen under him.
verses.text_hr: Pogledao sam, i gle, taj je čovjek bio osnažen nebeskim tisućama; kad je okrenuo lice da pogleda, zadrhtalo je sve što se pod njim moglo vidjeti.

verses.text_en: And whensoever the voice went out of his mouth, all they burned that heard his voice, like as the earth faileth when it feeleth the fire.
verses.text_hr: Kad god bi mu glas izišao iz usta, svi koji su ga čuli izgorjeli bi, kao što zemlja iščezava kad osjeti oganj.

verses.text_en: And after this I beheld, and, lo, there was gathered together a multitude of men, out of number, from the four winds of the heaven, to subdue the man that came out of the sea
verses.text_hr: Nakon toga sam vidio, i gle, nebrojeno mnoštvo ljudi okupilo se s četiriju vjetrova nebeskih kako bi pokorilo čovjeka koji je izišao iz mora.

verses.text_en: But I beheld, and, lo, he had graved himself a great mountain, and flew up upon it.
verses.text_hr: Pogledao sam, i gle, on je sebi isklesao veliku goru i uzletio na nju.

verses.text_en: But I would have seen the region or place whereout the hill was graven, and I could not.
verses.text_hr: Htio sam vidjeti kraj ili mjesto iz kojega je gora bila isklesana, ali nisam mogao.

verses.text_en: And after this I beheld, and, lo, all they which were gathered together to subdue him were sore afraid, and yet durst fight.
verses.text_hr: Nakon toga sam vidio, i gle, svi koji su se okupili da ga pokore silno su se prestrašili, ali su se ipak usudili boriti.

verses.text_en: And, lo, as he saw the violence of the multitude that came, he neither lifted up his hand, nor held sword, nor any instrument of war:
verses.text_hr: I gle, kad je vidio navalu mnoštva koje je dolazilo, nije podigao ruku niti držao mač ili ikakvo ratno oruđe.

verses.text_en: But only I saw that he sent out of his mouth as it had been a blast of fire, and out of his lips a flaming breath, and out of his tongue he cast out sparks and tempests.
verses.text_hr: Vidio sam samo kako je iz usta ispustio nešto poput udara ognja, iz usana plameni dah, a s jezika iskre i oluju.

verses.text_en: And they were all mixed together; the blast of fire, the flaming breath, and the great tempest; and fell with violence upon the multitude which was prepared to fight, and burned them up every one, so that upon a sudden of an innumerable multitude nothing was to be perceived, but only dust and smell of smoke: when I saw this I was afraid.
verses.text_hr: Sve se to pomiješalo — udar ognja, plameni dah i silna oluja — te se svom snagom obrušilo na mnoštvo spremno za boj i sve ih spalilo. Od nebrojenoga mnoštva odjednom se više nije moglo vidjeti ništa osim praha i osjetiti zadah dima. Kad sam to vidio, prestrašio sam se.

verses.text_en: Afterward saw I the same man come down from the mountain, and call unto him another peaceable Multitude.
verses.text_hr: Poslije sam vidio istog čovjeka kako silazi s planine i poziva k sebi drugo miroljubivo mnoštvo.

verses.text_en: And there came much people unto him, whereof some were glad, some were sorry, and some of them were bound, and other some brought of them that were offered: then was I sick through great fear, and I awaked, and said,
verses.text_hr: K njemu je došlo mnogo ljudi: neki su se radovali, neki tugovali, neki su bili svezani, a drugi su dovodili one koji su bili prineseni. Tada sam od silnoga straha klonuo, probudio se i rekao:

verses.text_en: Thou hast shewed thy servant these wonders from the beginning, and hast counted me worthy that thou shouldest receive my prayer:
verses.text_hr: Od početka si svojemu sluzi pokazivao ova čudesa i udostojao me da primiš moju molitvu.

verses.text_en: Shew me now yet the interpretation of this dream.
verses.text_hr: Pokaži mi sada i tumačenje ovoga sna.

verses.text_en: For as I conceive in mine understanding, woe unto them that shall be left in those days and much more woe unto them that are not left behind!
verses.text_hr: Koliko razumijem, teško onima koji ostanu u one dane, a mnogo teže onima koji ne ostanu!

verses.text_en: For they that were not left were in heaviness.
verses.text_hr: Jer oni koji nisu ostali prebivali su u žalosti.

verses.text_en: Now understand I the things that are laid up in the latter days, which shall happen unto them, and to those that are left behind.
verses.text_hr: Sada razumijem što se čuva za posljednje dane i što će se dogoditi njima i onima koji ostanu.

verses.text_en: Therefore are they come into great perils and many necessities, like as these dreams declare.
verses.text_hr: Zato će zapasti u velike opasnosti i mnoge oskudice, kao što objavljuju ovi snovi.

verses.text_en: Yet is it easier for him that is in danger to come into these things, than to pass away as a cloud out of the world, and not to see the things that happen in the last days. And he answered unto me, and said,
verses.text_hr: Ipak je onomu tko je u opasnosti lakše proći kroz to nego poput oblaka iščeznuti sa svijeta i ne vidjeti što će se dogoditi u posljednje dane. Odgovorio mi je:

verses.text_en: The interpretation of the vision shall I shew thee, and I will open unto thee the thing that thou hast required.
verses.text_hr: Pokazat ću ti tumačenje viđenja i razotkriti ono što si zatražio.

verses.text_en: Whereas thou hast spoken of them that are left behind, this is the interpretation:
verses.text_hr: Što se tiče onih za koje si rekao da ostaju, tumačenje je ovo:

verses.text_en: He that shall endure the peril in that time hath kept himself: they that be fallen into danger are such as have works, and faith toward the Almighty.
verses.text_hr: Tko u ono vrijeme izdrži opasnost, sačuvao je sebe; oni koji zapadnu u opasnost ljudi su koji imaju djela i vjeru u Svemogućega.

verses.text_en: Know this therefore, that they which be left behind are more blessed than they that be dead.
verses.text_hr: Znaj, dakle, da su oni koji ostanu blaženiji od umrlih.

verses.text_en: This is the meaning of the vision: Whereas thou sawest a man coming up from the midst of the sea:
verses.text_hr: Ovo je značenje viđenja: čovjek kojega si vidio kako izlazi iz sredine mora

verses.text_en: The same is he whom God the Highest hath kept a great season, which by his own self shall deliver his creature: and he shall order them that are left behind.
verses.text_hr: Onaj je kojega je Bog Svevišnji čuvao dugo vrijeme. On će sam izbaviti svoje stvorenje i urediti život onih koji ostanu.

verses.text_en: And whereas thou sawest, that out of his mouth there came as a blast of wind, and fire, and storm;
verses.text_hr: A to što si vidio da mu je iz usta izišlo nešto poput udara vjetra, ognja i oluje,

verses.text_en: And that he held neither sword, nor any instrument of war, but that the rushing in of him destroyed the whole multitude that came to subdue him; this is the interpretation:
verses.text_hr: I da nije držao ni mač ni ikakvo ratno oruđe, nego je njegov nalet uništio čitavo mnoštvo koje ga je došlo pokoriti, znači ovo:

verses.text_en: Behold, the days come, when the most High will begin to deliver them that are upon the earth.
verses.text_hr: Evo, dolaze dani, kada će Svevišnji početi izbavljati one koji su na zemlji.

verses.text_en: And he shall come to the astonishment of them that dwell on the earth.
verses.text_hr: On će zaprepastiti stanovnike zemlje.

verses.text_en: And one shall undertake to fight against another, one city against another, one place against another, one people against another, and one realm against another.
verses.text_hr: Jedni će se upustiti u boj protiv drugih: grad protiv grada, mjesto protiv mjesta, narod protiv naroda i kraljevstvo protiv kraljevstva.

verses.text_en: And the time shall be when these things shall come to pass, and the signs shall happen which I shewed thee before, and then shall my Son be declared, whom thou sawest as a man ascending.
verses.text_hr: Kad se to dogodi i pojave se znakovi koje sam ti prije pokazao, tada će se objaviti moj Sin, kojega si vidio kao čovjeka koji uzlazi.

verses.text_en: And when all the people hear his voice, every man shall in their own land leave the battle they have one against another.
verses.text_hr: Kad svi narodi čuju njegov glas, svatko će u svojoj zemlji prekinuti boj koji vodi protiv drugoga.

verses.text_en: And an innumerable multitude shall be gathered together, as thou sawest them, willing to come, and to overcome him by fighting.
verses.text_hr: Okupit će se nebrojeno mnoštvo, kao što si vidio, spremno doći i svladati ga u boju.

verses.text_en: But he shall stand upon the top of the mount Sion.
verses.text_hr: Ali on će stajati na vrhu brda Sion.

verses.text_en: And Sion shall come, and shall be shewed to all men, being prepared and builded, like as thou sawest the hill graven without hands.
verses.text_hr: Sion će doći i pokazati se svim ljudima, pripravljen i izgrađen poput gore koju si vidio isklesanu bez ruku.

verses.text_en: And this my Son shall rebuke the wicked inventions of those nations, which for their wicked life are fallen into the tempest;
verses.text_hr: Taj će moj Sin ukoriti zle nakane onih naroda koji su zbog svojega opakog života zapali u oluju.

verses.text_en: And shall lay before them their evil thoughts, and the torments wherewith they shall begin to be tormented, which are like unto a flame: and he shall destroy them without labour by the law which is like unto fire.
verses.text_hr: Pred njih će iznijeti njihove zle misli i muke kojima će se početi mučiti, nalik plamenu; bez napora će ih uništiti Zakonom koji je poput ognja.

verses.text_en: And whereas thou sawest that he gathered another peaceable multitude unto him;
verses.text_hr: A to što si vidio da je k sebi okupio drugo, miroljubivo mnoštvo,

verses.text_en: Those are the ten tribes, which were carried away prisoners out of their own land in the time of Osea the king, whom Salmanasar the king of Assyria led away captive, and he carried them over the waters, and so came they into another land.
verses.text_hr: To su deset plemena koja su u vrijeme kralja Hošee kao sužnji odvedena iz svoje zemlje. Salmanasar, kralj Asirije, odveo ih je u sužanjstvo, preveo preko voda i tako su stigli u drugu zemlju.

verses.text_en: But they took this counsel among themselves, that they would leave the multitude of the heathen, and go forth into a further country, where never mankind dwelt,
verses.text_hr: Među sobom su se dogovorili da napuste mnoštvo naroda i pođu u udaljeniju zemlju u kojoj ljudski rod nikada nije prebivao,

verses.text_en: That they might there keep their statutes, which they never kept in their own land.
verses.text_hr: Da ondje drže svoje zakone, kojih se nikada nisu držali u svojoj zemlji.

verses.text_en: And they entered into Euphrates by the narrow places of the river.
verses.text_hr: Ušli su u Eufrat kroz uske riječne prolaze.

verses.text_en: For the most High then shewed signs for them, and held still the flood, till they were passed over.
verses.text_hr: Svevišnji im je tada pokazao znakove i zaustavio bujicu dok nisu prešli.

verses.text_en: For through that country there was a great way to go, namely, of a year and a half: and the same region is called Arsareth.
verses.text_hr: Kroz tu je zemlju trebalo prijeći dug put od godine i pol dana; taj se kraj zove Arsaret.

verses.text_en: Then dwelt they there until the latter time; and now when they shall begin to come,
verses.text_hr: Ondje su prebivali do posljednjega vremena. A kada se počnu vraćati,

verses.text_en: The Highest shall stay the springs of the stream again, that they may go through: therefore sawest thou the multitude with peace.
verses.text_hr: Svevišnji će ponovno zaustaviti izvore rijeke kako bi mogli prijeći. Zato si vidio miroljubivo mnoštvo.

verses.text_en: But those that be left behind of thy people are they that are found within my borders.
verses.text_hr: Oni iz tvojega naroda koji ostanu bit će oni koji se nađu unutar mojih granica.

verses.text_en: Now when he destroyeth the multitude of the nations that are gathered together, he shall defend his people that remain.
verses.text_hr: Kad uništi okupljeno mnoštvo naroda, zaštitit će svoj preostali narod.

verses.text_en: And then shall he shew them great wonders.
verses.text_hr: Tada će im pokazati velika čudesa.

verses.text_en: Then said I, O Lord that bearest rule, shew me this: Wherefore have I seen the man coming up from the midst of the sea?
verses.text_hr: Tada sam rekao: O Gospodine, Vladaru, pokaži mi zašto sam vidio čovjeka kako izlazi iz sredine mora.

verses.text_en: And he said unto me, Like as thou canst neither seek out nor know the things that are in the deep of the sea: even so can no man upon earth see my Son, or those that be with him, but in the day time.
verses.text_hr: Odgovorio mi je: Kao što ne možeš istražiti ni spoznati što je u morskim dubinama, tako nitko na zemlji ne može vidjeti mojega Sina ni one koji su s njim, osim za njegova dana.

verses.text_en: This is the interpretation of the dream which thou sawest, and whereby thou only art here lightened.
verses.text_hr: Ovo je tumačenje sna koji si vidio i zbog kojega si jedini ovdje prosvijetljen.

verses.text_en: For thou hast forsaken thine own way, and applied thy diligence unto my law, and sought it.
verses.text_hr: Napustio si vlastiti put, marljivo se posvetio mojemu Zakonu i istraživao ga.

verses.text_en: Thy life hast thou ordered in wisdom, and hast called understanding thy mother.
verses.text_hr: Život si svoj uredio u mudrosti, a razum si svojom majkom nazvao.

verses.text_en: And therefore have I shewed thee the treasures of the Highest: after other three days I will speak other things unto thee, and declare unto thee mighty and wondrous things.
verses.text_hr: Zato sam ti pokazao blaga Svevišnjega. Nakon još tri dana govorit ću ti o drugim stvarima i objaviti ti silne i čudesne stvari.

verses.text_en: Then went I forth into the field, giving praise and thanks greatly unto the most High because of his wonders which he did in time;
verses.text_hr: Tada sam izišao u polje, silno hvaleći Svevišnjega i zahvaljujući mu za čudesa koja je učinio u svoje vrijeme,

verses.text_en: And because he governeth the same, and such things as fall in their seasons: and there I sat three days.
verses.text_hr: I zato što upravlja vremenima i onim što se u njima događa. Ondje sam sjedio tri dana.

verses.text_en: And it came to pass upon the third day, I sat under an oak, and, behold, there came a voice out of a bush over against me, and said, Esdras, Esdras.
verses.text_hr: Trećega dana sjedio sam pod hrastom. I gle, iz grma nasuprot meni začuo se glas: Ezra, Ezra!

verses.text_en: And I said, Here am I, Lord And I stood up upon my feet.
verses.text_hr: Rekao sam: Evo me, Gospodine. I ustao sam na noge.

verses.text_en: Then said he unto me, In the bush I did manifestly reveal myself unto Moses, and talked with him, when my people served in Egypt:
verses.text_hr: Tada mi je rekao: U grmu sam se jasno objavio Mojsiju i razgovarao s njim dok je moj narod služio u Egiptu.

verses.text_en: And I sent him and led my people out of Egypt, and brought him up to the mount of where I held him by me a long season,
verses.text_hr: Poslao sam ga, izveo svoj narod iz Egipta i doveo Mojsija na goru, gdje sam ga dugo držao uza se.

verses.text_en: And told him many wondrous things, and shewed him the secrets of the times, and the end; and commanded him, saying,
verses.text_hr: Govorio sam mu o mnogim čudesnim stvarima, pokazao mu tajne vremena i svršetka te mu zapovjedio:

verses.text_en: These words shalt thou declare, and these shalt thou hide.
verses.text_hr: Ove riječi ćeš objaviti, a ove ćeš sakriti.

verses.text_en: And now I say unto thee,
verses.text_hr: A sada ti kažem,

verses.text_en: That thou lay up in thy heart the signs that I have shewed, and the dreams that thou hast seen, and the interpretations which thou hast heard:
verses.text_hr: Pohrani u srce znakove koje sam ti pokazao, snove koje si vidio i tumačenja koja si čuo.

verses.text_en: For thou shalt be taken away from all, and from henceforth thou shalt remain with my Son, and with such as be like thee, until the times be ended.
verses.text_hr: Jer ćeš biti uzet od svih, i od sada ćeš ostati s mojim Sinom, i sa onima koji su tebi slični, do kraja vremena.

verses.text_en: For the world hath lost his youth, and the times begin to wax old.
verses.text_hr: Jer svijet je izgubio mladost, a vremena počinju stariti.

verses.text_en: For the world is divided into twelve parts, and the ten parts of it are gone already, and half of a tenth part:
verses.text_hr: Svijet je podijeljen na dvanaest dijelova; deset i polovica desetoga dijela već su prošli.

verses.text_en: And there remaineth that which is after the half of the tenth part.
verses.text_hr: Preostaje ono što dolazi nakon polovice desetoga dijela.

verses.text_en: Now therefore set thine house in order, and reprove thy people, comfort such of them as be in trouble, and now renounce corruption,
