verses.text_en: And the women also of the angels who went astray shall become sirens.’
verses.text_hr: A žene anđela koje su zastranile postat će sirene.’

verses.text_en: And I, Enoch, alone saw the vision, the ends of all things: and no man shall see as I have seen.
verses.text_hr: Samo sam ja, Henok, vidio to viđenje, svršetke svega; nijedan čovjek neće vidjeti kao što sam ja vidio.

verses.text_en: And these are the names of the holy angels who watch.
verses.text_hr: Ovo su imena svetih anđela koji bdiju.

verses.text_en: Uriel, one of the holy angels, who is over the world and over Tartarus.
verses.text_hr: Uriel, jedan od svetih anđela, nad svijetom i Tartarom.

verses.text_en: Raphael, one of the holy angels, who is over the spirits of men.
verses.text_hr: Rafael, jedan od svetih anđela, nad duhovima ljudi.

verses.text_en: Raguel, one of the holy angels who †takes vengeance on† the world of the luminaries.
verses.text_hr: Raguel, jedan od svetih anđela, koji †se osvećuje nad† svijetom svjetlila.

verses.text_en: Michael, one of the holy angels, to wit, he that is set over the best part of mankind 〚and〛 over chaos.
verses.text_hr: Mihael, jedan od svetih anđela, onaj koji je postavljen nad najboljim dijelom čovječanstva 〚i〛 nad kaosom.

verses.text_en: Saraqâêl, one of the holy angels, who is set over the spirits, who sin in the spirit.
verses.text_hr: Sarakael, jedan od svetih anđela, postavljen nad duhovima koji griješe u duhu.

verses.text_en: Gabriel, one of the holy angels, who is over Paradise and the serpents and the Cherubim.
verses.text_hr: Gabriel, jedan od svetih anđela, nad Rajem, zmijama i kerubinima.

verses.text_en: Remiel, one of the holy angels, whom God set over those who rise.
verses.text_hr: Remiel, jedan od svetih anđela, kojega je Bog postavio nad one koji ustaju.

verses.text_en: And I proceeded to where things were chaotic.
verses.text_hr: Nastavih do mjesta gdje je sve bilo kaotično.

verses.text_en: And I saw there something horrible: I saw neither a heaven above nor a firmly founded earth, but a place chaotic and horrible.
verses.text_hr: Ondje vidjeh nešto strašno: nisam vidio ni neba iznad ni čvrsto utemeljene zemlje, nego kaotično i užasno mjesto.

verses.text_en: And there I saw seven stars of the heaven bound together in it, like great mountains and burning with fire.
verses.text_hr: Ondje vidjeh sedam nebeskih zvijezda svezanih zajedno, nalik velikim gorama koje gore ognjem.

verses.text_en: Then I said: ‘For what sin are they bound, and on what account have they been cast in hither?’
verses.text_hr: Tada upitah: ‘Zbog kojega su grijeha svezane i zašto su bačene ovamo?’

verses.text_en: Then said Uriel, one of the holy angels, who was with me, and was chief over them, and said: ‘Enoch, why dost thou ask, and why art thou eager for the truth?
verses.text_hr: Uriel, jedan od svetih anđela koji bijaše sa mnom i njihov starješina, reče mi: ‘Henok, zašto pitaš i zašto žarko želiš istinu?

verses.text_en: These are of the number of the stars ⌜of heaven⌝ which have transgressed the commandment of the Lord, and are bound here till ten thousand years, the time entailed by their sins, are consummated.’
verses.text_hr: One pripadaju zvijezdama ⌜nebeskim⌝ koje su prestupile Gospodinovu zapovijed; ovdje su svezane dok se ne navrši deset tisuća godina, vrijeme određeno njihovim grijesima.’

verses.text_en: And from thence I went to another place, which was still more horrible than the former, and I saw a horrible thing: a great fire there which burnt and blazed, and the place was cleft as far as the abyss, being full of great descending columns of fire: neither its extent or magnitude could I see, nor could I conjecture.
verses.text_hr: Odatle odoh na drugo mjesto, još strašnije od prethodnoga, i vidjeh užas: velik oganj koji je gorio i plamtio; mjesto bijaše rascijepljeno sve do ponora i puno golemih silaznih stupova ognja. Nisam mogao vidjeti ni njegov opseg ni veličinu, niti sam ih mogao naslutiti.

verses.text_en: Then I said: ‘How fearful is the place and how terrible to look upon!’
verses.text_hr: Tada rekoh: ‘Kako je strašno ovo mjesto i kako ga je užasno gledati!’

verses.text_en: Then Uriel answered me, one of the holy angels who was with me, and said unto me: ‘Enoch, why hast thou such fear and affright?’ And I answered: ‘Because of this fearful place, and because of the spectacle of the pain.’
verses.text_hr: Uriel, jedan od svetih anđela koji bijaše sa mnom, odgovori: ‘Henok, zašto te obuzimaju takav strah i užas?’ Odgovorih: ‘Zbog ovoga strašnoga mjesta i prizora muke.’

verses.text_en: And he said 〚unto me〛: ‘This place is the prison of the angels, and here they will be imprisoned for ever.’
verses.text_hr: On mi 〚reče〛: ‘Ovo je mjesto tamnica anđela; ovdje će biti zatočeni zauvijek.’

verses.text_en: And thence I went to another place, and he showed me in the west ⌜another⌝ great and high mountain [and] of hard rock.
verses.text_hr: Odatle odoh na drugo mjesto; na zapadu mi pokaza ⌜drugu⌝ veliku i visoku goru [od] tvrde stijene.

verses.text_en:
[variant E] And there was in it †four† =hollow= places, deep and wide and very smooth. †How† smooth are =the hollow places= and deep and dark to look at.

[variant G^g] And there were †four† hollow places in it, deep and very smooth: †three† of them were dark and one bright; and there was a fountain of water in its midst. And I said: ‘†How† smooth are these hollow places, and deep and dark to view.’
verses.text_hr:
[varijanta E] U njoj bijahu †četiri† =šuplja= prostora, duboka, široka i posve glatka. †Kako† su glatki =ti šuplji prostori=, duboki i mračni na pogled.

[varijanta G^g] U njoj bijahu †četiri† šuplja prostora, duboka i posve glatka: †tri† su bila mračna, a jedan svijetao; usred njega bijaše izvor vode. Rekoh: ‘†Kako† su glatki ti šuplji prostori, duboki i mračni na pogled.’

verses.text_en: Then Raphael answered, one of the holy angels who was with me, and said unto me: ‘These hollow places have been created for this very purpose, that the spirits of the souls of the dead should assemble therein, yea that all the souls of the children of men should assemble here.
verses.text_hr: Tada Rafael, jedan od svetih anđela koji bijaše sa mnom, odgovori: ‘Ti su šuplji prostori stvoreni upravo zato da se u njima okupljaju duhovi duša umrlih; da, da se ovdje okupe sve duše sinova ljudskih.

verses.text_en: And these places =have been made= to receive them till the day of their judgement and till their appointed period [till the period appointed], till the great judgement (comes) upon them.’
verses.text_hr: Ta su mjesta =načinjena= da ih prime do dana njihova suda i do određenoga im roka [do određenoga roka], dok nad njima ne dođe veliki sud.’

verses.text_en:
[variant E] I saw the spirits of the children of men who were dead, and their voice went forth to heaven and made suit.

[variant G^g] I saw ‹the spirit of› =a dead man= making suit, and his voice went forth to heaven and made suit.
verses.text_hr:
[varijanta E] Vidjeh duhove umrlih sinova ljudskih; njihov je glas dopirao do neba i iznosio tužbu.

[varijanta G^g] Vidjeh ‹duh› =mrtva čovjeka= kako iznosi tužbu; njegov je glas dopirao do neba i tužio se.

verses.text_en:
[variant E] Then I asked Raphael the angel who was with me, and I said unto him: ‘This spirit—whose is it whose voice goeth forth and maketh suit?’

[variant G^g] And I asked Raphael the angel who was with me, and I said unto him: ‘This spirit which maketh suit, whose is it, whose voice goeth forth and maketh suit to heaven?’
verses.text_hr:
[varijanta E] Tada upitah anđela Rafaela koji bijaše sa mnom: ‘Čiji je ovaj duh čiji glas dopire i iznosi tužbu?’

[varijanta G^g] Upitah anđela Rafaela koji bijaše sa mnom: ‘Čiji je ovaj duh koji se tuži, čiji glas dopire do neba i iznosi tužbu?’

verses.text_en: And he answered me saying: ‘This is the spirit which went forth from Abel, whom his brother Cain slew, and he makes his suit against him till his seed is destroyed from the face of the earth, and his seed is annihilated from amongst the seed of men.’
verses.text_hr: On mi odgovori: ‘To je duh koji je izišao iz Abela, kojega je ubio njegov brat Kajin. On se tuži protiv njega dok njegovo potomstvo ne bude uništeno s lica zemlje i iskorijenjeno među potomstvom ljudi.’

verses.text_en:
[variant E] Then I asked regarding it, and regarding all the _hollow places_: ‘Why is one separated from the other?’

[variant G^g] Then I asked regarding all the =hollow places=: ‘Why is one separated from the other?’
verses.text_hr:
[varijanta E] Tada upitah o njemu i o svim _šupljim prostorima_: ‘Zašto je jedan odvojen od drugoga?’

[varijanta G^g] Tada upitah o svim =šupljim prostorima=: ‘Zašto je jedan odvojen od drugoga?’

verses.text_en:
[variant E] And he answered me and said unto me: ‘These three have been made that the spirits of the dead might be separated. And such a division has been made ‹for› the spirits of the righteous, in which there is the =bright= spring of water.

[variant G^g] And he answered me saying: ‘These three have been made that the spirits of the dead might be separated. And =this= division has been made for the spirits of the righteous, in which there is the bright spring of water.
verses.text_hr:
[varijanta E] On mi odgovori: ‘Ova su tri načinjena da se duhovi umrlih razdvoje. Takva je pregrada načinjena ‹za› duhove pravednika, a u njoj je =svijetao= izvor vode.

[varijanta G^g] On mi odgovori: ‘Ova su tri načinjena da se duhovi umrlih razdvoje. =Ova= je pregrada načinjena za duhove pravednika, a u njoj je svijetao izvor vode.

verses.text_en:
[variant E] =And= such has been made for sinners when they die and are buried in the earth and judgement has not been executed on them in their lifetime.

[variant G^g] And =this= has been made for sinners when they die and are buried in the earth and judgement has not been executed upon them in their lifetime.
verses.text_hr:
[varijanta E] =A= takva je načinjena za grešnike kada umru i budu pokopani u zemlji, a sud nad njima nije izvršen za njihova života.

[varijanta G^g] =Ova= je načinjena za grešnike kada umru i budu pokopani u zemlji, a sud nad njima nije izvršen za njihova života.

verses.text_en:
[variant E] Here their spirits shall be set apart in this great pain till the great day of judgement and punishment and torment of those who †curse† for ever, and retribution for their spirits. There He shall bind them for ever.

[variant G^g] Here their spirits shall be set apart in this great pain, till the great day of judgement, scourgings, and torments of the accursed for ever, =so that= (there may be) retribution for their spirits. There He shall bind them for ever.
verses.text_hr:
[varijanta E] Ovdje će njihovi duhovi biti odvojeni u ovoj velikoj boli do velikoga dana suda, kazne i muke onih koji †proklinju† dovijeka, i do odmazde nad njihovim duhovima. Ondje će ih On svezati zauvijek.

[varijanta G^g] Ovdje će njihovi duhovi biti odvojeni u ovoj velikoj boli do velikoga dana suda, bičevanja i vječnih muka prokletih, =kako bi= njihovi duhovi primili odmazdu. Ondje će ih On svezati zauvijek.

verses.text_en:
[variant E] And such a division has been made for the spirits of those who make their suit, who make disclosures concerning their destruction, when they were slain in the days of the sinners.

[variant G^g] And =this= division has been made for the spirits of those who make their suit, who make disclosures concerning their destruction, when they were slain in the days of the sinners.
verses.text_hr:
[varijanta E] Takva je pregrada načinjena za duhove onih koji iznose tužbu i objavljuju svoju propast jer su bili ubijeni u dane grešnika.

[varijanta G^g] =Ova= je pregrada načinjena za duhove onih koji iznose tužbu i objavljuju svoju propast jer su bili ubijeni u dane grešnika.

verses.text_en:
[variant E] Such has been made for the spirits of men who were not righteous but sinners, who were complete in transgression, and of the transgressors they shall be companions: but their spirits shall not be slain in the day of judgement nor shall they be raised from thence.’

[variant G^g] And =this= has been made for the spirits of men who shall not be righteous but sinners, who are godless, and of the lawless they shall be companions: but their spirits shall not be punished in the day of judgement nor shall they be raised from thence.’
verses.text_hr:
[varijanta E] Takva je načinjena za duhove ljudi koji nisu bili pravedni, nego grešnici, potpuni prijestupnici i drugovi prijestupnika. Njihovi duhovi neće biti ubijeni na dan suda niti će odande uskrsnuti.’

[varijanta G^g] =Ova= je načinjena za duhove ljudi koji neće biti pravedni, nego grešnici i bezbožnici, drugovi bezakonika. Njihovi duhovi neće biti kažnjeni na dan suda niti će odande uskrsnuti.’

verses.text_en:
[variant E] Then I blessed the Lord of glory and said: ‘Blessed be my Lord, the Lord of righteousness who ruleth for ever.’

[variant G^g] Then I blessed the Lord of Glory and said: ‘Blessed art Thou, Lord of righteousness, who rulest over the world.’
verses.text_hr:
[varijanta E] Tada blagoslovih Gospodina slave i rekoh: ‘Blagoslovljen bio moj Gospodin, Gospodin pravednosti koji vlada dovijeka.’

[varijanta G^g] Tada blagoslovih Gospodina Slave i rekoh: ‘Blagoslovljen si Ti, Gospodine pravednosti, koji vladaš svijetom.’

verses.text_en: From thence I went to another place to the west of the ends of the earth.
verses.text_hr: Odatle odoh na drugo mjesto, prema zapadu, na krajeve zemlje.

verses.text_en: And I saw a 〚burning〛 fire which ran without resting, and paused not from its course day or night but (ran) regularly.
verses.text_hr: Vidjeh 〚gorući〛 oganj koji je tekao bez odmora i nije zastajao na svojem putu ni danju ni noću, nego je tekao jednoliko.

verses.text_en: And I asked saying: ‘What is this which rests not?’
verses.text_hr: Upitah: ‘Što je ovo što ne miruje?’

verses.text_en: Then Raguel, one of the holy angels who was with me, answered me 〚and said unto me〛: ‘This course ⌜of fire⌝ 〚which thou hast seen〛 is the fire in the west which †persecutes† all the luminaries of heaven.’
verses.text_hr: Tada mi Raguel, jedan od svetih anđela koji bijaše sa mnom, odgovori 〚i reče〛: ‘Ovaj put ⌜ognja⌝ 〚koji si vidio〛 jest oganj na zapadu koji †progoni† sva nebeska svjetlila.’

verses.text_en: 〚And from thence I went to another place of the earth〛, and he showed me a mountain range of fire which burnt 〚day and〛 night.
verses.text_hr: 〚Odatle odoh na drugo mjesto na zemlji〛, a on mi pokaza gorski lanac od ognja koji je gorio 〚danju i〛 noću.

verses.text_en: And I went beyond it and saw seven magnificent mountains all differing each from the other, and the stones (thereof) were magnificent and beautiful, magnificent as a whole, of glorious appearance and fair exterior: 〚three towards〛 the east, 〚one〛 founded on the other, and three towards the south, 〚one〛 upon the other, and deep rough ravines, no one of which joined with any other.
verses.text_hr: Pođoh dalje i vidjeh sedam veličanstvenih gora, svaku različitu od drugih. Njihovo kamenje bijaše veličanstveno i lijepo; sve bijahu veličanstvene, slavna izgleda i krasne vanjštine: 〚tri prema〛 istoku, 〚jedna〛 utemeljena na drugoj, i tri prema jugu, 〚jedna〛 nad drugom. Među njima bijahu duboke, hrapave gudure, od kojih se nijedna nije spajala s drugom.

verses.text_en: And the seventh mountain was in the midst of these, and it excelled them in height, resembling the seat of a throne: and fragrant trees encircled the throne.
verses.text_hr: Sedma je gora bila usred njih i nadvisivala ih visinom, nalik prijestolju; prijestolje su okruživala mirisna stabla.

verses.text_en: And amongst them was a tree such as I had never yet smelt, neither was any amongst them nor were others like it: it had a fragrance beyond all fragrance, and its leaves and blooms and wood wither not for ever: and its fruit 〚is beautiful, and its fruit〛 resembles the dates of a palm.
verses.text_hr: Među njima bijaše stablo kakvo nikada prije nisam pomirisao; nijedno drugo među njima, niti igdje drugdje, nije mu bilo nalik. Miris mu bijaše jači od svakoga mirisa; lišće, cvjetovi i drvo ne venu dovijeka, a plod mu 〚je lijep i plod mu〛 nalikuje datuljama palme.

verses.text_en: Then I said: ‘⌜How⌝ beautiful is this tree, and fragrant, and its leaves are fair, and its blooms 〚very〛 delightful in appearance.’
verses.text_hr: Tada rekoh: ‘⌜Kako⌝ je lijepo i mirisno ovo stablo! Lišće mu je krasno, a cvjetovi su mu 〚veoma〛 ugodni na pogled.’

verses.text_en: Then answered Michael, one of the holy 〚and honoured〛 angels who was with me, and was their leader,
verses.text_hr: Tada odgovori Mihael, jedan od svetih 〚i čašćenih〛 anđela koji bijaše sa mnom i njihov vođa,

verses.text_en: And he said unto me: ‘Enoch, why dost thou ask me regarding the fragrance of the tree, and ⌜why⌝ dost thou wish to learn the truth?’
verses.text_hr: On mi reče: ‘Henok, zašto me pitaš o mirisu toga stabla i ⌜zašto⌝ želiš spoznati istinu?’

verses.text_en: Then I answered him, 〚saying〛: ‘I wish to know about everything, but especially about this tree.’
verses.text_hr: Odgovorih mu 〚govoreći〛: ‘Želim doznati o svemu, ali osobito o ovome stablu.’

verses.text_en: And he answered, saying: ‘This high mountain 〚which thou hast seen〛, whose summit is like the throne of God, is His throne, where the Holy Great One, the Lord of Glory, the Eternal King will sit, when He shall come down to visit the earth with goodness.
verses.text_hr: On odgovori: ‘Ova visoka gora 〚koju si vidio〛, čiji je vrh nalik Božjem prijestolju, Njegovo je prijestolje. Ondje će Sveti i Veliki, Gospodin Slave, Vječni Kralj, sjediti kada siđe posjetiti zemlju u dobroti.

verses.text_en: And as for this fragrant tree no mortal is permitted to touch it till the great judgement, when He shall take vengeance on all and bring (everything) to its consummation for ever. It shall then be given to the righteous and holy.
verses.text_hr: Što se tiče ovoga mirisnoga stabla, nijednom ga smrtniku nije dopušteno dotaknuti do velikoga suda, kada On izvrši osvetu nad svima i sve zauvijek dovede do dovršenja. Tada će ono biti dano pravednima i svetima.

verses.text_en: Its fruit =shall be= for food to the elect: it shall be transplanted to the holy place, to the temple of the Lord, the Eternal King.
verses.text_hr: Njegov =će plod biti= hrana izabranima; bit će presađeno na sveto mjesto, uz Hram Gospodina, Vječnoga Kralja.

verses.text_en:
Then shall they rejoice with joy and be glad.
And into the holy place shall they enter;
And its fragrance shall be in their bones,
And they shall live a long life on earth,
Such as thy fathers lived:
And in their days shall no 〚sorrow or〛 plague
Or torment or calamity touch them.’
verses.text_hr:
Tada će klicati od radosti i veseliti se.
Ući će na sveto mjesto;
njegov će miris prožeti njihove kosti
i dugo će živjeti na zemlji,
kao što su živjeli tvoji očevi.
U njihove ih dane neće dotaknuti nikakva 〚žalost ni〛 pošast,
ni muka ni nesreća.’

verses.text_en: Then blessed I the God of Glory, the Eternal King, who hath prepared such things for the righteous, and hath created them and promised to give to them.
verses.text_hr: Tada blagoslovih Boga Slave, Vječnoga Kralja, koji je takvo što pripravio pravednima, stvorio to i obećao da će im dati.

verses.text_en: And I went from thence to the middle of the earth, and I saw a blessed place ⌜in which there were trees⌝ with branches abiding and blooming [of a dismembered tree].
verses.text_hr: Odatle odoh u središte zemlje i vidjeh blagoslovljeno mjesto ⌜na kojem bijahu stabla⌝ s granama koje su trajno ostajale i cvjetale [od raskomadana stabla].

verses.text_en: And there I saw a holy mountain, 〚and〛 underneath the mountain to the east there was a stream and it flowed towards the south.
verses.text_hr: Ondje vidjeh svetu goru; 〚a〛 pod gorom, prema istoku, tekao je potok prema jugu.

verses.text_en: And I saw towards the east another mountain higher than this, and between them a deep and narrow ravine: in it also ran a stream ⌜underneath⌝ the mountain.
verses.text_hr: Prema istoku vidjeh drugu goru, višu od ove, a između njih duboku i usku guduru. Njome je također tekao potok ⌜podno⌝ gore.

verses.text_en: And to the west thereof there was another mountain, lower than the former and of small elevation, and a ravine ⌜deep and dry⌝ between them: and another deep and dry ravine was at the extremities of the three ⌜mountains⌝.
verses.text_hr: Zapadno od nje bijaše još jedna gora, niža od prethodne i neznatne visine, a između njih gudura ⌜duboka i suha⌝. Druga duboka i suha gudura bijaše na krajevima triju ⌜gora⌝.

verses.text_en: And all the ravines were deep 〚and narrow〛, (being formed) of hard rock, and trees were not planted upon them.
verses.text_hr: Sve su gudure bile duboke 〚i uske〛, (načinjene) od tvrde stijene, a na njima nije bilo zasađeno drveće.

verses.text_en: And I marvelled 〚at the rocks, and I marvelled〛 at the ravine, yea, I marvelled very much.
verses.text_hr: Čudio sam se 〚stijenama i čudio se〛 guduri; da, silno sam se čudio.

verses.text_en: Then said I: ‘For what object is this blessed land, which is entirely filled with trees, and this accursed valley 〚between?〛’
verses.text_hr: Tada rekoh: ‘Čemu služi ova blagoslovljena zemlja, posve ispunjena drvećem, i ova prokleta dolina 〚između njih?〛’

verses.text_en:
[common reading] 〚Then Uriel, one of the holy angels who was with me, answered and said: ‘This〛 valley is for those who are accursed for ever: here shall all ⌜the accursed⌝ be gathered together who utter with their lips against the Lord unseemly words and of His glory speak hard things.

[variant E · continuation] Here shall they be gathered together, and here shall be their place of judgement.

[variant G^g · continuation] Here shall they be gathered together, and here shall be the place of their habitation.
verses.text_hr:
[zajedničko čitanje] 〚Tada Uriel, jedan od svetih anđela koji bijaše sa mnom, odgovori: ‘Ova〛 je dolina za one koji su zauvijek prokleti. Ovdje će se okupiti svi ⌜prokleti⌝ koji svojim usnama protiv Gospodina izgovaraju nedolične riječi i grubo govore o Njegovoj slavi.

[varijanta E · nastavak] Ovdje će biti okupljeni i ovdje će biti mjesto njihova suda.

[varijanta G^g · nastavak] Ovdje će biti okupljeni i ovdje će biti mjesto njihova prebivališta.

verses.text_en:
[variant E] In the last days there shall be upon them the spectacle of righteous judgement in the presence of the righteous for ever: here shall the merciful bless the Lord of Glory, the Eternal King.

[variant G^g] In the last times, in the days of the true judgement in the presence of the righteous for ever: here shall the =godly= bless the Lord of Glory, the Eternal King.
verses.text_hr:
[varijanta E] U posljednje će dane pred pravednicima dovijeka biti izloženi prizoru pravednoga suda; ovdje će milosrdni blagoslivljati Gospodina Slave, Vječnoga Kralja.

[varijanta G^g] U posljednja vremena, u dane istinskoga suda pred pravednicima dovijeka, ovdje će =pobožni= blagoslivljati Gospodina Slave, Vječnoga Kralja.

verses.text_en: In the days of judgement over the former, they shall bless Him for the mercy in accordance with which He has assigned them (their lot).’
verses.text_hr: U dane suda nad onima prije spomenutima blagoslivljat će Ga zbog milosrđa po kojemu im je dodijelio (njihov dio).’

verses.text_en: Then I blessed the Lord of Glory and set forth His ⌜glory⌝ and lauded Him gloriously.
verses.text_hr: Tada blagoslovih Gospodina Slave, objavih Njegovu ⌜slavu⌝ i slavno Ga hvalih.

verses.text_en: And thence I went 〚towards the east〛, into the midst 〚of the mountain range〛 of the desert, and I saw a wilderness and it was solitary, full of trees =and plants=.
verses.text_hr: Odatle odoh 〚prema istoku〛, usred 〚gorskoga lanca〛 u pustinji. Vidjeh samotnu pustoš punu drveća =i biljaka=.

verses.text_en: 〚And〛 water gushed forth from above.
verses.text_hr: 〚A〛 voda je izvirala odozgor.

verses.text_en: Rushing like a copious watercourse [which flowed] towards the north-west it caused =clouds= and dew to ascend on every side.
verses.text_hr: Jureći poput obilna vodotoka [koji je tekao] prema sjeverozapadu, podizala je =oblake= i rosu na sve strane.

verses.text_en: And thence I went to another place in the desert, and approached to the east of this mountain range.
verses.text_hr: Odatle odoh na drugo mjesto u pustinji i približih se istočnoj strani toga gorskog lanca.

verses.text_en: And 〚there〛 I saw =aromatic= trees exhaling the fragrance of frankincense and myrrh, and the trees also were similar to the almond tree.
verses.text_hr: Ondje 〚vidjeh〛 =mirisna= stabla koja su širila miris tamjana i smirne; stabla bijahu nalik i bademu.

verses.text_en: And beyond these, I went afar to the east, and I saw another place, a valley (full) of water.
verses.text_hr: Iza njih odoh daleko prema istoku i vidjeh drugo mjesto, dolinu (punu) vode.

verses.text_en: And ⌜therein there was⌝ a tree, the colour (?) of fragrant trees such as the mastic.
verses.text_hr: ⌜U njoj bijaše⌝ stablo boje (?) mirisnih stabala poput tršlje.

verses.text_en: And on the sides of those valleys I saw fragrant cinnamon. And beyond these I proceeded to the east.
verses.text_hr: Na obroncima tih dolina vidjeh mirisni cimet. Prošavši dalje od njih, nastavih prema istoku.

verses.text_en: And I saw other mountains, and amongst them were ⌜groves of⌝ trees, and there flowed forth from them nectar, which is named sarara and galbanum.
verses.text_hr: Vidjeh druge gore, a među njima ⌜gajeve⌝ stabala iz kojih je tekao nektar, nazvan sarara i galbanum.

verses.text_en: And beyond these mountains I saw another mountain ⌜to the east of the ends of the earth⌝, 〚whereon were aloe trees〛, and all the trees were full =of stacte=, being like almond trees.
verses.text_hr: Iza tih gora vidjeh drugu goru ⌜istočno od krajeva zemlje⌝, 〚na kojoj su rasla stabla aloje〛. Sva su stabla bila puna =stakte= i nalik bademima.

verses.text_en: And when one =burnt= it, it smelt sweeter than any fragrant odour.
verses.text_hr: Kad bi se to =zapalilo=, mirisalo je slađe od svakoga mirisa.

verses.text_en:
[variant E] And after these fragrant odours, as I looked towards the north over the mountains I saw seven mountains full of choice nard and fragrant trees and cinnamon and pepper.

[variant G^g] To the north-east I beheld seven mountains full of choice nard and mastic and cinnamon and pepper.
verses.text_hr:
[varijanta E] Nakon tih mirisa pogledah preko gora prema sjeveru i vidjeh sedam gora punih birana narda, mirisnoga drveća, cimeta i papra.

[varijanta G^g] Prema sjeveroistoku ugledah sedam gora punih birana narda, tršlje, cimeta i papra.

verses.text_en: And thence I went over the summits of ⌜all⌝ these mountains, far towards the east ⌜of the earth⌝, and passed above the Erythraean sea, and went far from it, and passed over 〚the angel〛 Zotîêl.
verses.text_hr: Odatle prijeđoh preko vrhova ⌜svih⌝ tih gora, daleko prema istoku ⌜zemlje⌝. Pređoh iznad Eritrejskoga mora, udaljih se od njega i prođoh iznad 〚anđela〛 Zotiela.

verses.text_en:
[variant E] And I came to the Garden of Righteousness, and saw beyond those trees many large trees growing there and of goodly fragrance, large, very beautiful and glorious, and the tree of wisdom whereof they eat and know great wisdom.

[variant G^g] And I came to the Garden of Righteousness, and from afar off trees more numerous than these trees and great—†two† trees there, very great, beautiful, and glorious, and magnificent, and the tree of knowledge, whose holy fruit they eat and know great wisdom.
verses.text_hr:
[varijanta E] Dođoh u Vrt Pravednosti i iza onih stabala vidjeh kako rastu mnoga velika stabla ugodna mirisa, velika, veoma lijepa i slavna, te stablo mudrosti s kojega jedu i spoznaju veliku mudrost.

[varijanta G^g] Dođoh u Vrt Pravednosti i izdaleka vidjeh stabla brojnija i veća od ovih — ondje bijahu †dva† stabla, veoma velika, lijepa, slavna i veličanstvena, te stablo spoznaje čiji sveti plod jedu i spoznaju veliku mudrost.

verses.text_en: ⌜That tree is in height like the fir, and its leaves are⌝ like (those of) the Carob tree: and its fruit is like the clusters of the vine, very beautiful: and the fragrance of the tree penetrates afar.
verses.text_hr: ⌜To je stablo visoko poput jele, a lišće mu je⌝ poput lišća rogača. Plod mu je poput grozdova loze, veoma lijep, a miris stabla prodire daleko.

verses.text_en: Then I said: ‘⌜How⌝ beautiful is the tree, and how attractive is its look!’
verses.text_hr: Tada rekoh: ‘⌜Kako⌝ je lijepo ovo stablo i kako je privlačan njegov izgled!’

verses.text_en: Then Raphael, the holy angel who was with me, answered me 〚and said〛: ‘This is the tree of wisdom, of which thy father old (in years) and thy aged mother, who were before thee, have eaten, and they learnt wisdom and their eyes were opened, and they knew that they were naked and they were driven out of the garden.’
verses.text_hr: Rafael, sveti anđeo koji bijaše sa mnom, odgovori mi 〚i reče〛: ‘To je stablo mudrosti s kojega su jeli tvoj ostarjeli otac i tvoja vremešna majka koji bijahu prije tebe. Spoznali su mudrost, oči su im se otvorile, spoznali su da su goli i bili su istjerani iz vrta.’

verses.text_en: And from thence I went to the ends of the earth and saw there great beasts, and each differed from the other; and (I saw) birds also differing in appearance and beauty and voice, the one differing from the other.
verses.text_hr: Odatle odoh do krajeva zemlje i ondje vidjeh velike zvijeri, svaku različitu od druge; vidjeh i ptice koje su se razlikovale izgledom, ljepotom i glasom, jedna od druge.

verses.text_en: And to the east of those beasts I saw the ends of the earth whereon the heaven rests, and the portals of the heaven open.
verses.text_hr: Istočno od tih zvijeri vidjeh krajeve zemlje na kojima počiva nebo i otvorena vrata neba.

verses.text_en: And I saw how the stars of heaven come forth, and I counted the portals out of which they proceed, and wrote down all their outlets, of each individual star by itself, according to their number and their names, their courses and their positions, and their times and their months, as Uriel the holy angel who was with me showed me.
verses.text_hr: Vidjeh kako izlaze nebeske zvijezde; prebrojih vrata kroz koja izlaze i zapisa sve njihove izlaze, za svaku zvijezdu napose, prema njihovu broju i imenima, njihovim putanjama i položajima, njihovim vremenima i mjesecima, kako mi je pokazao sveti anđeo Uriel koji bijaše sa mnom.

verses.text_en: He showed all things to me and wrote them down for me: also their names he wrote for me, and their laws and their companies.
verses.text_hr: Sve mi je pokazao i zapisao za mene; zapisao mi je i njihova imena, njihove zakone i njihove skupine.

verses.text_en: And from thence I went towards the north to the ends of the earth, and there I saw a great and glorious device at the ends of the whole earth.
verses.text_hr: Odatle odoh prema sjeveru, do krajeva zemlje. Ondje na krajevima cijele zemlje vidjeh velik i slavan poredak.

verses.text_en: And here I saw three portals of heaven open in the heaven: through each of them proceed north winds: when they blow there is cold, hail, frost, snow, dew, and rain.
verses.text_hr: Ondje vidjeh troja nebeska vrata otvorena na nebu. Kroz svaka od njih izlaze sjeverni vjetrovi; kad pušu, donose hladnoću, tuču, mraz, snijeg, rosu i kišu.

verses.text_en: And out of one portal they blow for good: but when they blow through the other two portals, †it is with violence and affliction on the earth, and they blow with violence.†
verses.text_hr: Kroz jedna vrata pušu na dobro, ali kad pušu kroz druga dvoja, †čine to silovito i donose nevolju zemlji; silovito pušu.†

verses.text_en: And from thence I went towards the west to the ends of the earth, and saw there three portals of the heaven open such as I had seen in the †east†, the same number of portals, and the same number of outlets.
verses.text_hr: Odatle odoh prema zapadu, do krajeva zemlje. Ondje vidjeh otvorena troja nebeska vrata, kao što sam vidio na †istoku†: isti broj vrata i isti broj izlaza.

verses.text_en: And from thence I went to the south to the ends of the earth, and saw there three open portals of the heaven: and thence there come dew, rain, †and wind†.
verses.text_hr: Odatle odoh prema jugu, do krajeva zemlje. Ondje vidjeh troja otvorena nebeska vrata; iz njih dolaze rosa, kiša †i vjetar†.

verses.text_en: And from thence I went to the east to the ends of the heaven, and saw here the three eastern portals of heaven open and small portals above them.
verses.text_hr: Odatle odoh prema istoku, do krajeva neba. Ondje vidjeh otvorena troja istočna nebeska vrata, a iznad njih mala vrata.

verses.text_en: Through each of these small portals pass the stars of heaven and run their course to the west on the path which is shown to them.
verses.text_hr: Kroz svaka od tih malih vrata prolaze nebeske zvijezde i kreću se svojom putanjom prema zapadu, putem koji im je pokazan.

verses.text_en: And as often as I saw I blessed always the Lord of Glory, and I continued to bless the Lord of Glory who has wrought great and glorious wonders, to show the greatness of His work to the angels and to =spirits= and to men, that they might praise His work and all His creation: that they might see the work of His might and praise the great work of His hands and bless Him for ever.
verses.text_hr: Kad god bih to vidio, uvijek sam blagoslivljao Gospodina Slave. Neprestano sam blagoslivljao Gospodina Slave koji je učinio velika i slavna čudesa da bi veličinu svojega djela pokazao anđelima, =duhovima= i ljudima, kako bi hvalili Njegovo djelo i sve Njegovo stvorenje; da vide djelo Njegove moći, hvale veliko djelo Njegovih ruku i blagoslivljaju Ga dovijeka.

verses.text_en: The second vision which he saw, the vision of wisdom—which Enoch, the son of Jared, the son of Mahalalel, the son of Cainan, the son of Enos, the son of Seth, the son of Adam, saw.
verses.text_hr: Drugo viđenje koje je vidio, viđenje mudrosti što ga je vidio Henok, sin Jaredov, sin Mahalalelov, sin Kenanov, sin Enošev, sin Šetov, sin Adamov.

verses.text_en: And this is the beginning of the words of wisdom which I lifted up my voice to speak and say to those which dwell on earth: Hear, ye men of old time, and see, ye that come after, the words of the Holy One which I will speak before the Lord of Spirits.
verses.text_hr: Ovo je početak riječi mudrosti o kojima sam podigao glas da ih izgovorim i kažem stanovnicima zemlje: Čujte, vi iz davnih vremena, i promotrite, vi koji dolazite poslije, riječi Svetoga koje ću izgovoriti pred Gospodarom duhova.

verses.text_en: It were better to declare (them only) to the men of old time, but even from those that come after we will not withhold the beginning of wisdom.
verses.text_hr: Bilo bi bolje objaviti ih samo ljudima iz davnih vremena, ali ni onima koji dolaze poslije nećemo uskratiti početak mudrosti.

verses.text_en: Till the present day such wisdom has never been given =by= the Lord of Spirits as I have received according to my insight, according to the good pleasure of the Lord of Spirits by whom the lot of eternal life has been given to me.
verses.text_hr: Sve do današnjega dana Gospodar duhova nikomu nije dao mudrost kakvu sam ja primio prema svojem uvidu i dobrohotnosti Gospodara duhova, po kojem mi je dodijeljena baština vječnoga života.

verses.text_en: Now three parables were imparted to me, and I lifted up my voice and recounted them to those that dwell on the earth.
verses.text_hr: Tada su mi priopćene tri prispodobe, a ja sam podigao glas i ispripovijedao ih stanovnicima zemlje.

verses.text_en:
The first Parable.
When the congregation of the righteous shall appear,
And sinners shall be judged for their sins,
And shall be driven from the face of the earth,
verses.text_hr:
Prva prispodoba.
Kad se pojavi zajednica pravednika,
kad grešnici budu osuđeni zbog svojih grijeha
i protjerani s lica zemlje,

verses.text_en:
And when the Righteous One shall appear before the eyes of the righteous,
Whose elect works hang upon the Lord of Spirits,
And light shall appear to the righteous and the elect who dwell on the earth,
Where then will be the dwelling of the sinners,
And where the resting-place of those who have denied the Lord of Spirits?
It had been good for them if they had not been born.
verses.text_hr:
i kad se Pravednik pojavi pred očima pravednih,
čija izabrana djela ovise o Gospodaru duhova,
i kad svjetlost zasja pravednima i izabranima koji prebivaju na zemlji,
gdje će tada biti prebivalište grešnika
i gdje počivalište onih koji su zanijekali Gospodara duhova?
Bolje bi im bilo da se nisu ni rodili.

verses.text_en:
When the secrets of the righteous shall be revealed and the sinners judged,
And the godless driven from the presence of the righteous and elect,
verses.text_hr:
Kad se otkriju tajne pravednika i grešnicima bude suđeno,
a bezbožnici budu protjerani iz nazočnosti pravednih i izabranih,

verses.text_en:
From that time those that possess the earth shall no longer be powerful and exalted:
And they shall not be able to behold the face of the holy,
For the Lord of Spirits =has caused His light to appear=
On the face of the holy, righteous, and elect.
verses.text_hr:
od toga časa posjednici zemlje više neće biti moćni ni uzvišeni
i neće moći gledati lice svetih,
jer je Gospodar duhova učinio da njegova svjetlost zasja
na licu svetih, pravednih i izabranih.

verses.text_en:
Then shall the kings and the mighty perish
And be given into the hands of the righteous and holy.
verses.text_hr:
Tada će kraljevi i moćnici propasti
i biti predani u ruke pravednih i svetih.

verses.text_en:
And thenceforward none shall seek for themselves mercy from the Lord of Spirits:
For their life is at an end.
verses.text_hr:
Od tada nitko od njih neće moći tražiti milosrđe od Gospodara duhova,
jer je njihov život došao kraju.

verses.text_en: [And it †shall come to pass in those days that elect and holy children †will descend from the high heaven, and their seed †will become one with the children of men.
verses.text_hr: [I dogodit će se †u one dane da će izabrana i sveta djeca †sići s visokoga neba i njihovo će se potomstvo †sjediniti sa sinovima ljudskim.

verses.text_en:
And in those days Enoch received books of zeal and wrath, and books of disquiet and expulsion.]

And mercy shall not be accorded to them, saith the Lord of Spirits.
verses.text_hr:
U one je dane Henok primio knjige revnosti i srdžbe te knjige nemira i izgona.]

„I neće im se iskazati milosrđe“, govori Gospodar duhova.

verses.text_en:
And in those days a whirlwind carried me off from the earth,
And set me down at the end of the heavens.
verses.text_hr:
U one me dane vihor odnio sa zemlje
i spustio na kraj nebesa.

verses.text_en:
And there I saw another vision, the dwelling-places of the holy,
And the resting-places of the righteous.
verses.text_hr:
Ondje sam vidio drugo viđenje: prebivališta svetih
i počivališta pravednih.

verses.text_en:
Here mine eyes saw their dwellings with His righteous angels,
And their resting-places with the holy.
And they petitioned and interceded and prayed for the children of men.
And righteousness flowed before them as water,
And mercy like dew upon the earth:
Thus it is amongst them for ever and ever.
verses.text_hr:
Ondje su moje oči vidjele njihova prebivališta s njegovim pravednim anđelima
i njihova počivališta sa svetima.
Molili su, zauzimali se i preklinjali za sinove ljudske.
Pravednost je pred njima tekla poput vode,
a milosrđe poput rose po zemlji:
tako je među njima u vijeke vjekova.

verses.text_en:
[6a] And in that place mine eyes saw the Elect One of righteousness and of faith,

[6b] And righteousness shall prevail in his days,
And the righteous and elect shall be without number before Him for ever and ever.
verses.text_hr:
[6a] Na tome su mjestu moje oči vidjele Izabranoga pravednosti i vjere.

[6b] Pravednost će prevladati u njegove dane,
a pravednih i izabranih bit će pred njim bezbroj u vijeke vjekova.

verses.text_en:
[7a] And I saw his dwelling-place under the wings of the Lord of Spirits.

[7b] And all the righteous and elect before Him shall be †strong† as fiery lights,
And their mouth shall be full of blessing,
And their lips shall extol the name of the Lord of Spirits,
And righteousness before Him shall never fail,
[And uprightness shall never fail before Him].
verses.text_hr:
[7a] Vidio sam njegovo prebivalište pod krilima Gospodara duhova.

[7b] Svi pravedni i izabrani pred njim bit će †snažni† poput ognjenih svjetala,
usta će im biti puna blagoslova,
a njihove će usne uzvisivati ime Gospodara duhova.
Pravednosti pred njim nikada neće uzmanjkati
[i čestitosti pred njim nikada neće uzmanjkati].

verses.text_en:
There I wished to dwell,
And my spirit longed for that dwelling-place:
And there heretofore hath been my portion,
For so hath it been established concerning me before the Lord of Spirits.
verses.text_hr:
Ondje sam poželio prebivati
i moj je duh čeznuo za tim prebivalištem.
Ondje je otprije bio moj dio,
jer je tako o meni određeno pred Gospodarom duhova.

verses.text_en: In those days I praised and extolled the name of the Lord of Spirits with blessings and praises, because He hath destined me for blessing and glory according to the good pleasure of the Lord of Spirits.
verses.text_hr: U one sam dane blagoslovima i hvalospjevima hvalio i uzvisivao ime Gospodara duhova, jer me prema svojoj dobrohotnosti odredio za blagoslov i slavu.

verses.text_en: For a long time my eyes regarded that place, and I blessed Him and praised Him, saying: ‘Blessed is He, and may He be blessed from the beginning and for evermore.
verses.text_hr: Dugo su moje oči promatrale to mjesto, a ja sam ga blagoslivljao i hvalio govoreći: „Blagoslovljen je on i neka bude blagoslovljen od početka i zauvijek.

verses.text_en: And before Him there is no ceasing. He knows before the world was created what is for ever and what will be from generation unto generation.
verses.text_hr: Pred njim nema prestanka. On je još prije stvaranja svijeta znao što traje zauvijek i što će biti od naraštaja do naraštaja.

verses.text_en: Those who sleep not bless Thee: they stand before Thy glory and bless, praise, and extol, saying: “Holy, holy, holy, is the Lord of Spirits: He filleth the earth with spirits.”’
verses.text_hr: Oni koji ne spavaju blagoslivljaju te: stoje pred tvojom slavom i blagoslivljaju, hvale i uzvisuju govoreći: ‘Svet, svet, svet je Gospodar duhova; on ispunja zemlju duhovima.’“

verses.text_en: And here my eyes saw all those who sleep not: they stand before Him and bless and say: ‘Blessed be Thou, and blessed be the name of the Lord for ever and ever.’
verses.text_hr: Ondje su moje oči vidjele sve one koji ne spavaju: stoje pred njim, blagoslivljaju i govore: „Blagoslovljen si ti i blagoslovljeno neka je ime Gospodnje u vijeke vjekova.“

verses.text_en: And my face was changed; for I could no longer behold.
verses.text_hr: Moje se lice promijenilo, jer više nisam mogao gledati.

verses.text_en: And after that I saw thousands of thousands and ten thousand times ten thousand, I saw a multitude beyond number and reckoning, who stood before the Lord of Spirits.
verses.text_hr: Nakon toga vidio sam tisuće tisuća i deset tisuća puta deset tisuća; vidio sam mnoštvo kojemu nije bilo ni broja ni računa kako stoji pred Gospodarom duhova.

verses.text_en: And on the four sides of the Lord of Spirits I saw four presences, different from those that sleep not, and I learnt their names: for the angel who went with me made known to me their names, and showed me all the hidden things.
verses.text_hr: Na četiri strane Gospodara duhova vidio sam četiri lika, različita od onih koji ne spavaju, i doznao njihova imena. Anđeo koji je išao sa mnom otkrio mi je njihova imena i pokazao mi sve što je skriveno.

verses.text_en: And I heard the voices of those four presences as they uttered praises before the Lord of glory.
verses.text_hr: Čuo sam glasove tih četiriju likova kako izriču hvale pred Gospodarom slave.

verses.text_en: The first voice blesses the Lord of Spirits for ever and ever.
verses.text_hr: Prvi glas blagoslivlja Gospodara duhova u vijeke vjekova.

verses.text_en: And the second voice I heard blessing the Elect One and the elect ones who hang upon the Lord of Spirits.
verses.text_hr: Drugi sam glas čuo kako blagoslivlja Izabranoga i izabrane koji ovise o Gospodaru duhova.

verses.text_en: And the third voice I heard =pray and intercede= for those who dwell on the earth and =supplicate= in the name of the Lord of Spirits.
verses.text_hr: Treći sam glas čuo kako moli i zauzima se za stanovnike zemlje te usrdno preklinje u ime Gospodara duhova.

verses.text_en: And I heard the fourth voice fending off the Satans and forbidding them to come before the Lord of Spirits to accuse them who dwell on the earth.
verses.text_hr: Čuo sam četvrti glas kako odbija sotone i zabranjuje im pristupiti pred Gospodara duhova da optužuju stanovnike zemlje.

verses.text_en: After that I asked the angel of peace who went with me, who showed me everything that is hidden: ‘Who are these four presences which I have seen and whose words I have heard and written down?’
verses.text_hr: Nakon toga upitao sam anđela mira koji je išao sa mnom i pokazivao mi sve što je skriveno: „Tko su ta četiri lika koja sam vidio i čije sam riječi čuo i zapisao?“

verses.text_en: And he said to me: ‘This first is Michael, the merciful and long-suffering: and the second, who is set over all the diseases and all the wounds of the children of men, is Raphael: and the third, who is set over all the powers, is Gabriel: and the fourth, who is set over the repentance unto hope of those who inherit eternal life, is named Phanuel.’
verses.text_hr: Rekao mi je: „Prvi je Mihael, milosrdan i strpljiv; drugi, postavljen nad svim bolestima i svim ranama sinova ljudskih, jest Rafael; treći, postavljen nad svim silama, jest Gabriel; a četvrti, postavljen nad pokajanjem koje vodi k nadi onih što baštine vječni život, zove se Fanuel.“

verses.text_en: And these are the four angels of the Lord of Spirits and the four voices I heard in those days.
verses.text_hr: To su četiri anđela Gospodara duhova i četiri glasa koja sam čuo u one dane.

verses.text_en: And after that I saw all the secrets of the heavens, and how the kingdom is divided, and how the actions of men are weighed in the balance.
verses.text_hr: Nakon toga vidio sam sve tajne nebesa: kako je kraljevstvo razdijeljeno i kako se djela ljudi važu na tezulji.

verses.text_en: And there I saw the mansions of the elect and the mansions of the holy, and mine eyes saw there all the sinners being driven from thence which deny the name of the Lord of Spirits, and being dragged off: and they could not abide because of the punishment which proceeds from the Lord of Spirits.
verses.text_hr: Ondje sam vidio boravišta izabranih i boravišta svetih. Moje su oči vidjele kako odande izgone i odvlače sve grešnike koji niječu ime Gospodara duhova. Nisu mogli ostati zbog kazne koja dolazi od Gospodara duhova.

verses.text_en: And there mine eyes saw the secrets of the lightning and of the thunder, and the secrets of the winds, how they are divided to blow over the earth, and the secrets of the clouds and dew, and there I saw from whence they proceed in that place and from whence they saturate the dusty earth.
verses.text_hr: Ondje su moje oči vidjele tajne munje i groma, tajne vjetrova i kako se razdjeljuju da bi puhali nad zemljom, zatim tajne oblaka i rose. Vidio sam odakle na tome mjestu izlaze i odakle natapaju prašnjavu zemlju.

verses.text_en: And there I saw closed chambers out of which the winds are divided, the chamber of the hail and winds, the chamber of the mist, and of the clouds, and the cloud thereof hovers over the earth from the beginning of the world.
verses.text_hr: Ondje sam vidio zatvorene odaje iz kojih se razdjeljuju vjetrovi: odaju tuče i vjetrova, odaju magle i oblaka; njihov oblak lebdi nad zemljom od početka svijeta.

verses.text_en: And I saw the chambers of the sun and moon, whence they proceed and whither they come again, and their glorious return, and how one is superior to the other, and their stately orbit, and how they do not leave their orbit, and they add nothing to their orbit and they take nothing from it, and they keep faith with each other, in accordance with the oath by which they are bound together.
verses.text_hr: Vidio sam odaje sunca i mjeseca, odakle izlaze i kamo se vraćaju, njihov slavni povratak, kako je jedno uzvišenije od drugoga, njihove veličanstvene putanje i kako ih ne napuštaju. Ništa ne dodaju svojoj putanji niti od nje išta oduzimaju, nego ostaju vjerni jedno drugomu prema zakletvi koja ih veže.

verses.text_en: And first the sun goes forth and traverses his path according to the commandment of the Lord of Spirits, and mighty is His name for ever and ever.
verses.text_hr: Najprije izlazi sunce i prolazi svojim putem prema zapovijedi Gospodara duhova, čije je ime moćno u vijeke vjekova.

Nakon toga vidio sam skriveni i vidljivi put mjeseca. On na tome mjestu dovršava tijek svojega puta danju i noću; jedno stoji nasuprot drugomu pred Gospodarom duhova.

Zahvaljuju i hvale bez prestanka,
jer im je zahvaljivanje odmor.

verses.text_en:
For the sun changes oft for a blessing or a curse,
And the course of the path of the moon is light to the righteous,
And darkness to the sinners in the name of the Lord,
Who made a separation between the light and the darkness,
And divided the spirits of men,
And strengthened the spirits of the righteous,
In the name of His righteousness.
verses.text_hr:
Sunce se često mijenja na blagoslov ili na prokletstvo,
a tijek mjesečeva puta jest svjetlost pravednima
i tama grešnicima, u ime Gospodina
koji je razdvojio svjetlost od tame,
razlučio ljudske duhove
i ojačao duhove pravednih
u ime svoje pravednosti.

verses.text_en: For no angel hinders and no power is able to hinder; for He appoints a judge for them all and he judges them all before Him.
verses.text_hr: Nijedan anđeo ne priječi i nijedna sila ne može spriječiti, jer on svima postavlja suca, a taj im svima sudi pred njim.

verses.text_en:
Wisdom found no place where she might dwell;
Then a dwelling-place was assigned her in the heavens.
verses.text_hr:
Mudrost nije našla mjesta gdje bi prebivala;
stoga joj je određeno prebivalište na nebesima.

verses.text_en:
Wisdom went forth to make her dwelling among the children of men,
And found no dwelling-place:
Wisdom returned to her place
And took her seat among the angels.
verses.text_hr:
Mudrost je izišla da se nastani među sinovima ljudskim,
ali nije našla prebivališta.
Vratila se na svoje mjesto
i sjela među anđele.

verses.text_en:
And unrighteousness went forth from her chambers:
Whom she sought not she found,
And dwelt with them,
As rain in a desert,
And dew on a thirsty land.
verses.text_hr:
A nepravda je izišla iz svojih odaja.
Našla je one koje nije tražila
i nastanila se među njima,
poput kiše u pustinji
i rose na žednoj zemlji.

verses.text_en: And I saw other lightnings and the stars of heaven, and I saw how He called them all by their names and they hearkened unto Him.
verses.text_hr: Vidio sam druge munje i zvijezde nebeske; vidio sam kako ih je sve pozvao po imenu i one su ga poslušale.

verses.text_en: And I saw how they are weighed in a righteous balance according to their proportions of light: (I saw) the width of their spaces and the day of their appearing, and how their revolution produces lightning: and (I saw) their revolution according to the number of the angels, and (how) they keep faith with each other.
verses.text_hr: Vidio sam kako se važu na pravednoj tezulji prema omjeru svoje svjetlosti: vidio sam širinu njihovih prostora i dan njihova pojavljivanja, kako njihovo kruženje proizvodi munju, njihovo kruženje prema broju anđela i kako ostaju vjerne jedna drugoj.

verses.text_en: And I asked the angel who went with me who showed me what was hidden: ‘What are these?’
verses.text_hr: Upitao sam anđela koji je išao sa mnom i pokazivao mi što je skriveno: „Što je to?“

verses.text_en: And he said to me: ‘The Lord of Spirits hath showed thee their parabolic meaning (lit. ‘their parable’): these are the names of the holy who dwell on the earth and believe in the name of the Lord of Spirits for ever and ever.’
verses.text_hr: Odgovorio mi je: „Gospodar duhova pokazao ti je njihovo značenje u prispodobi, doslovno ‘njihovu prispodobu’. To su imena svetih koji prebivaju na zemlji i vjeruju u ime Gospodara duhova u vijeke vjekova.“

verses.text_en: Also another phenomenon I saw in regard to the lightnings: how some of the stars arise and become lightnings and cannot part with their new form.
verses.text_hr: Vidio sam i drugu pojavu povezanu s munjama: neke zvijezde izlaze, postaju munje i više se ne mogu rastati od svojega novog oblika.

verses.text_en: And this is the Second Parable concerning those who deny the name of the dwelling of the holy ones and the Lord of Spirits.
verses.text_hr: Ovo je Druga prispodoba o onima koji niječu ime prebivališta svetih i Gospodara duhova.

verses.text_en:
And into the heaven they shall not ascend,
And on the earth they shall not come:
Such shall be the lot of the sinners
Who have denied the name of the Lord of Spirits,
Who are thus preserved for the day of suffering and tribulation.
verses.text_hr:
Oni neće uzaći na nebo
niti će doći na zemlju.
Takva će biti baština grešnika
koji su zanijekali ime Gospodara duhova
i tako se čuvaju za dan patnje i nevolje.

verses.text_en:
On that day Mine Elect, One shall sit on the throne of glory
And shall =try= their works,
And their places of rest shall be innumerable.
And their souls shall grow strong within them when they see Mine elect ones,
And those who have called upon My glorious name:
verses.text_hr:
Toga će dana moj Izabrani sjesti na prijestolje slave
i ispitati njihova djela,
a njegovim počivalištima neće biti broja.
Njihove će duše ojačati u njima kad vide moje izabrane
i one koji su zazvali moje slavno ime.

verses.text_en:
Then will I cause Mine Elect One to dwell among them.
And I will transform the heaven and make it an eternal blessing and light,
verses.text_hr:
Tada ću svojega Izabranoga nastaniti među njima.
Preobrazit ću nebo i učiniti ga vječnim blagoslovom i svjetlošću.

verses.text_en:
And I will transform the earth and make it a blessing:
And I will cause Mine elect ones to dwell upon it:
But the sinners and evil-doers shall not set foot thereon.
verses.text_hr:
Preobrazit ću zemlju i učiniti je blagoslovom,
te na njoj nastaniti svoje izabrane.
Ali grešnici i zločinci neće na nju stupiti.

verses.text_en:
For I have provided and satisfied with peace My righteous ones,
And have caused them to dwell before Me:
But for the sinners there is judgement impending with Me,
So that I shall destroy them from the face of the earth.
verses.text_hr:
Jer svojim sam pravednicima pribavio mir i njime ih nasitio
te ih nastanio pred sobom.
Ali kod mene grešnike čeka sud,
da ih uništim s lica zemlje.

verses.text_en:
And there I saw One, who had a head of days,
And His head was white like wool,
And with Him was another being whose countenance had the appearance of a man,
And his face was full of graciousness, like one of the holy angels.
verses.text_hr:
Ondje sam vidio Onoga koji je imao Glavu Dana,
a glava mu je bila bijela poput vune.
S njim je bilo drugo biće čije je lice imalo obličje čovjeka,
a bilo je puno miline poput lica jednoga od svetih anđela.

verses.text_en: And I asked the =angel= who went with me and showed me all the hidden things, concerning that Son of Man, who he was, and whence he was, (and) why he went with the Head of Days?
verses.text_hr: Upitao sam anđela koji je išao sa mnom i pokazivao mi sve što je skriveno o tome Sinu Čovječjemu: tko je, odakle dolazi i zašto ide s Glavom Dana?

verses.text_en:
And he answered and said unto me:

This is the Son of Man who hath righteousness,
With whom dwelleth righteousness,
And who revealeth all the treasures of that which is hidden,
Because the Lord of Spirits hath chosen him,
And whose lot hath the pre-eminence before the Lord of Spirits in uprightness for ever.
verses.text_hr:
Odgovorio mi je:

„To je Sin Čovječji koji ima pravednost,
u kojem prebiva pravednost
i koji otkriva sve riznice onoga što je skriveno,
jer ga je Gospodar duhova izabrao,
a njegov je dio zbog čestitosti zauvijek uzvišen pred Gospodarom duhova.

verses.text_en:
And this Son of Man whom thou hast seen
Shall †raise up† the kings and the mighty from their seats,
[And the strong from their thrones]
And shall loosen the reins of the strong,
And break the teeth of the sinners;
verses.text_hr:
Taj Sin Čovječji kojega si vidio
†podignut će† kraljeve i moćnike s njihovih sjedišta,
[i snažne s njihovih prijestolja],
razriješit će uzde snažnih
i polomiti zube grešnicima.

verses.text_en:
[And he shall put down the kings from their thrones and kingdoms]
Because they do not extol and praise Him,
Nor humbly acknowledge whence the kingdom was bestowed upon them.
verses.text_hr:
[Zbacit će kraljeve s njihovih prijestolja i iz njihovih kraljevstava],
jer njega ne uzvisuju niti hvale
i ponizno ne priznaju odakle im je darovano kraljevstvo.

verses.text_en:
And he shall put down the countenance of the strong,
And shall fill them with shame.
And darkness shall be their dwelling,
And worms shall be their bed,
And they shall have no hope of rising from their beds,
Because they do not extol the name of the Lord of Spirits.
verses.text_hr:
Oborit će lice snažnih
i ispuniti ih sramotom.
Tama će biti njihovo prebivalište,
a crvi njihova postelja.
Neće biti nade da ustanu sa svojih postelja,
jer ne uzvisuju ime Gospodara duhova.

verses.text_en:
And these are they who †judge† the stars of heaven,
[And raise their hands against the Most High],
†And tread upon the earth and dwell upon it†.
And all their deeds manifest unrighteousness,
And their power rests upon their riches,
And their faith is in the †gods† which they have made with their hands,
And they deny the name of the Lord of Spirits,
verses.text_hr:
To su oni koji †sude† zvijezdama nebeskim,
[podižu ruke protiv Svevišnjega],
†gaze zemlju i prebivaju na njoj†.
Sva njihova djela očituju nepravdu,
a njihova moć počiva na njihovu bogatstvu.
Uzdaju se u †bogove† koje su načinili vlastitim rukama
i niječu ime Gospodara duhova.

verses.text_en:
And they persecute the houses of His congregations,
And the faithful who hang upon the name of the Lord of Spirits.
verses.text_hr:
Progone domove njegovih zajednica
i vjerne koji se oslanjaju na ime Gospodara duhova.

verses.text_en:
And in those days shall have ascended the prayer of the righteous.
And the blood of the righteous from the earth before the Lord of Spirits.
verses.text_hr:
U one će dane molitva pravednih uzaći,
a krv pravednih podići se sa zemlje pred Gospodara duhova.

verses.text_en:
In those days the holy ones who dwell above in the heavens
Shall unite with one voice
And supplicate and pray [and praise,
And give thanks and bless the name of the Lord of Spirits]
On behalf of the blood of the righteous which has been shed,
And that the prayer of the righteous may not be in vain before the Lord of Spirits,
That judgement may be done unto them,
And that they may not have to suffer for ever.
verses.text_hr:
U one će se dane sveti koji prebivaju gore na nebesima
ujediniti jednim glasom
i preklinjati i moliti [i hvaliti,
zahvaljivati i blagoslivljati ime Gospodara duhova]
zbog krvi pravednih koja je prolivena,
da molitva pravednih ne bude uzaludna pred Gospodarom duhova,
da im se izvrši pravda
i da ne moraju trpjeti zauvijek.

verses.text_en:
In those days I saw the Head of Days when He seated himself upon the throne of His glory,
And the books of the living were opened before Him:
And all His host which is in heaven above and
His counsellors stood before Him,
verses.text_hr:
U one sam dane vidio Glavu Dana kako sjeda na prijestolje svoje slave,
a pred njim su se otvorile knjige živih.
Sva njegova vojska koja je na nebesima gore
i njegovi savjetnici stajali su pred njim.

verses.text_en:
And the hearts of the holy were filled with joy;
Because the number of the righteous =had been offered=,
And the prayer of the righteous had been heard,
And the blood of the righteous been required before the Lord of Spirits.
verses.text_hr:
Srca svetih ispunila su se radošću,
jer je broj pravednih =bio prinesen=,
molitva pravednih bila uslišana,
a za krv pravednih zatražena pravda pred Gospodarom duhova.

verses.text_en:
And in that place I saw the fountain of righteousness,
Which was inexhaustible:
And around it were many fountains of wisdom;
And all the thirsty drank of them,
And were filled with wisdom,
And their dwellings were with the righteous and holy and elect.
verses.text_hr:
Na tome sam mjestu vidio neiscrpan izvor pravednosti.
Oko njega su bili mnogi izvori mudrosti;
svi žedni pili su iz njih
i ispunili se mudrošću,
a njihova prebivališta bila su s pravednima, svetima i izabranima.

verses.text_en:
And at that hour that Son of Man was named
In the presence of the Lord of Spirits,
And his name before the Head of Days.
verses.text_hr:
U tome je času taj Sin Čovječji bio imenovan
u nazočnosti Gospodara duhova,
a njegovo ime pred Glavom Dana.

verses.text_en:
Yea, before the sun and the signs were created,
Before the stars of the heaven were made,
His name was named before the Lord of Spirits.
verses.text_hr:
Još prije nego što su stvoreni sunce i znakovi,
prije nego što su načinjene zvijezde nebeske,
njegovo je ime bilo izgovoreno pred Gospodarom duhova.

verses.text_en:
He shall be a staff to the righteous whereon to stay themselves and not fall,
And he shall be the light of the Gentiles,
And the hope of those who are troubled of heart.
verses.text_hr:
On će biti štap na koji će se pravedni oslanjati da ne padnu,
svjetlost narodima
i nada onima kojima je srce izmučeno.

verses.text_en:
All who dwell on earth shall fall down and worship before him,
And will praise and bless and celebrate with song the Lord of Spirits.
verses.text_hr:
Svi stanovnici zemlje past će ničice i pokloniti se pred njim
te hvaliti, blagoslivljati i pjesmom slaviti Gospodara duhova.

verses.text_en:
And for this reason hath he been chosen and hidden before Him,
Before the creation of the world and for evermore.
verses.text_hr:
Zato je bio izabran i skriven pred njim
još prije stvaranja svijeta i zauvijek.

Mudrost Gospodara duhova objavila ga je svetima i pravednima,
jer je sačuvao baštinu pravednih.
Oni su zamrzili i prezreli ovaj svijet nepravde
i u ime Gospodara duhova zamrzili sva njegova djela i putove.
U njegovo se ime spašavaju,
a prema njegovoj dobrohotnosti određeno je što će biti s njihovim životom.

U one će dane kraljevi zemlje postati oborena lica,
kao i snažni koji posjeduju zemlju, zbog djela svojih ruku.
U dan svoje tjeskobe i nevolje neće se moći spasiti.

verses.text_en:
And I will give them over into the hands of Mine elect:
As straw in the fire so shall they burn before the face of the holy:
As lead in the water shall they sink before the face of the righteous,
And no trace of them shall any more be found.
verses.text_hr:
Predat ću ih u ruke svojih izabranih.
Kao slama u vatri gorjet će pred licem svetih;
kao olovo u vodi potonut će pred licem pravednih
i više im se neće naći nikakva traga.

verses.text_en:
And on the day of their affliction there shall be rest on the earth,
And before them they shall fall and not rise again:
And there shall be no one to take them with his hands and raise them:
For they have denied the Lord of Spirits and His Anointed.
The name of the Lord of Spirits be blessed.
verses.text_hr:
U dan njihove nevolje na zemlji će zavladati mir,
a oni će pred njima pasti i neće više ustati.
Neće biti nikoga da ih uzme za ruku i podigne,
jer su zanijekali Gospodara duhova i njegova Pomazanika.
Neka je blagoslovljeno ime Gospodara duhova.

verses.text_en:
For wisdom is poured out like water,
And glory faileth not before him for evermore.
verses.text_hr:
Jer mudrost se izlijeva poput vode,
a slava pred njim ne prestaje zauvijek.

verses.text_en:
For he is mighty in all the secrets of righteousness,
And unrighteousness shall disappear as a shadow,
And have no continuance;
Because the Elect One standeth before the Lord of Spirits,
And his glory is for ever and ever,
And his might unto all generations.
verses.text_hr:
Moćan je u svim tajnama pravednosti,
a nepravda će nestati poput sjene
i neće opstati,
jer Izabrani stoji pred Gospodarom duhova.
Njegova slava traje u vijeke vjekova,
a njegova moć kroz sve naraštaje.

verses.text_en:
And in him dwells the spirit of wisdom,
And the spirit which gives insight,
And the spirit of understanding and of might,
And the spirit of those who have fallen asleep in righteousness.
verses.text_hr:
U njemu prebiva duh mudrosti,
duh koji daje uvid,
duh razboritosti i snage
i duh onih koji su usnuli u pravednosti.

On će suditi skrivenim stvarima
i nitko pred njim neće moći izgovoriti lažnu riječ,
jer je on Izabrani pred Gospodarom duhova prema njegovoj dobrohotnosti.

verses.text_en:
And in those days a change shall take place for the holy and elect,
And the light of days shall abide upon them,
And glory and honour shall turn to the holy,

On the day of affliction on which evil shall have been treasured up against the sinners.
And the righteous shall be victorious in the name of the Lord of Spirits:
And He will cause the others to witness (this),
That they may repent
And forgo the works of their hands.
verses.text_hr:
u dan nevolje kad zlo bude nagomilano protiv grešnika.
Pravedni će pobijediti u ime Gospodara duhova,
a on će dati drugima da to vide
kako bi se pokajali
i odrekli djela svojih ruku.

verses.text_en:
They shall have no honour through the name of the Lord of Spirits,
Yet through His name shall they be saved,
And the Lord of Spirits will have compassion on them,
For His compassion is great.
verses.text_hr:
Neće steći časti po imenu Gospodara duhova,
ali će se po njegovu imenu spasiti.
Gospodar duhova smilovat će im se,
jer je njegovo milosrđe veliko.

verses.text_en:
And He is righteous also in His judgement,
And in the presence of His glory unrighteousness also shall not maintain itself:
At His judgement the unrepentant shall perish before Him.
verses.text_hr:
On je pravedan i u svojem sudu,
a pred njegovom se slavom nepravda neće održati.
Na njegovu će sudu nepokajani propasti pred njim.

verses.text_en: And from henceforth I will have no mercy on them, saith the Lord of Spirits.
verses.text_hr: „Od tada im se više neću smilovati“, govori Gospodar duhova.

verses.text_en:
And in those days shall the earth also give back that which has been entrusted to it,
And Sheol also shall give back that which it has received,
And hell shall give back that which it owes.
verses.text_hr:
U one će dane zemlja vratiti ono što joj je bilo povjereno,
Šeol će vratiti ono što je primio,
a pakao ono što duguje.

verses.text_en:
And he shall choose the righteous and holy from among them:
For the day has drawn nigh that they should be saved.
verses.text_hr:
On će među njima izabrati pravedne i svete,
jer se približio dan njihova spasenja.

verses.text_en:
And the Elect One shall in those days sit on My throne,
And his mouth shall pour forth all the secrets of wisdom and counsel:
For the Lord of Spirits hath given (them) to him and hath glorified him.
verses.text_hr:
U one će dane Izabrani sjesti na moje prijestolje,
a njegova će usta izlijevati sve tajne mudrosti i savjeta,
jer mu ih je Gospodar duhova dao i proslavio ga.

verses.text_en:
And in those days shall the mountains leap like rams,
And the hills also shall skip like lambs satisfied with milk,
And the faces of [all] the angels in heaven shall be lighted up with joy.

[5a] For in those days the Elect One shall arise,

[5b] And the earth shall rejoice,

[5c] And the righteous shall dwell upon it,

[5d] And the elect shall walk thereon.
verses.text_hr:
[5a] Jer u one će dane Izabrani ustati,

[5b] i zemlja će se radovati,

[5c] pravedni će prebivati na njoj,

[5d] a izabrani hoditi po njoj.

verses.text_en: And after those days in that place where I had seen all the visions of that which is hidden—for I had been carried off in a whirlwind and they had borne me towards the west—
verses.text_hr: Nakon tih dana, na mjestu gdje sam vidio sva viđenja onoga što je skriveno — jer me vihor odnio i ponio prema zapadu —

verses.text_en: There mine eyes saw all the secret things of heaven that shall be, a mountain of iron, and a mountain of copper, and a mountain of silver, and a mountain of gold, and a mountain of soft metal, and a mountain of lead.
verses.text_hr: ondje su moje oči vidjele sve buduće tajne nebesa: planinu od željeza, planinu od bakra, planinu od srebra, planinu od zlata, planinu od meke kovine i planinu od olova.

verses.text_en: And I asked the angel who went with me, saying, ‘What things are these which I have seen in secret?’
verses.text_hr: Upitao sam anđela koji je išao sa mnom: „Što je to što sam vidio u skrovitosti?“

verses.text_en: And he said unto me: ‘All these things which thou hast seen shall serve the dominion of His Anointed that he may be potent and mighty on the earth.’
verses.text_hr: Odgovorio mi je: „Sve što si vidio služit će vlasti njegova Pomazanika, da bude silan i moćan na zemlji.“

verses.text_en: And that angel of peace answered, saying unto me: ‘Wait a little and there shall be revealed unto thee all the secret things, which surround the Lord of Spirits.
verses.text_hr: Anđeo mira rekao mi je: „Pričekaj malo i bit će ti otkrivene sve tajne koje okružuju Gospodara duhova.

verses.text_en:
And these mountains which thine eyes have seen, The mountain of iron, and the mountain of copper, and the mountain of silver,
And the mountain of gold, and the mountain of soft metal, and the mountain of lead,
All these shall be in the presence of the Elect One,
As wax before the fire,
And like the water which streams down from above [upon those mountains],
And they shall become powerless before his feet.
verses.text_hr:
Ove planine koje su tvoje oči vidjele — planina od željeza, planina od bakra, planina od srebra,
planina od zlata, planina od meke kovine i planina od olova —
sve će one pred Izabranim biti
poput voska pred vatrom
i poput vode koja odozgo teče [niz te planine];
pred njegovim će nogama izgubiti svu snagu.

verses.text_en:
And it shall come to pass in those days that none shall be saved,
Either by gold or by silver,
And none be able to escape.
verses.text_hr:
U one se dane nitko neće spasiti
ni zlatom ni srebrom
i nitko neće moći umaći.

verses.text_en:
And there shall be no iron for war,
Nor shall one clothe oneself with a breastplate.
Bronze shall be of no service,
And tin [shall be of no service and] shall not be esteemed,
And lead shall not be desired.
verses.text_hr:
Neće biti željeza za rat
niti će se tko odjenuti u oklop.
Bronca neće biti ni od kakve koristi,
a kositar [neće biti ni od kakve koristi i] neće se cijeniti;
olovo neće biti poželjno.

verses.text_en:
And all these things shall be [denied and] destroyed from the surface of the earth,
When the Elect One shall appear before the face of the Lord of Spirits.’
verses.text_hr:
Sve će to biti [odbačeno i] uništeno s lica zemlje
kad se Izabrani pojavi pred licem Gospodara duhova.“

verses.text_en: There mine eyes saw a deep valley with open mouths, and all who dwell on the earth and sea and islands shall bring to him gifts and presents and tokens of homage, but that deep valley shall not become full.
verses.text_hr: Ondje su moje oči vidjele duboku dolinu razjapljenih usta. Svi koji prebivaju na zemlji, moru i otocima donosit će mu darove, poklone i znakove pokornosti, ali ta se duboka dolina neće napuniti.

verses.text_en:
And their hands commit lawless deeds,
And the sinners devour all whom they lawlessly =oppress=:
Yet the sinners shall be destroyed before the face of the Lord of Spirits,
And they shall be banished from off the face of His earth,
And they shall perish for ever and ever.
verses.text_hr:
Njihove ruke čine bezakona djela,
a grešnici proždiru sve koje bezakono =tlače=.
Ipak će grešnici biti uništeni pred licem Gospodara duhova,
protjerani s lica njegove zemlje
i propasti u vijeke vjekova.

verses.text_en: For I saw all the angels of punishment abiding (there) and preparing all the instruments of Satan.
verses.text_hr: Vidio sam sve anđele kazne kako ondje borave i pripravljaju sva Sotonina oruđa.

verses.text_en: And I asked the angel of peace who went with me: ‘For whom are they preparing these instruments?’
verses.text_hr: Upitao sam anđela mira koji je išao sa mnom: „Za koga pripravljaju ta oruđa?“

verses.text_en: And he said unto me: ‘They prepare these for the kings and the mighty of this earth, that they may thereby be destroyed.
verses.text_hr: Odgovorio mi je: „Pripravljaju ih za kraljeve i moćnike ove zemlje da njima budu uništeni.

verses.text_en: And after this the Righteous and Elect One shall cause the house of his congregation to appear: henceforth they shall be no more hindered in the name of the Lord of Spirits.
verses.text_hr: Nakon toga Pravednik i Izabrani dat će da se pojavi dom njegove zajednice; od tada više neće biti priječeni u ime Gospodara duhova.

verses.text_en:
And these mountains shall not stand as the earth before his righteousness,
But the hills shall be as a fountain of water,
And the righteous shall have rest from the oppression of sinners.’
verses.text_hr:
Te planine pred njegovom pravednošću neće ostati čvrste poput zemlje,
nego će brežuljci postati poput izvora vode,
a pravedni će počinuti od tlačenja grešnika.“

verses.text_en: And I looked and turned to another part of the earth, and saw there a deep valley with burning fire.
verses.text_hr: Pogledao sam, okrenuo se prema drugome dijelu zemlje i ondje vidio duboku dolinu s razbuktalom vatrom.

verses.text_en: And they brought the kings and the mighty, and began to cast them into this deep valley.
verses.text_hr: Doveli su kraljeve i moćnike te ih počeli bacati u tu duboku dolinu.

verses.text_en: And there mine eyes saw how they made these their instruments, iron chains of immeasurable weight.
verses.text_hr: Ondje su moje oči vidjele kako im izrađuju oruđa: željezne lance neizmjerne težine.

verses.text_en: And I asked the angel of peace who went with me, saying: ‘For whom are these chains being prepared?’
verses.text_hr: Upitao sam anđela mira koji je išao sa mnom: „Za koga se pripravljaju ovi lanci?“

verses.text_en: And he said unto me: ‘These are being prepared for the hosts of Azâzêl, so that they may take them and cast them into the abyss of complete condemnation, and they shall cover their jaws with rough stones as the Lord of Spirits commanded.
verses.text_hr: Odgovorio mi je: „Pripravljaju se za Azazelove vojske, da ih njima uhvate i bace u bezdan potpune osude. Njihova će usta prekriti grubim kamenjem, kako je zapovjedio Gospodar duhova.

verses.text_en: And Michael, and Gabriel, and Raphael, and Phanuel shall take hold of them on that great day, and cast them on that day into the burning furnace, that the Lord of Spirits may take vengeance on them for their unrighteousness in becoming subject to Satan and leading astray those who dwell on the earth.’
verses.text_hr: Mihael, Gabriel, Rafael i Fanuel uhvatit će ih onoga velikog dana i baciti ih toga dana u užarenu peć, da im se Gospodar duhova osveti zbog nepravde kojom su se podložili Sotoni i zaveli stanovnike zemlje.“

verses.text_en: ‘And in those days shall punishment come from the Lord of Spirits, and He will open all the chambers of waters which are above the heavens, and of the fountains which are beneath the earth.
verses.text_hr: „U one će dane kazna doći od Gospodara duhova. Otvorit će sve odaje voda koje su iznad nebesa i izvore koji su pod zemljom.

verses.text_en: And all the waters shall be joined with the waters: that which is above the heavens is the masculine, and the water which is beneath the earth is the feminine.
verses.text_hr: Sve će se vode sjediniti: voda iznad nebesa muška je, a voda pod zemljom ženska.

verses.text_en: And they shall destroy all who dwell on the earth and those who dwell under the ends of the heaven.
verses.text_hr: One će uništiti sve stanovnike zemlje i one koji prebivaju pod krajevima neba.

verses.text_en: And =when= they have recognized their unrighteousness which they have wrought on the earth, then by these shall they perish.’
verses.text_hr: Kad spoznaju nepravdu koju su činili na zemlji, tim će vodama propasti.“

verses.text_en: And after that the Head of Days repented and said: ‘In vain have I destroyed all who dwell on the earth.’
verses.text_hr: Nakon toga Glava Dana požalio je i rekao: „Uzalud sam uništio sve stanovnike zemlje.“

verses.text_en: And He sware by His great name: ‘Henceforth I will not do so to all who dwell on the earth, and I will set a sign in the heaven: and this shall be a pledge of good faith between Me and them for ever, so long as heaven is above the earth. And this is in accordance with My command.’
verses.text_hr: Zakleo se svojim velikim imenom: „Od sada više neću tako postupiti sa svim stanovnicima zemlje. Postavit ću znak na nebu i on će zauvijek biti zalog vjernosti između mene i njih, sve dok je nebo nad zemljom. Tako sam zapovjedio.“

verses.text_en: ‘When I have desired to take hold of them by the hand of the angels on the day of tribulation and pain =because of= this, I will cause My chastisement and My wrath to abide upon them, saith God, the Lord of Spirits.
verses.text_hr: „Kad na dan nevolje i boli =zbog= ovoga poželim da ih uhvate ruke anđela, dat ću da moja kazna i srdžba počivaju na njima“, govori Bog, Gospodar duhova.

verses.text_en: Ye †mighty kings† who dwell on the earth, ye shall have to behold Mine Elect One, how he sits on the throne of glory and judges Azâzêl, and all his associates, and all his hosts in the name of the Lord of Spirits.’
verses.text_hr: Vi †moćni kraljevi† koji prebivate na zemlji morat ćete gledati mojega Izabranoga kako sjedi na prijestolju slave i u ime Gospodara duhova sudi Azazelu, svim njegovim drugovima i svim njegovim vojskama.“

verses.text_en: And I saw there the hosts of the angels of punishment going, and they held scourges and chains of iron and bronze.
verses.text_hr: Ondje sam vidio kako prolaze vojske anđela kazne držeći bičeve i lance od željeza i bronce.

verses.text_en: And I asked the angel of peace who went with me, saying: ‘To whom are these who hold the scourges going?’
verses.text_hr: Upitao sam anđela mira koji je išao sa mnom: „Kamo idu ovi što drže bičeve?“

verses.text_en: And he said unto me: ‘To their elect and beloved ones that they may be cast into the chasm of the abyss of the valley.
verses.text_hr: Odgovorio mi je: „K njihovim izabranima i miljenicima, da ih bace u ponor dolinskoga bezdana.

verses.text_en:
And then that valley shall be filled with their elect and beloved,
And the days of their lives shall be at an end,
And the days of their leading astray shall not thenceforward be reckoned.
verses.text_hr:
Tada će se ta dolina napuniti njihovim izabranima i miljenicima,
dani njihova života doći će kraju,
a dani njihova zavođenja više se neće brojiti.

verses.text_en:
And in those days the angels shall return
And hurl themselves to the east upon the Parthians and Medes:
They shall stir up the kings, so that a spirit of unrest shall come upon them,
And they shall rouse them from their thrones,
That they may break forth as lions from their lairs,
