And as hungry wolves among their flocks.
verses.text_hr:
U one će se dane anđeli vratiti
i obrušiti se na istok, na Parte i Međane.
Uznemirit će kraljeve i duh će nemira doći na njih,
podići će ih s njihovih prijestolja,
da provale poput lavova iz svojih brloga
i poput gladnih vukova među svoja stada.

verses.text_en:
And they shall go up and tread under foot the land of His elect ones,
[And the land of His elect ones shall be before them a threshing-floor and a highway]:
verses.text_hr:
Uzaći će i zgaziti zemlju njegovih izabranih,
[a zemlja njegovih izabranih bit će pred njima poput gumna i široke ceste].

verses.text_en:
But the city of my righteous shall be a hindrance to their horses.
And they shall begin to fight among themselves,
And their right hand shall be strong against themselves,
And a man shall not know his brother,
Nor a son his father or his mother,
Till there be no number of the corpses through their slaughter,
And their punishment be not in vain.
verses.text_hr:
Ali grad mojih pravednika bit će zapreka njihovim konjima.
Počet će se boriti jedni protiv drugih,
a njihova će desnica biti snažna protiv njih samih.
Čovjek neće poznavati svojega brata
niti sin svojega oca ili majku,
sve dok se zbog njihova pokolja više ne budu mogla izbrojiti trupla
i njihova kazna ne bude uzaludna.

verses.text_en:
In those days Sheol shall open its jaws,
And they shall be swallowed up therein,
And their destruction shall be at an end;
Sheol shall devour the sinners in the presence of the elect.’
verses.text_hr:
U one će dane Šeol razjapiti čeljusti
i oni će biti progutani u njemu.
Njihovo će uništenje biti dovršeno;
Šeol će pred izabranima proždrijeti grešnike.“

verses.text_en: And it came to pass after this that I saw another host of wagons, and men riding thereon, and coming on the winds from the east, and from the west to the south.
verses.text_hr: Nakon toga vidio sam drugu vojsku bojnih kola i ljude kako se na njima voze, dolazeći na vjetrovima s istoka i sa zapada prema jugu.

verses.text_en: And the noise of their wagons was heard, and when this turmoil took place the holy ones from heaven remarked it, and the pillars of the earth were moved from their place, and the sound thereof was heard from the one end of heaven to the other, in one day.
verses.text_hr: Čuo se tutanj njihovih kola. Kad je nastao taj metež, sveti s neba opazili su ga, stupovi zemlje pomaknuli su se sa svojih mjesta, a njihov se zvuk u jednome danu čuo od jednoga kraja neba do drugoga.

verses.text_en: And they shall all fall down and worship the Lord of Spirits. And this is the end of the second Parable.
verses.text_hr: Svi će pasti ničice i pokloniti se Gospodaru duhova. To je kraj Druge prispodobe.

verses.text_en: And I began to speak the third Parable concerning the righteous and elect.
verses.text_hr: Počeo sam govoriti Treću prispodobu o pravednima i izabranima.

verses.text_en:
Blessed are ye, ye righteous and elect,
For glorious shall be your lot.
verses.text_hr:
Blago vama, pravedni i izabrani,
jer će slavna biti vaša baština.

verses.text_en:
And the righteous shall be in the light of the sun,
And the elect in the light of eternal life:
The days of their life shall be unending,
And the days of the holy without number.
verses.text_hr:
Pravedni će biti u svjetlosti sunca,
a izabrani u svjetlosti vječnoga života.
Danima njihova života neće biti kraja,
a danima svetih neće biti broja.

verses.text_en:
And they shall seek the light and find righteousness with the Lord of Spirits:
There shall be peace to the righteous in the name of the Eternal Lord.
verses.text_hr:
Tražit će svjetlost i naći pravednost kod Gospodara duhova.
Pravednima će biti mir u ime Vječnoga Gospodina.

verses.text_en:
And after this it shall be said to the holy in heaven
That they should seek out the secrets of righteousness, the heritage of faith:
For it has become bright as the sun upon earth,
And the darkness is past.
verses.text_hr:
Nakon toga svetima na nebu bit će rečeno
da potraže tajne pravednosti, baštinu vjere,
jer je ona postala sjajna poput sunca nad zemljom,
a tama je prošla.

verses.text_en:
And there shall be a light that never =endeth=,
And to a limit (lit. ‘number’) of days they shall not come,
For the darkness shall first have been destroyed,
[And the light established before the Lord of Spirits]
And the light of uprightness established for ever before the Lord of Spirits.
verses.text_hr:
Bit će svjetlost koja nikada =ne prestaje=
i oni neće doći do granice — doslovno „broja“ — dana,
jer će tama prije toga biti uništena,
[a svjetlost učvršćena pred Gospodarom duhova]
i svjetlost čestitosti zauvijek utvrđena pred Gospodarom duhova.

verses.text_en: [In those days mine eyes saw the secrets of the lightnings, and of the lights, and the judgements they execute (lit. ‘their judgement’): and they lighten for a blessing or a curse as the Lord of Spirits willeth.
verses.text_hr: [U one su dane moje oči vidjele tajne munja i svjetala te sudove koje izvršavaju, doslovno „njihov sud“: one svijetle na blagoslov ili prokletstvo kako hoće Gospodar duhova.

verses.text_en: And there I saw the secrets of the thunder, and how when it resounds above in the heaven, the sound thereof is heard, and he caused me to see the =judgements= executed on the earth, whether they be for well-being and blessing, or for a curse, according to the word of the Lord of Spirits.
verses.text_hr: Ondje sam vidio tajne groma: kako se, kad odjekne gore na nebu, čuje njegov zvuk. Pokazao mi je =sudove= koji se izvršavaju na zemlji, bilo za dobrobit i blagoslov bilo za prokletstvo, prema riječi Gospodara duhova.

verses.text_en: And after that all the secrets of the lights and lightnings were shown to me, and they lighten for blessing and for satisfying.]
verses.text_hr: Nakon toga pokazane su mi sve tajne svjetala i munja, a one svijetle radi blagoslova i okrjepe.]

verses.text_en: In the year five hundred, in the seventh month, on the fourteenth day of the month in the life of †Enoch†. In that Parable I saw how a mighty quaking made the heaven of heavens to quake, and the host of the Most High, and the angels, a thousand thousands and ten thousand times ten thousand, were disquieted with a great disquiet.
verses.text_hr: Petstote godine, sedmoga mjeseca, četrnaestoga dana u mjesecu, za života †Henokova†, u toj sam Prispodobi vidio kako je silan potres zatresao nebo nad nebesima. Vojska Svevišnjega i anđeli — tisuću tisuća i deset tisuća puta deset tisuća — silno su se uznemirili.

verses.text_en: And the Head of Days sat on the throne of His glory, and the angels and the righteous stood around Him.
verses.text_hr: Glava Dana sjedio je na prijestolju svoje slave, a anđeli i pravedni stajali su oko njega.

verses.text_en:
And a great trembling seized me,
And fear took hold of me,
And my loins gave way,
And dissolved were my reins,
And I fell upon my face.
verses.text_hr:
Obuzelo me silno drhtanje,
strah me zahvatio,
bedra su mi popustila,
utroba mi se rastopila
i pao sam ničice.

verses.text_en: And Michael sent another angel from among the holy ones and he raised me up, and when he had raised me up my spirit returned; for I had not been able to endure the look of this host, and the commotion and the quaking of the heaven.
verses.text_hr: Mihael je poslao drugoga anđela između svetih; on me je podigao, a kad me podigao, moj se duh vratio. Nisam mogao podnijeti prizor te vojske, metež i potres neba.

verses.text_en:
[common reading] And Michael said unto me: ‘Why art thou disquieted with such a vision? Until this day lasted the day of His mercy; and He hath been merciful and long-suffering towards those who dwell on the earth.

[common reading] When the punishment of the Lord of Spirits shall rest upon them, it shall rest in order that the punishment of the Lord of Spirits may not come in vain, and it shall slay the children with their mothers and the children with their fathers. Afterwards the judgement shall take place according to His mercy and His patience.’
verses.text_hr:
[uobičajeno čitanje] Mihael mi je rekao: „Zašto te je takvo viđenje uznemirilo? Sve do danas trajao je dan njegova milosrđa: bio je milostiv i strpljiv prema stanovnicima zemlje.

[uobičajeno čitanje] Kad kazna Gospodara duhova počine na njima, počivat će na njima kako kazna Gospodara duhova ne bi došla uzalud. Pobit će djecu s njihovim majkama i djecu s njihovim očevima. Poslije će se sud izvršiti prema njegovu milosrđu i strpljivosti.“

verses.text_en: And when the day, and the power, and the punishment, and the judgement come, which the Lord of Spirits hath prepared for those who worship not the righteous =law=, and for those who deny the righteous judgement, and for those who take His name in vain—that day is prepared; for the elect a covenant, but for sinners an inquisition.
verses.text_hr: Kad dođu dan, moć, kazna i sud koje je Gospodar duhova pripravio onima što se ne klanjaju pravednome =Zakonu=, onima što niječu pravedni sud i onima što uzalud uzimaju njegovo ime — taj je dan pripravljen: izabranima za savez, a grešnicima za istragu.

verses.text_en: And on that day were two monsters parted, a female monster named Leviathan, to dwell in the abysses of the ocean over the fountains of the waters.
verses.text_hr: Toga su dana razdvojene dvije nemani: ženska neman zvana Levijatan, određena da prebiva u dubinama oceana nad izvorima voda.

verses.text_en: But the male is named Behemoth, who occupied with his breast a waste wilderness named †Dûidâin†, on the east of the garden where the elect and righteous dwell, where my grandfather was taken up, the seventh from Adam, the first man whom the Lord of Spirits created.
verses.text_hr: Mužjak se zove Behemot; svojim je prsima zaposjeo pustu divljinu zvanu †Dûidâin†, istočno od vrta u kojem prebivaju izabrani i pravedni, gdje je bio uznesen moj djed, sedmi od Adama, prvoga čovjeka kojega je stvorio Gospodar duhova.

verses.text_en: And I besought the other angel that he should show me the might of those monsters, how they were parted on one day and cast, the one into the abysses of the sea, and the other unto the dry land of the wilderness.
verses.text_hr: Zamolio sam drugoga anđela da mi pokaže moć tih nemani: kako su u istome danu razdvojene i bačene, jedna u morske dubine, a druga na suho tlo pustinje.

verses.text_en: And he said to me: ‘Thou son of man, herein thou dost seek to know what is hidden.’
verses.text_hr: Odgovorio mi je: „Ti, sine čovječji, ovdje nastojiš spoznati ono što je skriveno.“

verses.text_en: And the other angel who went with me and showed me what was hidden told me, what is first and last in the heaven in the height, and beneath the earth in the depth, and at the ends of the heaven, and on the foundation of the heaven.
verses.text_hr: Drugi anđeo koji je išao sa mnom i pokazivao mi što je skriveno otkrio mi je što je prvo i posljednje: gore na visini neba, dolje u dubini pod zemljom, na krajevima neba i na temelju neba.

verses.text_en: And the chambers of the winds, and how the winds are divided, and how they are weighed, and (how) the =portals= of the winds are reckoned, each according to the power of the wind, and the power of the lights of the moon, and according to the power that is fitting: and the divisions of the stars according to their names, and how all the divisions are divided.
verses.text_hr: Pokazao mi je odaje vjetrova, kako se vjetrovi razdjeljuju i važu, kako se broje =vrata= vjetrova, svaka prema snazi vjetra; zatim snagu mjesečevih svjetala prema moći koja im pripada, podjele zvijezda prema njihovim imenima i kako se sve te podjele razdjeljuju.

verses.text_en: And the thunders according to the places where they fall, and all the divisions that are made among the lightnings that it may lighten, and their host that they may at once obey.
verses.text_hr: Pokazao mi je gromove prema mjestima na koja padaju, sve podjele među munjama da bi mogle sijevati i njihove vojske da bi odmah poslušale.

verses.text_en: For the thunder has †places of rest† (which) are assigned (to it) while it is waiting for its peal; and the thunder and lightning are inseparable, and although not one and undivided, they both go together through the spirit and separate not.
verses.text_hr: Grom ima †počivališta† koja su mu određena dok čeka svoj prasak. Grom i munja nerazdvojni su; premda nisu jedno i nedjeljivo, oboje zajedno idu po duhu i ne rastaju se.

verses.text_en: For when the lightning lightens, the thunder utters its voice, and the spirit enforces a pause during the peal, and divides equally between them; for the treasury of their peals is like the sand, and each one of them as it peals is held in with a bridle, and turned back by the power of the spirit, and pushed forward according to the many quarters of the earth.
verses.text_hr: Kad munja sijevne, grom pusti svoj glas, a duh tijekom praska prisiljava na stanku i ravnomjerno dijeli između njih. Riznica njihovih prasaka nalik je pijesku; svaki je prasak zadržan uzdom, moć duha vraća ga natrag i gura naprijed prema mnogim stranama zemlje.

verses.text_en: And the spirit of the sea is masculine and strong, and according to the might of his strength he draws it back with a rein, and in like manner it is driven forward and disperses amid all the mountains of the earth.
verses.text_hr: Duh mora muški je i snažan. Prema svojoj silnoj moći povlači more natrag uzdom; na isti se način ono tjera naprijed i raspršuje među svim planinama zemlje.

verses.text_en: And the spirit of the hoar-frost is his own angel, and the spirit of the hail is a good angel.
verses.text_hr: Duh inja njegov je vlastiti anđeo, a duh tuče dobar je anđeo.

verses.text_en: And the spirit of the snow has forsaken (his chamber) on account of his strength—there is a special spirit therein, and that which ascends from it is like smoke, and its name is frost.
verses.text_hr: Duh snijega zbog svoje je snage napustio svoju odaju — u njemu je poseban duh, a ono što se iz njega podiže nalik je dimu i zove se mraz.

verses.text_en: And the spirit of the mist is not united with them in their chambers, but it has a special chamber; for its course is †glorious† both in light and in darkness, and in winter and in summer, and in its chamber is an angel.
verses.text_hr: Duh magle nije sjedinjen s njima u njihovim odajama, nego ima posebnu odaju. Njegov je tijek †slavan† i na svjetlosti i u tami, zimi i ljeti, a u njegovoj je odaji anđeo.

verses.text_en: And the spirit of the dew has its dwelling at the ends of the heaven, and is connected with the chambers of the rain, and its course is in winter and summer: and its clouds and the clouds of the mist are connected, and the one gives to the other.
verses.text_hr: Duh rose prebiva na krajevima neba i povezan je s odajama kiše. Njegov je tijek i zimi i ljeti; njegovi oblaci povezani su s oblacima magle i jedni daju drugima.

verses.text_en: And when the spirit of the rain goes forth from its chamber, the angels come and open the chamber and lead it out, and when it is diffused over the whole earth it unites with the water on the earth. And whensoever it unites with the water on the earth....
verses.text_hr: Kad duh kiše izađe iz svoje odaje, anđeli dolaze, otvaraju odaju i izvode ga. Kad se razlije nad svom zemljom, sjedinjuje se s vodom na zemlji. I kad god se sjedini s vodom na zemlji....

verses.text_en: For the waters are for those who dwell on the earth; for they are nourishment for the earth from the Most High who is in heaven: therefore there is a measure for the rain, and the angels take it in charge.
verses.text_hr: Vode su za stanovnike zemlje, jer one hrane zemlju darom Svevišnjega koji je na nebu. Zato kiša ima svoju mjeru, a anđeli se za nju brinu.

verses.text_en: And these things I saw towards the Garden of the Righteous.
verses.text_hr: Sve sam to vidio prema Vrtu pravednih.

verses.text_en: And the angel of peace who was with me said to me: ‘These two monsters, prepared, conformably to the greatness of God, shall feed....’
verses.text_hr: Anđeo mira koji je bio sa mnom rekao mi je: „Ove dvije nemani, pripravljene u skladu s Božjom veličinom, hranit će se....“

verses.text_en: And I saw in those days how long cords were given to those angels, and they took to themselves wings and flew, and they went towards the north.
verses.text_hr: U one sam dane vidio kako su tim anđelima dana duga užad. Uzeli su krila, poletjeli i otišli prema sjeveru.

verses.text_en: And I asked the angel, saying unto him: ‘Why have those (angels) taken these cords and gone off?’ And he said unto me: ‘They have gone to measure.’
verses.text_hr: Upitao sam anđela: „Zašto su ti anđeli uzeli užad i otišli?“ Odgovorio mi je: „Otišli su mjeriti.“

verses.text_en:
And the angel who went with me said unto me:
‘These shall bring the measures of the righteous,
And the ropes of the righteous to the righteous,
That they may stay themselves on the name of the Lord of Spirits for ever and ever.
verses.text_hr:
Anđeo koji je išao sa mnom rekao mi je:
„Oni će donijeti mjere pravednih
i užad pravednih pravednicima,
da se u vijeke vjekova oslanjaju na ime Gospodara duhova.

verses.text_en:
The elect shall begin to dwell with the elect,
And those are the measures which shall be given to faith
And which shall strengthen righteousness.
verses.text_hr:
Izabrani će početi prebivati s izabranima.
To su mjere koje će biti dane vjeri
i koje će učvrstiti pravednost.

verses.text_en:
And these measures shall reveal all the secrets of the depths of the earth,
And those who have been destroyed by the desert,
And those who have been devoured by the beasts,
And those who have been devoured by the fish of the sea,
That they may return and stay themselves
On the day of the Elect One;
For none shall be destroyed before the Lord of Spirits,
And none can be destroyed.
verses.text_hr:
Te će mjere otkriti sve tajne zemaljskih dubina,
one koje je uništila pustinja,
one koje su proždrle zvijeri
i one koje su proždrle morske ribe,
da se mogu vratiti i osloniti
u dan Izabranoga.
Jer pred Gospodarom duhova nitko neće biti uništen
niti itko može biti uništen.

verses.text_en: And all who dwell above in the heaven received a command and power and one voice and one light like unto fire.
verses.text_hr: Svi stanovnici neba gore primili su jednu zapovijed, jednu moć, jedan glas i jednu svjetlost nalik vatri.

verses.text_en:
And that One (with) their first words they blessed,
And extolled and lauded with wisdom,
And they were wise in utterance and in the spirit of life.

And the Lord of Spirits placed the Elect One on the throne of glory.
And he shall judge all the works of the holy above in the heaven,
And in the balance shall their deeds be weighed.
verses.text_hr:
Gospodar duhova postavio je Izabranoga na prijestolje slave.
On će suditi svim djelima svetih gore na nebu,
a njihova će se djela vagati na tezulji.

verses.text_en:
And when he shall lift up his countenance
To judge their secret ways according to the word of the name of the Lord of Spirits,
And their path according to the way of the righteous judgement of the Lord of Spirits,
Then shall they all with one voice speak and bless,
And glorify and extol and sanctify the name of the Lord of Spirits.
verses.text_hr:
Kad podigne lice
da sudi njihovim tajnim putovima prema riječi imena Gospodara duhova
i njihovoj stazi prema putu pravednoga suda Gospodara duhova,
tada će svi jednim glasom govoriti i blagoslivljati,
slaviti, uzvisivati i svetiti ime Gospodara duhova.

verses.text_en: And He will summon all the host of the heavens, and all the holy ones above, and the host of God, the Cherubin, Seraphin, and Ophannin, and all the angels of power, and all the angels of principalities, and the Elect One, and the other powers on the earth (and) over the water.
verses.text_hr: On će sazvati svu vojsku nebesa, sve svete gore, Božju vojsku, kerubine, serafine i ofanine, sve anđele moći, sve anđele poglavarstava, Izabranoga i ostale sile na zemlji i nad vodom.

verses.text_en: On that day shall they raise one voice, and bless and glorify and exalt in the spirit of faith, and in the spirit of wisdom, and in the spirit of patience, and in the spirit of mercy, and in the spirit of judgement and of peace, and in the spirit of goodness, and shall all say with one voice: “Blessed is He, and may the name of the Lord of Spirits be blessed for ever and ever.”
verses.text_hr: Toga će dana podići jedan glas te blagoslivljati, slaviti i uzvisivati u duhu vjere, duhu mudrosti, duhu strpljivosti, duhu milosrđa, duhu suda i mira te duhu dobrote. Svi će jednim glasom reći: „Blagoslovljen je on i neka ime Gospodara duhova bude blagoslovljeno u vijeke vjekova.“

verses.text_en:
All who sleep not above in heaven shall bless Him:
All the holy ones who are in heaven shall bless him,
And all the elect who dwell in the garden of life:
And every spirit of light who is able to bless, and glorify, and extol, and hallow Thy blessed name,
And all flesh shall beyond measure glorify and bless Thy name for ever and ever.
verses.text_hr:
Svi koji ne spavaju gore na nebu blagoslivljat će ga;
svi sveti na nebu blagoslivljat će ga,
svi izabrani koji prebivaju u vrtu života
i svaki duh svjetlosti koji može blagoslivljati, slaviti, uzvisivati i svetiti tvoje blagoslovljeno ime.
Sve će tijelo preko svake mjere slaviti i blagoslivljati tvoje ime u vijeke vjekova.

verses.text_en:
For great is the mercy of the Lord of Spirits, and He is long-suffering,
And all His works and all that He has created
He has revealed to the righteous and elect,
In the name of the Lord of Spirits.’
verses.text_hr:
Jer veliko je milosrđe Gospodara duhova i on je strpljiv.
Sva svoja djela i sve što je stvorio
otkrio je pravednima i izabranima
u ime Gospodara duhova.“

verses.text_en: And thus the Lord commanded the kings and the mighty and the exalted, and those who dwell on the earth, and said: ‘Open your eyes and lift up your horns if ye are able to recognize the Elect One.’
verses.text_hr: Tako je Gospodin zapovjedio kraljevima, moćnicima, uzvišenima i stanovnicima zemlje: „Otvorite oči i podignite svoje rogove ako možete prepoznati Izabranoga.“

verses.text_en:
And the Lord of Spirits seated him on the throne of His glory,
And the spirit of righteousness was poured out upon him,
And the word of his mouth slays all the sinners,
And all the unrighteous are destroyed from before his face.
verses.text_hr:
Gospodar duhova postavio ga je na prijestolje svoje slave,
duh pravednosti izlio se na njega,
riječ njegovih usta ubija sve grešnike,
a svi nepravednici nestaju pred njegovim licem.

verses.text_en:
And there shall stand up in that day all the kings and the mighty,
And the exalted and those who hold the earth,
And they shall see and recognize
How he sits on the throne of his glory,
And righteousness is judged before him,
And no lying word is spoken before him.
verses.text_hr:
Toga će dana ustati svi kraljevi i moćnici,
uzvišeni i oni koji drže zemlju.
Vidjet će i prepoznati
kako on sjedi na prijestolju svoje slave,
kako se pred njim sudi pravedno
i kako se pred njim ne izgovara lažna riječ.

verses.text_en:
Then shall pain come upon them as on a woman in travail,
[And she has pain in bringing forth]
When her child enters the mouth of the womb,
And she has pain in bringing forth.
verses.text_hr:
Tada će ih obuzeti bol poput žene u trudovima,
[i ona trpi porođajnu bol]
kad joj dijete uđe u otvor utrobe
i ona trpi porođajnu bol.

verses.text_en:
And one portion of them shall look on the other,
And they shall be terrified,
And they shall be downcast of countenance,
And pain shall seize them,
When they see that Son of Man
Sitting on the throne of his glory.
verses.text_hr:
Jedan će dio njih gledati drugi,
a oni će se prestrašiti,
lica će im klonuti
i bol će ih obuzeti
kad vide toga Sina Čovječjega
gdje sjedi na prijestolju svoje slave.

verses.text_en: And the kings and the mighty and all who possess the earth shall bless and glorify and extol him who rules over all, who was hidden.
verses.text_hr: Kraljevi, moćnici i svi koji posjeduju zemlju blagoslivljat će, slaviti i uzvisivati onoga koji vlada nad svima i koji je bio skriven.

verses.text_en:
For from the beginning the Son of Man was hidden,
And the Most High preserved him in the presence of His might,
And revealed him to the elect.
verses.text_hr:
Jer Sin Čovječji bio je skriven od početka,
Svevišnji ga je čuvao u nazočnosti svoje moći
i objavio izabranima.

verses.text_en:
And the congregation of the elect and holy shall be sown,
And all the elect shall stand before him on that day.
verses.text_hr:
Zajednica izabranih i svetih bit će posijana,
a svi će izabrani toga dana stajati pred njim.

verses.text_en:
And all the kings and the mighty and the exalted and those who rule the earth
Shall fall down before him on their faces,
And worship and set their hope upon that Son of Man,
And petition him and supplicate for mercy at his hands.
verses.text_hr:
Svi kraljevi, moćnici, uzvišeni i oni koji vladaju zemljom
past će pred njim ničice,
pokloniti se i položiti nadu u toga Sina Čovječjega
te ga moliti i iz njegovih ruku preklinjati milosrđe.

verses.text_en:
Nevertheless that Lord of Spirits will so press them
That they shall hastily go forth from His presence,
And their faces shall be filled with shame,
And the darkness shall grow deeper on their faces.
verses.text_hr:
Ali Gospodar duhova toliko će ih pritisnuti
da će žurno otići iz njegove nazočnosti.
Lica će im se ispuniti sramotom,
a tama se produbiti na njihovim licima.

verses.text_en:
And =He will deliver= them to the angels for punishment,
To execute vengeance on them because they have oppressed His children and His elect.
verses.text_hr:
On će ih =predati= anđelima za kaznu
da im se osvete zato što su tlačili njegovu djecu i njegove izabrane.

verses.text_en:
And they shall be a spectacle for the righteous and for His elect:
They shall rejoice over them,
Because the wrath of the Lord of Spirits resteth upon them,
And His sword is drunk with their blood.
verses.text_hr:
Bit će prizor pravednima i njegovim izabranima,
a oni će im se radovati,
jer srdžba Gospodara duhova počiva na njima
i njegov je mač opijen njihovom krvlju.

verses.text_en:
And the righteous and elect shall be saved on that day,
And they shall never thenceforward see the face of the sinners and unrighteous.
verses.text_hr:
Toga će se dana pravedni i izabrani spasiti
i od tada više nikada neće gledati lice grešnika i nepravednika.

verses.text_en:
And the Lord of Spirits will abide over them,
And with that Son of Man shall they eat
And lie down and rise up for ever and ever.
verses.text_hr:
Gospodar duhova prebivat će nad njima,
a s tim će Sinom Čovječjim jesti,
počivati i ustajati u vijeke vjekova.

verses.text_en:
And the righteous and elect shall have risen from the earth,
And ceased to be of downcast countenance.
verses.text_hr:
Pravedni i izabrani ustat će sa zemlje
i njihova će lica prestati biti klonula.

verses.text_en:
And they shall have been clothed with garments of glory,
And they shall be the garments of life from the Lord of Spirits:
And your garments shall not grow old,
Nor your glory pass away before the Lord of Spirits.
verses.text_hr:
Bit će odjeveni u haljine slave,
a to će biti haljine života od Gospodara duhova.
Vaše haljine neće ostarjeti
niti će vaša slava proći pred Gospodarom duhova.

verses.text_en: In those days shall the mighty and the kings who possess the earth implore (Him) to grant them a little respite from His angels of punishment to whom they were delivered, that they might fall down and worship before the Lord of Spirits, and confess their sins before Him.
verses.text_hr: U one će dane moćnici i kraljevi koji posjeduju zemlju preklinjati da im dopusti kratak predah od njegovih anđela kazne kojima su bili predani, kako bi mogli pasti ničice, pokloniti se Gospodaru duhova i pred njim priznati svoje grijehe.

verses.text_en:
And they shall bless and glorify the Lord of Spirits, and say:

‘Blessed is the Lord of Spirits and the Lord of kings,
And the Lord of the mighty and the Lord of the rich,
And the Lord of glory and the Lord of wisdom;
verses.text_hr:
Blagoslivljat će i slaviti Gospodara duhova te govoriti:

„Blagoslovljen je Gospodar duhova i Gospodar kraljeva,
Gospodar moćnika i Gospodar bogataša,
Gospodar slave i Gospodar mudrosti.

verses.text_en:
And splendid in every secret thing is Thy power from generation to generation,
And Thy glory for ever and ever:
Deep are all Thy secrets and innumerable,
And Thy righteousness is beyond reckoning.
verses.text_hr:
Tvoja je moć veličanstvena u svakoj tajni od naraštaja do naraštaja,
a tvoja slava u vijeke vjekova.
Duboke su sve tvoje tajne i bezbrojne,
a tvoja je pravednost neizmjerna.

verses.text_en:
We have now learnt that we should glorify
And bless the Lord of kings and Him who is King over all kings.’
verses.text_hr:
Sada smo spoznali da trebamo slaviti
i blagoslivljati Gospodara kraljeva, onoga koji je Kralj nad svim kraljevima.“

verses.text_en:
And they shall say:
‘Would that we had rest to glorify and give thanks
And confess our faith before His glory!
verses.text_hr:
Govorit će:
„O, kad bismo imali počinka da slavimo i zahvaljujemo
te ispovjedimo svoju vjeru pred njegovom slavom!

verses.text_en:
And now we long for a little rest, but find it not:
We follow hard upon (it) and obtain (it) not:
And light has vanished from before us,
And darkness is our dwelling-place for ever and ever:
verses.text_hr:
Sada čeznemo za kratkim počinkom, ali ga ne nalazimo.
Uporno ga slijedimo, ali ga ne dosežemo.
Svjetlost je nestala pred nama,
a tama je naše prebivalište u vijeke vjekova.

verses.text_en:
For we have not believed before Him,
Nor glorified the name of the Lord of Spirits, [nor glorified our Lord]
But our hope was in the sceptre of our kingdom,
And in our glory.
verses.text_hr:
Jer nismo vjerovali pred njim
niti smo slavili ime Gospodara duhova [niti slavili svojega Gospodina],
nego smo se uzdali u žezlo svojega kraljevstva
i u svoju slavu.

verses.text_en:
And in the day of our suffering and tribulation He saves us not,
And we find no respite for confession,
That our Lord is true in all His works, and in His judgements and His justice;
And His judgements have no respect of persons.
verses.text_hr:
U dan naše patnje i nevolje on nas ne spašava
i ne nalazimo predaha da ispovjedimo
kako je naš Gospodin istinit u svim svojim djelima, sudovima i pravdi
te kako njegovi sudovi nisu pristrani.

verses.text_en:
And we pass away from before His face on account of our works,
And all our sins are reckoned up in righteousness.’
verses.text_hr:
Zbog svojih djela odlazimo ispred njegova lica,
a svi su naši grijesi pravedno izbrojeni.“

verses.text_en: Now they will say unto themselves: ‘Our souls are full of unrighteous gain, but it does not prevent us from descending from the midst thereof into the †burden† of Sheol.’
verses.text_hr: Tada će reći sami sebi: „Naše su duše pune nepravedna dobitka, ali ni to nas ne sprečava da se iz njegove sredine spustimo u †breme† Šeola.“

verses.text_en:
And after that their faces shall be filled with darkness
And shame before that Son of Man,
And they shall be driven from his presence,
And the sword shall abide before his face in their midst.
verses.text_hr:
Nakon toga njihova će se lica ispuniti tamom
i sramotom pred tim Sinom Čovječjim.
Bit će protjerani iz njegove nazočnosti,
a mač će pred njegovim licem prebivati među njima.

verses.text_en: Thus spake the Lord of Spirits: ‘This is the ordinance and judgement with respect to the mighty and the kings and the exalted and those who possess the earth before the Lord of Spirits.’
verses.text_hr: Ovako govori Gospodar duhova: „Ovo je odredba i sud o moćnicima, kraljevima, uzvišenima i onima koji posjeduju zemlju pred Gospodarom duhova.“

verses.text_en: And other forms I saw hidden in that place.
verses.text_hr: Na tome sam mjestu vidio i druge skrivene oblike.

verses.text_en: I heard the voice of the angel saying: ‘These are the angels who descended to the earth, and revealed what was hidden to the children of men, and seduced the children of men into committing sin.’
verses.text_hr: Čuo sam glas anđela kako govori: „To su anđeli koji su sišli na zemlju, otkrili sinovima ljudskim ono što je bilo skriveno i zaveli sinove ljudske da počine grijeh.“

verses.text_en: And in those days Noah saw the earth that it had sunk down and its destruction was nigh.
verses.text_hr: U one je dane Noa vidio da je zemlja potonula i da se približilo njezino uništenje.

verses.text_en: And he arose from thence and went to the ends of the earth, and cried aloud to his grandfather Enoch: and Noah said three times with an embittered voice: ‘Hear me, hear me, hear me.’
verses.text_hr: Ustao je odande, otišao do krajeva zemlje i glasno povikao svojemu djedu Henoku. Noa je tri puta ogorčenim glasom rekao: „Čuj me, čuj me, čuj me!“

verses.text_en: And I said unto him: ‘Tell me what it is that is falling out on the earth that the earth is in such evil plight and shaken, lest perchance I shall perish with it.’
verses.text_hr: Rekao sam mu: „Kaži mi što se događa na zemlji da je u tako zlu stanju i da se trese, da možda ne propadnem zajedno s njom.“

verses.text_en: And thereupon there was a great commotion on the earth, and a voice was heard from heaven, and I fell on my face.
verses.text_hr: Tada je nastao silan potres na zemlji, začuo se glas s neba, a ja sam pao ničice.

verses.text_en: And Enoch my grandfather came and stood by me, and said unto me: ‘Why hast thou cried unto me with a bitter cry and weeping?
verses.text_hr: Moj djed Henok došao je, stao kraj mene i rekao: „Zašto si me zazvao gorkim krikom i plačem?

verses.text_en: And a command has gone forth from the presence of the Lord concerning those who dwell on the earth that their ruin is accomplished because they have learnt all the secrets of the angels, and all the violence of the Satans, and all their powers—the most secret ones—and all the power of those who practise sorcery, and the power of witchcraft, and the power of those who make molten images for the whole earth:
verses.text_hr: Iz nazočnosti Gospodnje izišla je zapovijed o stanovnicima zemlje da je njihova propast dovršena. Saznali su sve tajne anđela, sve nasilje sotona i sve njihove sile — one najskrivenije — zatim svu moć onih koji se bave vračanjem, moć čarobnjaštva i moć onih koji za svu zemlju izrađuju lijevane likove.

verses.text_en: And how silver is produced from the dust of the earth, and how soft metal originates in the earth.
verses.text_hr: Saznali su kako se srebro dobiva iz praha zemaljskoga i kako meka kovina nastaje u zemlji.

verses.text_en: For lead and tin are not produced from the earth like the first: it is a fountain that produces them, and an angel stands therein, and that angel is pre-eminent.’
verses.text_hr: Olovo i kositar ne nastaju iz zemlje poput onoga prvoga; proizvodi ih izvor u kojem stoji jedan anđeo, a taj je anđeo iznad ostalih.“

verses.text_en: And after that my grandfather Enoch took hold of me by my hand and raised me up, and said unto me: ‘Go, for I have asked the Lord of Spirits as touching this commotion on the earth.
verses.text_hr: Nakon toga moj me djed Henok uzeo za ruku, podigao i rekao: „Pođi, jer sam o tome potresu na zemlji pitao Gospodara duhova.

verses.text_en: And He said unto me: “Because of their unrighteousness their judgement has been determined upon and shall not be =withheld= by Me for ever. Because of the =sorceries= which they have searched out and learnt, the earth and those who dwell upon it shall be destroyed.”
verses.text_hr: Rekao mi je: ‘Zbog njihove nepravde njihov je sud određen i ja ga neću zauvijek =odgađati=. Zbog =čarolija= koje su istražili i naučili bit će uništeni zemlja i oni koji na njoj prebivaju.’

verses.text_en: And these—they have no =place of repentance= for ever, because they have shown them what was hidden, and they are the damned: but as for thee, my son, the Lord of Spirits knows that thou art pure, and guiltless of this reproach concerning the secrets.
verses.text_hr: Oni zauvijek nemaju =mjesta za pokajanje= jer su ljudima pokazali ono što je bilo skriveno; oni su prokleti. Ali za tebe, sine moj, Gospodar duhova zna da si čist i nedužan za ovaj prijekor zbog tajni.

verses.text_en:
And He has destined thy name to be among the holy,
And will preserve thee amongst those who dwell on the earth,
And has destined thy righteous seed both for kingship and for great honours,
And from thy seed shall proceed a fountain of the righteous and holy without number for ever.’
verses.text_hr:
Odredio je da tvoje ime bude među svetima,
sačuvat će te među stanovnicima zemlje
i odredio je tvojemu pravednom potomstvu kraljevstvo i velike časti.
Iz tvojega će potomstva poteći nebrojen izvor pravednih i svetih zauvijek.“

verses.text_en: And after that he showed me the angels of punishment who are prepared to come and let loose all the powers of the waters which are beneath in the earth in order to bring judgement and destruction on all who [abide and] dwell on the earth.
verses.text_hr: Nakon toga pokazao mi je anđele kazne koji su pripravljeni doći i osloboditi sve sile voda koje su dolje u zemlji, da donesu sud i uništenje svima koji [ostaju i] prebivaju na zemlji.

verses.text_en: And the Lord of Spirits gave commandment to the angels who were going forth, that they should not cause =the waters= to rise but should hold them in check; for those angels were over the powers of the waters.
verses.text_hr: Gospodar duhova zapovjedio je anđelima koji su izlazili da ne dopuste =vodama= da se podignu, nego da ih zadrže, jer su ti anđeli bili nad silama voda.

verses.text_en: And I went away from the presence of Enoch.
verses.text_hr: Tada sam otišao iz Henokove nazočnosti.

verses.text_en: And in those days the word of God came unto me, and He said unto me: ‘Noah, thy lot has come up before Me, a lot without blame, a lot of love and uprightness.
verses.text_hr: U one dane došla mi je riječ Božja i Bog mi je rekao: „Noa, tvoj je dio došao preda me — dio bez prijekora, dio ljubavi i čestitosti.

verses.text_en: And now the angels are making a wooden (building), and when they have completed that task I will place My hand upon it and preserve it, and there shall come forth from it the seed of life, and a change shall set in so that the earth will not remain without inhabitant.
verses.text_hr: Anđeli sada izrađuju drvenu građevinu. Kad dovrše taj zadatak, položit ću na nju svoju ruku i sačuvati je. Iz nje će izići sjeme života i nastupit će promjena, tako da zemlja neće ostati bez stanovnika.

verses.text_en: And I will make fast thy seed before me for ever and ever, and I will spread abroad those who dwell with thee: it shall not =be unfruitful= on the face of the earth, but it shall be blessed and multiply on the earth in the name of the Lord.’
verses.text_hr: Učvrstit ću tvoje potomstvo preda mnom u vijeke vjekova i rasprostraniti one koji prebivaju s tobom. Ono neće =ostati bez ploda= na licu zemlje, nego će biti blagoslovljeno i umnožit će se na zemlji u ime Gospodnje.“

verses.text_en: And He will imprison those angels, who have shown unrighteousness, in that burning valley which my grandfather Enoch had formerly shown to me in the west among the mountains of gold and silver and iron and soft metal and tin.
verses.text_hr: On će zatočiti one anđele koji su pokazali nepravdu u užarenoj dolini koju mi je moj djed Henok prije pokazao na zapadu, među planinama zlata, srebra, željeza, meke kovine i kositra.

verses.text_en: And I saw that valley in which there was a great convulsion and a convulsion of the waters.
verses.text_hr: Vidio sam tu dolinu u kojoj je vladalo silno komešanje, kao i komešanje voda.

verses.text_en: And when all this took place, from that fiery molten metal and from the convulsion thereof in that place, there was produced a smell of sulphur, and it was connected with those waters, and that valley of the angels who had led astray (mankind) burned beneath that land.
verses.text_hr: Kad se sve to dogodilo, iz užarene rastaljene kovine i njezina komešanja na tome mjestu podigao se miris sumpora i pomiješao s tim vodama; dolina anđela koji su zaveli čovječanstvo gorjela je pod tom zemljom.

verses.text_en: And through its valleys proceed streams of fire, where these angels are punished who had led astray those who dwell upon the earth.
verses.text_hr: Kroz njezine doline teku rijeke vatre u kojima se kažnjavaju anđeli što su zaveli stanovnike zemlje.

verses.text_en: But those waters shall in those days serve for the kings and the mighty and the exalted, and those who dwell on the earth, for the healing of the body, but for the punishment of the spirit; now their spirit is full of lust, that they may be punished in their body, for they have denied the Lord of Spirits and see their punishment daily, and yet believe not in His name.
verses.text_hr: U one će dane te vode služiti kraljevima, moćnicima, uzvišenima i stanovnicima zemlje za ozdravljenje tijela, ali i za kaznu duha. Njihov je duh sada pun požude, pa će biti kažnjeni u svojem tijelu: zanijekali su Gospodara duhova, svakodnevno gledaju svoju kaznu, a ipak ne vjeruju u njegovo ime.

verses.text_en: And in proportion as the burning of their bodies becomes severe, a corresponding change shall take place in their spirit for ever and ever; for before the Lord of Spirits none shall utter an idle word.
verses.text_hr: Kako se bude pojačavalo izgaranje njihovih tijela, tako će se u vijeke vjekova događati odgovarajuća promjena u njihovu duhu, jer pred Gospodarom duhova nitko neće izgovoriti ispraznu riječ.

verses.text_en: For the judgement shall come upon them, because they believe in the lust of their body and deny the Spirit of the Lord.
verses.text_hr: Sud će doći na njih jer vjeruju požudi svojega tijela, a niječu Duha Gospodnjega.

verses.text_en: And those same waters shall undergo a change in those days; for when those angels are punished in these waters, these water-springs shall change their temperature, and when the angels ascend, this water of the springs shall change and become cold.
verses.text_hr: U one će se dane iste vode promijeniti. Kad anđeli budu kažnjeni u tim vodama, izvori će promijeniti svoju temperaturu; kad anđeli uzađu, voda će se u izvorima promijeniti i ohladiti.

verses.text_en: And I heard Michael answering and saying: ‘This judgement wherewith the angels are judged is a testimony for the kings and the mighty who possess the earth.’
verses.text_hr: Čuo sam Mihaela kako odgovara: „Ovaj sud kojim su anđeli osuđeni svjedočanstvo je kraljevima i moćnicima koji posjeduju zemlju.“

verses.text_en: Because these waters of judgement minister to the healing of the body of the =kings= and the lust of their body; therefore they will not see and will not believe that those waters will change and become a fire which burns for ever.
verses.text_hr: Budući da te vode suda služe ozdravljenju tijela =kraljeva= i požudi njihova tijela, oni neće vidjeti niti vjerovati da će se te vode promijeniti i postati vatra koja gori zauvijek.

verses.text_en: And after that my grandfather Enoch gave me the teaching of all the secrets in the book and in the Parables which had been given to him; and he put them together for me in the words of the book of the Parables.
verses.text_hr: Nakon toga moj djed Henok predao mi je pouku o svim tajnama iz knjige i Prispodoba koje su bile dane njemu; za mene ih je sastavio u riječima Knjige prispodoba.

verses.text_en: And on that day Michael answered Raphael and said: ‘The power of the spirit transports and =makes me to tremble= because of the severity of the judgement of the secrets, the judgement of the angels: who can endure the severe judgement which has been executed, and before which they melt away?’
verses.text_hr: Toga dana Mihael odgovori Rafaelu: „Moć duha odnosi me i =čini da dršćem= zbog strogosti suda nad tajnama, suda nad anđelima. Tko može podnijeti strogi sud koji je izvršen i pred kojim se oni tope?“

verses.text_en: And Michael answered again, and said to Raphael: ‘Who is he whose heart is not softened concerning it, and whose reins are not troubled by this word of judgement (that) has gone forth upon them because of those who have thus led them out?’
verses.text_hr: Mihael ponovno odgovori Rafaelu: „Čije srce zbog toga ne bi omekšalo i čija se utroba ne bi uznemirila zbog ove riječi suda koja je izišla protiv njih radi onih koji su ih tako izveli?“

verses.text_en: And it came to pass when he stood before the Lord of Spirits, Michael said thus to Raphael: ‘I will not take their part under the eye of the Lord; for the Lord of Spirits has been angry with them because they do as if they were the Lord.
verses.text_hr: Kad je stao pred Gospodara duhova, Mihael je rekao Rafaelu: „Neću stati na njihovu stranu pred očima Gospodnjim, jer se Gospodar duhova razgnjevio na njih zato što se ponašaju kao da su Gospodin.

verses.text_en: Therefore all that is hidden shall come upon them for ever and ever; for neither angel nor man shall have his portion (in it), but alone they have received their judgement for ever and ever.’
verses.text_hr: Zato će sve što je skriveno dolaziti na njih u vijeke vjekova. Ni anđeo ni čovjek neće imati udjela u tome; samo su oni primili svoj sud u vijeke vjekova.“

verses.text_en: And after this judgement they shall terrify and =make= them =to tremble= because they have shown this to those who dwell on the earth.
verses.text_hr: Nakon toga suda prestrašivat će ih i =učiniti= da =dršću= jer su to pokazali stanovnicima zemlje.

verses.text_en: And behold the names of those angels [and these are their names: the first of them is Samjâzâ, the second Artâqîfâ, and the third Armên, the fourth Kôkabêl, the fifth †Tûrâêl†, the sixth Rûmjâl, the seventh Dânjâl, the eighth †Nêqâêl†, the ninth Barâqêl, the tenth Azâzêl, the eleventh Armârôs, the twelfth Batarjâl, the thirteenth †Busasêjal†, the fourteenth Hanânêl, the fifteenth †Tûrêl†, and the sixteenth Sîmâpêsîêl, the seventeenth Jetrêl, the eighteenth Tûmâêl, the nineteenth Tûrêl, the twentieth †Rûmâêl†, the twenty-first †Azâzêl†.
verses.text_hr: A ovo su imena tih anđela [ovo su njihova imena: prvi je Samjâzâ, drugi Artâqîfâ, treći Armên, četvrti Kôkabêl, peti †Tûrâêl†, šesti Rûmjâl, sedmi Dânjâl, osmi †Nêqâêl†, deveti Barâqêl, deseti Azazel, jedanaesti Armârôs, dvanaesti Batarjâl, trinaesti †Busasêjal†, četrnaesti Hanânêl, petnaesti †Tûrêl†, šesnaesti Sîmâpêsîêl, sedamnaesti Jetrêl, osamnaesti Tûmâêl, devetnaesti Tûrêl, dvadeseti †Rûmâêl†, a dvadeset i prvi Azazel.

verses.text_en: And these are the chiefs of their angels and their names, and their chief ones over hundreds and over fifties and over tens.]
verses.text_hr: To su poglavari njihovih anđela i njihova imena te njihovi poglavari nad stotinama, pedesetinama i desetinama.]

verses.text_en: The name of the first Jeqôn: that is, the one who led astray [all] the sons of =God=, and brought them down to the earth, and led them astray through the daughters of men.
verses.text_hr: Prvi se zove Jeqôn. On je zaveo [sve] sinove =Božje=, doveo ih na zemlju i zaveo preko kćeri ljudskih.

verses.text_en: And the second was named Asbeêl: he imparted to the holy sons of =God= evil counsel, and led them astray so that they defiled their bodies with the daughters of men.
verses.text_hr: Drugi se zove Asbeêl. On je svetim sinovima =Božjim= dao zao savjet i zaveo ih da svoja tijela oskvrnu s kćerima ljudskim.

verses.text_en: And the third was named Gâdreêl: he it is who showed the children of men all the blows of death, and he led astray Eve, and showed [the weapons of death to the sons of men] the shield and the coat of mail, and the sword for battle, and all the weapons of death to the children of men.
verses.text_hr: Treći se zove Gâdreêl. On je sinovima ljudskim pokazao sve smrtonosne udarce, zaveo Evu i pokazao [sinovima ljudskim oružja smrti:] štit, oklop, mač za boj i sva smrtonosna oružja.

verses.text_en: And from his hand they have proceeded against those who dwell on the earth from that day and for evermore.
verses.text_hr: Iz njegove ruke ona izlaze protiv stanovnika zemlje od onoga dana i zauvijek.

verses.text_en: And the fourth was named Pênêmûe: he taught the children of men the bitter and the sweet, and he taught them all the secrets of their wisdom.
verses.text_hr: Četvrti se zove Pênêmûe. On je sinove ljudske poučio gorkomu i slatkomu te im otkrio sve tajne njihove mudrosti.

verses.text_en: And he instructed mankind in writing with ink and paper, and thereby many sinned from eternity to eternity and until this day.
verses.text_hr: Poučio je čovječanstvo pisanju tintom i papirom, pa su zbog toga mnogi griješili od vječnosti do vječnosti i sve do današnjega dana.

verses.text_en: For men were not created for such a purpose, to give confirmation to their good faith with pen and ink.
verses.text_hr: Ljudi nisu stvoreni zato da perom i tintom potvrđuju svoju vjernost.

verses.text_en: For men were created exactly like the angels, to the intent that they should continue pure and righteous, and death, which destroys everything, could not have taken hold of them; but through this their knowledge they are perishing, and through this power †it is consuming me†.
verses.text_hr: Ljudi su stvoreni upravo poput anđela, da zauvijek ostanu čisti i pravedni, pa ih smrt koja sve uništava ne bi mogla zahvatiti. Ali zbog ovoga svojeg znanja propadaju, a zbog te moći †ono proždire mene†.

verses.text_en: And the fifth was named Kâsdejâ: this is he who showed the children of men all the wicked smitings of spirits and demons, and the smitings of the embryo in the womb, that it may pass away, and [the smitings of the soul] the bites of the serpent, and the smitings which befall through the noontide heat, the son of the serpent named Tabâ’ĕt.
verses.text_hr: Peti se zove Kâsdejâ. On je sinovima ljudskim pokazao sve opake udarce duhova i zloduha, udarce zametku u utrobi da propadne, [udarce duši], ugrize zmije i udarce koji dolaze od podnevne žege, od sina zmije zvanoga Tabâ’ĕt.

verses.text_en: And this is the =task= of Kâsbeêl, the chief of the oath which he showed to the holy ones when he dwelt high above in glory, and its name is Bîqâ.
verses.text_hr: Ovo je =zadaća= Kâsbeêla, poglavara zakletve koju je pokazao svetima dok je prebivao visoko gore u slavi; ime joj je Bîqâ.

verses.text_en: This (angel) requested Michael to show him the hidden name, that he might enunciate it in the oath, so that those might quake before that name and oath who revealed all that was in secret to the children of men.
verses.text_hr: Taj je anđeo zamolio Mihaela da mu pokaže skriveno ime kako bi ga izgovorio u zakletvi, da pred tim imenom i zakletvom zadršću oni koji su sinovima ljudskim otkrili sve što je bilo tajno.

verses.text_en: And this is the power of this oath, for it is powerful and strong, and he placed this oath Akâe in the hand of Michael.
verses.text_hr: To je snaga ove zakletve: ona je moćna i snažna, a on je tu zakletvu Akâe predao u Mihaelovu ruku.

verses.text_en:
And these are the secrets of this oath....

And they are strong through his oath:
And the heaven was suspended before the world was created,
And for ever.
verses.text_hr:
Ovo su tajne te zakletve....

One su snažne po njegovoj zakletvi:
nebo je bilo obješeno prije stvaranja svijeta
i tako ostaje zauvijek.

verses.text_en:
And through it the earth was founded upon the water,
And from the secret recesses of the mountains come beautiful waters,
From the creation of the world and unto eternity.
verses.text_hr:
Po njoj je zemlja utemeljena nad vodom,
a iz skrivenih udubina planina dolaze prekrasne vode
od stvaranja svijeta do vječnosti.

verses.text_en:
And through that oath the sea was created,
And †as its foundation† He set for it the sand against the time of (its) anger,
And it dare not pass beyond it from the creation of the world unto eternity.
verses.text_hr:
Po toj je zakletvi stvoreno more,
a †za njegov temelj† postavio mu je pijesak kao granicu u vrijeme njegove srdžbe.
More se od stvaranja svijeta do vječnosti ne usuđuje prijeći tu granicu.

verses.text_en:
And through that oath are the depths made fast,
And abide and stir not from their place from eternity to eternity.
verses.text_hr:
Po toj su zakletvi dubine učvršćene,
ostaju na svojem mjestu i ne pomiču se od vječnosti do vječnosti.

verses.text_en:
And through that oath the sun and moon complete their course,
And deviate not from their ordinance from eternity to eternity.
verses.text_hr:
Po toj zakletvi sunce i mjesec dovršavaju svoj tijek
i od vječnosti do vječnosti ne odstupaju od svoje odredbe.

verses.text_en:
And through that oath the stars complete their course,
And He calls them by their names,
And they answer Him from eternity to eternity.
verses.text_hr:
Po toj zakletvi zvijezde dovršavaju svoj tijek.
On ih zove po imenu,
a one mu odgovaraju od vječnosti do vječnosti.

verses.text_en: [And in like manner the spirits of the water, and of the winds, and of all zephyrs, and (their) paths from all the quarters of the winds.
verses.text_hr: [Na isti način duhovi vode i vjetrova, svi povjetarci i njihove staze iz svih smjerova vjetrova.

verses.text_en: And there are preserved the voices of the thunder and the light of the lightnings: and there are preserved the chambers of the hail and the chambers of the hoar-frost, and the chambers of the mist, and the chambers of the rain and the dew.
verses.text_hr: Ondje se čuvaju glasovi groma i svjetlost munja; ondje se čuvaju odaje tuče, odaje inja, odaje magle te odaje kiše i rose.

verses.text_en: And all these believe and give thanks before the Lord of Spirits, and glorify (Him) with all their power, and their food is in every act of thanksgiving: they thank and glorify and extol the name of the Lord of Spirits for ever and ever.]
verses.text_hr: Svi oni vjeruju i zahvaljuju pred Gospodarom duhova te ga slave svom svojom snagom. Njihova je hrana u svakome činu zahvaljivanja: zahvaljuju, slave i uzvisuju ime Gospodara duhova u vijeke vjekova.]

verses.text_en:
And this oath is mighty over them,
And through it [they are preserved and] their paths are preserved,
And their course is not destroyed.
verses.text_hr:
Ta je zakletva moćna nad njima.
Po njoj [su sačuvani i] njihove su staze sačuvane,
a njihov tijek nije uništen.

verses.text_en:
And there was great joy amongst them,
And they blessed and glorified and extolled,
Because the name of that Son of Man had been revealed unto them.
verses.text_hr:
Među njima je zavladala velika radost.
Blagoslivljali su, slavili i uzvisivali
jer im je bilo objavljeno ime toga Sina Čovječjega.

verses.text_en:
And he sat on the throne of his glory,
And the sum of judgement was given unto the Son of Man,
And he caused the sinners to pass away and be destroyed from off the face of the earth,
And those who have led the world astray.
verses.text_hr:
On sjede na prijestolje svoje slave,
a ukupnost suda bi predana Sinu Čovječjemu.
Dao je da grešnici i oni koji su zaveli svijet
nestanu i budu uništeni s lica zemlje.

verses.text_en:
With chains shall they be bound,
And in their assemblage-place of destruction shall they be imprisoned,
And all their works vanish from the face of the earth.
verses.text_hr:
Bit će svezani lancima
i zatočeni na svojem zbornome mjestu uništenja,
a sva će njihova djela nestati s lica zemlje.

verses.text_en:
And from henceforth there shall be nothing corruptible,
For that Son of Man has appeared,
And has seated himself on the throne of his glory,
And all evil shall pass away before his face,
And the word of that Son of Man shall go forth
And be strong before the Lord of Spirits.

This is the third Parable of Enoch.
verses.text_hr:
Od tada više neće biti ničega propadljivog,
jer se pojavio taj Sin Čovječji
i sjeo na prijestolje svoje slave.
Sve će zlo proći pred njegovim licem,
a riječ toga Sina Čovječjega izići će
i biti snažna pred Gospodarom duhova.

Ovo je Treća Henokova prispodoba.

verses.text_en: And it came to pass after this that his name during his lifetime was raised aloft to that Son of Man and to the Lord of Spirits from amongst those who dwell on the earth.
verses.text_hr: Nakon toga njegovo je ime još za njegova života bilo uzdignuto iz sredine stanovnika zemlje k tome Sinu Čovječjemu i Gospodaru duhova.

verses.text_en: And he was raised aloft on the chariots of the spirit and his name vanished among them.
verses.text_hr: Bio je uzdignut na kolima duha, a njegovo je ime iščezlo među njima.

verses.text_en: And from that day I was no longer numbered amongst them; and he set me between the two winds, between the north and the west, where the angels took the cords to measure for me the place for the elect and righteous.
verses.text_hr: Od toga dana više se nisam ubrajao među njih. Postavio me između dva vjetra, između sjevera i zapada, gdje su anđeli uzeli užad da mi izmjere mjesto za izabrane i pravedne.

verses.text_en: And there I saw the first fathers and the righteous who from the beginning dwell in that place.
verses.text_hr: Ondje sam vidio prve oce i pravedne koji od početka prebivaju na tome mjestu.

verses.text_en:
And it came to pass after this that my spirit was translated
And it ascended into the heavens:
And I saw the =holy sons of God=.
They were stepping on flames of fire:
Their garments were white [and their raiment],
And their faces shone like snow.
verses.text_hr:
Nakon toga moj je duh bio prenesen
i uzašao na nebesa.
Vidio sam =svete sinove Božje=.
Koračali su po ognjenim plamenovima;
njihove su haljine [i njihovo ruho] bile bijele,
a lica su im sjala poput snijega.

verses.text_en:
And I saw two streams of fire,
And the light of that fire shone like hyacinth,
And I fell on my face before the Lord of Spirits.
verses.text_hr:
Vidio sam dvije ognjene rijeke,
a svjetlost te vatre sjala je poput hijacinta.
Pao sam ničice pred Gospodarom duhova.

verses.text_en:
And the angel Michael [one of the archangels] seized me by my right hand,
And lifted me up and led me forth into all the secrets,
And he showed me all the secrets of righteousness.
verses.text_hr:
Anđeo Mihael [jedan od arkanđela] uhvatio me za desnicu,
podigao i poveo kroz sve tajne
te mi pokazao sve tajne pravednosti.

verses.text_en:
And he showed me all the secrets of the ends of the heaven,
And all the chambers of all the stars, and all the luminaries,
Whence they proceed before the face of the holy ones.
verses.text_hr:
Pokazao mi je sve tajne krajeva neba,
sve odaje svih zvijezda i svih svjetlila,
odakle izlaze pred licem svetih.

verses.text_en:
And he translated my spirit into the heaven of heavens,
And I saw there as it were a structure built of crystals,
And between those crystals tongues of living fire.
verses.text_hr:
Prenio je moj duh u nebo nad nebesima.
Ondje sam vidio građevinu kao da je sagrađena od kristala,
a među kristalima jezike žive vatre.

verses.text_en:
And my spirit saw the girdle which girt that house of fire,
And on its four sides were streams full of living fire,
And they girt that house.
verses.text_hr:
Moj je duh vidio pojas koji je opasivao tu ognjenu kuću.
Na njezine četiri strane bile su rijeke pune žive vatre
i one su opasivale kuću.

verses.text_en:
And round about were Seraphin, Cherubin, and Ophannin:
And these are they who sleep not,
And guard the throne of His glory.
verses.text_hr:
Uokolo su bili serafini, kerubini i ofanini.
To su oni koji ne spavaju
i koji čuvaju prijestolje njegove slave.

verses.text_en:
And I saw angels who could not be counted.
A thousand thousands, and ten thousand times ten thousand.
Encircling that house,
And Michael, and Raphael, and Gabriel, and Phanuel,
And the holy angels who are above the heavens,
Go in and out of that house.
verses.text_hr:
Vidio sam nebrojene anđele:
tisuću tisuća i deset tisuća puta deset tisuća
okruživalo je tu kuću.
Mihael, Rafael, Gabriel i Fanuel
te sveti anđeli koji su iznad nebesa
ulazili su i izlazili iz te kuće.

verses.text_en:
And they came forth from that house,
And Michael and Gabriel, Raphael and Phanuel,
And many holy angels without number.
verses.text_hr:
Iz kuće su izišli
Mihael i Gabriel, Rafael i Fanuel
te bezbroj svetih anđela.

verses.text_en:
And with them the Head of Days,
His head white and pure as wool,
And His raiment indescribable.
verses.text_hr:
S njima je bio Glava Dana,
glave bijele i čiste poput vune,
a njegova se odjeća nije mogla opisati.

verses.text_en:
And I fell on my face,
And my whole body became relaxed,
And my spirit was transfigured;
And I cried with a loud voice,
with the spirit of power,
And blessed and glorified and extolled.
verses.text_hr:
Pao sam ničice,
cijelo mi se tijelo opustilo,
a duh mi se preobrazio.
Povikao sam snažnim glasom,
duhom moći,
te blagoslivljao, slavio i uzvisivao.

verses.text_en: And these blessings which went forth out of my mouth were well pleasing before that Head of Days.
verses.text_hr: Blagoslovi koji su izlazili iz mojih usta bili su ugodni pred Glavom Dana.

verses.text_en:
And that Head of Days came with Michael and Gabriel, Raphael and Phanuel, thousands and ten thousands of angels without number.

[Lost passage wherein the Son of Man was described as accompanying the Head of Days, and Enoch asked one of the angels (as in 46^3) concerning the Son of Man as to who he was.]
verses.text_hr:
Glava Dana došao je s Mihaelom i Gabrielom, Rafaelom i Fanuelom te s tisućama i desecima tisuća nebrojenih anđela.

[Izgubljen je odlomak u kojem je Sin Čovječji opisan kako prati Glavu Dana, a Henok pita jednoga od anđela, kao u 46³, tko je taj Sin Čovječji.]

verses.text_en:
And he (_i. e._ the angel) came to me and greeted me with His voice, and said unto me:

‘=This is= the Son of Man who is born unto righteousness;
And righteousness abides over =him=,
And the righteousness of the Head of Days forsakes =him= not.’
verses.text_hr:
On — to jest anđeo — prišao mi je, pozdravio me svojim glasom i rekao:

„=Ovo je= Sin Čovječji rođen za pravednost.
Pravednost prebiva nad =njim=,
a pravednost Glave Dana ne napušta =ga=.“

verses.text_en:
And he said unto me:
‘He proclaims unto thee peace in the name of the world to come;
For from hence has proceeded peace since the creation of the world,
And so shall it be unto thee for ever and for ever and ever.
verses.text_hr:
Rekao mi je:
„On ti navješćuje mir u ime budućega svijeta,
jer odatle mir izlazi od stvaranja svijeta.
Tako će biti i tebi zauvijek, u vijeke vjekova.

verses.text_en:
And all shall walk in =his= ways since righteousness never forsakes =him=:
With =him= will be their dwelling-places, and with =him= their heritage,
And they shall not be separated from =him= for ever and ever and ever.
verses.text_hr:
Svi će hoditi njegovim putovima jer pravednost nikada ne napušta =ga=.
S =njim= će biti njihova prebivališta i s =njim= njihova baština.
Od =njega= se neće odvojiti u vijeke vjekova.

verses.text_en:
And so there shall be length of days with that Son of Man,
And the righteous shall have peace and an upright way,
In the name of the Lord of Spirits for ever and ever.’
verses.text_hr:
S tim će Sinom Čovječjim biti podaren dug život,
a pravedni će imati mir i čestit put
u ime Gospodara duhova u vijeke vjekova.“

verses.text_en: The Book of the courses of the luminaries of the heaven, the relations of each, according to their classes, their dominion and their seasons, according to their names and places of origin, and according to their months, which Uriel, the holy angel, who was with me, who is their guide, showed me; and he showed me all their laws exactly as they are, and how it is with regard to all the years of the world and unto eternity, till the new creation is accomplished which dureth till eternity.
verses.text_hr: Knjiga o putanjama nebeskih svjetlila, o odnosima svakoga od njih prema njihovim razredima, vlasti i razdobljima, prema njihovim imenima i mjestima podrijetla te prema njihovim mjesecima; sve mi je to pokazao Uriel, sveti anđeo koji bijaše sa mnom i njihov je vodič. Pokazao mi je sve njihove zakone točno onakvima kakvi jesu i kako vrijede za sve godine svijeta sve do vječnosti, dok se ne dovrši novo stvaranje koje će trajati zauvijek.

verses.text_en: And this is the first law of the luminaries: the luminary the Sun has its rising in the eastern portals of the heaven, and its setting in the western portals of the heaven.
verses.text_hr: Ovo je prvi zakon svjetlila: svjetlilo zvano Sunce izlazi na istočnim vratima neba, a zalazi na zapadnim vratima neba.

verses.text_en: And I saw six portals in which the sun rises, and six portals in which the sun sets: and the moon rises and sets in these portals, and the leaders of the stars and those whom they lead: six in the east and six in the west, and all following each other in accurately corresponding order: also many windows to the right and left of these portals.
verses.text_hr: Vidio sam šest vrata kroz koja Sunce izlazi i šest vrata kroz koja zalazi. Na tim vratima izlazi i zalazi i Mjesec, zajedno s vođama zvijezda i zvijezdama koje oni vode: šest vrata na istoku i šest na zapadu, poredanih točno jedno za drugim, te mnogo prozora desno i lijevo od tih vrata.

verses.text_en: And first there goes forth the great luminary, named the Sun, and his circumference is like the circumference of the heaven, and he is quite filled with illuminating and heating fire.
verses.text_hr: I prvo izlazi velika svjetiljka, po imenu Sunce, a njegov opseg je poput opsega neba, i on je sasvim ispunjen vatrom koja osvjetljava i grije.

verses.text_en: The chariot on which he ascends, the wind drives, and the sun goes down from the heaven and returns through the north in order to reach the east, and is so guided that he comes to the appropriate (lit. ‘that’) portal and shines in the face of the heaven.
verses.text_hr: Kola na kojima se uspinje pokreće vjetar. Sunce zalazi s neba i vraća se preko sjevera da bi stiglo na istok; tako se vodi do odgovarajućih vrata i obasjava lice neba.

verses.text_en: In this way he rises in the first month in the great portal, which is the fourth [those six portals in the east].
verses.text_hr: Na ovaj način on ustaje u prvom mjesecu u velikom portalu, koji je četvrti [onih šest portala na istoku].

verses.text_en: And in that fourth portal from which the sun rises in the first month are twelve window-openings, from which proceed a flame when they are opened in their season.
verses.text_hr: A u tom četvrtom portalu iz kojeg sunce izlazi u prvom mjesecu nalazi se dvanaest prozorskih otvora, iz kojih izlazi plamen kada se otvore u svoje doba.

verses.text_en: When the sun rises in the heaven, he comes forth through that fourth portal thirty mornings in succession, and sets accurately in the fourth portal in the west of the heaven.
verses.text_hr: Kada sunce izađe na nebu, ono izlazi kroz taj četvrti portal trideset uzastopnih jutara, i zalazi točno na četvrtom portalu na zapadu neba.

verses.text_en: And during this period the day becomes daily longer and the night nightly shorter to the thirtieth morning.
verses.text_hr: I tijekom ovog razdoblja dan postaje svaki dan duži, a noć svake noći kraća do tridesetog jutra.

verses.text_en: On that day the day is longer than the night by a ninth part, and the day amounts exactly to ten parts and the night to eight parts.
verses.text_hr: Toga dana dan je duži od noći za devetinu, a dan iznosi točno deset dijelova, a noć osam dijelova.

verses.text_en: And the sun rises from that fourth portal, and sets in the fourth and returns to the fifth portal of the east thirty mornings, and rises from it and sets in the fifth portal.
verses.text_hr: I sunce izlazi iz tog četvrtog portala, i zalazi u četvrtom i vraća se na peti portal na istoku trideset jutara, i izlazi iz njega i zalazi u petom portalu.

verses.text_en: And then the day becomes longer by †two† parts and amounts to eleven parts, and the night becomes shorter and amounts to seven parts.
verses.text_hr: I tada dan postaje duži za †dva† dijela i iznosi jedanaest dijelova, a noć postaje kraća i iznosi sedam dijelova.

verses.text_en: And it returns to the east and enters into the sixth portal, and rises and sets in the sixth portal one and thirty mornings on account of its sign.
verses.text_hr: I vraća se na istok i ulazi u šesti portal, i izlazi i zalazi u šestom portalu trideset i jedno jutro zbog svog znaka.

verses.text_en: On that day the day becomes longer than the night, and the day becomes double the night, and the day becomes twelve parts, and the night is shortened and becomes six parts.
verses.text_hr: Toga dana dan postaje duži od noći, i dan postaje dvostruko veći od noći, i dan postaje dvanaest dijelova, a noć se skraćuje i postaje šest dijelova.

verses.text_en: And the sun mounts up to make the day shorter and the night longer, and the sun returns to the east and enters into the sixth portal, and rises from it and sets thirty mornings.
verses.text_hr: I sunce se penje da bi dan bio kraći, a noć duža, i sunce se vraća na istok i ulazi u šesti portal, i izlazi iz njega i zalazi trideset jutara.

verses.text_en: And when thirty mornings are accomplished, the day decreases by exactly one part, and becomes eleven parts, and the night seven.
verses.text_hr: A kada se navrši trideset jutara, dan se smanjuje za točno jedan dio, i postaje jedanaest dijelova, a noć sedam.

verses.text_en: And the sun goes forth from that sixth portal in the west, and goes to the east and rises in the fifth portal for thirty mornings, and sets in the west again in the fifth western portal.
verses.text_hr: I sunce izlazi iz tog šestog portala na zapadu, ide prema istoku i izlazi u petom portalu trideset jutara, i opet zalazi na zapadu u petom zapadnom portalu.

verses.text_en: On that day the day decreases by †two† parts, and amounts to ten parts and the night to eight parts.
verses.text_hr: Tog dana dan se smanjuje za †dva† dijela, i iznosi deset dijelova, a noć na osam dijelova.

verses.text_en: And the sun goes forth from that fifth portal and sets in the fifth portal of the west, and rises in the fourth portal for one and thirty mornings on account of its sign, and sets in the west.
verses.text_hr: I sunce izlazi iz tog petog portala i zalazi na petom portalu na zapadu, i izlazi na četvrtom portalu trideset i jedno jutro zbog svog znaka, i zalazi na zapadu.

verses.text_en: On that day the day is equalised with the night, [and becomes of equal length], and the night amounts to nine parts and the day to nine parts.
verses.text_hr: Toga dana dan se izjednačava s noći, [i postaje jednake dužine], te noć iznosi devet dijelova, a dan devet dijelova.

verses.text_en: And the sun rises from that portal and sets in the west, and returns to the east and rises thirty mornings in the third portal and sets in the west in the third portal.
verses.text_hr: I sunce izlazi iz tog portala i zalazi na zapadu, i vraća se na istok i izlazi trideset jutara na trećem portalu i zalazi na zapadu na trećem portalu.

verses.text_en: And on that day the night becomes longer than the day, and night becomes longer than night, and day shorter than day till the thirtieth morning, and the night amounts exactly to ten parts and the day to eight parts.
verses.text_hr: I toga dana noć postaje duža od dana, i noć postaje duža od noći, a dan kraći od dana do tridesetog jutra, i noć iznosi točno deset dijelova, a dan osam dijelova.

verses.text_en: And the sun rises from that third portal and sets in the third portal in the west and returns to the east, and for thirty mornings rises in the second portal in the east, and in like manner sets in the second portal in the west of the heaven.
verses.text_hr: I sunce izlazi iz tog trećeg portala i zalazi u trećem portalu na zapadu i vraća se na istok, i trideset jutara izlazi u drugom portalu na istoku, i na sličan način zalazi u drugom portalu na zapadu neba.

verses.text_en: And on that day the night amounts to eleven parts and the day to seven parts.
verses.text_hr: I tog dana noć se sastoji od jedanaest dijelova, a dan od sedam dijelova.

verses.text_en: And the sun rises on that day from that second portal and sets in the west in the second portal, and returns to the east into the first portal for one and thirty mornings, and sets in the first portal in the west of the heaven.
verses.text_hr: I sunce izađe tog dana iz tog drugog portala i zađe na zapadu u drugom portalu, i vrati se na istok u prvi portal za trideset i jedno jutro, i zađe u prvom portalu na zapadu neba.

verses.text_en: And on that day the night becomes longer and amounts to the double of the day: and the night amounts exactly to twelve parts and the day to six.
verses.text_hr: I tog dana noć postaje duža i iznosi dvostruko od dana: i noć iznosi točno dvanaest dijelova, a dan šest.

verses.text_en: And the sun has (therewith) traversed the divisions of his orbit and turns again on those divisions of his orbit, and enters that portal thirty mornings and sets also in the west opposite to it.
verses.text_hr: I sunce je (time) prešlo dionice svoje orbite i ponovno se okreće na tim dionicama svoje orbite, i ulazi u taj portal trideset jutara i zalazi također na zapadu nasuprot njemu.

verses.text_en: And on that night has the night decreased in length by a †ninth† part, and the night has become eleven parts and the day seven parts.
verses.text_hr: I te noći noć se smanjila za †deveti† dio, te je noć postala jedanaest dijelova, a dan sedam dijelova.

verses.text_en: And the sun has returned and entered into the second portal in the east, and returns on those his divisions of his orbit for thirty mornings, rising and setting.
verses.text_hr: I sunce se vratilo i ušlo u drugi portal na istoku, i vraća se na tim svojim dijelovima svoje orbite trideset jutara, izlazeći i zalazeći.

verses.text_en: And on that day the night decreases in length, and the night amounts to ten parts and the day to eight.
verses.text_hr: I toga dana noć se skrati, i noć iznosi deset dijelova, a dan osam.

verses.text_en: And on that day the sun rises from that portal, and sets in the west, and returns to the east, and rises in the third portal for one and thirty mornings, and sets in the west of the heaven.
verses.text_hr: I tog dana sunce izlazi iz tog portala, i zalazi na zapadu, i vraća se na istok, i izlazi na trećem portalu za trideset i jedno jutro, i zalazi na zapadu neba.

verses.text_en: On that day the night decreases and amounts to nine parts, and the day to nine parts, and the night is equal to the day and the year is exactly as to its days three hundred and sixty-four.
verses.text_hr: Toga dana noć se smanjuje i iznosi devet dijelova, a dan devet dijelova, a noć je jednaka danu, a godina je točno kao svojih dana tri stotine šezdeset i četiri.

verses.text_en: And the length of the day and of the night, and the shortness of the day and of the night arise—through the course of the sun these distinctions are made (lit. ‘they are separated’).
verses.text_hr: Duljina i kratkoća dana i noći nastaju kretanjem Sunca; po njemu se te razlike stvaraju (doslovno: ‘razdvajaju se’).

verses.text_en: So it comes that its course becomes daily longer, and its course nightly shorter.
verses.text_hr: Tako dolazi do toga da njegov tok postaje svakim danom duži, a tok svake noći kraći.

verses.text_en: And this is the law and the course of the sun, and his return as often as he returns sixty times and rises, _i. e._ the great luminary which is named the Sun, for ever and ever.
verses.text_hr: I ovo je zakon i tok sunca, i njegov povratak onoliko često koliko se vraća šezdeset puta i izlazi, _tj._ velika svjetiljka koja se zove Sunce, zauvijek i zauvijek.

verses.text_en: And that which (thus) rises is the great luminary, and is so named according to its appearance, according as the Lord commanded.
verses.text_hr: A ono što (tako) izlazi je velika svjetiljka, i tako je nazvana prema svom izgledu, prema onome kako je Gospod naredio.

verses.text_en: As he rises, so he sets and decreases not, and rests not, but runs day and night, and his light is sevenfold brighter than that of the moon; but as regards size they are both equal.
verses.text_hr: Kako izlazi, tako zalazi i ne zalazi, i ne odmara se, nego trči danju i noću, a njegova je svjetlost sedam puta svjetlija od mjesečeve; ali što se tiče veličine, oboje su jednaki.

verses.text_en: And after this law I saw another law dealing with the smaller luminary, which is named the Moon.
verses.text_hr: Nakon toga zakona vidio sam drugi zakon, koji se odnosi na manje svjetlilo zvano Mjesec.

verses.text_en: And her circumference is like the circumference of the heaven, and her chariot in which she rides is driven by the wind, and light is given to her in (definite) measure.
verses.text_hr: Njegov je opseg poput opsega neba. Kola kojima se vozi pokreće vjetar, a svjetlost mu se daje u određenoj mjeri.

verses.text_en: And her rising and setting changes every month: and her days are like the days of the sun, and when her light is uniform (_i. e._ full) it amounts to the seventh part of the light of the sun.
verses.text_hr: Njegov se izlazak i zalazak mijenjaju svakoga mjeseca. Dani su mu poput Sunčevih, a kad mu je svjetlost jednolika (_tj._ puna), on iznosi sedminu Sunčeve svjetlosti.

verses.text_en: And thus she rises. And her first phase in the east comes forth on the thirtieth morning: and on that day she becomes visible, and constitutes for you the first phase of the moon on the thirtieth day together with the sun in the portal where the sun rises.
verses.text_hr: Ovako izlazi: njegova prva mijena na istoku nastupa tridesetoga jutra. Toga dana postaje vidljiv i označuje vam prvu Mjesečevu mijenu tridesetoga dana, zajedno sa Suncem na vratima kroz koja Sunce izlazi.

verses.text_en: And the one half of her goes forth by a seventh part, and her whole circumference is empty, without light, with the exception of one-seventh part of it, (and) the fourteenth part of her light.
verses.text_hr: Jedna njegova polovica napreduje za sedminu, dok mu je sav krug prazan i bez svjetlosti, osim jedne njegove sedmine i četrnaestine njegove svjetlosti.

verses.text_en: And when she receives one-seventh part of the half of her light, her light amounts to one-seventh part and the half thereof.
verses.text_hr: Kad primi jednu sedminu polovice svoje svjetlosti, svjetlost mu iznosi jednu sedminu i polovicu nje.

verses.text_en: And she sets with the sun, and when the sun rises the moon rises with him and receives the half of one part of light, and in that night in the beginning of her morning [in the commencement of the lunar day] the moon sets with the sun, and is invisible that night with the fourteen parts and the half of one of them.
verses.text_hr: Zalazi sa Suncem. Kad Sunce iziđe, Mjesec izlazi s njim i prima polovicu jednoga dijela svjetlosti. Te noći, na početku njegova jutra [na početku lunarnoga dana], Mjesec zalazi sa Suncem i nevidljiv je s četrnaest dijelova i polovicom jednoga od njih.

verses.text_en: And she rises on that day with exactly a seventh part, and comes forth and recedes from the rising of the sun, and in her remaining days she becomes bright in the (remaining) thirteen parts.
verses.text_hr: Toga dana izlazi s točno jednom sedminom, udaljava se od Sunčeva izlaska i tijekom preostalih dana svjetlost mu raste u preostalih trinaest dijelova.

verses.text_en: And I saw another course, a law for her, (and) how according to that law she performs her monthly revolution.
verses.text_hr: Vidio sam još jednu putanju, zakon za Mjesec i način na koji prema tom zakonu dovršava svoj mjesečni ophod.
