verses.text_en: And all these Uriel, the holy angel who is the leader of them all, showed to me, and their positions, and I wrote down their positions as he showed them to me, and I wrote down their months as they were, and the appearance of their lights till fifteen days were accomplished.
verses.text_hr: I sve mi je to Uriel, sveti anđeo koji je vođa svih njih, pokazao, i njihove položaje, i zapisao sam njihove položaje kako mi ih je pokazao, i zapisao sam njihove mjesece kakvi su bili, i pojavljivanje njihovih svjetala dok se nije ispunilo petnaest dana.

verses.text_en: In single seventh parts she accomplishes all her light in the east, and in single seventh parts accomplishes all her darkness in the west.
verses.text_hr: U jednoj sedmini Mjesec prima svu svoju svjetlost na istoku, a u jednoj sedmini dovršava svu svoju tamu na zapadu.

verses.text_en: And in certain months she alters her settings, and in certain months she pursues her own peculiar course.
verses.text_hr: U nekim mjesecima mijenja mjesta zalaska, a u nekima slijedi vlastitu posebnu putanju.

verses.text_en: In two months the moon sets with the sun in those two middle portals the third and the fourth.
verses.text_hr: Dva mjeseca Mjesec zalazi sa Suncem na dvojim srednjim vratima, trećim i četvrtim.

verses.text_en: She goes forth for seven days, and turns about and returns again through the portal where the sun rises, and accomplishes all her light: and she recedes from the sun, and in eight days enters the sixth portal from which the sun goes forth.
verses.text_hr: On ide naprijed sedam dana, okreće se i opet vraća kroz portal gdje sunce izlazi, i ostvaruje svu svoju svjetlost: i on se udaljava od sunca, i za osam dana ulazi u šesti portal iz kojeg sunce izlazi.

verses.text_en: And when the sun goes forth from the fourth portal she goes forth seven days, until she goes forth from the fifth and turns back again in seven days into the fourth portal and accomplishes all her light: and she recedes and enters into the first portal in eight days.
verses.text_hr: I kada sunce izađe iz četvrtog portala, on ide naprijed sedam dana, sve dok ne izađe iz petog i ponovno se vrati za sedam dana u četvrti portal i postigne svu svoju svjetlost: i on se povuče i uđe u prvi portal za osam dana.

verses.text_en: And she returns again in seven days into the fourth portal from which the sun goes forth.
verses.text_hr: I on se ponovno vraća za sedam dana u četvrti portal iz kojeg sunce izlazi.

verses.text_en: Thus I saw their position—how the moons rose and the sun set in those days.
verses.text_hr: Tako sam vidio njihov položaj - kako su mjeseci izlazili i sunce zalazilo tih dana.

verses.text_en: And if five years are added together the sun has an overplus of thirty days, and all the days which accrue to it for one of those five years, when they are full, amount to 364 days.
verses.text_hr: Ako se zbroji pet godina, Sunce ima višak od trideset dana; svi dani koji mu se pridodaju tijekom jedne od tih pet punih godina iznose 364 dana.

verses.text_en: And the overplus of the sun and of the stars amounts to six days: in 5 years 6 days every year come to 30 days: and the moon falls behind the sun and stars to the number of 30 days.
verses.text_hr: Višak Sunca i zvijezda iznosi šest dana: u pet godina, po šest dana svake godine, ukupno trideset dana. Mjesec zaostaje za Suncem i zvijezdama trideset dana.

verses.text_en: And =the sun= and the stars bring in all the years exactly, so that they do not advance or delay their position by a single day unto eternity; but =complete= the years with perfect justice in 364 days.
verses.text_hr: =Sunce= i zvijezde dovršavaju sve godine posve točno: ne pomiču niti odgađaju svoj položaj ni za jedan dan dovijeka, nego =dovršavaju= godine savršeno pravilno u 364 dana.

verses.text_en: In 3 years there are 1092 days, and in 5 years 1820 days, so that in 8 years there are 2912 days.
verses.text_hr: U 3 godine ima 1092 dana, a u 5 godina 1820 dana, tako da u 8 godina ima 2912 dana.

verses.text_en: For the moon alone the days amount in 3 years to 1062 days, and in 5 years she falls 50 days behind: [_i. e._ to the sum (of 1770) there is to be added (1000 and) 62 days].
verses.text_hr: Samo za Mjesec dani iznose u 3 godine 1062 dana, a u 5 godina on zaostaje 50 dana: [_tj._ zbroju (od 1770) treba dodati (1000 i) 62 dana].

verses.text_en: And in 5 years there are 1770 days, so that for the moon the days in 8 years amount to 2832 days.
verses.text_hr: A u 5 godina ima 1770 dana, tako da za mjesec dani u 8 godina iznose 2832 dana.

verses.text_en: [For in 8 years she falls behind to the amount of 80 days], all the days she falls behind in 8 years are 80.
verses.text_hr: [U osam godina zaostaje osamdeset dana]; ukupan broj dana zaostajanja u osam godina jest osamdeset.

verses.text_en: And the year is accurately completed in conformity with their world-stations and the stations of the sun, which rise from the portals through which it (the sun) rises and sets 30 days.
verses.text_hr: Godina se točno dovršava prema njihovim postajama svijeta i postajama Sunca, koje izlaze na vratima kroz koja Sunce izlazi i zalazi trideset dana.

verses.text_en: And the leaders of the heads of the thousands, who are placed over the whole creation and over all the stars, have also to do with the four intercalary days, being inseparable from their office, according to the reckoning of the year, and these render service on the four days which are not reckoned in the reckoning of the year.
verses.text_hr: Vođe glavara tisuća, postavljeni nad cijelim stvorenjem i nad svim zvijezdama, upravljaju i četirima umetnutim danima. Oni su, prema računanju godine, neodvojivi od svoje službe i služe u ona četiri dana koja se ne ubrajaju u godinu.

verses.text_en: And owing to them men go wrong therein, for those luminaries truly render service on the world-stations, one in the first portal, one in the third portal of the heaven, one in the fourth portal, and one in the sixth portal, and the exactness of the year is accomplished through its separate three hundred and sixty-four stations.
verses.text_hr: Zbog njih ljudi griješe, jer ta svjetlila doista služe na postajama svijeta: jedno na prvim vratima, jedno na trećim vratima neba, jedno na četvrtim i jedno na šestim. Točnost godine ostvaruje se kroz njezine odvojene 364 postaje.

verses.text_en: For the signs and the times and the years and the days the angel Uriel showed to me, whom the Lord of glory hath set for ever over all the luminaries of the heaven, in the heaven and in the world, that they should rule on the face of the heaven and be seen on the earth, and be leaders for the day and the night, _i. e._ the sun, moon, and stars, and all the ministering creatures which make their revolution in all the chariots of the heaven.
verses.text_hr: Znakove, vremena, godine i dane pokazao mi je anđeo Uriel, kojega je Gospodar Slave zauvijek postavio nad svim nebeskim svjetlilima, na nebu i na zemlji, da upravljaju licem neba, budu vidljiva na zemlji i vode dan i noć — to jest Sunce, Mjesec, zvijezde i sva službujuća stvorenja koja obilaze u svim nebeskim kolima.

verses.text_en: In like manner twelve doors Uriel showed me, open in the circumference of the sun’s chariot in the heaven, through which the rays of the sun break forth: and from them is warmth diffused over the earth, when they are opened at their appointed seasons.
verses.text_hr: Na sličan način Uriel mi je pokazao dvanaest vrata, otvorenih u obodu sunčevih kola na nebu, kroz koja probijaju zrake sunca: i iz njih se toplina širi zemljom, kada se otvore u svoje određeno doba godine.

verses.text_en: [And for the winds and the spirit of the dew† when they are opened, standing open in the heavens at the ends.]
verses.text_hr: [I kada se otvore vjetrovima i duhu rose†, ostaju otvorena na nebu, na njegovim krajevima.]

verses.text_en: As for the twelve portals in the heaven, at the ends of the earth, out of which go forth the sun, moon, and stars, and all the works of heaven in the east and in the west.
verses.text_hr: Na krajevima zemlje nalazi se dvanaest nebeskih vrata iz kojih izlaze Sunce, Mjesec i zvijezde te sva djela neba na istoku i zapadu.

verses.text_en: There are many windows open to the left and right of them, and one window at its (appointed) season produces warmth, corresponding (as these do) to those doors from which the stars come forth according as He has commanded them, and wherein they set corresponding to their number.
verses.text_hr: Mnogo je prozora otvorenih lijevo i desno od njih, a jedan prozor u svom (određenom) godišnjem dobu proizvodi toplinu, koja odgovara (kao što ovi čine) onim vratima iz kojih zvijezde izlaze prema onome kako im je On naredio, i na kojima su postavljene u skladu sa svojim brojem.

verses.text_en: And I saw chariots in the heaven, running in the world, above those portals in which revolve the stars that never set.
verses.text_hr: I vidio sam kola na nebu, kako jure u svijetu, iznad onih portala u kojima se okreću zvijezde koje nikada ne zalaze.

verses.text_en: And one is larger than all the rest, and it is that that makes its course through the entire world.
verses.text_hr: A jedan je veći od svih ostalih, i to je ono što prolazi kroz cijeli svijet.

verses.text_en: And at the ends of the earth I saw twelve portals open to all the =quarters= (of the heaven), from which the winds go forth and blow over the earth.
verses.text_hr: I na krajevima zemlje vidio sam dvanaest portala otvorenih prema svim =četvrtinama= (neba), iz kojih vjetrovi izlaze i pušu nad zemljom.

verses.text_en: Three of them are open on the face (_i. e._ the east) of the heavens, and three in the west, and three on the right (_i. e._ the south) of the heaven, and three on the left (_i. e._ the north).
verses.text_hr: Troja su otvorena na prednjoj strani neba (_tj._ na istoku), troja na zapadu, troja zdesna (_tj._ na jugu), a troja slijeva (_tj._ na sjeveru).

verses.text_en: And the three first are those of the east, and three are of †the north, and three [after those on the left] of the south†, and three of the west.
verses.text_hr: I tri prva su oni od istoka, a tri su od †sjevera, a tri [nakon onih s lijeve strane] od juga†, a tri od zapada.

verses.text_en: Through four of these come winds of blessing and prosperity, and from those eight come hurtful winds: when they are sent, they bring destruction on all the earth and on the water upon it, and on all who dwell thereon, and on everything which is in the water and on the land.
verses.text_hr: Kroz četiri od njih dolaze vjetrovi blagoslova i blagostanja, a od onih osam dolaze štetni vjetrovi: kada su poslani, donose uništenje na svu zemlju i na vodu na njoj, i na sve koji žive na njoj, i na sve što je u vodi i na zemlji.

verses.text_en: And the first wind from those portals, called the east wind, comes forth through the first portal which is in the east, inclining towards the south: from it come forth desolation, drought, heat, and destruction.
verses.text_hr: I prvi vjetar iz tih portala, zvan istočni vjetar, izlazi kroz prvi portal koji je na istoku, nagnut prema jugu: iz njega izlaze pustoš, suša, vrućina i uništenje.

verses.text_en: And through the second portal in the middle comes what is fitting, and from it there come rain and fruitfulness and prosperity and dew; and through the third portal which lies toward the north come cold and drought.
verses.text_hr: I kroz drugi portal u sredini dolazi ono što je prikladno, a iz toga dolazi kiša i plodnost i blagostanje i rosa; a kroz treći portal koji se nalazi prema sjeveru dolaze hladnoća i suša.

verses.text_en: And after these come forth the south winds through three portals: through the first portal of them inclining to the east comes forth a hot wind.
verses.text_hr: A nakon njih izlaze južni vjetrovi kroz tri portala: kroz prvi njihov portal nagnut prema istoku izlazi vrući vjetar.

verses.text_en: And through the middle portal next to it there come forth fragrant smells, and dew and rain, and prosperity and health.
verses.text_hr: A kroz srednji portal pored njega izlaze mirisni mirisi, i rosa i kiša, i blagostanje i zdravlje.

verses.text_en: And through the third portal lying to the west come forth dew and rain, locusts and desolation.
verses.text_hr: I kroz treći portal koji leži na zapadu izlaze rosa i kiša, skakavci i pustoš.

verses.text_en: And after these the north winds: from the seventh portal in the east come dew and rain, locusts and desolation.
verses.text_hr: A nakon njih sjeverni vjetrovi: sa sedmog portala na istoku dolaze rosa i kiša, skakavci i pustoš.

verses.text_en: And from the middle portal come in a direct direction health and rain and dew and prosperity; and through the third portal in the west come cloud and hoar-frost, and snow and rain, and dew and locusts.
verses.text_hr: A iz srednjeg portala dolaze u izravnom smjeru zdravlje i kiša i rosa i blagostanje; i kroz treći portal na zapadu dolaze oblak i inje, i snijeg i kiša, i rosa i skakavci.

verses.text_en: And after these [four] are the west winds: through the first portal adjoining the north come forth dew and hoar-frost, and cold and snow and frost.
verses.text_hr: A nakon ova [četiri] su zapadni vjetrovi: kroz prvi portal koji graniči sa sjeverom izlazi rosa i inje, i hladnoća i snijeg i mraz.

verses.text_en: And from the middle portal come forth dew and rain, and prosperity and blessing; and through the last portal which adjoins the south come forth drought and desolation, and burning and destruction.
verses.text_hr: A iz srednjeg portala izlazi rosa i kiša, i blagostanje i blagoslov; i kroz posljednji portal koji se nadovezuje na jug izlazi suša i pustoš, i paljenje i uništenje.

verses.text_en: And the twelve portals of the four =quarters= of the heaven are therewith completed, and all their laws and all their plagues and all their benefactions have I shown to thee, my son Methuselah.
verses.text_hr: Time su dovršena dvanaestera vrata četiriju =četvrtina= neba. Sve njihove zakone, sva njihova zla i sva njihova dobročinstva pokazao sam ti, sine moj Metušalaše.

verses.text_en: And the first =quarter= is called the east, because it is the first: and the second, the south, because the Most High =will descend= there, yea, there in quite a special sense will He who is blessed for ever =descend=.
verses.text_hr: Prva se =četvrtina= zove istok jer je prva; druga se zove jug jer će Svevišnji ondje =sići=. Da, ondje će u posve osobitom smislu Onaj koji je blagoslovljen dovijeka =sići=.

verses.text_en: And the west =quarter= is named the diminished, because there all the luminaries of the heaven wane and go down.
verses.text_hr: A zapadna =četvrt= nazvana je smanjenom, jer tamo sva svjetla nebeska jenjavaju i silaze.

verses.text_en: And the fourth =quarter=, named the north, is divided into three parts: the first of them is for the dwelling of men: and the second contains seas of water, and the abysses and forests and rivers, and darkness and clouds; and the third part contains the garden of righteousness.
verses.text_hr: A četvrta =četvrt=, nazvana sjever, podijeljena je na tri dijela: prvi od njih je za stanovanje ljudi: a drugi sadrži mora vode, i ponore i šume i rijeke, i tamu i oblake; a treći dio sadrži vrt pravednosti.

verses.text_en: I saw seven high mountains, higher than all the mountains which are on the earth: and thence comes forth hoar-frost, and days, seasons, and years pass away.
verses.text_hr: Vidio sam sedam visokih planina, viših od svih planina koje su na zemlji: i odande izlazi inje, i prolaze dani, godišnja doba i godine.

verses.text_en: I saw seven rivers on the earth larger than all the rivers: one of them coming from the †west† pours its waters into the Great Sea.
verses.text_hr: Vidio sam sedam rijeka na zemlji većih od svih rijeka: jedna od njih koja dolazi sa †zapada† izlijeva svoje vode u Veliko more.

verses.text_en: And these two come from the north to the sea and pour their waters into the Erythraean Sea in the east.
verses.text_hr: Dvije rijeke dolaze sa sjevera do mora i izlijevaju svoje vode u Eritrejsko more na istoku.

verses.text_en: And the remaining four come forth on the side of the north to their own sea, ‹two of them to› the Erythraean Sea, and two into the Great Sea and discharge themselves there [and some say: into the desert].
verses.text_hr: A preostala četvorica izlaze na sjevernu stranu prema vlastitom moru, ‹dva od njih› u Eritrejsko more, a dvojica u Veliko more i tamo se ispuštaju [a neki kažu: u pustinju].

verses.text_en: Seven great islands I saw in the sea and in the mainland: two in the mainland and five in the Great Sea.
verses.text_hr: Sedam velikih otoka koje sam vidio u moru i na kopnu: dva na kopnu i pet u Velikom moru.

verses.text_en: And the names of the sun are the following: the first Orjârês, and the second Tômâs.
verses.text_hr: A imena sunca su sljedeća: prvo Orjârês, a drugo Tômâs.

verses.text_en: And the moon has four names: the first name is Asônjâ, the second Eblâ, the third Benâsê, and the fourth Erâe.
verses.text_hr: I mjesec ima četiri imena: prvo ime je Asônjâ, drugo Eblâ, treće Benâsê, a četvrto Erâe.

verses.text_en: These are the two great luminaries: their circumference is like the circumference of the heaven, and the size of the circumference of both is alike.
verses.text_hr: Ovo su dva velika svjetla: njihov opseg je poput opsega neba, a veličina opsega oba je jednaka.

verses.text_en: In the circumference of the sun there are seven portions of light which are added to it more than to the moon, and in definite measures it is transferred till the seventh portion of the sun is exhausted.
verses.text_hr: U Sunčevu krugu nalazi se sedam dijelova svjetlosti više nego u Mjesečevu. Svjetlost se u određenim mjerama prenosi dok se ne iscrpi sedmi dio Sunčeve svjetlosti.

verses.text_en: And they set and enter the portals of the west, and make their revolution by the north, and come forth through the eastern portals on the face of the heaven.
verses.text_hr: Zalaze i ulaze kroz zapadna vrata, obilaze prema sjeveru i izlaze kroz istočna vrata na lice neba.

verses.text_en: And when the moon rises one-fourteenth part appears in the heaven: [the light becomes full in her]: on the fourteenth day she accomplishes her light.
verses.text_hr: Kad Mjesec iziđe, na nebu se pojavi jedna četrnaestina [svjetlost u njemu postaje puna]; četrnaestoga dana dovršava svoju svjetlost.

verses.text_en: And fifteen parts of light are transferred to her till the fifteenth day (when) her light is accomplished, according to the sign of the year, and she becomes fifteen parts, and the moon grows by (the addition of) fourteenth parts.
verses.text_hr: Do petnaestoga dana prenese mu se petnaest dijelova svjetlosti, kada mu se svjetlost ispuni prema znaku godine. Njegova svjetlost tada ima petnaest dijelova, a Mjesec raste za dodatnih četrnaest dijelova.

verses.text_en: And in her waning (the moon) decreases on the first day to fourteen parts of her light, on the second to thirteen parts of light, on the third to twelve, on the fourth to eleven, on the fifth to ten, on the sixth to nine, on the seventh to eight, on the eighth to seven, on the ninth to six, on the tenth to five, on the eleventh to four, on the twelfth to three, on the thirteenth to two, on the fourteenth to the half of a seventh, and all her remaining light disappears wholly on the fifteenth.
verses.text_hr: I u svom opadanju (Mjesec) se smanjuje prvog dana na četrnaest dijelova svjetla, drugog na trinaest dijelova svjetla, trećeg na dvanaest, četvrtog na jedanaest, petog na deset, šestog na devet, sedmog na osam, osmog na sedam, devetog na šest, desetog na pet, na jedanaesti na četiri, na dvanaesti na tri, na trinaesti na dva, na četrnaesti na polovicu sedme, a svo njegovo preostalo svjetlo potpuno nestaje na petnaestom.

verses.text_en: And in certain months the month has twenty-nine days and once twenty-eight.
verses.text_hr: I u određenim mjesecima mjesec ima dvadeset i devet dana, a jednom dvadeset i osam.

verses.text_en: And Uriel showed me another law: when light is transferred to the moon, and on which side it is transferred to her by the sun.
verses.text_hr: Uriel mi je pokazao još jedan zakon: kada se svjetlost prenosi na Mjesec i s koje mu je strane Sunce prenosi.

verses.text_en: During all the period during which the moon is growing in her light, she is transferring it to herself when opposite to the sun during fourteen days [her light is accomplished in the heaven], and when she is illumined throughout, her light is accomplished in the heaven.
verses.text_hr: Tijekom cijeloga razdoblja u kojem Mjesecu raste svjetlost, on je prima dok je četrnaest dana nasuprot Suncu [njegova se svjetlost dovršava na nebu]. Kad je posve osvijetljen, njegova se svjetlost dovršava na nebu.

verses.text_en: And on the first day she is called the new moon, for on that day the light rises upon her.
verses.text_hr: Prvoga dana zove se mladi Mjesec, jer toga dana svjetlost izlazi nad njim.

verses.text_en: She becomes full moon exactly on the day when the sun sets in the west, and from the east she rises at night, and the moon shines the whole night through till the sun rises over against her and the moon is seen over against the sun.
verses.text_hr: Postaje pun Mjesec upravo onoga dana kada Sunce zađe na zapadu, a on noću iziđe s istoka. Mjesec sja cijelu noć dok Sunce ne iziđe nasuprot njemu i dok se Mjesec ne nađe nasuprot Suncu.

verses.text_en: On the side whence the light of the moon comes forth, there again she wanes till all the light vanishes and all the days of the month are at an end, and her circumference is empty, void of light.
verses.text_hr: Na strani s koje Mjesečeva svjetlost izlazi on ponovno slabi dok sva svjetlost ne nestane i ne završe svi dani mjeseca; tada mu je krug prazan i bez svjetlosti.

verses.text_en: And three months she makes of thirty days, and at her time she makes three months of twenty-nine days each, in which she accomplishes her waning in the first period of time, and in the first portal for one hundred and seventy-seven days.
verses.text_hr: Tri mjeseca ima po trideset dana, a u svojem razdoblju ima tri mjeseca po dvadeset i devet dana. U njima dovršava svoje opadanje u prvom vremenskom razdoblju i na prvim vratima tijekom 177 dana.

verses.text_en: And in the time of her going out she appears for three months (of) thirty days each, and for three months she appears (of) twenty-nine each.
verses.text_hr: U vrijeme svojega izlaženja pojavljuje se tri mjeseca po trideset dana i tri mjeseca po dvadeset i devet dana.

verses.text_en: At night she appears like a man for twenty days each time, and by day she appears like the heaven, and there is nothing else in her save her light.
verses.text_hr: Noću se svaki put pojavljuje poput čovjeka tijekom dvadeset dana, a danju poput neba; u njemu nema ničega osim njegove svjetlosti.

verses.text_en: And now, my son, I have shown thee everything, and the law of all the stars of the heaven is completed.
verses.text_hr: A sada, sine moj, sve sam ti pokazao, i zakon svih zvijezda na nebu je ispunjen.

verses.text_en: And he showed me all the laws of these for every day, and for every season of bearing rule, and for every year, and for its going forth, and for the order prescribed to it every month and every week:
verses.text_hr: Pokazao mi je sve te zakone za svaki dan, za svako razdoblje vlasti, za svaku godinu i njezin početak te za red koji joj je određen za svaki mjesec i svaki tjedan:

verses.text_en: And the waning of the moon which takes place in the sixth portal: for in this sixth portal her light is accomplished, and after that there is the beginning of the waning:
verses.text_hr: I opadanje Mjeseca koje nastaje na šestim vratima: na tim se šestim vratima dovršava njegova svjetlost, a nakon toga počinje opadanje.

verses.text_en: ‹And the waning› which takes place in the first portal in its season, till one hundred and seventy-seven days are accomplished: reckoned according to weeks, twenty-five (weeks) and two days.
verses.text_hr: ‹To opadanje› nastaje na prvim vratima u određeno doba, dok se ne navrši 177 dana — računajući po tjednima, dvadeset i pet tjedana i dva dana.

verses.text_en: She falls behind the sun and the order of the stars exactly five days in the course of one period, and when this place which thou seest has been traversed.
verses.text_hr: Mjesec zaostaje za Suncem i poretkom zvijezda točno pet dana u jednom razdoblju, kada prijeđe mjesto koje vidiš.

verses.text_en: Such is the picture and sketch of every luminary which Uriel the archangel, who is their leader, showed unto me.
verses.text_hr: Takav je prikaz i nacrt svakog svjetlila koji mi je pokazao arkanđeo Uriel, njihov vođa.

verses.text_en: And in those days the angel Uriel answered and said to me: ‘Behold, I have shown thee everything, Enoch, and I have revealed everything to thee that thou shouldest see this sun and this moon, and the leaders of the stars of the heaven and all those who turn them, their tasks and times and departures.
verses.text_hr: U one dane anđeo Uriel odgovori mi: ‘Gle, sve sam ti pokazao, Henoče, i sve ti otkrio da bi vidio Sunce, Mjesec, vođe nebeskih zvijezda i sve koji ih okreću, njihove zadaće, vremena i izlaske.

verses.text_en:
And in the days of the sinners the years shall be shortened,
And their seed shall be tardy on their lands and fields,
And all things on the earth shall alter,
And shall not appear in their time:
And the rain shall be kept back,
And the heaven shall withhold (it).
verses.text_hr: U dane grešnika godine će se skratiti, njihovo će sjeme kasniti na njihovim njivama i poljima, sve će se na zemlji promijeniti i ništa se neće pojaviti u svoje vrijeme. Kiša će biti uskraćena i nebo će je zadržati.

verses.text_en:
And in those times the fruits of the earth shall be backward,
And shall not grow in their time,
And the fruits of the trees shall be withheld in their time.
verses.text_hr: U ta će vremena plodovi zemlje kasniti i neće rasti u svoje doba, a plodovi drveća bit će uskraćeni u svoje vrijeme.

verses.text_en:
And the moon shall alter her order,
And not appear at her time.
verses.text_hr: Mjesec će promijeniti svoj poredak i neće se pojaviti u određeno vrijeme.

verses.text_en:
[And in those days the =sun= shall be seen and he shall journey in the =evening= †on the extremity of the great chariot in† the west]
And shall shine more brightly than accords with the order of light.
verses.text_hr: [U one dane vidjet će se =Sunce= kako putuje prema =večeri= †na kraju velikih kola na† zapadu], i sjat će jače nego što odgovara poretku svjetlosti.
Mnogi će poglavari zvijezda prekršiti propisani poredak; promijenit će svoje putanje i zadaće te se neće pojavljivati u razdobljima koja su im određena.

verses.text_en:
And the whole order of the stars shall be concealed from the sinners,
And the thoughts of those on the earth shall err concerning them,
[And they shall be altered from all their ways],
Yea, they shall err and take them to be gods.
verses.text_hr: Cijeli će poredak zvijezda biti skriven grešnicima. Misli stanovnika zemlje o njima će zabludjeti [i oni će skrenuti sa svih svojih putova]; da, pogriješit će i smatrati ih bogovima.

verses.text_en:
And evil shall be multiplied upon them,
And punishment shall come upon them
So as to destroy all.’
verses.text_hr: Zlo će se nad njima umnožiti i stići će ih kazna koja će ih sve uništiti.’

verses.text_en:
And he said unto me:

‘Observe, Enoch, these heavenly tablets,
And read what is written thereon,
And mark every individual fact.’
verses.text_hr: Reče mi: ‘Promatraj, Henoče, ove nebeske ploče, pročitaj što je na njima napisano i pomno zabilježi svaku činjenicu.’

verses.text_en: And I observed the heavenly tablets, and read everything which was written (thereon) and understood everything, and read the book of all the deeds of mankind, and of all the children of flesh that shall be upon the earth to the remotest generations.
verses.text_hr: I promatrao sam nebeske ploče, i čitao sve što je napisano (na njima) i razumio sve, i čitao sam knjigu svih djela čovječanstva, i sve djece tijela koja će biti na zemlji do najudaljenijih naraštaja.

verses.text_en:
And forthwith I blessed the great Lord, the King of glory for ever, in that He has made all the works of the world.

And I extolled the Lord because of His patience,
And blessed Him because of the children of men.
verses.text_hr: Odmah sam blagoslovio velikoga Gospodina, Kralja Slave dovijeka, jer je stvorio sva djela svijeta. Slavio sam Gospodina zbog Njegove strpljivosti i blagoslovio Ga zbog sinova ljudskih.

verses.text_en:
And after that I said:

‘Blessed is the man who dies in righteousness and goodness,
Concerning whom there is no book of unrighteousness written,
And against whom no day of judgement shall be found.’
verses.text_hr: Nakon toga rekoh: ‘Blago čovjeku koji umre u pravednosti i dobroti, protiv kojega nije napisana knjiga nepravde i protiv kojega se neće naći krivnja na dan suda.’

verses.text_en: And those seven holy ones brought me and placed me on the earth before the door of my house, and said to me: ‘Declare everything to thy son Methuselah, and show to all thy children that no flesh is righteous in the sight of the Lord, for He is their Creator.
verses.text_hr: Tada me onih sedam svetih dovede i postavi na zemlju pred vrata moje kuće. Rekoše mi: ‘Sve objavi svojemu sinu Metušalahu i pokaži svoj svojoj djeci da nijedno tijelo nije pravedno pred Gospodinom, jer On je njihov Stvoritelj.

verses.text_en: One year we will leave thee with thy son, till thou givest thy (last) commands, that thou mayest teach thy children and record (it) for them, and testify to all thy children; and in the second year they shall take thee from their midst.
verses.text_hr: Jednu ćemo te godinu ostaviti s tvojim sinom, dok ne izdaš svoje posljednje zapovijedi, poučiš svoju djecu, sve im zapišeš i posvjedočiš svoj svojoj djeci; druge će te godine uzeti iz njihove sredine.

verses.text_en:
Let thy heart be strong,
For the good shall announce righteousness to the good;
The righteous with the righteous shall rejoice,
And shall offer congratulation to one another.
verses.text_hr: Neka ti srce bude snažno, jer će dobri navješćivati pravednost dobrima; pravednik će se radovati s pravednikom i jedan će drugomu čestitati.

verses.text_en:
But the sinners shall die with the sinners,
And the apostate go down with the apostate.
verses.text_hr: Ali grešnik će umrijeti s grešnikom, a otpadnik će potonuti s otpadnikom.

verses.text_en:
And those who practise righteousness shall die on account of the deeds of men,
And be taken away on account of the doings of the godless.’
verses.text_hr: Oni koji vrše pravednost umrijet će zbog ljudskih djela i bit će odvedeni zbog djela bezbožnika.’

verses.text_en: And in those days they ceased to speak to me, and I came to my people, blessing the Lord of the world.
verses.text_hr: I u one dane prestadoše mi govoriti, i ja sam došao k svome narodu, blagoslivljajući Gospodara svijeta.

verses.text_en: And now, my son Methuselah, all these things I am recounting to thee and writing down for thee, and I have revealed to thee everything, and given thee books concerning all these: so preserve, my son Methuselah, the books from thy father’s hand, and (see) that thou deliver them to the generations of the world.
verses.text_hr: A sada, sine moj Metušalah, sve ove stvari ti prepričavam i zapisujem za tebe, i otkrio sam ti sve, i dao ti knjige o svemu ovome: zato sačuvaj, sine moj Metušalah, knjige iz ruke svoga oca, i (pobrini se) da ih predaš naraštajima svijeta.

verses.text_en:
I have given wisdom to thee and to thy children,
[And thy children that shall be to thee],
That they may give it to their children for generations,
This wisdom (namely) that passeth their thought.
verses.text_hr: Dao sam mudrost tebi i tvojoj djeci [i tvojoj djeci koja će ti se roditi], da je predaju svojoj djeci kroz naraštaje — ovu mudrost koja nadilazi njihove misli.

verses.text_en:
And those who understand it shall not sleep,
But shall listen with the ear that they may learn this wisdom,
And it shall please those that eat thereof better than good food.
verses.text_hr: Oni koji je razumiju neće spavati, nego će prikloniti uho da nauče ovu mudrost, a onima koji je kušaju bit će ugodnija od dobre hrane.

verses.text_en: Blessed are all the righteous, blessed are all those who walk in the way of righteousness and sin not as the sinners in the reckoning of all their days in which the sun traverses the heaven, entering into and departing from the portals for thirty days with the heads of thousands of the order of the stars, together with the four which are intercalated which divide the four portions of the year, which lead them and enter with them four days.
verses.text_hr: Blagoslovljeni svi pravednici, blaženi svi oni koji hodaju putem pravednosti i griješe ne kao grešnici pri računanju svih svojih dana u kojima sunce prolazi nebom, ulazeći i izlazeći iz portala trideset dana s glavama tisuća reda zvijezda, zajedno s četiri umetnute koje dijele četiri dijela godine, koja ih vodi i ulazi s njima četiri dana.

verses.text_en: Owing to them men shall be at fault and not reckon them in the =whole reckoning of the year=: yea, men shall be at fault, and not recognize them accurately.
verses.text_hr: Zbog njih će ljudi griješiti i neće ih uračunati u =cijelo računanje godine=: da, ljudi će biti krivi i neće ih točno prepoznati.

verses.text_en: For they belong to the reckoning of the year and are truly recorded (thereon) for ever, one in the first portal and one in the third, and one in the fourth and one in the sixth, and the year is completed in three hundred and sixty-four days.
verses.text_hr: Jer oni pripadaju računanju godine i uistinu su (na njemu) zauvijek zabilježeni, jedan u prvom portalu i jedan u trećem, i jedan u četvrtom i jedan u šestom, a godina je završena za tri stotine šezdeset i četiri dana.

verses.text_en: And the account thereof is accurate and the recorded reckoning thereof exact; for the luminaries, and months and festivals, and years and days, has Uriel shown and revealed to me, =to whom= the Lord of the whole creation of the world has =subjected= the host of heaven.
verses.text_hr: Račun je točan i njegovo bilježenje precizno. Uriel mi je pokazao i otkrio svjetlila, mjesece, blagdane, godine i dane — on, =kojemu= je Gospodar svega stvorenoga svijeta =podložio= nebesku vojsku.

verses.text_en: And he has power over night and day in the heaven to cause the light to give light to men—sun, moon, and stars, and all the powers of the heaven which revolve in their circular chariots.
verses.text_hr: On ima vlast nad danom i noći na nebu, da svjetlila daju svjetlost ljudima — Sunce, Mjesec, zvijezde i sve nebeske sile koje se okreću u svojim kružnim kolima.

verses.text_en: And these are the orders of the stars, which set in their places, and in their seasons and festivals and months.
verses.text_hr: I ovo su redovi zvijezda, koje zalaze na svoja mjesta, i u svojim godišnjim dobima, svetkovinama i mjesecima.

verses.text_en: And these are the names of those who lead them, who watch =that they= enter at their times, in their orders, in their seasons, in their months, in their periods of dominion, and in their positions.
verses.text_hr: A ovo su imena onih koji ih vode, koji paze da uđu u vrijeme njihovo, u redovima svojim, u godišnjim dobima, u mjesecima, u razdobljima vladanja i na položajima.

verses.text_en: Their four leaders who divide the four parts of the year enter first; and after them the twelve leaders of the orders who divide the months; and for the three hundred and sixty (days) there are heads over thousands who divide the days; and for the four intercalary days there are the leaders which sunder the four parts of the year.
verses.text_hr: Njihova četiri vođe koji dijele četiri dijela godine ulaze prvi; a nakon njih dvanaest vođa redova koji dijele mjesece; a za tri stotine i šezdeset (dana) postoje glave nad tisućama koji dijele dane; a za četiri interkalarna dana postoje predvodnici koji razdvajaju četiri dijela godine.

verses.text_en: And these heads over thousands are intercalated between leader and leader, each behind a station, but their leaders make the division.
verses.text_hr: I ti glavari nad tisućama raspoređeni su između vođe i vođe, svaki iza svoje stanice, ali njihovi vođe čine podjelu.

verses.text_en: And these are the names of the leaders who divide the four parts of the year which are ordained: Mîlkî’êl, Hel’emmêlêk, and Mêl’êjal, and Nârêl.
verses.text_hr: A ovo su imena vođa koji dijele četiri dijela godine koji su određeni: Mîlkî’êl, Hel’emmêlêk, i Mêl’êjal, i Nârêl.

verses.text_en: And the names of those who lead them: Adnâr’êl, and Îjâsûsa’êl, and ‘Elômê’êl—these three follow the leaders of the orders, and there is one that follows the three leaders of the orders which follow those leaders of stations that divide the four parts of the year.
verses.text_hr: I imena onih koji ih vode: Adnâr’êl, i Îjâsûsa’êl, i ‘Elômê’êl — ova trojica slijede vođe redova, a postoji jedan koji slijedi tri vođe redova koji slijede one vođe postaja koje dijele četiri dijela godine.

verses.text_en: In the beginning of the year Melkejâl rises first and rules, who is named †Tam’âinî, and sun† and all the days of his dominion whilst he bears rule are ninety-one days.
verses.text_hr: Početkom godine prvi ustaje i vlada Melkejâl, koji se zove †Tam’âinî, i sunce† i svi dani njegove vladavine dok on vlada su devedeset i jedan dan.

verses.text_en: And these are the signs of the days which are to be seen on earth in the days of his dominion: sweat, and heat, and calms; and all the trees bear fruit, and leaves are produced on all the trees, and the harvest of wheat, and the rose-flowers, and all the flowers which come forth in the field, but the trees of the winter season become withered.
verses.text_hr: I ovo su znakovi dana koji će se vidjeti na zemlji u danima njegove vladavine: znoj, i vrućina, i smiraj; i sva stabla rađaju plodove, i lišće se proizvodi na svim stablima, i žetva pšenice, i cvjetovi ruža, i sve cvijeće koje iznikne u polju, ali drveće zimske sezone se suši.

verses.text_en: And these are the names of the leaders which are under them: Berka’êl, Zêlebs’êl, and another who is added a head of a thousand, called Hîlûjâsěph: and the days of the dominion of this (leader) are at an end.
verses.text_hr: Ovo su imena vođa pod njima: Berka’êl, Zêlebs’êl i još jedan pridružen glavaru tisuće, po imenu Hîlûjâsěph. Dani vladavine ovoga vođe tada završavaju.

verses.text_en: The next leader after him is Hêl’emmêlêk, whom one names the shining sun, and all the days of his light are ninety-one days.
verses.text_hr: Sljedeći vođa nakon njega je Hêl’emmêlêk, kojeg se zove blistavo sunce, a svi dani njegove svjetlosti su devedeset i jedan dan.

verses.text_en: And these are the signs of (his) days on the earth: glowing heat and dryness, and the trees ripen their fruits and produce all their fruits ripe and ready, and the sheep pair and become pregnant, and all the fruits of the earth are gathered in, and everything that is in the fields, and the winepress: these things take place in the days of his dominion.
verses.text_hr: I ovo su znakovi (njegovih) dana na zemlji: žarka vrućina i suhoća, i drveće sazrijeva svoje plodove i rađa sve svoje plodove zrele i spremne, i ovce se pare i postaju trudne, i svi plodovi zemlje su sabrani, i sve što je u poljima, i tijesak: te se stvari zbivaju u danima njegove vladavine.

verses.text_en: These are the names, and the orders, and the leaders of those heads of thousands: Gîdâ’îjal, Kê’êl, and Hê’êl, and the name of the head of a thousand which is added to them, Asfâ’êl’: and the days of his dominion are at an end.
verses.text_hr: Ovo su imena, redovi i vođe tih tisućnika: Gîdâ’îjal, Kê’êl i Hê’êl, i ime tisućnikovog glavara koji im je pridodan, Asfâ’êl’: i dani njegove vladavine su pri kraju.

verses.text_en: And now, my son Methuselah, I will show thee all my visions which I have seen, recounting them before thee.
verses.text_hr: A sada, sine moj Metušalaše, pokazat ću ti sve svoje viđenja koje sam vidio, prepričavajući ih pred tobom.

verses.text_en: Two visions I saw before I took a wife, and the one was quite unlike the other: the first when I was learning to write, the second before I took thy mother, (when) I saw a terrible vision. And regarding them I prayed to the Lord.
verses.text_hr: Dvije viđenja koje sam vidio prije nego što sam se oženio, a jedna je bila sasvim drugačija od druge: prvu kad sam učio pisati, drugu prije nego što sam uzeo tvoju majku, (kada) sam vidio strašnu viđenje. I za njih sam se molio Gospodinu.

verses.text_en: I had laid me down in the house of my grandfather Mahalalel, (when) I saw in a vision how the heaven collapsed and was borne off and fell to the earth.
verses.text_hr: Legao sam u kući svojega djeda Mahalalela kada u viđenju ugledah kako se nebo ruši, odnosi i pada na zemlju.

verses.text_en: And when it fell to the earth I saw how the earth was swallowed up in a great abyss, and mountains were suspended on mountains, and hills sank down on hills, and high trees were rent from their stems, and hurled down and sunk in the abyss.
verses.text_hr: I kad je pao na zemlju, vidio sam kako je zemlja bila progutana u velikom ponoru, i planine su visjele na planinama, i brda su se srušila na brda, i visoka stabla su bila otrgnuta od svojih stabljika, i bačena dolje i potopljena u ponor.

verses.text_en: And thereupon a word fell into my mouth, and I lifted up (my voice) to cry aloud, and said: ‘The earth is destroyed.’
verses.text_hr: Tada mi riječ dođe u usta, podigoh glas, glasno povikah i rekoh: ‘Zemlja je uništena!’

verses.text_en: And my grandfather Mahalalel waked me as I lay near him, and said unto me: ‘Why dost thou cry so, my son, and why dost thou make such lamentation?’
verses.text_hr: I moj djed Mahalalel me probudio dok sam ležao blizu njega, i rekao mi: ‘Zašto tako plačeš, sine moj, i zašto tako naričeš?’

verses.text_en: And I recounted to him the whole vision which I had seen, and he said unto me: ‘A terrible thing hast thou seen, my son, and of grave moment is thy dream-vision as to the secrets of all the sin of the earth: it must sink into the abyss and be destroyed with a great destruction.
verses.text_hr: Ispripovjedih mu cijelo viđenje koje sam vidio, a on mi reče: ‘Strašno si vidio, sine moj, i vrlo je ozbiljno tvoje viđenje u snu o tajnama svih grijeha zemlje. Zemlja mora potonuti u bezdan i biti uništena velikom propašću.

verses.text_en: And now, my son, arise and make petition to the Lord of glory, since thou art a believer, that a remnant may remain on the earth, and that He may not destroy the whole earth.
verses.text_hr: A sada, sine moj, ustani i uputi molbu Gospodaru Slave, jer si vjeran, da ostatak ostane na zemlji i da On ne uništi svu zemlju.

verses.text_en: My son, from heaven all this will come upon the earth, and upon the earth there will be great destruction.’
verses.text_hr: Sine moj, s neba će sve ovo doći na zemlju, a na zemlji će biti veliko uništenje.’

verses.text_en: After that I arose and prayed and implored and besought, and wrote down my prayer for the generations of the world, and I will show everything to thee, my son Methuselah.
verses.text_hr: Potom ustadoh, molih, preklinjah i zaklinjah te zapisah svoju molitvu za naraštaje svijeta. Sve ću ti pokazati, sine moj Metušalaše.

verses.text_en: And when I had gone forth below and seen the heaven, and the sun rising in the east, and the moon setting in the west, and a few stars, and the whole earth, and everything as †He had known† it in the beginning, then I blessed the Lord of judgement and extolled Him because He had made the sun to go forth from the windows of the east, †and he ascended and rose on the face of the heaven, and set out and kept traversing the path shown unto him.
verses.text_hr: Kad sam izišao i ugledao nebo, Sunce kako izlazi na istoku, Mjesec kako zalazi na zapadu, nekoliko zvijezda, cijelu zemlju i sve kako je †On to poznavao† od početka, blagoslovih Gospodara Suda i veličah Ga jer je učinio da Sunce iziđe kroz istočne prozore, †uspne se i uzdigne na lice neba te krene i nastavi prelaziti put koji mu je pokazan.

verses.text_en: And I lifted up my hands in righteousness and blessed the Holy and Great One, and spake with the breath of my mouth, and with the tongue of flesh, which God has made for the children of the flesh of men, that they should speak therewith, and He gave them breath and a tongue and a mouth that they should speak therewith:
verses.text_hr: I podigoh svoje ruke u pravednosti i blagoslovih Svetoga i Velikoga, i progovorih dahom svojih usta i tjelesnim jezikom, koji je Bog načinio za tjelesnu djecu ljudsku, da njime govore, i dade im dah, jezik i usta da njime govore:

verses.text_en:
‘Blessed be Thou, O Lord, King,
Great and mighty in Thy greatness,
Lord of the whole creation of the heaven,
King of kings and God of the whole world.
And Thy power and kingship and greatness abide for ever and ever,
And throughout all generations Thy dominion:
And all the heavens are Thy throne for ever,
And the whole earth Thy footstool for ever and ever.
verses.text_hr: ‘Blagoslovljen budi, Gospodine, Kralju, Velik i moćan u svojoj veličini, Gospodar svega stvorenja neba, Kralj kraljeva i Bog svega svijeta. A Tvoja moć i kraljevstvo i veličina ostaju u vijeke vjekova, i kroz sve naraštaje Tvoja vlast: i sva su nebesa Tvoje prijestolje zauvijek, i sva zemlja podnožje tvojim nogama u vijeke vjekova.

verses.text_en:
For Thou hast made and Thou rulest all things,
And nothing is too hard for Thee,
Wisdom departs not =from the place of Thy throne=,
=Nor turns away= from Thy presence.
And Thou knowest and seest and hearest everything,
And there is nothing hidden from Thee [for Thou seest everything].
verses.text_hr: Jer Ti si stvorio i Ti vladaš svim stvarima, i ništa ti nije teško, Mudrost ne odstupa =od mjesta Tvoga prijestolja=, =Niti se odvraća= od Tvoga prisustva. A Ti znaš i vidiš i čuješ sve, i ništa Tebi nije skriveno [jer Ti sve vidiš].

verses.text_en:
And now the angels of Thy heavens are guilty of trespass,
And upon the flesh of men abideth Thy wrath until the great day of judgement.
verses.text_hr: I sada su anđeli Tvog neba krivi za prijestup, i na tijelu ljudskom ostaje tvoj gnjev do velikog dana suda.

verses.text_en:
And now, O God and Lord and Great King,
I implore and beseech Thee to fulfil my prayer,
To leave me a posterity on earth,
And not to destroy all the flesh of man,
And make the earth without inhabitant,
So that there should be an eternal destruction.
verses.text_hr: A sada, Bože, Gospodine i Veliki Kralju, molim Te i preklinjem da ispuniš moju molitvu, da mi ostaviš potomstvo na zemlji, da ne uništiš svako ljudsko tijelo i ne učiniš zemlju bez stanovnika, kako ne bi nastala vječna propast.

verses.text_en:
And now, my Lord, destroy from the earth the flesh which has aroused Thy wrath,
But the flesh of righteousness and uprightness establish as a plant of the eternal seed,
And hide not Thy face from the prayer of Thy servant, O Lord.’
verses.text_hr: A sada, Gospodaru moj, ukloni sa zemlje tijelo koje je izazvalo Tvoj gnjev, ali tijelo pravednosti i čestitosti učvrsti kao biljku vječnoga sjemena. Ne skrivaj svoje lice od molitve svojega sluge, Gospodine.’

verses.text_en: And after this I saw another dream, and I will show the whole dream to thee, my son.
verses.text_hr: I nakon ovoga vidjeh još jedan san, i pokazat ću ti cijeli san, sine moj.

verses.text_en: And Enoch lifted up (his voice) and spake to his son Methuselah: ‘To thee, my son, will I speak: hear my words—incline thine ear to the dream-vision of thy father.
verses.text_hr: Henok podiže glas i obrati se svojemu sinu Metušalahu: ‘Govorit ću s tobom, sine moj; poslušaj moje riječi i prigni uho viđenju iz sna svojega oca.

verses.text_en: Before I took thy mother Edna, I saw in a vision on my bed, and behold a bull came forth from the earth, and that bull was white; and after it came forth a heifer, and along with this (latter) came forth two bulls, one of them black and the other red.
verses.text_hr: Prije nego što sam uzeo tvoju majku Ednu, vidio sam u viđenju na svojoj postelji — i gle, iz zemlje iziđe bijeli bik. Nakon njega iziđe junica, a s njom iziđoše dva bika, jedan crn, a drugi riđ.

verses.text_en: And that black bull gored the red one and pursued him over the earth, and thereupon I could no longer see that red bull.
verses.text_hr: I taj crni bik je probo crvenog i progonio ga preko zemlje, i tada više nisam mogao vidjeti tog crvenog bika.

verses.text_en: But that black bull grew and that heifer went with him, and I saw that many oxen proceeded from him which resembled and followed him.
verses.text_hr: Crni je bik rastao, a junica je išla s njim. Vidio sam da od njega potječu mnogi volovi koji su mu nalikovali i slijedili ga.

verses.text_en: And that cow, that first one, went from the presence of that first bull in order to seek that red one, but found him not, and lamented with a great lamentation over him and sought him.
verses.text_hr: Ta prva krava ode od prvoga bika tražiti riđega, ali ga ne nađe; silno je jadikovala za njim i tražila ga.

verses.text_en: And I looked till that first bull came to her and quieted her, and from that time onward she cried no more.
verses.text_hr: I gledao sam sve dok joj nije došao onaj prvi bik i utišao je, i od tada više nije plakala.

verses.text_en: And after that she bore another white bull, and after him she bore many bulls and black cows.
verses.text_hr: Nakon toga je rodila još jednog bijelog bika, a nakon njega je rodila mnogo bikova i crnih krava.

verses.text_en: And I saw in my sleep that white bull likewise grow and become a great white bull, and from him proceeded many white bulls, and they resembled him.
verses.text_hr: I vidio sam u snu da je bijeli bik isto tako rastao i postao veliki bijeli bik, a od njega su potekli mnogi bijeli bikovi, i sličili su mu.

verses.text_en: And they began to beget many white bulls, which resembled them, one following the other, (even) many.
verses.text_hr: I počeli su rađati mnoge bijele bikove, koji su nalikovali njima, jedan za drugim, (čak) mnogo.

verses.text_en: And again I saw with mine eyes as I slept, and I saw the heaven above, and behold a star fell from heaven, and it arose and ate and pastured amongst those oxen.
verses.text_hr: Dok sam spavao, ponovno pogledah i ugledah nebo iznad sebe. Gle, s neba pade zvijezda; ustala je, jela i pasla među onim volovima.

verses.text_en: And after that I saw the large and the black oxen, and behold they all changed their stalls and pastures and their cattle, and began to live with each other.
verses.text_hr: Nakon toga ugledah velike crne volove. Gle, svi promijeniše svoje obore, pašnjake i stada te počeše živjeti jedni s drugima.

verses.text_en: And again I saw in the vision, and looked towards the heaven, and behold I saw many stars descend and cast themselves down from heaven to that first star, and they became bulls amongst those cattle and pastured with them [amongst them].
verses.text_hr: Ponovno sam gledao u viđenju i pogledao prema nebu. Gle, vidio sam mnogo zvijezda kako silaze i bacaju se s neba prema prvoj zvijezdi; postale su bikovi među onim stadom i pasle s njima [među njima].

verses.text_en: And I looked at them and saw, and behold they all let out their privy members, like horses, and began to cover the cows of the oxen, and they all became pregnant and bare elephants, camels and asses.
verses.text_hr: Pogledah ih i vidjeh kako su svi izbacili svoje spolne udove poput konja te počeli općiti s kravama. Sve su krave zatrudnjele i rodile slonove, deve i magarce.

verses.text_en: And all the oxen feared them and were affrighted at them, and began to bite with their teeth and to devour, and to gore with their horns.
verses.text_hr: Svi su ih se volovi bojali i bili prestrašeni; oni ih počeše gristi zubima, proždirati i bosti svojim rogovima.

verses.text_en: And they began moreover to devour those oxen; and behold all the children of the earth began to tremble and quake before them and to flee from them.
verses.text_hr: Nastavili su proždirati volove; i gle, sva djeca zemlje počeše pred njima drhtati, strepiti i bježati.

verses.text_en: And again I saw how they began to gore each other and to devour each other, and the earth began to cry aloud.
verses.text_hr: I opet sam vidio kako su počeli bosti jedni druge i proždirati jedni druge, a zemlja je počela glasno plakati.

verses.text_en: And I raised mine eyes again to heaven, and I saw in the vision, and behold there came forth from heaven beings who were like white men: and four went forth from that place and three with them.
verses.text_hr: I podigoh svoje oči ponovno prema nebu, i vidjeh u viđenju, i gle, iziđoše s neba bića koja bijahu poput bijelih ljudi: i četvorica su izašla s tog mjesta i trojica s njima.

verses.text_en: And those three that had last come forth grasped me by my hand and took me up, away from the generations of the earth, and raised me up to a lofty place, and showed me a tower raised high above the earth, and all the hills were lower.
verses.text_hr: I ona trojica koja su posljednja izašla zgrabiše me za ruku i odvedoše me gore, daleko od naraštaja zemlje, i podigoše me na uzvišeno mjesto, i pokazaše mi toranj visoko iznad zemlje, a sva su brda bila niža.

verses.text_en: And one said unto me: ‘Remain here till thou seest everything that befalls those elephants, camels, and asses, and the stars and the oxen, and all of them.’
verses.text_hr: I jedan mi je rekao: ‘Ostani ovdje dok ne vidiš sve što zadesi te slonove, deve i magarce, i zvijezde i volove, i sve njih.’

verses.text_en: And I saw one of those four who had come forth first, and he seized that first star which had fallen from the heaven, and bound it hand and foot and cast it into an abyss: now that abyss was narrow and deep, and horrible and dark.
verses.text_hr: I vidio sam jednog od one četvorice koji su prvi izašli, i on je zgrabio onu prvu zvijezdu koja je pala s neba, i vezao joj ruke i noge i bacio je u ponor: sada je ponor bio uzak i dubok, i užasan i mračan.

verses.text_en: And one of them drew a sword, and gave it to those elephants and camels and asses: then they began to smite each other, and the whole earth quaked because of them.
verses.text_hr: I jedan od njih isuka mač i dade ga tim slonovima, devama i magarcima: tada se oni počeše međusobno udarati, i cijela se zemlja tresla od njih.

verses.text_en: And as I was beholding in the vision, lo, one of the four who had come forth stoned (them) from heaven, and gathered and took all the great stars whose privy members were like those of horses, and bound them all hand and foot, and cast them in an abyss of the earth.
verses.text_hr: Dok sam gledao u viđenju, gle, jedan od četvorice koji su izišli zasuo ih je kamenjem s neba. Okupio je i uzeo sve velike zvijezde čiji su spolni udovi bili poput konjskih, svezao im ruke i noge i bacio ih u zemaljski bezdan.

verses.text_en: And one of those four went to that white bull and instructed him in a secret, without his being terrified: he was born a bull and became a man, and built for himself a great vessel and dwelt thereon; and three bulls dwelt with him in that vessel and they were covered in.
verses.text_hr: Jedan od četvorice ode do bijeloga bika i povjeri mu tajnu, a da ga nije prestrašio. Bik se rodio kao bik, a postao čovjekom; sagradio je sebi veliku lađu i nastanio se u njoj. Tri su bika boravila s njim u lađi i bili su natkriveni.

verses.text_en: And again I raised mine eyes towards heaven and saw a lofty roof, with seven water torrents thereon, and those torrents flowed with much water into an enclosure.
verses.text_hr: I opet sam podigao svoje oči prema nebu i vidio sam uzvišeni krov, sa sedam vodenih bujica na njemu, a te su bujice tekle s mnogo vode u ograđeni prostor.

verses.text_en: And I saw again, and behold fountains were opened on the surface of that great enclosure, and that water began to swell and rise upon the surface, and I saw that enclosure till all its surface was covered with water.
verses.text_hr: Ponovno pogledah i gle, izvori se otvoriše na površini velikoga ograđenog prostora. Voda je počela bujati i dizati se na površini, a ja sam gledao taj prostor dok mu voda nije prekrila cijelu površinu.

verses.text_en: And the water, the darkness, and mist increased upon it; and as I looked at the height of that water, that water had risen above the height of that enclosure, and was streaming over that enclosure, and it stood upon the earth.
verses.text_hr: I voda, tama i magla se povećaše na njemu; i dok sam gledao u visinu te vode, ta se voda podigla iznad visine tog ograđenog prostora, i tekla je preko tog ograđenog prostora, i stala je na zemlju.

verses.text_en: And all the cattle of that enclosure were gathered together until I saw how they sank and were swallowed up and perished in that water.
verses.text_hr: I sva stoka iz tog ograđenog prostora bila je skupljena dok nisam vidio kako su potonula i kako su progutana i nestala u toj vodi.

verses.text_en: But that vessel floated on the water, while all the oxen and elephants and camels and asses sank to the bottom with all the animals, so that I could no longer see them, and they were not able to escape, (but) perished and sank into the depths.
verses.text_hr: Ali ta je posuda plutala po vodi, dok su svi volovi i slonovi i deve i magarci potonuli na dno sa svim životinjama, tako da ih više nisam mogao vidjeti, i nisu mogli pobjeći, (nego) su poginuli i potonuli u dubine.

verses.text_en: And again I saw in the vision till those water torrents were removed from that high roof, and the chasms of the earth were levelled up and other abysses were opened.
verses.text_hr: I opet sam vidio u viđenju dok te vodene bujice nisu bile uklonjene s tog visokog krova, a ponori zemlje su bili poravnati i drugi ponori su bili otvoreni.

verses.text_en: Then the water began to run down into these, till the earth became visible; but that vessel settled on the earth, and the darkness retired and light appeared.
verses.text_hr: Tada je voda počela teći u njih, sve dok zemlja nije postala vidljiva; ali ta se posuda smjestila na zemlju, tama se povukla i svjetlo se pojavilo.

verses.text_en: But that white bull which had become a man came out of that vessel, and the three bulls with him, and one of those three was white like that bull, and one of them was red as blood, and one black: and that white bull departed from them.
verses.text_hr: Ali onaj bijeli bik koji je postao čovjek izašao je iz te posude, i tri bika s njim, a jedan od te trojice je bio bijel poput tog bika, i jedan od njih je bio crven kao krv, a jedan crn: i taj bijeli bik je otišao od njih.

verses.text_en: And they began to bring forth beasts of the field and birds, so that there arose different genera: lions, tigers, wolves, dogs, hyenas, wild boars, foxes, squirrels, swine, falcons, vultures, kites, eagles, and ravens; and among them was born a white bull.
verses.text_hr: I počeli su izvoditi poljske zvijeri i ptice, tako da su nastali različiti rodovi: lavovi, tigrovi, vukovi, psi, hijene, divlje svinje, lisice, vjeverice, svinje, sokolovi, lešinari, zmajevi, orlovi i gavrani; a među njima se rodio bijeli bik.

verses.text_en: And they began to bite one another; but that white bull which was born amongst them begat a wild ass and a white bull with it, and the wild asses multiplied.
verses.text_hr: I počeli su se gristi; ali onaj bijeli bik koji se rodio među njima rodio je divljeg magarca i bijelog bika s njim, i divlji magarci su se množili.

verses.text_en: But that bull which was born from him begat a black wild boar and a white sheep; and the former begat many boars, but that sheep begat twelve sheep.
verses.text_hr: Bik koji se od njega rodio dobio je crnoga divljeg vepra i bijelu ovcu. Prvi je dobio mnogo veprova, a ovca je ojanjila dvanaest ovaca.

verses.text_en: And when those twelve sheep had grown, they gave up one of them to the asses, and those asses again gave up that sheep to the wolves, and that sheep grew up among the wolves.
verses.text_hr: I kad je tih dvanaest ovaca naraslo, jednu su od njih predali magarcima, a ti su magarci opet predali tu ovcu vukovima, i ta je ovca odrasla među vukovima.

verses.text_en: And the Lord brought the eleven sheep to live with it and to pasture with it among the wolves: and they multiplied and became many flocks of sheep.
verses.text_hr: I Gospod dovede jedanaest ovaca da žive s njima i da pasu s njima među vukovima; i one se namnožiše i postadoše mnoga stada ovaca.

verses.text_en: And the wolves began to fear them, and they oppressed them until they destroyed their little ones, and they cast their young into a river of much water: but those sheep began to cry aloud on account of their little ones, and to complain unto their Lord.
verses.text_hr: I vukovi su ih se počeli bojati, i tlačili su ih sve dok nisu uništili njihovu mladunčad, i bacili svoje mlade u rijeku punu vode: ali su te ovce počele glasno plakati zbog svoje dječice i žaliti se svome Gospodaru.

verses.text_en: And a sheep which had been saved from the wolves fled and escaped to the wild asses; and I saw the sheep how they lamented and cried, and besought their Lord with all their might, till that Lord of the sheep descended at the voice of the sheep from a lofty abode, and came to them and pastured them.
verses.text_hr: Ovca koja se spasila od vukova pobježe i ode k divljim magarcima. Vidio sam ovce kako jadikuju, plaču i svom snagom mole svojega Gospodara, dok Gospodar ovaca na njihov glas nije sišao iz uzvišenoga prebivališta, došao k njima i pasao ih.

verses.text_en: And He called that sheep which had escaped the wolves, and spake with it concerning the wolves that it should admonish them not to touch the sheep.
verses.text_hr: I pozvao je onu ovcu koja je pobjegla od vukova, i razgovarao s njom o vukovima da ih opomene da ne diraju ovce.

verses.text_en: And the sheep went to the wolves according to the word of the Lord, and another sheep met it and went with it, and the two went and entered together into the assembly of those wolves, and spake with them and admonished them not to touch the sheep from henceforth.
verses.text_hr: I ovca je otišla k vukovima prema riječi Gospodnjoj, a druga ovca ju je srela i otišla s njom, i njih dvoje su otišli i zajedno ušli u skup tih vukova, i razgovarali s njima i opomenuli ih da od sada pa nadalje ne diraju ovce.

verses.text_en: And thereupon I saw the wolves, and how they oppressed the sheep exceedingly with all their power; and the sheep cried aloud.
verses.text_hr: I tada sam vidio vukove, i kako silno tlače ovce svom svojom snagom; a ovce su glasno plakale.

verses.text_en: And the Lord came to the sheep and they began to smite those wolves: and the wolves began to make lamentation; but the sheep became quiet and forthwith ceased to cry out.
verses.text_hr: Gospodin dođe k ovcama i poče udarati vukove; vukovi počeše naricati, a ovce se utišaše i odmah prestadoše vikati.

verses.text_en: And I saw the sheep till they departed from amongst the wolves; but the eyes of the wolves were blinded, and those wolves departed in pursuit of the sheep with all their power.
verses.text_hr: I vidio sam ovce dok nisu otišle od vukova; ali su oči vukova bile zaslijepljene, i ti su vukovi svom snagom krenuli u potjeru za ovcama.

verses.text_en: And the Lord of the sheep went with them, as their leader, and all His sheep followed Him: and His face was dazzling and glorious and terrible to behold.
verses.text_hr: I Gospodar ovaca je išao s njima, kao njihov vođa, i sve Njegove ovce su Ga slijedile: a Njegovo lice je bilo blistavo i slavno i strašno za vidjeti.

verses.text_en: But the wolves began to pursue those sheep till they reached a sea of water.
verses.text_hr: Ali vukovi su počeli progoniti te ovce sve dok nisu stigle do vodenog mora.

verses.text_en: And that sea was divided, and the water stood on this side and on that before their face, and their Lord led them and placed Himself between them and the wolves.
verses.text_hr: More se razdvojilo i voda je pred njima stala s jedne i druge strane. Njihov ih je Gospodar vodio i stao između njih i vukova.

verses.text_en: And as those wolves did not yet see the sheep, they proceeded into the midst of that sea, and the wolves followed the sheep, and [those wolves] ran after them into that sea.
verses.text_hr: I kako ti vukovi još nisu vidjeli ovce, krenuli su usred tog mora, a vukovi su slijedili ovce, i [ti vukovi] su potrčali za njima u to more.

verses.text_en: And when they saw the Lord of the sheep, they turned to flee before His face, but that sea gathered itself together, and became as it had been created, and the water swelled and rose till it covered those wolves.
verses.text_hr: Kad ugledaše Gospodara ovaca, okrenuše se i pokušaše pobjeći pred Njegovim licem. Ali more se sklopilo i vratilo u prijašnje stanje; voda nabujala, podigla se i prekrila vukove.

verses.text_en: And I saw till all the wolves who pursued those sheep perished and were drowned.
verses.text_hr: I vidio sam sve dok svi vukovi koji su progonili te ovce ne izginuše i utopiše se.

verses.text_en: But the sheep escaped from that water and went forth into a wilderness, where there was no water and no grass; and they began to open their eyes and to see; and I saw the Lord of the sheep pasturing them and giving them water and grass, and that sheep going and leading them.
verses.text_hr: Ovce iziđoše iz vode i odoše u pustinju bez vode i trave. Počele su otvarati oči i gledati. Vidio sam Gospodara ovaca kako ih pase i daje im vodu i travu, a onu ovcu kako ide pred njima i vodi ih.

verses.text_en: And that sheep ascended to the summit of that lofty rock, and the Lord of the sheep sent it to them.
verses.text_hr: I ta se ovca popela na vrh te uzvišene stijene, a Gospodar ovaca poslao ju je k njima.

verses.text_en: And after that I saw the Lord of the sheep who stood before them, and His appearance was great and terrible and majestic, and all those sheep saw Him and were afraid before His face.
verses.text_hr: I nakon toga sam vidio Gospodara ovaca koji je stajao pred njima, i Njegov izgled je bio velik, užasan i veličanstven, i sve te ovce su Ga vidjele i uplašile su se pred Njegovim licem.

verses.text_en: And they all feared and trembled because of Him, and they cried to that sheep with them [which was amongst them]: “We are not able to stand before our Lord or to behold Him.”
verses.text_hr: I svi su se bojali i drhtali zbog Njega, i povikali su onoj ovci s njima [koja je bila među njima]: "Nismo u stanju stati pred našeg Gospodara niti Ga gledati."

verses.text_en: And that sheep which led them again ascended to the summit of that rock, but the sheep began to be blinded and to wander from the way which he had showed them, but that sheep wot not thereof.
verses.text_hr: I ta ovca koja ih je vodila ponovno se popela na vrh te stijene, ali su ovce počele biti zaslijepljene i lutati od puta koji im je pokazao, ali ta ovca nije znala za to.

verses.text_en: And the Lord of the sheep was wrathful exceedingly against them, and that sheep discovered it, and went down from the summit of the rock, and came to the sheep, and found the greatest part of them blinded and fallen away.
verses.text_hr: I Gospodar ovaca bio je silno gnjevan na njih, i ta je ovca to otkrila, i sišla s vrha stijene, i došla do ovaca, i našla najveći dio njih oslijepljen i otpao.

verses.text_en: And when they saw it they feared and trembled at its presence, and desired to return to their folds.
verses.text_hr: Kad su je ugledale, uplašile su se i zadrhtale pred njom te se poželjele vratiti u svoje torove.

verses.text_en: And that sheep took other sheep with it, and came to those sheep which had fallen away, and began to slay them; and the sheep feared its presence, and thus that sheep brought back those sheep that had fallen away, and they returned to their folds.
verses.text_hr: Ta ovca uze sa sobom druge ovce, dođe do otpalih ovaca i poče ih ubijati. Ovce su se bojale njezine prisutnosti; tako je ona vratila otpale ovce i one se vratiše u svoje torove.

verses.text_en: And I saw in this vision till that sheep became a man and built a house for the Lord of the sheep, and placed all the sheep in that house.
verses.text_hr: I vidio sam u ovoj viđenju dok ta ovca nije postala čovjekom i izgradila kuću za Gospodara ovaca, i smjestila sve ovce u tu kuću.

verses.text_en: And I saw till this sheep which had met that sheep which led them fell asleep: and I saw till all the great sheep perished and little ones arose in their place, and they came to a pasture, and approached a stream of water.
verses.text_hr: I vidio sam dok ova ovca koja je susrela onu ovcu koja ih je vodila nije zaspala; i vidio sam dok sve velike ovce ne izginuše i male ustadoše na svoje mjesto, i dođoše do pašnjaka i približiše se potoku vode.

verses.text_en: Then that sheep, their leader which had become a man, withdrew from them and fell asleep, and all the sheep sought it and cried over it with a great crying.
verses.text_hr: Tada se ona ovca, njihov vođa koji je postao čovjekom, povukla od njih i zaspala. Sve su ga ovce tražile i nad njim glasno plakale.

verses.text_en: And I saw till they left off crying for that sheep and crossed that stream of water, and there arose the =two= sheep as leaders in the place of those which had led them and fallen asleep (lit. “had fallen asleep and led them”).
verses.text_hr: I vidio sam dok nisu prestale plakati za tom ovcom i prešle taj potok vode, i tamo su ustale =dvije= ovce kao vođe umjesto onih koji su ih vodili i zaspali (doslovno "zaspali i vodili ih").

verses.text_en: And I saw till the sheep came to a goodly place, and a pleasant and glorious land, and I saw till those sheep were satisfied; and that house stood amongst them in the pleasant land.
verses.text_hr: I vidio sam dok ovce nisu došle na lijepo mjesto, u ugodnu i slavnu zemlju, i vidio sam dok te ovce nisu bile zadovoljne; a ta je kuća stajala među njima u ugodnoj zemlji.

verses.text_en: And sometimes their eyes were opened, and sometimes blinded, till another sheep arose and led them and brought them all back, and their eyes were opened.
verses.text_hr: I ponekad su njihove oči bile otvorene, a ponekad zaslijepljene, sve dok druga ovca nije ustala i povela ih i vratila ih sve natrag, i njihove oči su bile otvorene.

verses.text_en: And the dogs and the foxes and the wild boars began to devour those sheep till the Lord of the sheep raised up [another sheep] a ram from their midst, which led them.
verses.text_hr: Psi, lisice i divlje svinje počeše proždirati ovce, dok Gospodar ovaca nije iz njihove sredine podigao [drugu ovcu], ovna koji ih je vodio.

verses.text_en: And that ram began to butt on either side those dogs, foxes, and wild boars till he had destroyed them †all†.
verses.text_hr: I taj je ovan počeo udarati s obje strane te pse, lisice i divlje svinje dok ih nije †sve† uništio.

verses.text_en: And that sheep whose eyes were opened saw that ram, which was amongst the sheep, =till= it †forsook its glory† and began to butt those sheep, and trampled upon them, and behaved itself unseemly.
verses.text_hr: I ta ovca čije su oči bile otvorene vidjela je onog ovna, koji je bio među ovcama, =sve dok= nije †napustio svoju slavu† i počeo udarati te ovce, i gaziti ih, i ponašati se nedolično.

verses.text_en: And the Lord of the sheep sent the =lamb= to another =lamb= and raised it to being a ram and leader of the sheep instead of that ram which had †forsaken its glory†.
verses.text_hr: Gospodar ovaca posla =janje= drugomu =janjetu= i podiže ga da postane ovan i vođa ovaca umjesto ovna koji je †napustio svoju slavu†.

verses.text_en: And it went to it and spake to it alone, and raised it to being a ram, and made it the prince and leader of the sheep; but during all these things those dogs oppressed the sheep.
verses.text_hr: I otišlo je do njega i razgovaralo s njim nasamo, i odgojilo ga u ovna, i učinilo ga princem i vođom ovaca; ali tijekom svih tih stvari ti su psi tlačili ovce.

verses.text_en: And the first ram pursued that second ram, and that second ram arose and fled before it; and I saw till those dogs pulled down the firsts ram.
verses.text_hr: I prvi ovan je progonio drugog ovna, a drugi ovan je ustao i pobjegao pred njim; i vidio sam dok oni psi nisu povukli prvog ovna.

verses.text_en: And that second ram arose and led the [little] sheep.
verses.text_hr: Drugi ovan ustade i povede [malu] ovcu.

verses.text_en: And those sheep grew and multiplied; but all the dogs, and foxes, and wild boars feared and fled before it, and that ram butted and killed the wild beasts, and those wild beasts had no longer any power among the sheep and robbed them no more of aught. 48^b. And that ram begat many sheep and fell asleep; and a little sheep became ram in its stead, and became prince and leader of those sheep.
verses.text_hr: I te su ovce rasle i množile se; ali su se svi psi, lisice i divlje svinje bojali i bježali pred njim, a taj je ovan udarao i ubijao divlje zvijeri, a te divlje zvijeri više nisu imale nikakve moći među ovcama i nisu im više ništa otimale. 48^b. I taj ovan okoti mnogo ovaca i zaspa; i ovčica je postala ovan umjesto nje, i postala princ i vođa tih ovaca.

verses.text_en: And that house became great and broad, and it was built for those sheep: ‹and› a tower lofty and great was built on the house for the Lord of the sheep, and that house was low, but the tower was elevated and lofty, and the Lord of the sheep stood on that tower and they offered a full table before Him.
verses.text_hr: I ta je kuća postala velika i široka, i bila je sagrađena za te ovce: ‹i› toranj, uzvišen i velik, sagrađen je na kući za Gospodara ovaca, i ta je kuća bila niska, ali je toranj bio uzdignut i uzvišen, i Gospodar ovaca je stajao na toj kuli i ponudili su pun stol pred Njim.

verses.text_en: And again I saw those sheep that they again erred and went many ways, and forsook that their house, and the Lord of the sheep called some from amongst the sheep and sent them to the sheep, but the sheep began to slay them.
verses.text_hr: I opet sam vidio one ovce da su opet pogriješile i otišle mnogo puteva, i napustile tu svoju kuću, i Gospodar ovaca je pozvao neke od ovaca i poslao ih ovcama, ali su ih ovce počele ubijati.

verses.text_en: And one of them was saved and was not slain, and it sped away and cried aloud over the sheep; and they sought to slay it, but the Lord of the sheep saved it from the sheep, and brought it up to me, and caused it to dwell there.
verses.text_hr: I jedan od njih je spašen i nije ubijen, te je odjurio i glasno plakao nad ovcama; i oni su ga htjeli zaklati, ali ga je Gospodar ovaca spasio od ovaca, doveo ga k meni i učinio da ondje prebiva.

verses.text_en: And many other sheep He sent to those sheep to testify unto them and lament over them.
verses.text_hr: I mnoge druge ovce je poslao tim ovcama da im svjedoče i nariču nad njima.

verses.text_en: And after that I saw that when they forsook the house of the Lord and His tower they fell away entirely, and their eyes were blinded; and I saw the Lord of the sheep how He wrought much slaughter amongst them in their herds until those sheep invited that slaughter and betrayed His place.
verses.text_hr: Nakon toga vidjeh: kad su napustile Dom Gospodnji i Njegovu kulu, posve su otpale i oči su im oslijepjele. Gospodar ovaca učinio je velik pokolj među njihovim stadima, sve dok te ovce nisu prizvale taj pokolj i izdale Njegovo mjesto.

verses.text_en: And He gave them over into the hands of the lions and tigers, and wolves and hyenas, and into the hand of the foxes, and to all the wild beasts, and those wild beasts began to tear in pieces those sheep.
verses.text_hr: I predao ih je u ruke lavova i tigrova, vukova i hijena, i u ruke lisica, i svim divljim zvijerima, i te su divlje zvijeri počele komadati te ovce.

verses.text_en: And I saw that He forsook that their house and their tower and gave them all into the hand of the lions, to tear and devour them, into the hand of all the wild beasts.
verses.text_hr: I vidjeh da je On napustio tu njihovu kuću i njihovu kulu i dao ih sve u ruke lavovima, da ih rastrgnu i prožderu, u ruke svim divljim zvijerima.

verses.text_en: And I began to cry aloud with all my power, and to appeal to the Lord of the sheep, and to represent to Him in regard to the sheep that they were devoured by all the wild beasts.
verses.text_hr: Počeh iz sve snage glasno vikati, zazivati Gospodara ovaca i iznositi Mu kako ovce proždiru sve divlje zvijeri.

verses.text_en: But He remained unmoved, though He saw it, and rejoiced that they were devoured and swallowed and robbed, and left them to be devoured in the hand of all the beasts.
verses.text_hr: Ali On je ostao nepomičan, iako je to vidio, i radovao se što su pojedeni i progutani i opljačkani, i ostavio ih da budu prožderane u rukama svih zvijeri.

verses.text_en: And He called seventy shepherds, and cast those sheep to them that they might pasture them, and He spake to the shepherds and their companions: “Let each individual of you pasture the sheep henceforward, and everything that I shall command you that do ye.
verses.text_hr: I pozvao je sedamdeset pastira, i dao im te ovce da ih pasu, i rekao je pastirima i njihovim drugovima: “Neka svaki od vas od sada pase ovce, i činite sve što vam zapovjedim.

verses.text_en: And I will deliver them over unto you duly numbered, and tell you which of them are to be destroyed—and them destroy ye.” And He gave over unto them those sheep.
verses.text_hr: I predat ću vam ih propisno pobrojane, i reći ću vam koje od njih treba uništiti - i njih uništite vi." I predao im je te ovce.

verses.text_en: And He called another and spake unto him: “Observe and mark everything that the shepherds will do to those sheep; for they will destroy more of them than I have commanded them.
verses.text_hr: I pozvao je drugoga i rekao mu: “Promatraj i označi sve što će pastiri učiniti tim ovcama; jer će ih uništiti više nego što sam im naredio.

verses.text_en: And every excess and the destruction which will be wrought through the shepherds, record (namely) how many they destroy according to my command, and how many according to their own caprice: record against every individual shepherd all the destruction he effects.
verses.text_hr: Zapiši svaki prekomjerni pokolj i uništenje koje pastiri počine: koliko ih unište po mojoj zapovijedi, a koliko po vlastitoj samovolji. Za svakoga pojedinog pastira zapiši sav pokolj koji počini.

verses.text_en: And read out before me by number how many they destroy, and how many they deliver over for destruction, that I may have this as a testimony against them, and know every deed of the shepherds, that I may =comprehend= and see what they do, whether or not they abide by my command which I have commanded them.
verses.text_hr: I pročitaj preda mnom po broju koliko su ih uništili i koliko su ih predali na uništenje, kako bih imao ovo kao svjedočanstvo protiv njih, i znao svako djelo pastira, kako bih mogao =shvatiti= i vidjeti što čine, drže li se ili ne moje zapovijedi koju sam im zapovjedio.
