verses.text_en: But they shall not know it, and thou shalt not declare it to them, nor admonish them, but only record against each individual all the destruction which the shepherds effect each in his time, and lay it all before me.”
verses.text_hr: Ali oni to neće znati, i nećeš im to objaviti, niti ih opomenuti, nego samo zabilježi protiv svakog pojedinca svo uništenje koje pastiri izvrše svaki u svoje vrijeme, i sve to izloži preda mnom.”

verses.text_en: And I saw till those shepherds pastured in their season, and they began to slay and to destroy more than they were bidden, and they delivered those sheep into the hand of the lions.
verses.text_hr: I vidio sam dok ti pastiri nisu pasli u svoje vrijeme, i počeli su ubijati i uništavati više nego što im je bilo naređeno, i predali su te ovce u ruke lavovima.

verses.text_en: And the lions and tigers ate and devoured the greater part of those sheep, and the wild boars ate along with them; and they burnt that tower and demolished that house.
verses.text_hr: I lavovi i tigrovi su pojeli i proždirali veći dio tih ovaca, a divlje svinje jele su zajedno s njima; te su spalili tu kulu i srušili onu kuću.

verses.text_en: And I became exceedingly sorrowful over that tower because that house of the sheep was demolished, and afterwards I was unable to see if those sheep entered that house.
verses.text_hr: I postao sam jako tužan zbog te kule jer je ta kuća od ovaca bila srušena, a poslije nisam mogao vidjeti jesu li te ovce ušle u tu kuću.

verses.text_en: And the shepherds and their associates delivered over those sheep to all the wild beasts, to devour them, and each one of them received in his time a definite number: it was written by the other in a book how many each one of them destroyed of them.
verses.text_hr: Pastiri i njihovi drugovi predali su ovce svim divljim zvijerima da ih prožderu. Svaki je pastir u svoje vrijeme primio određen broj, a onaj drugi zapisivao je u knjigu koliko ih je svaki uništio.

verses.text_en: And each one slew and destroyed many more than was prescribed; and I began to weep and lament on account of those sheep.
verses.text_hr: I svaki je pobio i uništio mnogo više nego što je propisano; i počeo sam plakati i jadikovati zbog tih ovaca.

verses.text_en: And thus in the vision I saw that one who wrote how he wrote down every one that was destroyed by those shepherds, day by day, and carried up and laid down and showed actually the whole book to the Lord of the sheep—(even) everything that they had done, and all that each one of them had made away with, and all that they had given over to destruction.
verses.text_hr: I tako sam u viđenju vidio onoga koji je zapisao kako je zapisao sve što su ti pastiri uništili, dan po dan, i nosio gore i položio i zapravo pokazao cijelu knjigu Gospodaru ovaca—(čak) sve što su učinili, i sve što je svaki od njih uništio, i sve što su predali uništenju.

verses.text_en: And the book was read before the Lord of the sheep, and He took the book from his hand and read it and sealed it and laid it down.
verses.text_hr: I knjiga je pročitana pred Gospodarom ovaca, i On je uzeo knjigu iz njegove ruke i pročitao je, zapečatio je i položio.

verses.text_en: And forthwith I saw how the shepherds pastured for twelve hours, and behold three of those sheep turned back and came and entered and began to build up all that had fallen down of that house; but the wild boars tried to hinder them, but they were not able.
verses.text_hr: I odmah sam vidio kako su pastiri pasli dvanaest sati, i gle, tri od tih ovaca su se vratile i došle i ušle i počele graditi sve što je srušeno od te kuće; ali su ih divlje svinje pokušale spriječiti, ali nisu uspjele.

verses.text_en: And they began again to build as before, and they reared up that tower, and it was named the high tower; and they began again to place a table before the tower, but all the bread on it was polluted and not pure.
verses.text_hr: Ponovno su počeli graditi kao prije i podigli su kulu, koja je nazvana Visoka kula. Opet su počeli postavljati stol pred kulu, ali sav je kruh na njemu bio okaljan i nečist.

verses.text_en: And as touching all this the eyes of those sheep were blinded so that they saw not, and (the eyes of) their shepherds likewise; and they delivered them in large numbers to their shepherds for destruction, and they trampled the sheep with their feet and devoured them.
verses.text_hr: I dok su dodirivali sve ovo, oči tih ovaca su bile zaslijepljene tako da nisu vidjele, a (oči) njihovih pastira isto tako; te su ih u velikom broju predavali svojim pastirima na uništenje, a oni su gazili ovce nogama i jeli ih.

verses.text_en: And the Lord of the sheep remained unmoved till all the sheep were dispersed over the field and mingled with them (_i. e._ the beasts), and they (_i. e._ the shepherds) did not save them out of the hand of the beasts.
verses.text_hr: Gospodar ovaca ostao je nepomičan dok se sve ovce nisu raspršile poljem i pomiješale s njima (_tj._ zvijerima), a oni (_tj._ pastiri) nisu ih izbavili iz ruku zvijeri.

verses.text_en: And this one who wrote the book carried it up, and showed it and read it before the Lord of the sheep, and implored Him on their account, and besought Him on their account as he showed Him all the doings of the shepherds, and gave testimony before Him against all the shepherds.
verses.text_hr: I ovaj koji je napisao knjigu iznio ju je, i pokazao je i pročitao pred Gospodarom ovaca, i molio Ga za njih, i molio Ga za njih dok Mu je pokazivao sva djela pastira, i svjedočio pred Njim protiv svih pastira.

verses.text_en: And he took the actual book and laid it down beside Him and departed.
verses.text_hr: I on je uzeo pravu knjigu, položio je pored sebe i otišao.

verses.text_en: And I saw till that in this manner =thirty-five= shepherds undertook the pasturing (of the sheep), and they severally completed their periods as did the first; and others received them into their hands to pasture them for their period, each shepherd in his own period.
verses.text_hr: Gledao sam sve dok na taj način =trideset i pet= pastira nije preuzelo napasanje ovaca. Svaki je dovršio svoje razdoblje kao i prvi, a zatim su ih drugi primali u svoje ruke da ih pasu u svojem vremenu, svaki pastir u svojem razdoblju.

verses.text_en: And after that I saw in my vision all the birds of heaven coming, the eagles, the vultures, the kites, the ravens; but the eagles led all the birds; and they began to devour those sheep, and to pick out their eyes and to devour their flesh.
verses.text_hr: I nakon toga sam u svojoj viđenju vidio sve ptice nebeske kako dolaze, orlove, lešinare, zmajeve, gavrane; ali orlovi su vodili sve ptice; i počeli su proždirati te ovce, vaditi im oči i jesti im meso.

verses.text_en: And the sheep cried out because their flesh was being devoured by the birds, and as for me I looked and lamented in my sleep over that shepherd who pastured the sheep.
verses.text_hr: I ovce su vikale jer su ptice proždirale njihovo meso, a ja sam gledao i jadikovao u snu za tim pastirom koji je pasao ovce.

verses.text_en: And I saw until those sheep were devoured by the dogs and eagles and kites, and they left neither flesh nor skin nor sinew remaining on them till only their bones stood there: and their bones too fell to the earth and the sheep became few.
verses.text_hr: I gledao sam sve dok te ovce nisu proždirali psi, orlovi i zmajevi, i nisu ostavili ni mesa ni kože ni tetiva na njima sve dok samo njihove kosti nisu stajale tamo: i njihove su kosti također pale na zemlju i ovaca je postalo malo.

verses.text_en: And I saw until that twenty-three had undertaken the pasturing and completed in their several periods fifty-eight times.
verses.text_hr: Vidio sam da su do tada dvadeset i trojica preuzela napasanje te u svojim različitim razdobljima dovršila pedeset i osam razdoblja.

verses.text_en: But behold lambs were borne by those white sheep, and they began to open their eyes and to see, and to cry to the sheep.
verses.text_hr: Ali gle, te bijele ovce rodile su janjad, i počele su otvarati oči i vidjeti, i vikati ovcama.

verses.text_en: Yea, they cried to them, but they did not hearken to what they said to them, but were exceedingly deaf, and their eyes were very exceedingly blinded.
verses.text_hr: Da, vikala su im, ali ovce nisu slušale što im govore; bile su veoma gluhe, a oči su im bile posve slijepe.

verses.text_en: And I saw in the vision how the ravens flew upon those lambs, and took one of those lambs, and dashed the sheep in pieces and devoured them.
verses.text_hr: U viđenju sam gledao kako gavrani slijeću na janjad, grabe jedno janje, komadaju ovce i proždiru ih.

verses.text_en: And I saw till horns grew upon those lambs, and the ravens cast down their horns; and I saw till there sprouted a great horn of one of those sheep, and their eyes were opened.
verses.text_hr: I vidio sam dok rogovi nisu izrasli tim jaganjcima, a gavrani su spustili svoje rogove; i vidio sam dok nije izrastao veliki rog jedne od tih ovaca, i otvorile su im se oči.

verses.text_en: And it †looked at† them [and their eyes opened], and it cried to the sheep, and the rams saw it and all ran to it.
verses.text_hr: I ono ih je †pogledalo† [i otvorile su im se oči], i zavapilo je ovcama, a ovnovi su to vidjeli i svi su potrčali k njemu.

verses.text_en: And notwithstanding all this those eagles and vultures and ravens and kites still kept tearing the sheep and swooping down upon them and devouring them: still the sheep remained silent, but the rams lamented and cried out.
verses.text_hr: I bez obzira na sve to oni orlovi i lešinari i gavrani i zmajevi i dalje su trgali ovce i obrušavali se na njih i proždirali ih: ovce su i dalje šutjele, ali ovnovi su jadikovali i vikali.

verses.text_en: And those ravens fought and battled with it and sought to lay low its horn, but they had no power over it.
verses.text_hr: I ti su se gavrani borili i borili s njim i nastojali su mu spustiti rog, ali nisu imali moći nad njim.

verses.text_en: And I saw till the †shepherds and† eagles and those vultures and kites came, and †they cried to the ravens† that they should break the horn of that ram, and they battled and fought with it, and it battled with them and cried that its help might come.
verses.text_hr: I vidio sam dok nisu došli †pastiri i† orlovi i oni lešinari i zmajevi, i †vikali su gavranima† da slome rog tom ovnu, i borili su se i borili se s njim, a on se borio s njima i vikao da dođe njegova pomoć.

verses.text_en: And I saw till that man, who wrote down the names of the shepherds [and] carried up into the presence of the Lord of the sheep [came and helped it and showed it everything: he had come down for the help of that ram].
verses.text_hr: Gledao sam sve dok onaj čovjek koji je zapisivao imena pastira [i nosio ih pred Gospodara ovaca nije došao i pomogao ovnu te mu sve pokazao: sišao je u pomoć onomu ovnu].

verses.text_en: And I saw till the Lord of the sheep came unto them in wrath, and all who saw Him fled, and they all fell †into His shadow† from before His face.
verses.text_hr: I vidio sam dok Gospodar ovaca nije došao k njima u gnjevu, i svi koji su Ga vidjeli su pobjegli, i svi su pali †u Njegovu sjenu† ispred Njegovog lica.

verses.text_en: All the eagles and vultures and ravens and kites were gathered together, and there came with them all the sheep of the field, yea, they all came together, and helped each other to break that horn of the ram.
verses.text_hr: Svi orlovi, lešinari, gavrani i zmajevi okupiše se, a s njima dođoše i sve poljske ovce. Svi su se udružili i pomagali jedni drugima da slome ovnov rog.

verses.text_en: And I saw that man, who wrote the book according to the command of the Lord, till he opened that book concerning the destruction which those twelve last shepherds had wrought, and showed that they had destroyed much more than their predecessors, before the Lord of the sheep.
verses.text_hr: I vidio sam tog čovjeka, koji je napisao knjigu prema zapovijedi Gospodnjoj, sve dok nije otvorio tu knjigu o uništenju koje su počinili onih dvanaest posljednjih pastira, i pokazao da su uništili mnogo više od svojih prethodnika, pred Gospodarom ovaca.

verses.text_en: And I saw till the Lord of the sheep came unto them and took in His hand the staff of his wrath, and smote the earth, and the earth clave asunder, and all the beasts and all the birds of the heaven fell from among those sheep, and were swallowed up in the earth and it covered them.
verses.text_hr: Gledao sam dok Gospodar ovaca nije došao k njima, uzeo u ruku štap svojega gnjeva i udario zemlju. Zemlja se raspuknula, sve zvijeri i sve ptice nebeske padoše među ovce, a zemlja ih proguta i prekri.

verses.text_en: And I saw till a great sword was given to the sheep, and the sheep proceeded against all the beasts of the field to slay them, and all the beasts and the birds of the heaven fled before their face.
verses.text_hr: I vidjeh dok veliki mač nije dan ovcama, i ovce krenuše protiv svih zvijeri u polju da ih pobiju, i sve zvijeri i ptice nebeske pobjegoše pred njihovim licem.

verses.text_en: And I saw till a throne was erected in the pleasant land, and the Lord of the sheep sat Himself thereon, and =the other= took the sealed books and opened those books before the Lord of the sheep.
verses.text_hr: I vidio sam dok prijestolje nije bilo podignuto u ugodnoj zemlji, i Gospodar ovaca je sam sjedio na njemu, a =drugi= je uzeo zapečaćene knjige i otvorio te knjige pred Gospodarom ovaca.

verses.text_en: And the Lord called those men the seven first white ones, and commanded that they should bring before Him, beginning with the first star which led the way, =all the= stars whose privy members were like those of horses, and they brought them all before Him.
verses.text_hr: Gospodin pozva sedmoricu prvih bijelih i zapovjedi im da pred Njega dovedu sve zvijezde, počevši od prve zvijezde koja je predvodila ostale — =sve= zvijezde čiji su spolni udovi bili poput konjskih. Oni ih sve dovedoše pred Njega.

verses.text_en: And He said to that man who wrote before Him, being one of those seven white ones, and said unto him: “Take those seventy shepherds to whom I delivered the sheep, and who taking them on their own authority slew more than I commanded them.”
verses.text_hr: I rekao je onom čovjeku koji je pisao pred Njim, budući da je bio jedan od onih sedam bijelih, i rekao mu: "Uzmi onih sedamdeset pastira kojima sam predao ovce, i koji su ih uzevši sami po sebi zaklali više nego što sam im naredio."

verses.text_en: And behold, they were all bound, I saw, and they all stood before Him.
verses.text_hr: I gle, svi su bili vezani, vidio sam, i svi su stajali pred Njim.

verses.text_en: And the judgement was held first over the stars, and they were judged and found guilty, and went to the place of condemnation, and they were cast into an abyss, full of fire and flaming, and full of pillars of fire.
verses.text_hr: I prvo je izvršen sud nad zvijezdama, i njima je suđeno i proglašeni krivima, i otišli su na mjesto osude, i bili su bačeni u ponor, pun vatre i plamena, i pun vatrenih stupova.

verses.text_en: And those seventy shepherds were judged and found guilty, and they were cast into that fiery abyss.
verses.text_hr: I tih sedamdeset pastira je osuđeno i proglašeno je krivim, te su bačeni u taj vatreni ponor.

verses.text_en: And I saw at that time how a like abyss was opened in the midst of the earth, full of fire, and they brought those blinded sheep, and they were all judged and found guilty and cast into this fiery abyss, and they burned; now this abyss was to the right of that house.
verses.text_hr: I vidio sam u to vrijeme kako se kao ponor otvorio usred zemlje, pun vatre, i doveli su te zaslijepljene ovce, i svi su bili osuđeni i proglašeni krivima i bačeni u ovaj vatreni ponor, i spaljene su; sada je ovaj ponor bio desno od te kuće.

verses.text_en: And I saw those sheep burning †and their bones burning†.
verses.text_hr: I vidio sam te ovce kako gore †i njihove kosti gore†.

verses.text_en: And I stood up to see till they folded up that old house; and carried off all the pillars, and all the beams and ornaments of the house were at the same time folded up with it, and they carried it off and laid it in a place in the south of the land.
verses.text_hr: Ustao sam gledati kako sklapaju staru kuću. Uklonili su sve njezine stupove, a sve grede i ukrase kuće istodobno su složili zajedno s njom; odnijeli su je i položili na mjesto na jugu zemlje.

verses.text_en: And I saw till the Lord of the sheep brought a new house greater and loftier than that first, and set it up in the place of the first which had been folded up: all its pillars were new, and its ornaments were new and larger than those of the first, the old one which He had taken away, and all the sheep were within it.
verses.text_hr: I vidio sam dok Gospodar ovaca nije donio novu kuću veću i uzvišeniju od one prve, i postavio je na mjesto prve koja je bila sklopljena: svi njezini stupovi bili su novi, a njezini su ukrasi bili novi i veći od onih u prvoj, staroj koju je On uzeo, i sve su ovce bile u njoj.

verses.text_en: And I saw all the sheep which had been left, and all the beasts on the earth, and all the birds of the heaven, falling down and doing homage to those sheep and making petition to and obeying them in every =thing=.
verses.text_hr: I vidjeh sve ovce koje bijahu ostale, i sve zvijeri na zemlji, i sve ptice nebeske, kako padaju i iskazuju počast tim ovcama i mole ih i slušaju ih u svakoj stvari.

verses.text_en: And thereafter those three who were clothed in white and had seized me by my hand [who had taken me up before], and the hand of that ram also seizing hold of me, they took me up and set me down in the midst of those sheep †before the judgement took place†.
verses.text_hr: I nakon toga ona trojica koja su bila odjevena u bijelo i koja su me uhvatila za ruku [koji su me prije toga uzeli], i ruka onog ovna koja me je također uhvatila, podigli su me i spustili usred tih ovaca †prije nego što se osuda dogodila†.

verses.text_en: And those sheep were all white, and their wool was abundant and clean.
verses.text_hr: Te su ovce bile sve bijele, a vuna im je bila obilna i čista.

verses.text_en: And all that had been destroyed and dispersed, and all the beasts of the field, and all the birds of the heaven, assembled in that house, and the Lord of the sheep rejoiced with great joy because they were all good and had returned to His house.
verses.text_hr: I sve što je bilo uništeno i raspršeno, i sve poljske zvijeri, i sve ptice nebeske, okupile su se u toj kući, a Gospodar ovaca radovao se velikom radošću jer su svi bili dobri i vratili su se u njegovu kuću.

verses.text_en: And I saw till they laid down that sword, which had been given to the sheep, and they brought it back into the house, and it was sealed before the presence of the Lord, and all the sheep were invited into that house, but it held them not.
verses.text_hr: Vidio sam kako odlažu mač koji je bio dan ovcama, vraćaju ga u kuću i pečate pred Gospodinovom prisutnošću. Sve su ovce bile pozvane u kuću, ali ih ona nije mogla primiti.

verses.text_en: And the eyes of them all were opened, and they saw the good, and there was not one among them that did not see.
verses.text_hr: I otvoriše im se oči svima, i vidješe dobro, i nije bilo nijednog među njima koji nije vidio.

verses.text_en: And I saw that that house was large and broad and very full.
verses.text_hr: I vidio sam da je ta kuća velika i široka i vrlo puna.

verses.text_en: And I saw that a white bull was born, with large horns, and all the beasts of the field and all the birds of the air feared him and made petition to him all the time.
verses.text_hr: I vidjeh da se rodio bijeli bik, s velikim rogovima, i sve su ga se zvijeri poljske i sve ptice nebeske bojale i molile ga sve vrijeme.

verses.text_en: And I saw till all their generations were transformed, and they all became white bulls; and the first among them became a =lamb=, and that =lamb= became a great animal and had great black horns on its head; and the Lord of the sheep rejoiced over =it= and over all the oxen.
verses.text_hr: I vidio sam dok se sve njihove generacije nisu preobrazile, i svi su postali bijeli bikovi; i prvi među njima postade =janje=, a to =janje= postade velika životinja i ima velike crne rogove na glavi; i Gospodar ovaca radovao se =tome= i svim volovima.

verses.text_en: And I slept in their midst: and I awoke and saw everything.
verses.text_hr: I zaspah usred njih: probudih se i vidjeh sve.

verses.text_en: This is the vision which I saw while I slept, and I awoke and blessed the Lord of righteousness and gave Him glory.
verses.text_hr: To je viđenje koje sam vidio dok sam spavao. Kad se probudih, blagoslovih Gospodina Pravednosti i dadoh Mu slavu.

verses.text_en: Then I wept with a great weeping, and my tears stayed not till I could no longer endure it: when I saw, they flowed on account of what I had seen; for everything shall come and be fulfilled; and all the deeds of men in their order were shown to me.
verses.text_hr: Tada sam zaplakao velikim plačem, a moje suze nisu stale sve dok više nisam mogao izdržati: kad sam vidio, tekle su zbog onoga što sam vidio; jer sve će doći i ispuniti se; i pokazana su mi sva djela ljudi u njihovom redu.

verses.text_en: On that night I remembered the first dream, and because of it I wept and was troubled—because I had seen that vision.’
verses.text_hr: Te sam se noći sjetio prvoga sna. Plakao sam i bio uznemiren jer sam vidio to viđenje.’

verses.text_en:
‘And now, my son Methuselah, call to me all thy brothers,
And gather together to me all the sons of thy mother,
For the word calls me,
And the spirit is poured out upon me,
That I may show you everything
That shall befall you for ever.’
verses.text_hr: ‘A sada, sine moj Metušalaše, pozovi k meni svu svoju braću i okupi oko mene sve sinove svoje majke. Riječ me zove i duh je izliven na mene da vam pokažem sve što će vas snaći dovijeka.’

verses.text_en: And thereupon Methuselah went and summoned to him all his brothers and assembled his relatives.
verses.text_hr: I tada je Metušalah otišao i pozvao k sebi svu svoju braću i okupio svoju rodbinu.

verses.text_en:
And he spake unto all the children of righteousness and said:

‘Hear, ye sons of Enoch, all the words of your father,
And hearken aright to the voice of my mouth;
For I exhort you and say unto you, beloved:
Love uprightness and walk therein.
verses.text_hr: Obrati se svim sinovima pravednosti i reče: ‘Čujte, sinovi Henokovi, sve riječi svojega oca i pomno poslušajte glas mojih usta. Potičem vas i govorim vam, ljubljeni: ljubite čestitost i hodajte u njoj.

verses.text_en:
And draw not nigh to uprightness with a double heart,
And associate not with those of a double heart,
But walk in righteousness, my sons.
And it shall guide you on good paths,
And righteousness shall be your companion.
verses.text_hr: Ne približavajte se čestitosti dvolična srca i ne družite se s dvoličnima, nego hodajte u pravednosti, sinovi moji. Ona će vas voditi dobrim stazama i pravednost će vam biti suputnica.

verses.text_en:
For I know that violence =must= increase on the earth,
And a great chastisement be executed on the earth,
And all unrighteousness come to an end:
Yea, it shall be cut off from its roots,
And its whole structure be destroyed.
verses.text_hr: Znam da se nasilje =mora= umnožiti na zemlji, da će se na zemlji izvršiti velika kazna i da će svakoj nepravdi doći kraj. Da, bit će iščupana iz korijena i cijela će joj građevina biti uništena.

verses.text_en:
And unrighteousness shall again be consummated on the earth,
And all the deeds of unrighteousness and of violence
And transgression shall prevail in a twofold degree.
verses.text_hr: I nepravda će opet biti dovršena na zemlji, i sva djela nepravednosti i nasilja A prijestup će prevladati u dvostrukom stupnju.

verses.text_en:
And when sin and unrighteousness and blasphemy
And violence in all kinds of deeds increase,
And apostasy and transgression and uncleanness increase,
A great chastisement shall come from heaven upon all these,
And the holy Lord will come forth with wrath and chastisement
To execute judgement on earth.
verses.text_hr: Kad se umnože grijeh, nepravda, bogohuljenje i nasilje u svakovrsnim djelima, kad porastu otpadništvo, prijestup i nečistoća, velika će kazna doći s neba na sve to. Sveti će Gospodin izići u gnjevu i s kaznom da izvrši sud na zemlji.

verses.text_en:
In those days violence shall be cut off from its roots,
And the roots of unrighteousness together with deceit,
And they shall be destroyed from under heaven.
verses.text_hr: U tim danima nasilje će biti odsječeno iz korijena, i korijeni nepravde zajedno s prijevarom, i oni će biti uništeni ispod neba.

verses.text_en:
And all the idols of the heathen shall be abandoned,
And the temples burned with fire,
And they shall remove them from the whole earth,
And they (_i. e._ the heathen) shall be cast into the judgement of fire,
And shall perish in wrath and in grievous judgement for ever.
verses.text_hr: Svi će idoli pogana biti napušteni, hramovi spaljeni ognjem i uklonjeni sa sve zemlje. Oni (_tj._ pogani) bit će bačeni na sud ognja i zauvijek propasti u gnjevu i teškom sudu.

verses.text_en:
And the righteous shall arise from their sleep,
And wisdom shall arise and be given unto them.
verses.text_hr: I pravednici će ustati iz sna svoga, i mudrost će ustati i bit će im dana.

verses.text_en: [And after that the roots of unrighteousness shall be cut off, and the sinners shall be destroyed by the sword ... shall be cut off from the blasphemers in every place, and those who plan violence and those who commit blasphemy shall perish by the sword.]
verses.text_hr: [I nakon toga će korijenje nepravednosti biti sasječeno, a grešnici će biti uništeni mačem ... bit će istrijebljeni od bogohulnika posvuda, a oni koji planiraju nasilje i oni koji čine bogohuljenje izginut će od mača.]

verses.text_en:
And after that there shall be another, the eighth week, that of righteousness,
And a sword shall be given to it that a righteous judgement may be executed on the oppressors,
And sinners shall be delivered into the hands of the righteous.
verses.text_hr: Nakon toga doći će drugi, osmi tjedan — tjedan pravednosti. Njemu će se dati mač da se izvrši pravedan sud nad tlačiteljima, a grešnici će biti predani u ruke pravednika.

verses.text_en:
And at its close they shall acquire houses through their righteousness,
And a house shall be built for the Great King in glory for evermore,
verses.text_hr: I na kraju će steći kuće svojom pravednošću, i sagradit će se kuća za Velikog Kralja u slavi zauvijek,

verses.text_en:
[14d] And all mankind shall look to the path of uprightness.

[14a] And after that, in the ninth week, the righteous judgement shall be revealed to the whole world,

[14b] And all the works of the godless shall vanish from all the earth,

[14c] And the world shall be written down for destruction.
verses.text_hr: [14d] I cijelo će čovječanstvo gledati na put čestitosti. [14a] A nakon toga, u devetom tjednu, pravedni će se sud objaviti cijelom svijetu, [14b] I sva će djela bezbožnika nestati sa cijele zemlje, [14c] I svijet će biti zapisan za uništenje.

verses.text_en:
And after this, in the tenth week in the seventh part,
There shall be the great eternal judgement,
In which He will execute vengeance amongst the angels.
verses.text_hr: I nakon toga, u desetom tjednu u sedmom dijelu, Bit će veliki vječni sud, U kojem će On izvršiti osvetu među anđelima.

verses.text_en:
And the first heaven shall depart and pass away,
And a new heaven shall appear,
And all the powers of the heavens shall give sevenfold light.
verses.text_hr: I prvo će nebo otići i proći, i pojavit će se novo nebo, i sve će sile nebeske dati sedmerostruku svjetlost.

verses.text_en:
And after that there will be many weeks without number for ever,
And all shall be in goodness and righteousness,
And sin shall no more be mentioned for ever.
verses.text_hr: I nakon toga će biti mnogo tjedana bez broja zauvijek, i sve će biti u dobru i pravednosti, i grijeh se više neće spominjati zauvijek.

verses.text_en:
And now I tell you, my sons, and show you
The paths of righteousness, and the paths of violence.
Yea, I will show them to you again,
That ye may know what will come to pass.
verses.text_hr: A sada vam, sinovi moji, govorim i pokazujem staze pravednosti i staze nasilja. Da, ponovno ću vam ih pokazati da biste znali što će se dogoditi.

verses.text_en:
And now, hearken unto me, my sons,
And walk in the paths of righteousness,
And walk not in the paths of violence;
For all who walk in the paths of unrighteousness shall perish for =ever=.’
verses.text_hr: A sada me poslušajte, sinovi moji: hodajte stazama pravednosti i ne hodajte stazama nasilja, jer svi koji hodaju stazama nepravde nestat će =zauvijek=.’

verses.text_en: The book written by Enoch—[Enoch indeed wrote this complete doctrine of wisdom, (which is) praised of all men and a judge of all the earth] for all my children who shall dwell on the earth; and for the future generations who shall observe uprightness and peace.
verses.text_hr: Knjiga koju je napisao Henok — [Henok je doista napisao ovu potpunu pouku mudrosti, koju hvale svi ljudi i koja sudi svoj zemlji] — za svu moju djecu koja će živjeti na zemlji i za buduće naraštaje koji će čuvati čestitost i mir.

verses.text_en:
Let not your spirit be troubled on account of the times;
For the Holy and Great One has appointed days for all things.
verses.text_hr: Neka se vaš duh ne uznemiruje zbog vremena; Jer Sveti i Veliki je za sve odredio dane.

verses.text_en:
And the righteous one shall arise from sleep,
[Shall arise] and walk in the paths of righteousness,
And all his path and conversation shall be in eternal goodness and grace.
verses.text_hr: Pravednik će ustati iz sna, [ustat će] i hodati stazama pravednosti, a sav njegov put i življenje bit će u vječnoj dobroti i milosti.

verses.text_en:
He will be gracious to the righteous and give him eternal uprightness,
And He will give him power so that he shall be (endowed) with goodness and righteousness,
And he shall walk in eternal light.
verses.text_hr: On će biti milostiv prema pravedniku i dat će mu vječnu čestitost, i On će mu dati moć da bude (obdaren) dobrotom i pravednošću, i hodit će u vječnom svjetlu.

verses.text_en:
And sin shall perish in darkness for ever,
And shall no more be seen from that day forevermore.
verses.text_hr: I grijeh će nestati u tami zauvijek, i neće se više vidjeti od toga dana zauvijek.

verses.text_en: And after that Enoch both †gave† and began to recount from the books.
verses.text_hr: I nakon toga Henok je i †dao† i počeo prepričavati iz knjiga.

verses.text_en:
And Enoch said:

‘Concerning the children of righteousness and concerning the elect of the world,
And concerning the plant of uprightness, I will speak these things,
Yea, I Enoch, will declare (them) unto you, my sons:
According to that which appeared to me in the heavenly vision,
And which I have known through the word of the holy angels,
And have learnt from the heavenly tablets.’
verses.text_hr: Henok reče: ‘O djeci pravednosti, o izabranima svijeta i o biljci čestitosti govorit ću ove stvari. Da, ja Henok objavit ću ih vama, sinovi moji, prema onome što mi se pokazalo u nebeskom viđenju, što sam spoznao po riječi svetih anđela i naučio s nebeskih ploča.’

verses.text_en:
And Enoch began to recount from the books and said:
‘I was born the seventh in the first week,
While judgement and righteousness still endured.
verses.text_hr: I Henok je počeo prepričavati iz knjiga i rekao: 'Rođen sam sedmi u prvom tjednu, Dok su još trajali sud i pravednost.

Poslije mene u drugom će tjednu nastati velika zloća i izniknut će prijevara. U njemu će doći prvi svršetak i u njemu će se spasiti čovjek. Kad on završi, nepravda će rasti i za grešnike će biti donesen zakon.

verses.text_en:
And after that in the third week at its close
A man shall be elected as the plant of righteous judgement.
And =his posterity= shall become the plant of righteousness for evermore.
verses.text_hr: I nakon toga u trećem tjednu na kraju Čovjek će biti izabran kao biljka pravednog suda. I =njegovo potomstvo= postat će biljka pravednosti zauvijek.

verses.text_en:
And after that in the fourth week, at its close,
Visions of the holy and righteous shall be seen,
And a law for all generations and an enclosure shall be made for them.
verses.text_hr: Nakon toga, na kraju četvrtoga tjedna, vidjet će se viđenja svetih i pravednih, a za sve naraštaje bit će načinjen zakon i ograda.

verses.text_en:
And after that in the fifth week, at its close,
The house of glory and dominion shall be built for ever.
verses.text_hr: I nakon toga u petom tjednu, na njegovom kraju, Kuća slave i vlasti bit će izgrađena zauvijek.

verses.text_en:
And after that in the sixth week all who live in it shall be blinded,
And the hearts of all of them shall godlessly forsake wisdom.
And in it a man shall ascend;
And at its close the house of dominion shall be burnt with fire,
And the whole race of the chosen root shall be dispersed.
verses.text_hr: Nakon toga, u šestom tjednu, svi koji u njemu žive oslijepjet će, a srca će svih njih bezbožno napustiti mudrost. U njemu će jedan čovjek uzaći; na njegovu će kraju kuća vlasti biti spaljena ognjem, a sav rod izabranoga korijena raspršit će se.

verses.text_en:
And after that in the seventh week shall an apostate generation arise,
And many shall be its deeds,
And all its deeds shall be apostate.
verses.text_hr: A nakon toga u sedmom tjednu pojavit će se otpadnički naraštaj, i mnoga će biti njegova djela, i sva njegova djela bit će otpadnička.

verses.text_en:
And at its close shall be elected
The elect righteous of the eternal plant of righteousness,
To receive sevenfold instruction concerning all His creation.
verses.text_hr: Na njegovu će kraju biti izabrani izabrani pravednici vječne biljke pravednosti, da prime sedmerostruku pouku o svemu Njegovu stvorenju.

verses.text_en: [For who is there of all the children of men that is able to hear the voice of the Holy One without being troubled? And who can think His thoughts? and who is there that can behold all the works of heaven?
verses.text_hr: [Jer tko je od sve djece ljudske da može čuti glas Svetoga, a da se ne uznemiri? A tko može misliti Njegove misli? i tko je tamo da može vidjeti sva djela neba?

verses.text_en: And how should there be one who could behold the heaven, and who is there that could understand the things of heaven and see a soul or a spirit and could tell thereof, or ascend and see all their ends and think them or do like them?
verses.text_hr: I kako bi mogao postojati netko tko bi mogao promatrati nebo, i tko je tamo tko bi mogao razumjeti stvari na nebu i vidjeti dušu ili duh i mogao o tome reći, ili se uzdići i vidjeti sve njihove krajeve i razmišljati o njima ili činiti poput njih?

verses.text_en: And who is there of all men that could know what is the breadth and the length of the earth, and to whom has been shown the measure of all of them?
verses.text_hr: A tko bi od svih ljudi znao što je širina i duljina zemlje, i kome je pokazana mjera svih njih?

verses.text_en: Or is there any one who could discern the length of the heaven and how great is its height, and upon what it is founded, and how great is the number of the stars, and where all the luminaries rest?]
verses.text_hr: Ili postoji itko tko bi mogao raspoznati duljinu neba i kolika mu je visina, i na čemu je utemeljeno, i koliki je broj zvijezda, i gdje počivaju sve svjetiljke?]
A sada vam kažem, sinovi moji, ljubite pravednost i hodite po njoj; Jer su staze pravednosti dostojne prihvaćanja, Ali staze nepravednosti iznenada će biti uništene i nestati.

verses.text_en:
And to certain men of a generation shall the paths of violence and of death be revealed,
And they shall hold themselves afar from them,
And shall not follow them.
verses.text_hr: I određenim ljudima jedne generacije otkrit će se staze nasilja i smrti, i držat će se daleko od njih, i neće ih slijediti.

verses.text_en:
And now I say unto you the righteous:
Walk not in the paths of wickedness, nor on the paths of death,
And draw not nigh to them, lest ye be destroyed.
verses.text_hr: A sada govorim vama, pravednici: ne hodajte stazama zloće ni stazama smrti i ne približavajte im se, da ne budete uništeni.

verses.text_en:
But seek and choose for yourselves righteousness and an elect life,
And walk in the paths of peace,
And ye shall live and prosper.
verses.text_hr: Tražite i izaberite sebi pravednost i izabrani život; hodajte stazama mira pa ćete živjeti i napredovati.

verses.text_en:
And hold fast my words in the thoughts of your hearts,
And suffer them not to be effaced from your hearts;
For know that sinners will tempt men to =evilly-entreat= wisdom,
So that no place may be found for her,
And no manner of temptation may minish.
verses.text_hr: Čvrsto držite moje riječi u mislima svojega srca i ne dopustite da se iz njega izbrišu. Znajte da će grešnici navoditi ljude da se =opako ophode= prema mudrosti, tako da joj se ne nađe mjesta i da je nikakva kušnja ne umanji.

verses.text_en:
Woe to those who build unrighteousness and oppression,
And lay deceit as a foundation;
For they shall be suddenly overthrown,
And they shall have no peace.
verses.text_hr: Teško onima koji grade nepravdu i tlačenje te prijevaru polažu za temelj, jer će iznenada biti oboreni i neće imati mira.

verses.text_en:
Woe to those who build their houses with sin;
For from all their foundations shall they be overthrown,
And by the sword shall they fall.
[And those who acquire gold and silver in judgement suddenly shall perish.]
verses.text_hr: Teško onima koji svoje kuće grijehom grade; Jer iz svih će temelja biti srušeni, i od mača će pasti. [A oni koji steknu zlato i srebro na sudu iznenada će propasti.]

verses.text_en:
Woe to you, ye rich, for ye have trusted in your riches,
And from your riches shall ye depart,
Because ye have not remembered the Most High in the days of your riches.
verses.text_hr: Teško vama, bogataši, jer ste se pouzdali u svoje bogatstvo. Od svojega ćete bogatstva otići jer se niste spomenuli Svevišnjega u dane svojega obilja.

verses.text_en:
Ye have committed blasphemy and unrighteousness,
And have become ready for the day of slaughter,
And the day of darkness and the day of the great judgement.
verses.text_hr: Počinili ste bogohuljenje i nepravdu, i bili spremni za dan klanja, i dan tame i dan velikoga suda.

verses.text_en:
Thus I speak and declare unto you:
He who hath created you will overthrow you,
And for your fall there shall be no compassion,
And your Creator will rejoice at your destruction.
verses.text_hr: Ovako vam govorim i izjavljujem: Onaj koji vas je stvorio oborit će vas; pri vašem padu neće biti samilosti i vaš će se Stvoritelj radovati vašoj propasti.

verses.text_en:
And your righteous ones in those days shall be
A reproach to the sinners and the godless.
verses.text_hr: Vaši će pravednici u one dane biti prijekor grešnicima i bezbožnicima.

verses.text_en:
Oh that mine eyes were [a cloud of] waters
That I might weep over you,
And pour down my tears as a cloud †of† waters:
That so I might rest from my trouble of heart!
verses.text_hr: O, kad bi moje oči bile [oblak] vode, da mogu plakati nad vama i izliti suze poput oblaka †punog† vode, pa da mi se srce odmori od muke!

verses.text_en:
†Who has permitted you to practise reproaches and wickedness?
And so judgement shall overtake you, sinners.†
verses.text_hr: †Tko vam je dopustio činiti prijekore i zloću? Zato će vas, grešnici, stići sud.†
Ne bojte se grešnika, vi pravednici; Jer opet će ih Gospodin predati u vaše ruke, Da biste nad njima mogli izvršiti presudu prema svojim željama.

verses.text_en:
Woe to you who fulminate anathemas which cannot be reversed:
Healing shall therefore be far from you because of your sins.
verses.text_hr: Jao vama koji bacate anateme koje se ne mogu poništiti: Liječenje će stoga biti daleko od vas zbog vaših grijeha.

verses.text_en:
Woe to you who requite your neighbour with evil;
For ye shall be requited according to your works.
verses.text_hr: Teško vama koji bližnjemu uzvraćate zlom; Jer ćete biti plaćeni po svojim djelima.

verses.text_en:
Woe to you, lying witnesses,
And to those who weigh out injustice,
For suddenly shall ye perish.
verses.text_hr: Teško vama, lažljivi svjedoci, i onima koji vagaju nepravdu, Jer iznenada ćete nestati.
Teško vama, grešnici, što progonite pravednike; Jer ćete biti predani i progonjeni zbog nepravde, i težak će jaram njegov biti na vama.

verses.text_en:
Be hopeful, ye righteous; for suddenly shall the sinners perish before you,
And ye shall have lordship over them according to your desires.
verses.text_hr: Nadajte se, pravednici, jer će grešnici iznenada nestati pred vama, a vi ćete nad njima vladati prema svojim željama.

verses.text_en:
[And in the day of the tribulation of the sinners,
Your children shall mount and rise as eagles,
And higher than the vultures will be your nest,
And ye shall ascend and enter the crevices of the earth,
And the clefts of the rock for ever as coneys before the unrighteous,
And the sirens shall sigh because of you and weep.]
verses.text_hr: [U dan nevolje grešnika vaša će se djeca uzdići i poletjeti poput orlova; vaše će gnijezdo biti više od gnijezda lešinara. Zauvijek ćete se uspeti i ući u pukotine zemlje i raspukline stijena, poput divljih kunića pred nepravednicima, a sirene će zbog vas uzdisati i plakati.]

verses.text_en:
Wherefore fear not, ye that have suffered;
For healing shall be your portion,
And a bright light shall enlighten you,
And the voice of rest ye shall hear from heaven.
verses.text_hr: Zato se ne bojte, vi koji ste patili, jer ozdravljenje će biti vaš dio, sjajna će vas svjetlost obasjati i s neba ćete čuti glas počinka.

verses.text_en:
Woe unto you, ye sinners, for your riches make you appear like the righteous,
But your hearts convict you of being sinners,
And this fact shall be a testimony against you for a memorial of (your) evil deeds.
verses.text_hr: Teško vama, vi grešnici, jer vaše bogatstvo čini da izgledate kao pravednici, Ali vaša srca vas osuđuju da ste grešnici, i ova činjenica će biti svjedočanstvo protiv vas za spomen (vaših) loših djela.

verses.text_en:
Woe to you who devour the finest of the wheat,
And drink =wine in large bowls=,
And tread under foot the lowly with your might.
verses.text_hr: Teško vama koji proždirete najfiniju pšenicu, pijete =vino iz velikih zdjela= i svojom snagom gazite ponizne.

verses.text_en:
Woe to you who drink water =from every fountain=,
For suddenly shall ye be consumed and wither away,
Because ye have forsaken the fountain of life.
verses.text_hr: Teško vama koji pijete vodu =iz svakoga izvora=, jer ćete iznenada biti uništeni i uvenuti, zato što ste napustili izvor života.

verses.text_en:
Woe to you who work unrighteousness,
And deceit and blasphemy:
It shall be a memorial against you for evil.
verses.text_hr: Teško vama koji činite nepravdu, prijevaru i bogohuljenje: to će ostati spomen protiv vas za zlo.

verses.text_en:
Woe to you, ye mighty,
Who with might oppress the righteous;
For the day of your destruction is coming.
In those days many and good days shall come to the righteous—in the day of your judgement.
verses.text_hr: Teško vama, moćnici, koji silom tlačite pravednika, jer dolazi dan vaše propasti. U one dane pravednicima će doći mnogi dobri dani — na dan vašega suda.

verses.text_en:
Believe, ye righteous, that the sinners will become a shame,
And perish in the day of unrighteousness.
verses.text_hr: Vjerujte, pravednici, da će grešnici postati sramota i propasti u dan nepravde.

verses.text_en:
Be it known unto you (ye sinners) that the Most High is mindful of your destruction,
And the angels of heaven rejoice over your destruction.
verses.text_hr: Neka vam bude poznato, grešnici, da Svevišnji pamti vašu propast, a nebeski se anđeli raduju vašoj propasti.

verses.text_en:
What will ye do, ye sinners,
And whither will ye flee on that day of judgement,
When ye hear the voice of the prayer of the righteous?
verses.text_hr: Što ćete učiniti, vi grešnici, i kamo ćete pobjeći na onaj sudnji dan, Kada čujete glas molitve pravednika?

verses.text_en:
Yea, ye shall fare like unto them,
Against whom this word shall be a testimony:
“Ye have been companions of sinners.”
verses.text_hr: Da, bit ćete poput onih protiv kojih će ova riječ svjedočiti: ‘Bili ste drugovi grešnika.’

verses.text_en:
And in those days the prayer of the righteous shall reach unto the Lord.
And for you the days of your judgement shall come,
verses.text_hr: I u one će dane molitva pravednika stići do Gospodina. I za vas će doći dani vašeg suda,
I sve riječi vaše nepravednosti bit će pročitane pred Velikim Svetim; i vaša će lica biti prekrivena sramotom, i On će odbaciti svako djelo koje je utemeljeno na nepravdi.

verses.text_en:
Woe to you, ye sinners, who live on the mid-ocean and on the dry land,
Whose remembrance is evil against you.
verses.text_hr: Teško vama, grešnici koji živite usred oceana i na kopnu, jer je spomen na vas zao.

verses.text_en:
Woe to you who acquire silver and gold in unrighteousness, and say:
“We have become rich with riches and have possessions,
And have acquired everything we have desired.
verses.text_hr: Teško vama koji nepravedno stječete srebro i zlato i govorite: ‘Obogatili smo se, imamo posjede i stekli smo sve što smo željeli.

verses.text_en:
And now let us do what we purposed:
For we have gathered silver,
9^d And many are the husbandmen in our houses,
9^c And our granaries are (brim)full as with water.”
verses.text_hr: A sada učinimo što smo naumili, jer smo nakupili srebro; 9^d mnogo je ratara u našim kućama, 9^c a žitnice su nam pune do vrha kao vodom.’
Da, vaše će laži oteći poput vode. Vaše bogatstvo neće opstati, nego će brzo otići od vas, jer ste sve stekli u nepravdi i bit ćete predani velikom prokletstvu.

verses.text_en:
And now I swear unto you, to the wise and to the foolish,
For ye shall have manifold experiences on the earth.
verses.text_hr: A sada se kunem vama, mudrima i bezumnima, jer ćete na zemlji iskusiti mnoge stvari.

verses.text_en:
For ye men shall put on more adornments than a woman,
And coloured garments more than a virgin:
In royalty and in grandeur and in power,
And in silver and in gold and in purple,
And in splendour and in food they shall be poured out as water.
verses.text_hr: Vi ćete se, muškarci, kititi više od žena i nositi šarenije haljine od djevica; u kraljevanju, veličini i moći, u srebru, zlatu, grimizu, sjaju i hrani sve će se to izlijevati poput vode.

verses.text_en:
Therefore they shall be wanting in doctrine and wisdom,
And they shall perish thereby together with their possessions;
And with all their glory and their splendour,
And in shame and in slaughter and in great destitution,
Their spirits shall be cast into the furnace of fire.
verses.text_hr: Zato će im nedostajati pouke i mudrosti te će propasti zajedno sa svojim imetkom, svom svojom slavom i sjajem. U sramoti, pokolju i velikoj oskudici njihovi će duhovi biti bačeni u ognjenu peć.

verses.text_en:
I have sworn unto you, ye sinners, as a mountain has not become a slave,
And a hill does not become the handmaid of a woman,
Even so sin has not been sent upon the earth,
But man of himself has created it,
And under a great curse shall they fall who commit it.
verses.text_hr: Zakleo sam vam se, vi grešnici, kao što planina nije postala rob, i brdo ne postaje ženina sluškinja, Čak ni grijeh nije poslan na zemlju, Ali čovjek ga je sam stvorio, i pod velikim će prokletstvom pasti oni koji ga počine.

verses.text_en:
And barrenness has not been given to the woman,
But on account of the deeds of her own hands she dies without children.
verses.text_hr: Neplodnost nije dana ženi; ona umire bez djece zbog djela svojih ruku.

verses.text_en:
I have sworn unto you, ye sinners, by the Holy Great One,
That all your evil deeds are revealed in the heavens,
And that none of your deeds of oppression are covered and hidden.
verses.text_hr: Zaklinjem vas, grešnici, Svetim i Velikim: sva su vaša zla djela razotkrivena na nebesima i nijedno vaše tlačiteljsko djelo nije pokriveno ni skriveno.

verses.text_en: And do not think in your spirit, nor say in your heart, that ye do not know and that ye do not see that every sin is every day recorded in heaven in the presence of the Most High.
verses.text_hr: Ne mislite u svojem duhu niti govorite u svojem srcu da ne znate i ne vidite kako se svaki grijeh svakoga dana bilježi na nebu pred Svevišnjim.

verses.text_en: From henceforth ye know that all your oppression wherewith ye oppress is written down every day till the day of your judgement.
verses.text_hr: Od sada znate da se sve tlačenje kojim tlačite zapisuje svakoga dana sve do dana vašega suda.

verses.text_en: Woe to you, ye fools, for through your folly shall ye perish: and ye transgress against the wise, and so good hap shall not be your portion.
verses.text_hr: Teško vama, bezumnici, jer ćete propasti zbog svojega bezumlja. Griješite protiv mudrih i zato dobra sreća neće biti vaš dio.

verses.text_en: And now, know ye that ye are prepared for the day of destruction: wherefore do not hope to live, ye sinners, but ye shall depart and die; for ye know no ransom; for ye are prepared for the day of the great judgement, for the day of tribulation and great shame for your spirits.
verses.text_hr: A sada, znajte da ste spremni za dan uništenja: stoga se ne nadajte životu, vi grešnici, nego ćete otići i umrijeti; jer ne poznajete otkupninu; jer ste pripravljeni za dan velikog suda, za dan nevolje i velike sramote za vaše duše.

verses.text_en:
Woe to you, ye obstinate of heart, who work wickedness and eat blood:
Whence have ye good things to eat and to drink and to be filled?

From all the good things which the Lord the Most High has placed in abundance on the earth; therefore ye shall have no peace.
verses.text_hr: Teško vama, tvrdokorna srca, koji činite zlo i jedete krv! Odakle vam dobra jela i piće kojima se sitite? Od svega dobra što ga je Gospodin Svevišnji u izobilju postavio na zemlju; zato nećete imati mira.

verses.text_en: Woe to you who love the deeds of unrighteousness: wherefore do ye hope for good hap unto yourselves? know that ye shall be delivered into the hands of the righteous, and they shall cut off your necks and slay you, and have no mercy upon you.
verses.text_hr: Teško vama koji ljubite djela nepravde! Zašto se nadate dobroj sreći? Znajte da ćete biti predani u ruke pravednika; oni će vam odsjeći vratove, zaklati vas i neće vam se smilovati.

verses.text_en: Woe to you who rejoice in the tribulation of the righteous; for no grave shall be dug for you.
verses.text_hr: Teško vama koji se radujete nevolji pravednika; jer vam se neće kopati grob.

verses.text_en: Woe to you who set at nought the words of the righteous; for ye shall have no hope of life.
verses.text_hr: Teško vama koji ponižavate riječi pravednika; jer nećete imati nade u život.

verses.text_en: Woe to you who write down lying and godless words; for they write down their lies that men may hear them and act godlessly towards (their) neighbour.
verses.text_hr: Teško vama koji zapisujete lažne i bezbožne riječi, jer svoje laži zapisujete da ih ljudi čuju i bezbožno postupaju prema svojemu bližnjem.

verses.text_en: Therefore they shall have no peace, but die a sudden death.
verses.text_hr: Stoga neće imati mira, nego će umrijeti iznenadnom smrću.

verses.text_en:
Woe to you who work godlessness,
And glory in lying, and extol them:
Ye shall perish, and no happy life shall be yours.
verses.text_hr: Teško vama koji činite bezboštvo, slavite se lažima i veličate ih: nestat ćete i sretan život neće biti vaš.

verses.text_en:
Woe to them who pervert the words of uprightness,
And transgress the eternal law,
And transform themselves into what they were not [into sinners]:
They shall be trodden under foot upon the earth.
verses.text_hr: Teško onima koji izvrću riječi čestitosti, krše vječni zakon i pretvaraju se u ono što nisu bili [u grešnike]: bit će zgaženi na zemlji.

verses.text_en:
In those days make ready, ye righteous, to raise your prayers as =a= memorial,
And place them as a testimony before the angels,
That they may place the sin of the sinners for a memorial before the Most High.
verses.text_hr: U one se dane pripravite, pravednici, uzdići svoje molitve kao =spomen= i postaviti ih kao svjedočanstvo pred anđelima, da grijeh grešnika stave kao spomen pred Svevišnjega.

verses.text_en:
In those days the nations shall be stirred up,
And the families of the nations shall arise on the day of destruction.
verses.text_hr: U one dane narodi će se uzburkati, i obitelji će naroda ustati na dan uništenja.

verses.text_en:
And in those days the destitute shall go forth and carry off their children,
And they shall abandon them, so that their children shall perish through them:
Yea, they shall abandon their children (that are still) sucklings, and not return to them,
And shall have no pity on their beloved ones.
verses.text_hr: U one će dane siromašni izići i odnijeti svoju djecu, pa ih napustiti da zbog njih propadnu. Da, napustit će svoju djecu dok su još dojenčad, neće im se vratiti i neće se smilovati svojim ljubljenima.

verses.text_en: And again I swear to you, ye sinners, that sin is prepared for a day of unceasing bloodshed.
verses.text_hr: I opet vam se kunem, vi grešnici, da je grijeh pripremljen za dan neprekidnog krvoprolića.

verses.text_en: And they who worship stones, and grave images of gold and silver and wood ‹and stone› and clay, and those who worship impure spirits and demons, and all kinds of idols not according to knowledge, shall get no manner of help from them.
verses.text_hr: A oni koji se klanjaju kamenju, i kipovima od zlata i srebra i drva ‹i kamena› i gline, i oni koji se klanjaju nečistim duhovima i demonima, i svakojakim idolima koji nisu u skladu sa znanjem, neće dobiti nikakvu pomoć od njih.

verses.text_en:
And they shall become godless by reason of the folly of their hearts,
And their eyes shall be blinded through the fear of their hearts,
And through visions in their dreams.
verses.text_hr: Postat će bezbožni zbog ludosti svojih srca; oči će im oslijepjeti od straha njihova srca i od viđenja u njihovim snovima.

verses.text_en:
Through these they shall become godless and fearful;
For they shall have wrought all their work in a lie,
And shall have worshipped a stone:
Therefore in an instant shall they perish.
verses.text_hr: Po njima će postati bezbožni i strašljivi, jer će sva svoja djela činiti u laži i klanjati se kamenu; zato će u trenu nestati.

verses.text_en:
But in those days blessed are all they who accept the words of wisdom, and understand them,
And observe the paths of the Most High, and walk in the path of His righteousness,
And become not godless with the godless;
For they shall be saved.
verses.text_hr: Ali u one su dane blaženi svi koji prihvate i razumiju riječi mudrosti, čuvaju staze Svevišnjega, hode stazom Njegove pravednosti i ne postanu bezbožni s bezbožnicima, jer će biti spašeni.

verses.text_en:
Woe to you who spread evil to your neighbours;
For you shall be slain in Sheol.
verses.text_hr: Teško vama koji širite zlo među svojim bližnjima, jer ćete biti ubijeni u šeolu.
Teško vama koji pravite varljive i lažne mjere, i onima koji nanose gorčinu zemlji, jer ćete time biti posve uništeni.
Teško vama koji gradite svoje kuće teškim mukom drugih, i sav njihov građevinski materijal su cigle i kamenje grijeha; Kažem vam da nećete imati mira.
Teško onima koji odbacuju mjeru i vječnu baštinu svojih otaca, A čije duše slijede idole; Jer oni neće imati odmora.

verses.text_en:
Woe to them who work unrighteousness and help oppression,
And slay their neighbours until the day of the great judgement.
verses.text_hr: Teško onima koji čine nepravdu, pomažu tlačenje i ubijaju svoje bližnje sve do dana velikoga suda.

verses.text_en:
For He shall cast down your glory,
And bring affliction on your hearts,
And shall arouse =His fierce indignation=,
And destroy you all with the sword;
And all the holy and righteous shall remember your sins.
verses.text_hr: On će oboriti vašu slavu, donijeti nevolju u vaša srca, probuditi =svoj žestoki gnjev= i sve vas uništiti mačem; svi će se sveti i pravedni spominjati vaših grijeha.

verses.text_en:
And in those days in one place the fathers together with their sons shall be smitten,
And brothers one with another shall fall in death,
Till the streams flow with their blood.
verses.text_hr: I u one će dane na jednom mjestu biti potučeni očevi sa svojim sinovima, i braća jedan s drugim u smrt će pasti, Dok potoci ne poteku njihovom krvlju.

verses.text_en:
For a man shall not withhold his hand from slaying his sons and his son’s sons,
And the sinner shall not withhold his hand from his honoured brother:
From dawn till sunset they shall slay one another.
verses.text_hr: Čovjek neće ustegnuti ruku od ubijanja svojih sinova i sinova svojih sinova, a grešnik neće ustegnuti ruku od svojega poštovanog brata. Od zore do zalaska Sunca ubijat će jedni druge.

verses.text_en:
And the horse shall walk up to the breast in the blood of sinners,
And the chariot shall be submerged to its height.
verses.text_hr: I konj će hodati do grudi u krvi grešnika, i kola će biti potopljena do svoje visine.

verses.text_en:
In those days the angels shall descend into the secret places,
And gather together into one place all those who brought down sin,
And the Most High will arise on that day of Judgement,
To execute great judgement amongst sinners.
verses.text_hr: U one dane anđeli će sići na skrovita mjesta i okupiti na jedno mjesto sve koji su donijeli grijeh. Svevišnji će ustati na dan Suda da izvrši veliki sud među grešnicima.

verses.text_en:
And over all the righteous and holy He will appoint guardians from amongst the holy angels,
To guard them as the apple of an eye,
Until He makes an end of all wickedness and all sin,
And though the righteous sleep a long sleep, they have nought to fear.
verses.text_hr: Nad svim pravednima i svetima postavit će čuvare među svetim anđelima, da ih čuvaju kao zjenicu oka dok ne učini kraj svakoj zloći i svakomu grijehu. Premda pravednici spavaju dugim snom, nemaju se čega bojati.

verses.text_en:
And (then) the children of the earth shall see the wise =in security=,
And shall understand all the words of this book,
And recognize that their riches shall not be able to save them
In the overthrow of their sins.
verses.text_hr: Tada će djeca zemlje vidjeti mudre =u sigurnosti=, razumjeti sve riječi ove knjige i priznati da ih njihovo bogatstvo neće moći spasiti kad njihovi grijesi budu oboreni.

verses.text_en:
Woe to you, sinners, on the day of strong anguish,
=Ye who= afflict the righteous and burn them with fire:
Ye shall be requited according to your works.
verses.text_hr: Teško vama, grješnici, u dan teške tjeskobe, =Vi koji= mučite pravedne i spaljujete ih vatrom: Bit ćete plaćeni prema svojim djelima.

verses.text_en:
Woe to you, ye obstinate of heart,
Who watch in order to devise wickedness:
Therefore shall fear come upon you,
And there shall be none to help you.
verses.text_hr: Teško vama, tvrdoglava srca, Koji bdiju da smišljaju zloću: Zato će te spopasti strah, i neće biti nikoga da ti pomogne.

verses.text_en:
Woe to you, ye sinners, on account of the words of your mouth,
And on account of the deeds of your hands which your godlessness has wrought,
In blazing flames burning worse than fire shall ye burn.
verses.text_hr: Teško vama, grešnici, zbog riječi vaših usta i djela vaših ruku koja je učinilo vaše bezboštvo: gorjet ćete u plamenu koji žeže snažnije od ognja.

verses.text_en: And now, know ye that from the angels He will inquire as to your deeds in heaven, from the sun and from the moon and from the stars in reference to your sins because upon the earth ye execute judgement on the righteous.
verses.text_hr: I sada znajte da će On od anđela pitati za vaša djela na nebu, od sunca i od mjeseca i od zvijezda u odnosu na vaše grijehe jer na zemlji vi izvršavate sud nad pravednicima.

verses.text_en: And He will summon to testify against you every cloud and mist and dew and rain; for they shall all be withheld because of you from descending upon you, and they shall be mindful of your sins.
verses.text_hr: Pozvat će svaki oblak, maglu, rosu i kišu da svjedoče protiv vas; zbog vas će svi biti zadržani da ne siđu na vas i pamtit će vaše grijehe.

verses.text_en: And now give presents to the rain that it be not withheld from descending upon you, nor yet the dew, when it has received gold and silver from you that it may descend.
verses.text_hr: A sada dajte darove kiši da se ne uskrati da siđe na vas, ni rosi, kad od vas primi zlato i srebro da može sići.

verses.text_en: When the hoar-frost and snow with their chilliness, and all the snow-storms with all their plagues fall upon you, in those days ye shall not be able to stand before them.
verses.text_hr: Kad inje i snijeg sa svojom hladnoćom, i sve snježne oluje sa svim svojim pošastima padnu na vas, u one dane nećete se moći održati pred njima.

verses.text_en: Observe the heaven, ye children of heaven, and every work of the Most High, and fear ye Him and work no evil in His presence.
verses.text_hr: Pazite na nebo, sinovi neba, i na svako djelo Svevišnjega, i bojte ga se i ne činite zlo u njegovoj prisutnosti.

verses.text_en: If He closes the windows of heaven, and withholds the rain and the dew from descending on the earth on your account, what will ye do then?
verses.text_hr: Ako On zatvori nebeske prozore i spriječi kišu i rosu da siđu na zemlju zbog vas, što ćete tada učiniti?

verses.text_en: And if He sends His anger upon you because of your deeds, ye cannot petition Him; for ye spake proud and insolent words against His righteousness: therefore ye shall have no peace.
verses.text_hr: Ako zbog vaših djela pošalje na vas svoj gnjev, nećete Ga moći moliti, jer ste protiv Njegove pravednosti govorili ohole i drske riječi; zato nećete imati mira.

verses.text_en: And see ye not the =sailors= of the ships, how their ships are tossed to and fro by the waves, and are shaken by the winds, and are in sore trouble?
verses.text_hr: I zar ne vidite =mornare= brodova, kako njihove brodove valovi njišu tamo-amo, kako ih vjetrovi tresu, i kako su u velikoj nevolji?

verses.text_en: And therefore do they fear because all their goodly possessions go upon the sea with them, and they have evil forebodings of heart that the sea will swallow them and they will perish therein.
verses.text_hr: I zato se boje jer sav njihov imetak odlazi na more s njima, i imaju zle slutnje u srcu da će ih more progutati i da će u njemu nestati.

verses.text_en: Are not the entire sea and all its waters, and all its movements, the work of the Most High, and has He not set limits to its doings, and confined it throughout by the sand?
verses.text_hr: Zar cijelo more i sve njegove vode, i svi njegovi pokreti, nisu djelo Svevišnjeg, i zar On nije postavio granice njegovim djelima, i zatvorio ih u cijelosti pijeskom?

verses.text_en: And at His reproof it is afraid and dries up, and all its fish die and all that is in it; but ye sinners that are on the earth fear Him not.
verses.text_hr: Na Njegov prijekor more se uplaši i presuši; ugibaju sve njegove ribe i sve što je u njemu. Ali vi grešnici na zemlji ne bojite Ga se.

verses.text_en: Has He not made the heaven and the earth, and all that is therein? Who has given understanding and wisdom to everything that moves on the earth and in the sea?
verses.text_hr: Nije li On stvorio nebo i Zemlju i sve što je na njima? Tko je dao razum i mudrost svemu što se miče na zemlji i u moru?

verses.text_en: Do not the =sailors= of the ships fear the sea? Yet sinners fear not the Most High.
verses.text_hr: Zar se =mornari= na brodovima ne boje mora? Ipak, grešnici se ne boje Svevišnjega.

verses.text_en:
In those days when He hath brought a grievous fire upon you,
Whither will ye flee, and where will ye find deliverance?
And when He launches forth His word against you,
Will you not be affrighted and fear?
verses.text_hr: U one dane, kad na vas spusti žestoki oganj, kamo ćete pobjeći i gdje naći izbavljenje? Kad protiv vas pošalje svoju riječ, nećete li se prestrašiti i uzdrhtati?

verses.text_en:
And all the luminaries shall be affrighted with great fear,
And all the earth shall be affrighted and tremble and be alarmed.
verses.text_hr: Sva će se svjetlila silno prestrašiti, a sva će zemlja drhtati, tresti se i biti užasnuta.

verses.text_en:
And all the †angels shall execute their commands†
And shall seek to hide themselves from the presence of the Great Glory,
And the children of earth shall tremble and quake;
And ye sinners shall be accursed for ever,
And ye shall have no peace.
verses.text_hr: I svi će †anđeli izvršiti svoje zapovijedi† I nastojat će se sakriti od prisutnosti Velike Slave, i djeca će zemlje drhtati i tresti se; A vi grešnici bit ćete prokleti zauvijek, i nećete imati mira.

verses.text_en:
Fear ye not, ye souls of the righteous,
And be hopeful ye that have died in righteousness.
verses.text_hr: Ne bojte se, duše pravedne, i nadajte se vi koji ste umrli u pravdi.

verses.text_en:
And grieve not if your soul into Sheol has descended in grief,
And that in your life your body fared not according to your goodness,
But =wait for= the day of the =judgement= of sinners,
And for the day of cursing and chastisement.
verses.text_hr: I ne tuguj ako je tvoja duša u šeol sišla u tuzi, i da u tvom životu tvoje tijelo nije prošlo prema tvojoj dobroti, Ali =čekajte= dan =suda= nad grešnicima, i za dan prokletstva i kazne.

verses.text_en:
And yet when ye die the sinners speak over you:
“As we die, so die the righteous,
And what benefit do they reap for their deeds?
verses.text_hr: Pa ipak, kad umrete, grešnici govore o vama: "Kako mi umiremo, tako umiru i pravednici, i kakvu korist oni ubiru za svoja djela?

verses.text_en:
Behold, even as we, so do they die in grief and darkness,
And what have they more than we?
From henceforth we are equal.
verses.text_hr: Gle, kao i mi, tako i oni umiru u tuzi i tami, A što oni imaju više od nas? Od sada smo ravnopravni.

verses.text_en:
And what will they receive and what will they see for ever?
Behold, they too have died,
And henceforth for ever shall they see no light.”
verses.text_hr: I što će primiti i što će zauvijek vidjeti? Gle, i oni su umrli, i od sada zauvijek neće vidjeti svjetlost.”

verses.text_en: I tell you, ye sinners, ye are content to eat and drink, and rob and sin, and strip men naked, and acquire wealth and see good days.
verses.text_hr: Kažem vam, vi grešnici, vi ste zadovoljni jesti i piti, i pljačkati i griješiti, i svlačiti ljude do gola, i stjecati bogatstvo i vidjeti dobre dane.

verses.text_en: Have ye seen the righteous how their end falls out, that no manner of violence is found in them till their death?
verses.text_hr: Jeste li vidjeli pravednike kako im kraj pada, da se u njima ne nalazi nikakvo nasilje do smrti njihove?

verses.text_en: “Nevertheless they perished and became as though they had not been, and their spirits descended into Sheol in tribulation.”
verses.text_hr: “Usprkos tome, nestali su i postali kao da ih nije ni bilo, a njihovi su duhovi sišli u šeol u nevolji.”

verses.text_en: Now, therefore, I swear to you, the righteous, by the glory of the Great and Honoured and Mighty One in dominion, and by His greatness I swear to you:
verses.text_hr: Sada se, dakle, kunem vama, pravednici, slavom Velikoga, Časnog i Moćnog u vlasti; kunem vam se Njegovom veličinom:

verses.text_en:
I know a mystery
And have read the heavenly tablets,
And have seen the holy books,
And have found written therein and inscribed regarding them:
verses.text_hr: Poznajem tajnu, čitao sam nebeske ploče, vidio svete knjige i našao u njima napisano i urezano o pravednicima:

verses.text_en:
That all goodness and joy and glory are prepared for them,
And written down for the spirits of those who have died in righteousness,
And that manifold good shall be given to you in recompense for your labours,
And that your lot is abundantly beyond the lot of the living.
verses.text_hr: Da su sva dobra, radost i slava za njih pripremljena, i zapisano za duhove onih koji su umrli u pravednosti, i to mnogostruko dobro bit će vam dano kao naknada za vaš trud, i da je vaša sudbina daleko veća od sudbine živih.

verses.text_en:
And the spirits of you who have died in righteousness shall live and rejoice,
And their spirits shall not perish, nor their memorial from before the face of the Great One
Unto all the generations of the world: wherefore no longer fear their contumely.
verses.text_hr: Duhovi vas koji ste umrli u pravednosti živjet će i radovati se. Vaši duhovi neće propasti, niti će spomen na vas nestati pred licem Velikoga kroz sve naraštaje svijeta; zato se više ne bojte njihovih poruga.

verses.text_en:
Woe to you, ye sinners, when ye have died,
If ye die in the wealth of your sins;
And those who are like you say regarding you:
“Blessed are the sinners: they have seen all their days.
verses.text_hr: Teško vama, grešnici, kad umrete, Ako umrete u bogatstvu svojih grijeha; A oni koji su kao ti kažu za tebe: “Blago grješnicima: proživjeli su sve dane svoje.

verses.text_en:
And now they have died in prosperity and in wealth,
And have not seen tribulation or murder in their life;
And they have died in honour,
And judgement has not been executed on them during their life.”
verses.text_hr: I sada su umrli u blagostanju i bogatstvu, i nisu vidjeli nevolje ni ubojstva u svom životu; i umrli su u čast, i presuda im nije izvršena za njihova života.”

verses.text_en:
Know ye, that their souls will be made to descend into Sheol,
And they shall be wretched in their great tribulation.
verses.text_hr: Znaj da će njihove duše biti natjerane da siđu u Šeol, i oni će biti jadni u svojoj velikoj nevolji.
I u tamu i okove i gorući plamen gdje je teški sud ući će vaši duhovi; i veliki će sud biti za sve naraštaje svijeta. Jao vama, jer nećete imati mira.

verses.text_en:
Say not in regard to the righteous and good who are in life:
“In our troubled days we have toiled laboriously and experienced every trouble,
And met with much evil and been consumed,
And have become few and our spirit small.
verses.text_hr: Ne govorite o pravednima i dobrima koji žive: ‘U danima svoje nevolje mukotrpno smo radili, iskusili svaku muku, susreli mnogo zla, bili uništavani, postali malobrojni i klonula duha.

verses.text_en:
And we have been destroyed and have not found any to help us even with a word:
We have been tortured [and destroyed], and hoped not to see life from day to day.
verses.text_hr: I uništeni smo i nismo našli nikoga da nam pomogne ni riječju: Bili smo mučeni [i uništeni] i nadali se da nećemo vidjeti život iz dana u dan.

verses.text_en:
We hoped to be the head and have become the tail:
We have toiled laboriously and had no satisfaction in our toil;
And we have become the food of the sinners and the unrighteous,
And they have laid their yoke heavily upon us.
verses.text_hr: Nadali smo se da smo glava, a postali smo rep: Mukotrpno smo radili i nismo imali zadovoljstva u našem radu; i postali smo hrana grešnika i nepravednika, i metnuše na nas težak jaram svoj.
Nad nama su imali vlast oni koji su nas mrzili †i tukli nas; i onima koji su nas mrzili† vrat smo pognuli, Ali nisu nas žalili.

verses.text_en:
We desired to get away from them that we might escape and be at rest,
But found no place whereunto we should flee and be safe from them.
verses.text_hr: Željeli smo pobjeći od njih kako bismo mogli pobjeći i odmoriti se, Ali nismo našli mjesta kamo bismo trebali pobjeći i biti sigurni od njih.

verses.text_en:
And we complained to the rulers in our tribulation,
And cried out against those who devoured us;
But they did not attend to our cries,
And would not hearken to our voice.
verses.text_hr: Žalili smo se vladarima u svojoj nevolji i vikali protiv onih koji su nas proždirali, ali oni se nisu obazirali na naše vapaje niti su htjeli poslušati naš glas.

verses.text_en: And they helped those who robbed us and devoured us and those who made us few; and they concealed their oppression, and they did not remove from us the yoke of those that devoured us and dispersed us and murdered us, and they concealed their murder, and remembered not that they had lifted up their hands against us.”
verses.text_hr: I pomogli su onima koji su nas opljačkali i proždirali i onima koji su nas smanjili; i sakrili su svoje ugnjetavanje, i nisu skinuli s nas jaram onih koji su nas proždirali i rastjerali i ubijali, i sakrili su svoje ubojstvo, i nisu se sjetili da su digli ruke svoje na nas.”

verses.text_en: I swear unto you, that in heaven the angels remember you for good before the glory of the Great One: and your names are written before the glory of the Great One.
verses.text_hr: Kunem vam se da vas se na nebu anđeli sjećaju po dobru pred slavom Velikog: i vaša su imena zapisana pred slavom Velikog.

verses.text_en: Be hopeful; for aforetime ye were put to shame through ill and affliction; but now ye shall shine as the lights of heaven, ye shall shine and ye shall be seen, and the portals of heaven shall be opened to you.
verses.text_hr: Nadajte se! Prije ste bili osramoćeni zbog zla i nevolje, ali sada ćete sjati poput nebeskih svjetlila; sjat ćete i bit ćete viđeni, a vrata neba otvorit će vam se.

verses.text_en: And in your cry, cry for judgement, and it shall appear to you; for all your tribulation shall be visited on the rulers, and on all who helped those who plundered you.
verses.text_hr: U svojem vapaju vapite za sudom i on će vam se pokazati, jer će sva vaša nevolja biti osvećena na vladarima i svima koji su pomagali onima koji su vas pljačkali.

verses.text_en: Be hopeful, and cast not away your hope; for ye shall have great joy as the angels of heaven.
verses.text_hr: Imajte nade i ne odbacujte svoju nadu; jer ćete imati veliku radost kao anđeli nebeski.

verses.text_en: What shall ye be obliged to do? Ye shall not have to hide on the day of the great judgement and ye shall not be found as sinners, and the eternal judgement shall be far from you for all the generations of the world.
verses.text_hr: Što ćete biti dužni učiniti? Nećete se morati skrivati na dan velikoga suda i nećete se naći kao grešnici, a vječni će sud biti daleko od vas za sve naraštaje svijeta.

verses.text_en: And now fear not, ye righteous, when ye see the sinners growing strong and prospering in their ways: be not companions with them, but keep afar from their violence; for ye shall become companions of the hosts of heaven.
verses.text_hr: A sada se ne bojte, vi pravednici, kad vidite grješnike kako jačaju i napreduju na svojim putovima: ne budite im drugovi, nego se držite podalje od njihova nasilja; jer postat ćete drugovi vojske nebeske.

verses.text_en: And, although ye sinners say: “All our sins shall not be searched out and written down,” nevertheless they shall write down all your sins every day.
verses.text_hr: I, iako vi grešnici kažete: “Svi naši grijesi neće biti istraženi i zapisani,” ipak će oni svaki dan zapisivati sve vaše grijehe.

verses.text_en: And now I show unto you that light and darkness, day and night, see all your sins.
verses.text_hr: I sada vam pokazujem da svjetlost i tama, dan i noć, vide sve vaše grijehe.

verses.text_en: Be not godless in your hearts, and lie not and alter not the words of uprightness, nor charge with lying the words of the Holy Great One, nor take account of your idols; for all your lying and all your godlessness issue not in righteousness, but in great sin.
verses.text_hr: Ne budite bezbožni u svojim srcima, i ne lažite i ne mijenjajte riječi pravednosti, niti optužujte lažima riječi Svetoga Velikog, niti uzimajte u obzir svoje idole; jer sva vaša laž i sve vaše bezboštvo ne proizlaze iz pravednosti, nego iz velikog grijeha.

verses.text_en: And now I know this mystery, that sinners will alter and pervert the words of righteousness in many ways, and will speak wicked words, and lie, and practise great deceits, and write books concerning their words.
verses.text_hr: I sada znam ovu tajnu, da će grešnici izmijeniti i izvrnuti riječi pravednosti na mnoge načine, i da će govoriti zle riječi, i lagati, i prakticirati velike prijevare, i pisati knjige o njihovim riječima.

verses.text_en: But when they write down truthfully all my words in their languages, and do not change or minish aught from my words, but write them all down truthfully—all that I first testified concerning them.
verses.text_hr: Ali kad zapišu istinito sve moje riječi na svojim jezicima, i ne promijene niti umanje ništa od mojih riječi, nego ih sve zapišu istinito - sve što sam prvi put svjedočio o njima.

verses.text_en: Then, I know another mystery, that books shall be given to the righteous and the wise to become a cause of joy and uprightness and much wisdom.
verses.text_hr: Zatim, znam još jednu tajnu, da će knjige biti dane pravednima i mudrima da postanu uzrokom radosti, čestitosti i mnogo mudrosti.

verses.text_en: And to them shall the books be given, and they shall believe in them and rejoice over them, and then shall all the righteous who have learnt therefrom all the paths of uprightness be recompensed.’
verses.text_hr: I njima će knjige biti date, i oni će vjerovati u njih i radovati im se, i tada će svi pravednici koji su od njih naučili sve staze čestitosti biti nagrađeni.’

verses.text_en: In those days the Lord bade (them) to summon and testify to the children of earth concerning their wisdom: Show (it) unto them; for ye are their guides, and a recompense over the whole earth.
verses.text_hr: U one dane Gospodin im zapovjedi da pozovu djecu zemlje i posvjedoče im o njihovoj mudrosti: ‘Pokažite im je, jer vi ste njihovi vodiči i nagrada po svoj zemlji.

verses.text_en: For I and My Son will be united with them for ever in the paths of uprightness in their lives; and ye shall have peace: rejoice, ye children of uprightness. Amen.
verses.text_hr: Jer Ja i Moj Sin bit ćemo ujedinjeni s njima zauvijek na stazama čestitosti u njihovim životima; i imat ćete mir: radujte se, sinovi poštenja. Amen.

verses.text_en: And after some days my son Methuselah took a wife for his son Lamech, and she became pregnant by him and bore a son.
verses.text_hr: I nakon nekoliko dana moj sin Metušalah uze ženu za svog sina Lameka, i ona zatrudnje s njim i rodi sina.

verses.text_en: And his body was white as snow and red as the blooming of a rose, and the hair of his head †and his long locks were white as wool, and his eyes beautiful†. And when he opened his eyes, he lighted up the whole house like the sun, and the whole house was very bright.
verses.text_hr: I njegovo tijelo bijaše bijelo kao snijeg i crveno kao ruža u cvatu, a kosa na njegovoj glavi †i njegovi dugi pramenovi bijahu bijeli kao vuna, a njegove oči lijepe†. I kad je otvorio oči, obasjao je cijelu kuću poput sunca, i cijela je kuća bila vrlo svijetla.

verses.text_en: And thereupon he arose in the hands of the midwife, opened his mouth, and †conversed with† the Lord of righteousness.
verses.text_hr: I tada je ustao u rukama babice, otvorio usta i †razgovarao s† Gospodarom pravde.

verses.text_en: And his father Lamech was afraid of him and fled, and came to his father Methuselah.
